intro:
Journey into the wilderness of Namibia, where deep canyons, towering dunes, and dry deserts form a unique and extraordinary adventure destination. See the best of it on this immersive trip: spotting iconic African animals in Etosha National Park, climbing the world’s tallest dunes in Sossusvlei, and enjoying spectacular scenery throughout. We end most nights sleeping under the stars, sharing the land with the animals who rule it and admiring the Milky Way as we relive our day’s adventure together.

Itinerary also available as Discover Namibia - Lodges

days.title: Windhoek
days.description: You'll arrive in Windhoek and check into Arebbusch Lodge, where the afternoon is yours to do as you please. Take a swim in the pool, kick back and relax, or watch the local bird activity around the lodge. Around 6pm or 7pm, you'll meet your tour leader and the rest of the group for a briefing on what's ahead, then head to a welcome dinner together.

days.title: Windhoek to Sesriem
days.description: This morning you're heading southwest through Namib-Naukluft Park, one of the largest and driest national parks around. The drive covers roughly 300 to 350km and takes about seven hours, but you'll stop for photos along the way. You'll see towering rock formations and desert landscapes that look almost like the moon. Bring a camera because there are some great shots here.

days.title: Sossusvlei - Namib Desert
included: Sunrise at Sossusvlei dunes with opportunity to climb
Walk to Hiddenvlei or transfer to Deadvlei (walk included; 4x4 transfer optional)
Guided visit to Namib Carnivore Conservation Centre to see cheetahs
optional: 4x4 transfer to Deadvlei (instead of walking to Hiddenvlei)
days.description: Get up early to catch the tallest dunes in the world bathed in golden light, then climb one as the sun rises. You can either walk to Hiddenvlei (about 1 hour 45 minutes round trip) or pay extra for a 4x4 transfer to Deadvlei, where ancient acacia trees sit in a strange desert setting. Watch for gemsbok and ostriches while you're up there. Later in the day, join a guide at the Namib Carnivore Conservation Centre to see cheetahs, or save that for tomorrow morning depending on how things run.

days.title: Swakopmund via Walvis Bay
included: Stop in Walvis Bay to see flamingos
optional: Explore German colonial architecture and cake shops in Swakopmund
days.description: After a long scenic drive through Namib-Naukluft Park, you're heading to Swakopmund. You'll stop in Walvis Bay for lunch and check out the flamingos there. By late afternoon you'll arrive in Swakopmund, a charming German colonial resort town with small cake shops, coffee houses, and plenty of adrenaline activities if you're interested.

days.title: Swakopmund
days.description: Today is completely yours in Swakopmund. You can try water activities like deep-sea fishing, head into the desert for sandboarding and quad-biking, or book an aerial flight over the Skeleton Coast. If you'd rather take it easy, grab some local Viennese-style cakes, walk the beach or nearby dunes, and soak in this unusual African town with its European feel.

days.title: Swakopmund to Brandberg
optional: 4x4 game drive looking for desert elephants (depending on arrival time)
days.description: You're leaving the Atlantic coast behind and heading inland to Brandberg, Namibia's highest mountain located in Damaraland. This region is where desert elephants roam around the Ugab River. Depending on when you arrive, there's an optional 4x4 game drive to look for these elephants. As evening falls, you'll have time for some spectacular stargazing.

days.title: Brandberg - White Lady Painting
included: View White Lady rock painting and San engravings
optional: Upgrade from camping to a room (contact sales representative for details)
days.description: The drive takes you to Brandberg for a 90-minute walk through Valley 45, where you'll move past large granite formations and keep an eye out for different bird species. The walk ends at the White Lady rock painting, created by San hunter-gatherers more than 2,000 years ago. After that, you'll drive toward Khorixas and likely spot Himba and Herero women selling crafts along the roadside, and if luck's on your side, you might see desert elephants or meerkats crossing the landscape.

days.title: Khorixas to Etosha National Park
included: Scenic drive to Etosha National Park
optional: Coffee and pastries stop in Outjo
days.description: You're taking a short drive to Etosha National Park, a massive wildlife area centered around a large salt pan with mixed forest and grassland. Stop in Outjo for coffee and German pastries on the way. You'll arrive around lunchtime with plenty of afternoon hours to start exploring this incredible game-viewing destination.

days.title: Etosha National Park
included: Full-day wildlife safari in Etosha National Park with expert guide
optional: Additional game drives (available for extra cost)
days.description: Your second day in Etosha gives you even more time to understand how the park works. Wildlife movements change constantly as animals travel between waterholes. Your guide will adjust the route based on recent sightings and seasonal conditions, guiding you toward the most productive areas. With more hours on safari, you can wait at waterholes, watch animal behavior unfold, and add to your wildlife checklist.

days.title: Etosha National Park
included: Full-day wildlife safari in Etosha National Park with expert guide
optional: Additional game drives (available for extra cost)
days.description: You'll leave Etosha National Park and head to Otjiwa Safari Lodge, which sits in a good location for rhino tracking the next day. The rest of the afternoon and evening are open, so you can relax at the lodge or sign up for optional activities like a cycling trip or a night drive if you want to stay active.

days.title: Etosha National Park to Otjiwa Safari Lodge
optional: Night drive at Otjiwa Safari Lodge
days.description: Start early with an expert guide for rhino tracking by vehicle around 9am. Once rhinos are spotted, you'll leave the vehicle and approach carefully on foot to watch them from a safe distance while learning about rhino conservation and what anti-poaching work looks like on the ground. From there, you'll drive back to Windhoek with a stop at a crafts market along the way.

days.title: Otjiwa to Windhoek
included: Rhino tracking by vehicle and on foot with expert guide
days.description: Your adventure ends after breakfast. You've camped under Namibian skies, spotted iconic safari animals, and seen the world's largest dunes. If you have free time before your flight, relax at your accommodation or check out Windhoek's museums and shops. A township tour is available as an optional add-on if you're interested.

attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Walk the Amalfi Coast, where cliffs rise sharply from the Mediterranean Sea and pastel-coloured fishing towns nestle in the coves below. It’s a special place for anyone who visits but is a spiritual home for us. We’re a pioneer of group walking getaways here with more than 20 years’ experience running this trip, while our family-run hotel in the village of Bomerano, away from the bustle, has welcomed countless numbers of our groups. The result is a finely tuned adventure taking in: ancient hillsides; quaint towns, including Positano, Ravello and Amalfi itself; a visit to Mount Vesuvius and the remains of Pompeii; and arguably the best coastal walk in the world: the Path of the Gods.

Walking in summer?

If you wish to travel in July or August, the warmest months, we offer a special itinerary on selected weeks. It features shortened, easier walks, visits to beaches with few tourists, free time in Sorrento, and a visit by boat to Positano. See Walking The Amalfi Coast – Summer Edition for dates, prices and the day-to-day schedule.

days.title: Bomerano
days.description: You'll arrive in Bomerano and check into Hotel Due Torri, which sits high in the hills away from the crowded Amalfi Coast. The village itself is quiet and peaceful, making it a good base for the week ahead. This evening there's a relaxed dinner where you'll meet your tour leader and the other travelers in your group. The main briefing about what's coming up happens tomorrow morning.

days.title: Bomerano - Monte Tre Calli
included: Circular walk to Monte Tre Calli with coastal views
optional: Lunch at Hotel Due Torri (traditional spread with wine for the table included, additional cost applies)
days.description: After the welcome briefing, you'll head out on a circular walk to Monte Tre Calli. The path combines different trail types and gives you wide views across the jagged coastline and Agerola Plain stretching below. On clear days, you can actually see out to Capri from up there. Back in Bomerano by lunchtime, there's an optional lunch spot if you want it, then the afternoon is yours to rest or do whatever you feel like.

days.title: Bomerano to Amalfi
included: Walk from Bomerano to Amalfi with coastal views
days.description: Today you'll walk down to Amalfi using old mule tracks and stone steps from Bomerano, roughly 2,000 steps total but with plenty of stopping points along the way. The downhill route keeps showing you the coast and Mediterranean views the whole way. Once you reach Amalfi, there's time to walk around town, see the duomo with its colorful tiled dome, jump in the small bay for a swim, or grab gelato before heading back up to Bomerano.

days.title: Vesuvius - Pompeii
included: Visit Mount Vesuvius crater with views of Bay of Naples
optional: Extended walk around Vesuvius caldera with expert volcanologist (€11 per person)
Detailed guided tour of Pompeii (€10 per person)
days.description: You'll transfer to Mount Vesuvius to look into the volcanic crater and take in the Bay of Naples views. If the weather cooperates and you're interested, there's an optional extended walk around the caldera with a volcanologist who can explain what you're seeing. After lunch, a bus takes you to Pompeii, the ancient Roman city buried back in 79 CE. A local guide can walk you through the preserved bathhouses, bakeries, homes with frescoes, and other structures trapped in time.

days.title: Ravello to Amalfi
included: Walk from Ravello through Valle delle Ferriere nature reserve to Amalfi
days.description: This morning you start in Ravello, a town that artists and writers have loved for generations. You'll have free time to check it out before beginning a mostly downhill walk with quite a few steps involved. The route passes through shaded paths, seasonal wildflowers, and moss-covered waterfalls in the Valle delle Ferriere nature reserve. From there, wooden bridges take you through lemon groves, past old paper factories and medieval ironworks, eventually reaching Amalfi.

days.title: Free day
optional: Visit Herculaneum (entrance fee €11; audio-tour €6.50; local guide €10 per person)
Boat transfer to Capri (€38 slow boat, €44 hydrofoil, seasonal and weather-dependent)
Capri town visit via funicular through lemon groves
Visit National Archaeological Museum of Naples
Return transfers to Herculaneum and Naples (approximately €40-€80 per person, depending on group size)
days.description: The day is completely yours to do what you want. Hang out at the hotel, use the pool, or get a private transfer to see other things in the region. Options include Herculaneum (actually better preserved than Pompeii since mud rather than ash buried it), taking a ferry to Capri with its funicular through lemon groves, exploring Sorrento, or visiting the National Archaeological Museum in Naples. You can also just spend the day poolside with espresso and no plans whatsoever.

days.title: Bomerano - Positano
included: Walk the Path of the Gods (Sentiero degli Dei) to Positano
Visit family-run mozzarella factory with cheese tasting
optional: Explore Positano's alleyways and designer boutiques
landmarks: Sentiero degli Dei (Path of the Gods)
days.description: You'll walk the Sentiero degli Dei, the Path of the Gods, from Bomerano down to Positano. This route gives you some of the best coastal views you'll see anywhere: dramatic cliffs with villages perched on them and wide Mediterranean views. The trail follows rolling terrain along the coastline, passing shepherd huts and old stone houses cut into limestone before descending long steps into Positano, which is basically built vertically on a sheltered bay. After exploring the alleyways and shops or swimming, you'll return by boat and bus. Later, before dinner, stop at a family mozzarella factory to watch how traditional smoked cheese gets made and taste the fresh results.

An optional lunch is available here too. If you want to extend the trip, your sales representative can help arrange extra nights in Sorrento or nearby areas.

intro:
Oktoberfest in Munich, Germany, is unapologetically about savoring the sweet amber nectar while dancing in traditional lederhosen — and we think that's absolutely brilliant! There’s no bond stronger, or more delightfully chaotic, than that formed over a stein of delicious beer. Oktoberfest tears down all barriers, uniting tipsy German locals and wide-eyed travelers in song and laughter across the legendary beer halls. It's a living, breathing celebration of humanity in all its colorful glory, turbocharged by wild rides, cheerful slurring, and instant friendships. Honestly, there’s no thrill quite like standing atop a table, hoisting a stein, and chugging Bavarian beer while thousands of new friends cheer you on. Get ready — Oktoberfest is a party like no other, and it's going to be unforgettable!
WHAT IS STOKETOBERFEST? Stoketoberfest is Stoke Travel’s very own beer-soaked masterpiece — our festival within a festival. Each year, we transform Oktoberfest into something uniquely ours at our epic campsite. Waiting for you will be your pre-pitched tent, complete with a mattress and sleeping bag to keep you cozy, plus a non-stop carnival of DJs, live bands, radio shows, and an open bar offering unlimited beer and sangria for just €15 extra per day. Our chefs will serve up hot, hearty breakfasts each morning to fuel your adventures. To truly grasp the madness, you’ll have to experience it — but trust us, you’ll leave dazed, amazed, and buzzing with good vibes after surviving our wild funhouse. As the largest Oktoberfest camping provider, we host up to 2,500 international guests every day — and this year promises to be the biggest yet. So hop aboard the beer train, meet some of the coolest people across Europe, and party with Stoke Travel. See for yourself why so many choose to celebrate Oktoberfest with us year after year. We put the Be-Here in beer, the Ale-Mania in Alemania, and, well... maybe a few Many-Germs in Germany too. We can't wait to raise a stein with you!

days.description: You'll arrive at Marrakech airport and head to your hotel where you get a warm welcome with mint tea and a quick briefing about the tour. The rest of the afternoon is free, so you can wander through the winding medina streets and check out the souks at whatever pace feels right.

days.title: Marrakech
included: Walk around Djemaa El Fna square
days.description: The full-day city tour starts at 9 a.m. You'll see historic palaces, walk through the spice souks, and tour some museums including the impressive Madrasa Ben Youssef. After grabbing lunch at Djemaa El Fna square, you'll head around the ancient Koutoubia Mosque, then move on to the striking Majorelle Gardens and Menara Gardens to catch the sunset. You're back at the hotel around 5 p.m.

days.title: Marrakech - Ouarzazate - Rose Valley - Dades Gorges
days.description: You leave Marrakech at 8 a.m. and drive 200 km through the High Atlas Mountains to reach Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah, a UNESCO World Heritage Site where films like Gladiator were shot. From there you continue through the scenic Rose Valley and Road of the Kasbahs. You arrive in Dades Gorges around 5 p.m. for the night.

days.title: Dades Gorges - Todra Gorges - Erfoud - Merzouga
included: Camel trek into the Sahara Desert dunes
Experience nomadic camp with traditional mint tea and dinner
Music and evening entertainment around the campfire
days.description: After breakfast you drive to the spectacular Todra Gorges where limestone canyon walls rise over 500 feet. Then it's on to Erfud oasis town for lunch, followed by the drive to Merzouga at the gateway to the Sahara Desert. You'll take a camel trek into the dunes before sunset, then spend the evening at a nomadic camp with traditional mint tea, dinner, and music around the fire under the stars.

days.title: Merzouga - Fes
included: Camel ride back to Merzouga hotel
Scenic stop at Er Rachidia region and Ziz Valley palmeraie
Stop in Ifrane to see alpine-style architecture and cedar forests
optional: Spot monkeys in the cedar forests of Ifrane
days.description: You wake early to watch the sunrise, have breakfast and shower at camp, then take a camel ride back to the hotel in Merzouga. After that you drive through the Middle Atlas region toward Fes with scenic stops in the Er Rachidia region to see the Ziz Valley palmeraie, lunch in Midelt, and a short visit to Ifrane known for its alpine architecture and cedar forests. You arrive in Fes around 6 p.m.

days.title: Fes - Chefchaouen
included: Guided tour of Fes Royal Palace Gate
Guided tour of Fes Jewish Quarter
Guided tour of Fes old medina
days.description: Starting after breakfast you get a guided tour of Fes visiting the Royal Palace Gate, Jewish Quarter, and the old medina. In the afternoon you travel to Chefchaouen with a lunch stop along the way. You arrive in the blue-washed mountain village known as the blue city, which features a charming old medina with Moroccan and Andalusian influences, red-tiled roofs, and narrow blue lanes.

days.title: Chefchaouen - Volubilis - Meknes
included: Visit ancient Roman ruins of Volubilis
View Place El Hedim and Bab El Mansour gateway in Meknes
days.description: After breakfast you travel to the ancient Roman ruins of Volubilis and spend time exploring the 2,000-year-old site. Then you continue to Moulay Idriss, Morocco's holy city, and then arrive in Meknes to see the impressive medina and Place El Hedim square facing the grand Bab El Mansour gateway. You'll also visit the Mausoleum of Moulay Ismail, the final resting place of one of Morocco's greatest rulers.

days.title: Meknes - Rabat - Casablanca - Marrakech
included: Visit Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca
Visit Corniche of Ain el Diab in Casablanca
days.description: From Meknes after breakfast you travel through Morocco's capital Rabat and coastal Casablanca to visit the impressive Hassan II Mosque, the old medina, and Corniche of Ain el Diab. Then you drive back to Marrakech, arriving in the evening for an overnight stay.

days.title: Marrakech
days.description: After breakfast you transfer to Marrakech airport for your departure flight home, taking wonderful memories of your Moroccan adventure with you.

We are glad to hear that you had an overall good experience, enjoyed the stunning landscapes from Chefchaouen to the Sahara, and felt well taken care of by Yasin, your driver, and your local guide in Fez.We also deeply appreciate your candid notes regarding areas where we can improve:Dining, Schedule & Food Prices: Because our itinerary covers significant ground across the country, our designated lunch stops are chosen primarily to keep the tour moving efficiently so guests can spend less time in transit and more time exploring cities and sightseeing. However, dining at these stops is always completely optional. Our guides are always more than happy to point you in the direction of alternative local options or independent dining spots whenever you prefer. Regarding pricing, local street food and casual spots naturally cost significantly less than sit-down, tourist-oriented restaurants—a standard difference you'll find anywhere in the world. That said, we are reviewing our stop recommendations to ensure better culinary variety and clearer communication regarding your options. Hotel Selections: We appreciate your perspective on the accommodations. While our goal is to balance authentic regional stays with comfort, we understand that standard hotel nights should still meet a high standard. Knowing that your stay at Les Jardins De La Koutoubia was a highlight gives us great insight into the level of comfort many of our travelers prefer, and we are evaluating our accommodation tiers accordingly.Shopping Stops: We aim to introduce travelers to authentic local craft traditions (such as artisan co-ops), but this should never feel like a high-pressure sales tactic. We will brief our team to ensure these stops are strictly educational and easy to opt out of.Day Guide Service: We sincerely apologize for the conduct of your day guide in Marrakech. Arrogance and rushing guests are completely unacceptable standards for our team. We are addressing this directly with our local operations team to ensure all day guides deliver the warm, hospitable service you experienced with Yasin and our Fez guide.Thank you again for helping us see the tour through your eyes—your insights on local spots like Trattoria and Aladdin are fantastic tips for future travelers, too! Thank you so much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us. We truly appreciate your honesty, as it helps us continuously improve the experiences we offer at Timeless Morocco.

Our tours are carefully designed to cover the absolute highlights that Morocco has to offer. In doing so, we always try to strike the perfect balance between structured guided tours and giving our guests enough free time to explore at their own pace and truly get a authentic feel for each city.
We are so glad to hear that you found Chefchaouen (the Blue City) and Rabat beautiful, and that you enjoyed the marvelous craftsmanship and hidden corners of Fez with your excellent guide! Pacing in Chefchaouen & Rabat: Your feedback regarding wanting more time in Rabat and a guided stroll through the winding streets of the Blue City is incredibly valuable. We are always looking at ways to tweak our itineraries for a better experience.

attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity

intro: Designed for passionate travellers, this 2-week Europe Jewel tour unveils the best of Western and Eastern Europe! Immerse yourself in Dutch culture in Amsterdam and cruise the scenic Rhine Valley in Germany. Explore historic cities like Nuremberg, Prague, and the Slovakian capital of Bratislava. Indulge in traditional Italian flavours, marvel at the natural beauty of the Swiss Alps, and discover Parisian delights. This guided group vacation promises an unforgettable European adventure!

days.title: Amsterdam
included: Cheese and clogs demonstration at local farm
Visit Zaanse Schans to see historic windmills and wooden houses
Dinner cruise on Amsterdam canals with two-course meal
days.meals: Dinner (Two-course dinner on Amsterdam canal cruise)
days.start_point: Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands (Hotel in Amsterdam, 10:00)
days.description: Your tour leader will meet you to start the day at a local cheese farm where you'll see how traditional cheese and clogs are made. After that, you'll have free time for lunch in Volendam, a lakeside town where you can wander around and grab a bite. From there, head to Zaanse Schans to check out the historic windmills and wooden houses. Back in Amsterdam by evening, you'll enjoy a two-course dinner cruise on the canals.

days.title: Amsterdam to Rhine Valley
included: Wine tasting at local wine merchant in Rhine Valley
Riverboat cruise from Boppard to St. Goar along the Rhine River
days.description: Travel to the Rhine Valley in Germany and stop at a local wine merchant for a tasting where you'll try regional wines and possibly eiswein depending on the harvest. Then you'll take a scenic riverboat from Boppard to St. Goar, watching the riverbanks pass by with all their Gothic castles lining the water. It's quite a sight with so many of them concentrated in one area.

days.title: Nuremberg to Prague
included: Guided walking tour of Prague with local guide
Group dinner with authentic Czech cuisine
days.description: First stop is Nuremberg, a Bavarian city that was rebuilt after World War 2 and has a lot of character now. Continue on to Prague where a local guide will walk you through the city, showing you the architecture, the quirky bars, and the cobbled streets. Dinner that evening features authentic Czech cuisine, so you'll get a real taste of local food.

days.title: Prague
optional: Prague+ optional tour exploring city history and architecture including churches, concert halls, opera houses, and Prague Castle
Optional evening of traditional Czech food, music, and dance
days.description: Today is free to explore Prague on your own and see why people call it Central Europe's gem. If you want more structure, there's an optional Prague+ tour that goes deeper into the city's history, taking you through churches, concert halls, and opera houses, plus Prague Castle. In the evening, you can optionally join a traditional dinner with Czech music and dance if that interests you.

days.title: Prague to Bratislava to Vienna
included: Visit Bratislava, capital of Slovakia, including medieval castle
Guided walking tour of Vienna's UNESCO-listed city centre
See Hofburg Palace and St. Stephen's Cathedral in Vienna
optional: Optional orchestra performance in Schönbrunn Palace Orangery
days.description: On the way to Vienna, you'll stop in Bratislava, Slovakia's capital, which sits surrounded by mountains, vineyards, and ski runs. There's time to explore the medieval castle and see the unique Socialist architecture before heading on. Once you reach Vienna, a local guide will walk you through the UNESCO-listed city centre, stopping at the Hofburg Palace and St. Stephen's Cathedral among other sights. Dinner is included, and there's an optional chance to hear an orchestra perform at Schönbrunn Palace Orangery if you want to extend the evening.

days.title: Vienna to Budapest
included: Driving tour of Budapest's historic heart with local guide
See Houses of Parliament and St. Stephen's Basilica in Budapest
optional: Optional dinner cruise along the Danube River
days.description: Leave Vienna and head to Budapest, where Hungary's capital straddles the Danube River. A local guide will drive you through the historic heart, showing you the Buda side and pointing out the Houses of Parliament and St. Stephen's Basilica as you go. The afternoon is yours to do what you want. In the evening, consider an optional dinner cruise on the Danube if you'd like something special.

days.title: Budapest to Lake Balaton to Maribor to Ljubljana
included: Guided walking tour of Ljubljana with local expert
optional: Optional excursion to explore Ljubljana's delights and taste traditional Slovenian cuisine
days.description: Start by visiting Lake Balaton, Central Europe's largest lake with nearly 200km of shoreline and lots of holiday spots around it. Then you'll head to Maribor in Slovenia and have free time for lunch there. Continue to Ljubljana, where a local expert will walk you around to see the fairytale castle, the architecture, and the natural areas. After the tour, there's an optional excursion if you want to explore more and try traditional Slovenian food.

days.title: Ljubljana to Postojna to Venice
optional: Optional guided tour through Postojna Cave
Optional An Evening in Venice excursion including water taxi cruise, gondola ride, and Italian dinner
days.description: Before heading to Venice, there's an optional stop at Postojna Cave in Slovenia where you can take a guided tour. Then you'll arrive at Venice, the floating city, and have free time to wander around Piazza San Marco, see the Basilica di San Marco, and check out Palazzo Ducale. If you want to experience more of Venice, there's an optional evening excursion that includes a water taxi, a gondola ride, and an Italian dinner.

days.title: Venice to Florence to Tuscany
included: Visit Piazzale Michelangelo for panoramic view of Florence
Guided walking tour of Florence with local guide
Traditional Italian dinner at local restaurant in Florence
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Traditional Italian meal at local restaurant in Florence)
days.description: Travel from Venice toward Florence, and you'll pass through scenic Tuscan countryside on the way. Stop at Piazzale Michelangelo for views across the city before a local guide walks you through Florence's Renaissance history and Roman landmarks. You'll have free time in the afternoon to explore on your own, then grab a traditional Italian meal at a local restaurant. Later, you'll head into the Tuscan countryside for the night.

days.title: Tuscany to Pisa to Swiss Alps
included: Visit the Leaning Tower of Pisa
Scenic mountain drive to Switzerland through Alpine landscapes
days.description: Leave Tuscany and stop at the Leaning Tower of Pisa to take photos and learn its story. From there, the route heads toward the Swiss Alps, winding through landscapes with snow-capped peaks and green valleys. By evening, you'll arrive at your Alpine village accommodation and sit down for an included group dinner.

days.title: Swiss Alps
optional: Jungfraujoch: Journey to the Top of Europe optional excursion including Europe's highest train station, snow activities, Sphinx Observatory, Ice Palace, and glacier views
days.description: The day is free to enjoy the Swiss Alps at your own pace. Take a leisurely walk through charming villages or along pristine lakes if that appeals to you. There's an optional Jungfraujoch excursion where you can visit Europe's highest train station, do snow activities, explore the Sphinx Observatory and Ice Palace, and see glacier views. In the evening, there's an optional Alpine Dinner Experience to round out your day.

days.title: Swiss Alps to Paris
included: See Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe
days.description: An early start as you head to Paris. Once there, a driving tour takes you past iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe so you can note spots to explore tomorrow. You'll have an included group dinner at a local restaurant that evening before heading to the hotel.

days.title: Paris
optional: Paris+ optional excursion including macaron shop visit, perfume museum tour, Seine River sightseeing cruise, Latin Quarter free time, Montmartre exploration, and Parisian dinner
days.description: Free day to explore Paris and enjoy what the city has to offer. Join the optional Paris+ excursion to visit a well-known macaron shop, tour a perfume museum, and take a sightseeing cruise on the Seine. After that, you'll have free time in the Latin Quarter and can wander the streets of Montmartre. The evening includes a Parisian dinner, and there's an optional cabaret show if you want to end the night with entertainment.

days.title: Paris to Ghent to Amsterdam
days.description: It's the final day of the tour. You'll travel to Ghent, a medieval Belgian city, where you have free time to explore the centre and grab a meal. From there, it's back to Amsterdam where the tour ends. Before you go, make sure to exchange contact information with the people you've met along the way.

intro: Embark on an unforgettable European adventure and immerse yourself in the historic culture, food, and sights of Europe. Tick off six iconic destinations — UK, France, Switzerland, Germany, Netherlands, and Belgium — in one exhilarating journey! This captivating itinerary promises an unforgettable blend of cultural immersion, breathtaking landscapes and delectable tastes. Is Europe calling your name? This is your chance to answer!

days.title: London to Paris
days.start_point: 86 Great Eastern Road, Newham, London, E15 1GR, United Kingdom (Outside Moxy London Stratford Hotel, 06:30)
days.description: Your trip begins with the crossing from London to Paris. Once you arrive, you'll take a driving tour through the city to see major sites like the Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe. The day winds down with a welcome dinner at your hotel, giving you a chance to settle in and meet your group.

days.title: Paris
optional: Paris+ excursion: macaron tasting at authentic shop
Paris+ excursion: sightseeing cruise on River Seine
days.description: Today is yours to shape. You can head to the Louvre or explore the Eiffel Tower on your own schedule, or sign up for the Paris+ excursion which includes a perfumery visit, macaron tasting, and a cruise on the River Seine. If you're interested in evening activities, Montmartre and cabaret shows are options worth considering.

days.title: Paris - Burgundy - Swiss Alps
included: Visit Beaune, wine capital of Burgundy
days.description: You'll leave Paris and head toward Burgundy, stopping in Beaune for lunch. The local market is worth walking through, and you can taste wines at your own pace. After that, it's a scenic drive through the Swiss Alps into the Jungfrau Region, a UNESCO site known for Europe's largest glacier. A group dinner is included to cap off the evening.

days.title: Swiss Alps
optional: Optional excursion to Jungfraujoch, Europe's highest train station
days.description: The Alps are your focus today. If you book the Jungfraujoch excursion, you'll reach Europe's highest train station and see mountain villages, snow-covered peaks, waterfalls, and glaciers year-round. If you prefer a slower pace, you can explore the region independently. An optional Alpine Dinner Experience is available if you want something special in the evening.

days.title: Swiss Alps to Rhine Valley
included: Cruise along the Rhine River from St. Goar to Boppard
Wine tasting at local wine merchant
days.description: From Switzerland, you'll cross into Germany and head to St. Goar in the Rhine Valley. A river cruise takes you from St. Goar to Boppard, and along the way you'll see Gothic castles, vineyards, medieval towns, and cliffs rising from the water. An included wine tasting at a local merchant gives you a chance to try regional wines like eiswein if it's harvest season. Dinner is at your hotel.

days.title: Rhine Valley to Amsterdam
included: Learn about traditional Dutch cheese and clogs crafting
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Farewell group dinner at a local restaurant in Amsterdam)
days.description: You're heading into the Netherlands from Germany, with a lunch break somewhere along the route. When you reach Amsterdam, you'll visit the historic Riekermolen Windmill and learn about traditional Dutch cheese and clog making. The rest of the day is free to wander around the city before an evening canal cruise through Amsterdam's waterways. A farewell group dinner at a local restaurant closes out the day.

days.title: Amsterdam - Ghent - London
included: Visit Ghent, a medieval city in Belgium
days.description: The journey back to London includes a stop in Ghent, Belgium, a medieval city with well-preserved architecture, cobblestone streets, historic churches, and old towers. You'll have time to walk around, shop for souvenirs if you want, and then head back to the coach for the final drive to London where your tour ends.

name: 5 day Best of South Africa Highlights: Garden Route with Addo National Park

attributes.name: Nature & Wildlife
attributes.tip: Explore untamed landscapes teeming with wildlife

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
• 🏅 TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice Best-of-the-Best Awards Winner - Listed under Top 10 South Africa (2025) 
  • 🏆 TourRadar Tour-of-the-Year Award Winner (2015)

Discover the highlights of South Africa’s legendary Garden Route on this fast-paced hightlights tour to get you to some of the best spots of this paradise – including Addo Elephant National Park, Jeffreys Bay, Wilderness National Park and Oudtshoorn – on a 5-day tour from Cape Town. Explore this coastal paradise with an experienced guide.  Hike in old-growth forests, see endangered animals in wildlife reserves, canoe through pristine waters and relax on white-sand beaches. A combination of included and optional activities allows you to tailor this trip to suit your taste for adventure.

  • Travel distance about 1900km in total / about 4 to 6 hours daily. This daily tour travel info does not include hotel pickups/drop-offs, transfers during activities, or game drives. This tour covers a large section of the Garden Route with plenty of driving to reach the locations of the included highlights.
  • Tours may need be suspended if the minimum amount of travellers needed to confirm a specific departure date is not reached. You will be informed of these changes at least 5 work days before the trip start date. An alternative option, date or full refund will be offered.
  • This is a small group tour with no more than 13 or 25 people per vehicle and tour guide. More than 1 vehicle might be travelling on the same tour. Subject to availability, this itinerary can run in a different or reverse order. 
  • This tour is not suitable for children younger than 10 years of age. Please contact us for an exclusive private tour quote for your family. Children between 10 and 17 must be accompanied by an adult. 
  • Please do not make any scheduled arrangements (especially flights) for the first or last day of the tour, as traffic and weather can delay the approximate pickup and drop-off times.
  • This scheduled group tour requires a minimum number of travellers to operate. Trip will be marked as guaranteed once enough travellers have initially been reached.
  • *Important notice for end of year peak season tours: For travel from 10 Dec to 10 Jan this tour will overnight 2 nights at Jeffreys bay and not in Addo town.
  • The bush drive vehicles used are an especially adopted open-roof converted jeep or truck. Subject to the group size of the day at the reserve. You'll join other groups on the safari drives.
  • As per usual, wildlife is unpredictable and animal sightings can't be guaranteed - but that makes safari experiences even more exciting as you'll never know what you'll find around the next bend.
  • Leopards are nocturnal and rarely seen on Western Cape region game drives.  They roam freely high up in the mountainous regions and cannot be contained in with fences.
  • Please do not book any flights or pre-/post accommodation until the tour operator email you your travel confirmation voucher directly by email. Do not book flights to arrive or depart on the tour start or end days. Tours are only guaranteed once it is listed as a guaranteed departure. Some scheduled tour departure dates may need to be suspended if the minimum amount of travellers needed to confirm is not reached. You will be informed of any changes or an alternative option, another available date or full refund can be offered.

days.title: Cape Town to Oudtshoorn
included: Route 62 Roadtrip drive through mountain passes and farmlands
optional: Braai (BBQ) experience with ostrich sosaties and pot brood around a fire
days.start_point: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa (Any location within 5km from Cape Town city centre or Stellenbosch, 06:00 - 07:00)
days.description: You'll get picked up early from Cape Town CBD or Stellenbosch and head out on Route 62, known as the world's longest wine route. The drive takes you through mountain passes and farmland, winding toward the Klein Karoo. Midway through, you'll stop for a wine tasting to break up the journey. By afternoon you'll reach Oudtshoorn, the ostrich capital of South Africa. The evening is yours to explore this countryside town at your own pace, and if you're interested, there are optional braai dining experiences available locally.

days.title: Oudtshoorn to Addo
included: Cango Caves visit - choice between Heritage Tour or Adventure Caves Tour
South African Treats tasting menu at padstal-inspired restaurant
days.description: Wake early and head into the Cango Caves for a guided tour through limestone chambers filled with stalactites, stalagmites, and Khoikhoi paintings. After exploring the caves, you'll drive through Karoo country to a padstal-inspired restaurant where you'll have a tasting menu of traditional South African dishes. From there, you continue toward Addo as the landscape gradually shifts from dusty plains to greener valleys with the Zuurberg Mountains visible ahead. You'll arrive near Addo National Park in the evening, positioning you perfectly for an early safari the next morning.

days.title: Addo to Jeffrey's Bay
included: Addo Elephant National Park safari game drive
optional: Surfing lessons or surfboard and wetsuit hire
Beach Horseback Riding along the sandy coastline
days.description: Get up before dawn to reach Addo Elephant National Park for a game drive where your guide uses local knowledge to track Big Five animals and other wildlife on dusty dirt roads. After the morning safari, you'll head toward the coast and arrive in Jeffreys Bay, South Africa's famous Surf City. Spend your afternoon relaxing at the beach, browsing surf wear shops, or trying surfing yourself if conditions and your confidence allow. Dinner can be at your accommodation or at one of the local seafood restaurants along the coast.

days.title: Jeffrey's Bay to Sedgefield
included: Tsitsikamma National Park forest walk and suspension bridge visit
optional: Tsitsikamma Waterfall Zipline - five slides over three waterfalls
Birding, game spotting, and waterfall exploration in Tsitsikamma National Park
days.description: This day brings high energy as you travel through lush landscapes along the Garden Route. You can choose between the world's highest bungy jump at Bloukrans Bridge (216m), thrilling waterfall ziplining through Tsitsikamma forest with five slides and three waterfalls, or a more relaxed option exploring Tsitsikamma National Park's forests, suspension bridge, and waterfall trails. Later you'll stop at the Knysna Heads for lagoon views before settling into Sedgefield for the evening. Before dinner at a local restaurant, take a sunset walk along the beach.

days.title: Sedgefield to Cape Town
included: Botlierskop Private Game Reserve 4x4 safari game drive
days.description: Your final day takes you back toward Cape Town along the ocean-lined N2 route, passing forested national parks. You'll visit Botlierskop Private Game Reserve for an open 4x4 safari game drive led by an experienced ranger where you'll spot Big Five animals, giraffe, white rhino, kudu, zebra, and wildebeest. This malaria-free reserve gives you a last chance to see African wildlife before leaving the Garden Route behind. You'll arrive back in Cape Town or Stellenbosch in the evening for your drop-off.

intro: Exciting cities and breathtaking scenery await you on this Eastern Canada tour that includes Toronto, Ottawa, Québec City, and Montréal. In each city you'll see the must-see sights, such as the 1,815-foot-tall CN Tower in Toronto, Canada’s largest city; Parliament Hill and the Peace Tower in Ottawa, Canada’s capital; Québec City's Place Royale, the historic square known as the birthplace of French Canada; and Mount Royal in Montréal, designed by the same architect as New York City’s Central Park. In Québec, visit the Basilica de Notre-Dame-du-Cap, with its beautiful stained-glass windows, and Our Lady of the Cape Sanctuary, made a national shrine in 1888. Enjoy time to stroll along the cobblestone streets and explore Québec City, Canada’s only walled city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. But that’s not all…you’ll travel to amazing Niagara Falls, one of the most beloved landmarks in the world, and board an exhilarating sightseeing cruise for a thrilling ride to view the Falls up close. They are nothing short of spectacular! You’ll also enjoy a relaxing narrated cruise through scenic Thousand Islands National Park to see the opulent Gilded Age mansions the wealthy built for their summer homes. From the vibrant cities to the natural wonders and gorgeous scenery, this Eastern Canada tour designed for the value-minded traveler is the perfect vacation!

days.title: Toronto
optional: Explore St. Lawrence Market for local culinary treats
days.description: You'll arrive in Toronto, Canada's largest city, and check into your hotel. Your Tour Director will be in the lobby from 3 to 6 p.m. if you have any questions. The rest of the day is open for exploring nearby spots like the Hockey Hall of Fame, browsing Eaton Centre for shopping, or wandering through St. Lawrence Market to get a feel for the city.

days.title: Toronto to Niagara Falls
included: Sightseeing tour of Toronto landmarks including CN Tower and Rogers Centre
optional: Optional excursion to Skylon Tower with buffet lunch and Falls views
days.description: You'll head toward Niagara Falls, passing by Toronto landmarks like the CN Tower and Rogers Centre along the way. From there, you'll take a sightseeing cruise right up to the falls, where water crashes down at over 3,160 tons per second. You'll have free time at the falls afterward, or you can opt for a trip up Skylon Tower that includes a buffet lunch and views of the surrounding area.

days.title: Toronto - Kingston - Thousand Islands National Park - Ottawa
included: Narrated cruise through Thousand Islands National Park
days.description: You'll leave Toronto and stop in Kingston, a city with over 300 years of history. The route takes you along the St. Lawrence River with views of Thousand Islands National Park. At Rockport, you'll board a narrated boat cruise that winds through the islands, passing charming homes and grand Gilded Age mansions. Later you'll continue on to Ottawa, Canada's capital.

days.title: Ottawa
included: Guided sightseeing tour of Ottawa including Royal Canadian Mint, embassy district, and Parliament Hill
optional: Explore Byward Market restaurants and shops
days.description: A guided tour of Ottawa takes you to the Royal Canadian Mint, the embassy district, and Parliament Hill. The city sits on the banks of the Ottawa River and Rideau Canal. After lunch, you can spend your afternoon at the Canadian Museum of History or checking out Byward Market with its shops and restaurants.

days.title: Ottawa to Quebec City
optional: Optional excursion to Érablière le Chemin du Roy Sugar Shack with traditional Quebec dinner
days.description: You'll drive into Quebec province where the language and culture shift noticeably. First you'll visit the Basilica de Notre-Dame-du-Cap to learn about its history. Then you'll travel along King's Highway on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River before reaching Quebec City, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the heart of French Canada. An optional evening trip to a traditional sugar shack is available if you're interested.

days.title: Quebec City
included: Guided tour of Quebec City including Château Frontenac, Place d'Armes, Laval Seminary, Citadelle, Place Royale, and Lower Town
optional: Optional excursion to Montmorency Falls with dinner at 18th century restaurant on Orleans Island
days.description: A guided tour of Quebec City shows you Canada's only walled city with the impressive Château Frontenac overlooking everything. You'll walk through Old Quebec, a UNESCO World Heritage Site from the New France period, visiting Place d'Armes, Laval Seminary, the Citadelle, and Place Royale. The narrow streets of Lower Town near the St. Lawrence River give you a real sense of the history here. Your afternoon and evening are free, though an optional excursion to Montmorency Falls and dinner at an 18th-century restaurant on Orleans Island is possible.

days.title: Quebec City to Montreal
included: Guided tour of Montreal including Old Montreal and views from Mount Royal
days.description: You'll head south to Montreal, a modern city that earned the title of UNESCO City of Design in 2006. An afternoon guided tour covers Old Montreal and takes you to the top of Mount Royal for views across the city. The evening is yours to explore Montreal's diverse food scene, which is one of the best parts of the city.

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided

intro:
Travel the length of Vietnam on this 10-day cultural journey from Ho Chi Minh City to Ha Noi. Cruise the Mekong Delta, explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, and wander Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets. Learn local recipes, visit ancient temples, and experience Da Nang’s charm before flying north to explore Ha Noi’s Old Quarter and the breathtaking landscapes of Ha Long Bay. A perfect blend of heritage, culture, and scenery.

  • Minimum 2 people per booking
  • Booking at least 30 days in advance

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
days.start_point: Tan Son Nhat International Airport, Trường Sơn, Quận Tân Bình, Ho Chi Minh City 736900, Vietnam (Hotel located centrally in Ho Chi Minh City or Airport)
days.description: You'll land at Tan Son Nhat International airport and get transferred to your hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. It's a straightforward arrival day, so you'll settle in for the night and adjust to the time zone.

days.title: Mekong Delta - My Tho and Ben Tre
included: Mekong River cruise to island in My Tho
Traditional music performance and tea with bee's honey
Exploration of local coconut candy cottage industry
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch ('Elephant-Ear Fish' combined with other delicious Vietnamese dishes - a local specialty)
days.description: This morning you'll cruise the Mekong River out to an island near My Tho. You'll have traditional music playing while sipping tea with bee's honey and tasting fresh fruit. After that, a paddle-boat takes you through narrow canals where you can see how locals make coconut candy. Lunch features 'Elephant-Ear Fish', then you'll visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before heading back to Ho Chi Minh City by evening.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Cu Chi Tunnels - Da Nang - Hoi An
included: Half-day tour to Cu Chi Tunnels
optional: Firing range experience with M16 or AK47 (fees not included)
days.description: The morning is free to do what you want. Later, a half-day tour takes you to Cu Chi Tunnels to explore the network from the Vietnam War. That afternoon you'll fly to Da Nang and transfer to Hoi An. If you're interested, there's an optional chance to shoot an M16 or AK47 at a firing range for an additional fee.

days.title: Hoi An
included: Walking tour of Hoi An Ancient Town
days.description: You'll walk through Hoi An Ancient Town and visit the local market, museum, and houses that show off old architecture with Chinese influences. The assembly halls have interesting historical details, and you'll check out where craftspeople make art. The Japanese Covered Bridge is on the list too. By afternoon, the time is yours to wander around and find your own spots.

days.title: Hoi An - My Son Sanctuary
included: Bicycle tour through Hoi An countryside
Tra Que Village visit with white rose dumpling cake making
Cam Nam Yin and Yang food experience
days.description: You're cycling through Hoi An's countryside today, starting with a stop at a local restaurant for 'Cao Lau', the specialty dish. Then you'll bike to Tra Que Village where a local family teaches you how to make 'white rose' dumpling cakes. After that, you'll head to Cam Nam for Yin and Yang food. In the afternoon, the trip continues to My Son Sanctuary, a UNESCO site with temples from the ancient Champa Kingdom.

days.title: Hoi An
optional: Optional tour with Hoi An Express
days.description: You have the full day to explore Hoi An however you like. If you'd prefer a guided experience, there's an optional tour available through Hoi An Express.

days.title: Da Nang - Ha Noi
included: Visit to Van Mieu - Quoc Tu Giam (Temple of Literature)
Visit to Ngoc Son Temple (Jade Mountain Temple)
Visit to But Tower and Dai Nghien
landmarks: Van Mieu - Quoc Tu Giam (Temple of Literature)
days.description: You'll head to Da Nang airport and fly to Ha Noi. Once you arrive at Noi Bai airport, you'll transfer to your hotel. After having lunch, you'll visit heritage sites including Van Mieu - Quoc Tu Giam (Temple of Literature), Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, But Tower, and The Huc Bridge. Later, a cyclo ride through the historic Old Quarter gives you a feel for local life.

days.title: Ha Noi - Ha Long Bay
days.description: You'll leave Ha Noi by boat and head into Ha Long Bay with its roughly 3,000 limestone islands rising from the water. The boat anchors so you can swim in a quiet cove and explore hidden grottoes under tall cliffs. You'll spend the night on the cruise.

days.title: Ha Long Bay - Ha Noi
days.description: After breakfast, you'll have time to swim and relax in the sun. Lunch happens on the boat before you head back to Ha Noi, where you'll stay overnight.

days.title: Ha Noi - Departure
days.description: Breakfast is at your hotel. You'll have time to relax before the transfer to Noi Bai International airport for your flight home.

name: 7 Day Namibian Highlights Accommodated Safari

attributes.name: Safari
attributes.tip: Track iconic wildlife on unforgettable game drives

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
This 7-day, 6-night accommodated safari is a tailor-made opportunity to experience the best of Namibia within a perfect time frame. Experience a moving insight into wildlife conservation and rehabilitation at the N/a’an ku se Wildlife Sanctuary before seeking spectacular wildlife encounters in Etosha National Park. We are looking for predators and prey alike.
Visit the mineral pan ’The Great White Space’ from which Etosha takes its name, a 22,000-square-kilometre desolate, dazzling expanse so vast that it can be seen from space.
 
Beautiful Damaraland gives us a unique ‘’Big Sky’’ experience, where the towering pink granite koppies seem to touch the very sky on our horizon, putting real meaning into the words ‘’breathtaking’’.
Meet some of the locals as we travel through Damaraland, Himba, Herero & Damara people, often in traditional dress, who welcome us to their makeshift roadside stalls under the shadow of Namibia’s highest mountain, The Brandberg.
 
Reaching the wild and rugged Skeleton Coast, we follow the ocean road into the unusual and quirky town of Swakopmund. Referred to by some as the adrenaline capital of Namibia, there are certainly some hair-raising experiences on offer, but Swakopmund is also a place where you can relax and recharge.
 
We head across the Tropic of Capricorn for an adventure on a magical trip to one of the most beautiful places on Planet Earth, the centre of the Namib - the world's oldest desert. A pre-dawn start to catch the soft light as we head for Dead Vlei with its stark collection of skeleton trees and on to Sossusvlei, the water's end of an ancient river. We watch out for wildlife; oryx and springbok are often seen in this sandy land

days.title: Windhoek
included: Airport transfer from Hosea Kutako International Airport to accommodation
optional: Afternoon excursion to N/a'an ku se Wildlife Sanctuary (available for those arriving before 12:00 midday)
days.start_point: Windhoek, Khomas, Namibia (Windhoek International Airport)
days.description: You'll be picked up from Hosea Kutako International Airport and taken to Chameleon Backpackers in central Windhoek. If you land before midday, there's an optional afternoon trip to N/a'an ku se Wildlife Sanctuary about 50 km out, where you can see rehabilitated baboons, caracals, lions, cheetahs, wild dogs, and leopards. You'll head back to Windhoek by late afternoon. Dinner is on your own, though your guide can point you toward good spots around town.

days.title: Windhoek to Etosha National Park
included: Game drive through Etosha National Park with stops at waterholes
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Light lunch pack consumed on the move), Dinner (Dinner at camp restaurant)
days.description: Your guide collects you at 07:00 from your accommodation and you head to Chameleon Headquarters for a quick briefing, then drive north toward Etosha National Park. You'll stop in Otjiwarongo to pick up supplies and grab lunch while traveling. Once in the park, you'll do a game drive hitting various waterholes, arriving at your lodge as the sun sets. After you settle in, check out the floodlit waterhole near your accommodation. Elephants and the critically endangered black rhinos often show up there at night.

days.title: Etosha National Park
included: Full day game drive in open vehicle through Etosha National Park
days.description: Start early after breakfast with a full day of game viewing on an open vehicle throughout Etosha. Early morning is your best bet for spotting big cats that are returning from nighttime hunts. Your guide takes you between multiple waterholes where you'll watch animals coming to drink. You'll see the famous Etosha Pan, which stretches over 4,700 square km of white mineral flat and is actually visible from space. You'll exit the park near sunset at Anderson Gate and drive to your accommodation for the night.

days.title: Etosha to Swakopmund
included: Drive through Damaraland with local village visits
optional: Purchases from local artisans in Damaraland
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Light picnic lunch under Brandberg mountain)
days.description: After breakfast at 7:30, you're heading toward the Skeleton Coast on a scenic drive south through Outjo, then west through Damaraland with granite mountains and grasslands around you. Along the way you'll encounter local Himba, Herero, and Damara people selling handcrafted items. Lunch is a picnic under Brandberg mountain, which at 2,573 meters is Namibia's highest peak. Later you reach the coast and see the shipwreck of The Zeila before checking into your accommodation in Swakopmund.

days.title: Swakopmund to Sesriem
optional: Morning exploration of Swakopmund town centre
days.description: Your morning in Swakopmund is relaxed, so you can walk around town or try optional activities like quad biking or sandboarding if that interests you. You depart at 11:30 heading east into the desert across the Namib gravel plains. The route takes you over two mountain passes, the Kuiseb Pass and the Gaub River canyon, crossing the Tropic of Capricorn along the way. You'll stop briefly in Solitaire to stretch your legs, then continue to your accommodation near Sesriem where you'll stay for two nights.

days.title: Sossusvlei
included: Visit to Dead Vlei and surrounding dunes
days.meals: Breakfast (Very early breakfast before pre-dawn start), Lunch, Dinner
days.description: You leave before dawn to reach the dune area right at sunrise when the light is perfect for photos. After a 60 km drive to the 2x4 car park, you continue through the ephemeral Tsauchab River-bed for the final 5 km to Sossusvlei. A 4x4 shuttle handles the sandy terrain to get you to Dead Vlei with its 1,000-year-old skeletal trees standing in the white pan. You can hike up some of the world's highest dunes, reaching up to 300 meters, and visit iconic Dune 45. On the way back you'll stop at Sesriem Canyon before returning to your accommodation late in the afternoon.

days.title: Sesriem to Windhoek
included: Drive through Namib Desert to Windhoek
days.description: Your final day takes you back to Solitaire where your guide arranges the famous apple pie, then you drive back to Windhoek across Namibia's central plateau with mountain scenery around you. You'll pass through the small community of Buellsport and the town of Rehoboth. Mid-afternoon you'll arrive in Windhoek and get dropped at Chameleon Backpackers or another accommodation of your choice within the city limits. This completes your 7-day tour.

intro:
Argentina’s highlights await: take a once-in-a-lifetime trip to the star destinations of the country. From the incredible jungle trails of Iguazú Falls to Ushuaia, the southernmost city in the world, tour Perito Moreno Glacier and discover Buenos Aires’ tango shows as you soak up the local Argentine culture on this 12 day adventure.

This is a tailor-made itinerary and may be adjusted to suit your interests, your budget and your schedule. Trips may depart any day of the week, upgrades are available and you may add new destinations or extra nights as you see fit.

For example, if you would like to add a visit to a ranch and horseback ride near Buenos Aires, visit the lovely wineries in Mendoza or continue on to Iguazu Falls, we are happy to help you plan your adventure.


*If you choose the booking now option, please consider that is necessary 48 hours to process from booking date or book departure.

Shop for leather goods and Argentine designer items

days.description: You'll arrive in Buenos Aires and get settled at your hotel, then the rest of the day is yours to explore. Walk around the cobblestone streets, check out local antique shops and artisan markets, and wander through the colorful neighborhoods of Palermo Soho at your own pace.

days.title: Buenos Aires
included: Buenos Aires City Tour - visit May Square (Plaza de Mayo), San Telmo, La Boca, and Recoleta
Dinner and Tango Show with professional display
days.meals: Dinner (Dinner with beverages at Tango Show)
days.description: This morning you have a guided tour of Buenos Aires covering the historical and political center, including May Square, San Telmo, and La Boca, plus the upscale Recoleta area. Later in the evening, you'll head to a dinner and tango show where professional dancers and local performers take the stage in an elegant venue.

days.title: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
optional: Visit Thematic Gallery of Historia Fueguina with 120+ life-size figures
Try local seafood, especially Blake Hake
days.description: After breakfast, transfer to the domestic airport for your flight to Ushuaia. Once you arrive and check into your hotel, you can either walk around this small town by the bay or visit one of the local museums like the Thematic Gallery or Prison Museum, depending on when you land.

days.title: Tierra del Fuego National Park
included: Hike Coastal Path in Tierra del Fuego National Park (approximately 4.4 miles, 3.5 hours)
Hot lunch in heated dome-tent with panoramic views
Inflatable canoe (duckies) paddle down Lapataia River to Lapataia Bay (approximately 1 hour)
days.meals: Lunch (Hot lunch with great panoramic view inside heated dome-tent)
days.description: Head out early for a full-day tour to Tierra del Fuego National Park. You'll hike the Coastal Path with views of lakes, mountains, and the sea, then grab a hot lunch in a heated dome-tent. After that, you'll paddle inflatable canoes down the Lapataia River to the bay where Route N° 3 ends at the southern tip.

days.title: Beagle Channel
included: 3-hour boat trip along Beagle Channel with views of Ushuaia Bay and Martial Glacier
Observe marine wildlife including cormorants and fur seals on Alicia Island
Stop at Bridges Island with wildlife interpretative path
optional: Enjoy hot chocolate with cookies or Mate (Argentine green tea)
days.description: Make your own way to the tourist pier for a 3-hour boat tour through the Beagle Channel, the same waters Darwin explored. You'll see Ushuaia Bay, the Martial Glacier, and spot marine life like cormorants and fur seals along with the Les Eclaireurs lighthouse. The trip includes a stop at Bridges Island where you can walk a path and learn about Yamana history.

days.title: Ushuaia to El Calafate
days.description: Transfer to Ushuaia Airport and fly to El Calafate, then get driven to your hotel in this gateway town to the glaciers. The town sits on the Patagonian steppe near Argentina's largest lake, and you'll have time to settle in and get your bearings.

days.title: Los Glaciares National Park
included: Los Glaciares National Park tour with views of Perito Moreno Glacier
Walk multiple viewpoint walkways in front of glacier ice wall
optional: 1-hour boat ride sailing along glacier wall and between floating icebergs (approximately one hour, hourly departures 10 am to 3 pm, subject to availability)
days.description: Early pickup today for a full-day trip to Los Glaciares National Park, about 50 miles away and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You'll walk right up to the Perito Moreno Glacier and see the massive ice wall from different angles with free time to explore. There's an optional boat ride available if you want to sail closer to the 240-foot glacier walls and see floating icebergs.

days.title: El Calafate
days.description: The day is completely free so you can relax at your hotel or explore El Calafate at your own pace. Maybe grab lunch at a local restaurant, walk around town, or just take things easy before the next leg of your trip.

days.title: El Calafate to Puerto Iguazú
days.description: Transfer to El Calafate Airport for your flight to Puerto Iguazú, then get driven to your hotel in this border town. You'll be near the Iguazú Falls, one of the Seven Natural Wonders, and can spend the rest of the day resting and adjusting to the tropical jungle climate.

days.title: Iguazú National Park (Argentine side)
included: Iguazú National Park (Argentine side) tour with lower and upper walkways
Visit Devil's Throat via ecological train and boardwalks
Wildlife spotting in humid subtropical forest
days.description: Full-day tour of Iguazú National Park on the Argentine side with lower and upper walkways winding through humid subtropical forest. You'll spot wildlife like toucans, parrots, and coatis, then head to Devil's Throat, the largest waterfall, via ecological train and boardwalks. Free time to grab lunch and take photos.

days.title: Puerto Iguazú (Brazilian side) to Buenos Aires
included: Half-day Iguazú Falls Brazilian side tour - Foz do Iguazú National Park
Bus transportation within park with guide
Explore boardwalks including Salto Santa María
days.description: Full-day tour on the Brazilian side of Foz do Iguazú National Park for panoramic views of the falls from a different angle. You'll walk boardwalks including the Salto Santa María section and get closer views of Devil's Throat. After exploring, you'll transfer to the airport for your flight back to Buenos Aires and check into your hotel.

days.title: Buenos Aires Departure
days.description: Transfer to the international airport for your departure flight. Safe travels!

name: Classic Europe

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity

intro: Embark on this Classic Europe tour and explore top European destinations! Cruise Amsterdam’s canals, and Germany’s Rhine River. Capture iconic sites like London’s Buckingham Palace, Italy’s Leaning Tower of Pisa, and Paris' Eiffel Tower. Savour Tuscan delights, German brews, and Belgian waffles. Summit the Swiss Alps for breathtaking vistas. Revel in free time in Paris, Rome, Amsterdam, and the Swiss Alps. This fast-paced adventure ensures no highlights are missed.

days.title: London
included: Explore London's top sights with tour leader
Roast lunch at a traditional British pub
optional: Thames, Towers & Tastes excursion - River Thames cruise and fish 'n' chips dinner
days.meals: Lunch (Classic British roast at a local pub)
days.start_point: London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom (Hotel in London, 10:00)
days.description: You'll arrive in London and connect with your tour leader and group at the hotel. This morning and afternoon, check out the major sights like Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, and Buckingham Palace. Grab a classic British roast lunch at a local pub, then your evening is yours to explore the city however you'd like. There's an optional Thames, Towers & Tastes excursion if you want a River Thames cruise and fish and chips dinner included.

days.title: London to Paris
included: Driving tour of Paris highlights including Eiffel Tower and Arc de Triomphe
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Group dinner at a local restaurant)
days.description: Today you're heading from London to Paris, crossing the English Channel. Once you arrive, take a driving tour around the city to see the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, and other landmarks. Later, the group gathers for dinner at a local restaurant, and you can start thinking about what to do during tomorrow's free time.

days.title: Paris
optional: Paris+ full-day excursion - Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées visit, macaron tasting, perfume museum visit, River Seine cruise with lunch, Latin Quarter exploration
days.description: You have the full day free to explore Paris on your own terms or join the Paris+ excursion. If you go on the excursion, you'll visit the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées, try macarons, check out a perfume museum, and take a River Seine cruise with lunch included. There's also time to wander the Latin Quarter. Later, you can opt into a Montmartre tour with a cabaret show.

days.title: Paris - Burgundy - Swiss Alps
included: Visit Beaune, wine capital of Burgundy
Marvel at the views on a scenic Swiss mountain drive
days.description: You're leaving Paris and driving through Burgundy with a lunch stop in Beaune, known for its wines. Spend time exploring the town and the Hospices de Beaune, then taste some regional wines. From there, continue into Switzerland on a scenic route through the Alps with views of forests, lakes, and mountains. Dinner is included once you arrive in the Swiss Alps.

days.title: Swiss Alps
optional: Full-day Jungfraujoch excursion - 'Top of Europe' glacier visit with panoramic mountain, lake, and glacier views
Explore local towns and Swiss chocolate tasting
Alpine Dinner Experience with traditional Swiss cuisine
days.description: This is a free day in the Swiss Alps. You can join an optional full-day excursion to Jungfraujoch, the 'Top of Europe', where snow covers the ground year-round and you'll see panoramic mountain and glacier views. Or stay at lower altitudes, walk through local towns, and try Swiss chocolate. There's also an optional Alpine Dinner Experience with traditional Swiss food in the evening.

days.title: Swiss Alps - Pisa - Tuscany
included: Photo stop at the Leaning Tower of Pisa
days.description: You're traveling from the Swiss Alps toward Italy, stopping at the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa for photos. After that, continue into the Tuscan region and arrive in Montecatini Terme, a charming spa town northwest of Florence. Spend your evening relaxing with local wine or join an optional excursion for dinner in town.

days.title: Tuscany - Florence - Rome
included: Guided tour of Florence, the 'Jewel of the Renaissance'
days.description: Drive through Tuscany to Florence, where you'll get a guided tour of this Renaissance city full of art and history. You'll have free time to explore on your own or join an optional family-style Tuscan lunch excursion. Later, continue to Rome, Italy's capital. Arrive with time to yourself before gathering for an included group dinner.

days.title: Rome
optional: Locally guided tour of Colosseum and Roman Forum
'Conquer the Capital' optional excursion - Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon visit, lunch, and gelato tasting
Vatican City and Sistine Chapel visit
days.description: You have a free day in Rome to explore the ancient history, culture, and food. Join a locally guided tour of the Colosseum and Roman Forum if you want historical insights, or choose 'Conquer the Capital' with Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, lunch, and gelato. Alternatively, visit Vatican City and see Michelangelo's work in the Sistine Chapel. There's flexibility depending on what interests you most.

days.title: Rome to Venice
optional: An Evening in Venice - gondola and water taxi rides with pizza or pasta dinner
days.description: You're heading to Venice, a unique floating city built across 118 islands. Walk around St. Mark's Square, the Grand Canal, and Rialto Bridge. The city is known for its canals, gondolas, Venetian masks, and traditional glass and lace crafts. Your evening is free to explore as you wish, or you can join 'An Evening in Venice' for gondola and water taxi rides with pizza or pasta dinner.

days.title: Venice - Innsbruck - Munich
included: Discover Munich on an orientation tour
Three-course German meal at a historic Munich restaurant
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Three-course German meal in a historic Munich restaurant)
days.description: Leave Venice and travel to Munich with a stop in Innsbruck, Austria along the way. You'll get an orientation tour of Innsbruck showing the Golden Roof and Gothic architecture, then have time for lunch. Continue to Munich for an orientation tour of the city's highlights and history. End the day with a three-course German meal at a historic restaurant.

days.title: Munich to Rhine Valley
included: Wine tasting of Riesling and Rhine Valley varietals in Boppard
days.description: You're heading from Munich to the Rhine Valley. Board a river cruise to see the region's castles, medieval fortresses, and historic vineyards set against steep cliffs. The cruise takes you to Boppard, a UNESCO World Heritage town. You'll taste local Riesling wines and learn about the region's varietals, then settle into your hotel with dinner included.

days.title: Rhine Valley to Amsterdam
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Dinner at a local restaurant)
days.description: Today you're traveling from the Rhine Valley toward the Netherlands. Stop in the Dutch countryside to sample local cheese and see traditional clog-making at work. Visit the Riekelmolen Windmill for photos before continuing to Amsterdam. Take a relaxing canal cruise to see the city's highlights, then have free time before dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Amsterdam - Ghent - London
included: Visit Ghent, a medieval Belgian city
optional: Farewell curry dinner on Brick Lane, London
days.description: Travel from Amsterdam to London with a stop in Ghent, Belgium. Spend time wandering the medieval cobblestone streets, looking at historic buildings, trying Belgian chocolate, and having Belgian waffles. Then head to the final leg back to London, crossing the English Channel and arriving by end of day. There's an optional farewell curry dinner on Brick Lane if you want.

days.title: London
days.description: Your tour ends this morning. Gather with the group for breakfast at the hotel to say goodbye to your fellow travelers and new friends. Safe travels on your journey home.
