days.title: Tokyo
days.description: After clearing customs, a shared shuttle bus takes you to your hotel. You'll have the rest of the day to relax and get settled in at your own pace. Later in the afternoon, your guide stops by to go over what's coming up on the tour.

days.title: Tokyo
included: Guided tour of Tokyo (approximately seven hours)
Tokyo Skytree admission up to Tembo Deck at 350 meters
days.meals: Lunch, Dinner (Local restaurant in Shinjuku area)
days.description: A seven-hour guided tour covers Tokyo's main attractions starting with Zojoji Temple and its hundreds of Jizo statues. You'll pass by Shibuya Crossing from the bus, then head to Meiji Shrine before taking Tokyo Skytree up for views across the city. The tour continues through Asakusa, where you'll walk Nakamise Street near Sensoji Temple, then moves through Akihabara and Ginza. By evening, take the subway to Shinjuku for a walk around this busy district and dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Tokyo - Mount Fuji - Kawaguchiko
included: Mount Fuji Fifth Station drive (up to permitted altitude)
Onsen (public hot spring bath) access at Ryokan
days.description: Travel toward Mount Fuji with a stop at Arakurayama Sengen Park for classic views of the mountain. Head to the lakeside town of Kawaguchiko and visit Fuji Sengen Shrine, followed by a boat ride on Lake Kawaguchiko. From there, you'll drive up toward Mount Fuji's Fifth Station, climbing to 2,305 meters through forest and mountain scenery. Return to Kawaguchiko for the night at a traditional ryokan where you can soak in the onsen hot spring.

days.title: Kawaguchiko - Iyashi no Sato Nenba - Toyota - Kyoto
included: Iyashi no Sato Nenba village visit
days.description: Scenic roads wind around lakes on the way to Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a restored village with traditional houses turned into shops and cultural spaces. Next is Shiraito Falls, a 20-meter waterfall that's one of Japan's most notable natural spots. The route continues to the Toyota Museum in Nagoya, then heads on to Kyoto for your overnight stay.

days.title: Kyoto
days.description: Spend the day exploring Kyoto, Japan's former capital with deep artistic roots. Start in Arashiyama at Togetsukyo Bridge, then visit Tenryuji Temple and walk through its bamboo forest. You'll also see Fushimi Inari Shrine, the Imperial Palace, and Kinkakuji Temple with its gardens. After the tour, there's time to walk around Gion, Kyoto's traditional district where you might spot geishas in the evening.

days.title: Kyoto - Nara - Osaka
days.description: Head to Nara to see Todaiji Temple and its giant Buddha statue, where deer roam freely around the park. Continue to Horyu-ji Buddhist Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with one of the world's oldest wooden pagodas and Japan's oldest Buddhist temple. You'll finish the day arriving in Osaka, Japan's second-largest city, then visit Dotonbori, a busy colorful district with lots of nightlife options.

days.title: Osaka
days.description: After breakfast, your tour ends and you head home with memories from your time traveling through Japan.

intro: Travel the Ring Road and Snæfellsnes Peninsula in 7 days. Explore all of the highlights that Iceland has to offer

days.title: Reykjavik - The Golden Circle & South Coast
included: Visit Thingvellir National Park with UNESCO World Heritage Site
See Silfra fissure between Eurasian and North American tectonic plates
Visit Geysir geothermal hot spring area
Visit Reynisfjara black sand beach with Reynisdrangar peaks
Explore basalt column cave at Reynisfjara
optional: Northern Lights viewing tips from guide (September to April)
days.description: You'll get picked up from Reykjavik and head straight to the Golden Circle. First stop is Thingvellir National Park, where you can walk between the tectonic plates at Silfra fissure and see where Iceland's oldest parliament met back in 930 CE. From there, you'll watch Strokkur geyser blow water into the air roughly every 5 to 10 minutes, then drive to Gullfoss waterfall where the water drops 32 meters through a canyon. Later in the afternoon, you'll head along the south coast and walk right behind Seljalandsfoss waterfall. Stop by Skogafoss to spot rainbows in the mist, then finish at Reynisfjara black sand beach with its dramatic basalt columns and rock formations. You'll stay at a country hotel near Kirkjubaerklaustur for the night.

days.title: Vik - Skaftafell - Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon - Hofn
included: Visit Skaftafell in Vatnajokull National Park
optional: Glacier hike on Vatnajokull outlet glacier with certified guide (April-September) - includes crampons and necessary equipment
Ice cave tour through Vatnajokull glacier (October-April)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll continue east toward Vatnajokull National Park. At Skaftafell, you have the choice to hike onto Vatnajokull glacier with a certified guide and crampons, or if it's October through April, explore an ice cave inside the glacier instead. Next you'll head to Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon to see icebergs floating in the water that break off from Breidarmerkurjokull glacier. The area sometimes has seals around too. From there, it's a short walk to Diamond Beach where icebergs rest on black sand. You'll end the day at accommodation in South East Iceland.

days.title: East Fjords - Djupivogur - Egilsstadir
included: Access to Wilderness Center hot pots (complimentary)
days.description: Today you'll drive through the remote East Fjords, taking narrow coastal roads around the Hvalnes peninsula and past the Þvottárskriður landslides. Stop in Djupivogur, a traditional fishing village where you can see the outdoor sculpture Eggin í Gleðivík. Later, you'll head to the Wilderness Center just 40 minutes from Egilsstaðir where there's a wilderness museum and you can relax in hot pots at no extra cost. If you're traveling in winter, keep an eye out for Northern Lights across this area.

days.title: Studlagil - Lake Myvatn - Godafoss - Akureyri
optional: Bathe in Myvatn Nature Baths - entrance fee can be added when booking or paid on site
days.description: You'll start the day at Studlagil Canyon with its dramatic basalt columns and turquoise glacial river. Then drive through Mödrudalur valley, where Iceland's highest farm sits at 469 meters elevation. The Námaskard geothermal area comes next with its colorful mud pools and steam vents. If you want, you can add on a soak at Mývatn Nature Baths which has mineral-rich, chlorine-free hot spring pools. You'll explore Hverfjall volcano crater and the surreal Dimmuborgir lava formations. Drive around Lake Mývatn and stop at Godafoss waterfall before heading to your country hotel in Akureyri, Iceland's second-largest city.

days.title: Akureyri - Trollaskagi Peninsula - Siglufjordur - Laugarbakki
optional: Whale watching boat tour across Eyjafjordur Fjord - spot humpback whales, dolphins, porpoises, and other ocean life
days.description: You'll drive through Akureyri and can optionally take a whale watching boat tour on Eyjafjörður Fjord where you might see humpback whales, dolphins, porpoises, and occasionally seals or blue whales. From there, continue along the scenic road between mountains and the fjord around the Trollaskagi peninsula. Stop at Siglufjörður, a village that was once the herring fishing capital of the Atlantic and still has that early 20th century gold-rush feel preserved. You'll get a real sense of Icelandic life in these small villages. Spend the night at a country hotel like Hotel Laugarbakki.

days.title: Laugarbakki - Borgarfjordur - West Iceland
days.description: Head to Borgarfjörður in West Iceland, a region that's been recognized as one of the best destinations around. You'll visit Deildartunguhver hot spring and see two waterfalls: Barnafoss and Hraunfossar, which flows right out of a lava field. Stop at Reykholt, the historic home of Snorri Sturluson, the famous Icelandic historian, lawyer, politician and author. You'll stay overnight in the Borgarnes area or back in Reykjavik.

days.title: Borgarnes - Snaefellsnes Peninsula - Reykjavik
included: Attempt to lift fishermen's strength stones at Djupalonssandur
View British Trawler Epine shipwreck remains
optional: Lunch at local restaurant in Arnarstapi or Hellnar (food and drink not included)
days.description: Have a relaxed breakfast before your Snaefellsnes guide picks you up around 9:15 AM. Start at Ytri-Tunga beach where you'll see lots of seals and birds plus golden sand and gentle dunes. Drive through countryside with mountain and coastal views, stopping in the villages of Arnarstapi and Hellnar for lunch at a local restaurant (food costs are on you). Walk through moss-covered lava and look out toward Snæfellsjökull glacier. Explore the black pebble beach at Djúpalónssandur with its wild cliff formations and try lifting the old fishermen's strength-testing stones. On the way back to Reykjavik, visit Kirkjufell, probably Iceland's most photographed mountain, and stop at Gerðuberg to see geometric basalt columns. End your week back in Reykjavik.

qa.question: Could you please provide information about the itinerary, inclusions, and the type of accommodations offered? intro:
Begin in Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire, before exploring Chinchero, the remarkable circular terraces of Moray, and the spectacular Maras Salt Mines. Travel by train through the Sacred Valley to Aguas Calientes and discover Machu Picchu, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.­ 

Your journey continues with a hands-on Peruvian cooking experience and a free day to explore Cusco at your own pace. Then, travel along the historic Route of the Sun to Puno, visiting Andahuaylillas, Raqchi, La Raya, and Pucará. Complete your adventure with a boat excursion across Lake Titicaca to the floating Uros Islands and Taquile Island, where ancient customs and community traditions remain alive.­ 

With small groups, professional local guides, comfortable transportation, and ongoing assistance from Inkayni Peru Tours, this itinerary offers a carefully organized and culturally enriching introduction to southern Peru.

days.title: Cusco
included: Welcome briefing with Inkayni Peru Tours team
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional Alejandro Velasco Astete (CUZ), Av. Velasco Astete S/N, Wanchaq, Cusco 08006, Peru (Pick-up point: Cusco Airport or bus station, 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive in Cusco and meet your Inkayni Peru Tours representative at the airport or bus station for a transfer to your hotel in the historic center. Spend the afternoon resting and getting used to the altitude since you're at 3,350m/11,000ft. Around 5:00 p.m. there's a welcome briefing where you'll learn about pickup times, what's included, and what to expect from your upcoming activities.

days.title: Sacred Valley - Chinchero - Moray - Maras - Aguas Calientes
included: Expedition train from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes
days.description: Start the day in Chinchero, a traditional Andean town, and visit a local textile center to watch artisans work with alpaca wool through cleaning, spinning, dyeing, and weaving. From there you'll check out Moray's circular agricultural terraces, then head to the Maras Salt Mines where thousands of pools cascade down the mountainside. Grab lunch after that, then transfer to Ollantaytambo Train Station to board the scenic tourist train to Aguas Calientes, arriving at your hotel in the evening.

days.title: Machu Picchu - Cusco
included: Shuttle bus from Aguas Calientes to Machu Picchu
Shuttle bus from Machu Picchu to Aguas Calientes
Tourist train from Aguas Calientes to Ollantaytambo
optional: Huayna Picchu entrance ticket (separate ticket and advance reservation required)
Machu Picchu Mountain entrance ticket (separate ticket and advance reservation required)
days.description: Your guide meets you at the hotel and takes you to the bus station for the shuttle up to Machu Picchu. After you show your passport and entrance ticket, you'll spend time exploring this Inca citadel with your guide learning about its history, architecture, and how the Incas lived there. You'll return by shuttle to Aguas Calientes for free time and lunch, then catch the afternoon train back to Ollantaytambo before driving to your Cusco hotel.

days.title: Cusco
included: Guided visit to San Pedro Market
Introduction to native ingredients and Peruvian food traditions
Hands-on Peruvian cooking class with experienced local chef
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Dishes prepared during the Peruvian cooking class)
days.description: After breakfast your guide picks you up for a visit to San Pedro Market, Cusco's most traditional local market. You'll walk through colorful aisles to see native potatoes, Andean grains, tropical fruits, herbs, cheeses, and spices while learning about their role in Peruvian cooking. Then you'll head to a cooking class with an experienced local chef who guides you in preparing traditional dishes. Enjoy the meal you've prepared and then you'll have free time to explore Cusco on your own.

days.title: Cusco
optional: Visit to local museums and attractions
days.description: This is your free day in Cusco. You can relax at your hotel, walk around the historic center, check out museums and local markets, discover traditional neighborhoods, or just enjoy the city's restaurants and cafés. If you want something more active, Inkayni Peru Tours can arrange optional excursions like a Cusco City Tour, ATV adventure, Rainbow Mountain, or other activities for an extra fee.

days.title: Cusco to Puno
included: Tourist bus journey from Cusco to Puno
Guided visit to Raqchi archaeological complex
Guided visit to Pucará archaeological complex
Transfer to hotel upon arrival in Puno
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Buffet lunch at a local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast you'll transfer to the tourist bus station to start the scenic Route of the Sun journey toward Puno. First stop is Andahuaylillas, a colonial church known as the 'Sistine Chapel of the Americas' for its decorated interior. You'll continue to the Raqchi archaeological complex to explore the Temple of Wiracocha, then have a buffet lunch. Next is La Raya, the highest point on the route with beautiful mountain views, followed by Pucará, an ancient ceremonial center with archaeological remains and traditional pottery. You'll arrive in Puno by evening.

days.title: Lake Titicaca - Uros and Taquile Islands
included: Shared boat excursion across Lake Titicaca
Cultural visit to floating Uros Islands
Return transfer to hotel in Puno
optional: Purchases of local textiles and handicrafts
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional lunch on Taquile Island)
days.description: After breakfast around 7:30 a.m. you'll transfer to Puno port for a full-day boat excursion on Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world. First you'll visit the floating Uros Islands made from totora reeds where locals explain how these islands are built and maintained. Then you'll travel by boat to Taquile Island to explore its landscapes and learn about local customs, traditional clothing, agriculture, and textile work. You'll have a traditional lunch with local ingredients before heading back to Puno.

days.title: Puno to Juliaca
included: Transfer to Juliaca Airport or bus station
days.description: After breakfast you'll have free time depending on when you're leaving. An Inkayni Peru Tours representative will meet you at your hotel at the right time and transfer you to Juliaca Airport for your onward flight, or to the bus station if you're traveling by bus. This wraps up your eight-day journey through Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, the Route of the Sun, and Lake Titicaca.

days.title: Beijing
days.start_point: Beijing, China (24-hour Airport Pick-up, 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive at Beijing Capital or Daxing Airport where a driver meets you for the transfer downtown to your hotel. The pickup is available around the clock, so whenever your flight lands, transportation is sorted and you can settle in.

days.title: Beijing
included: À la carte welcome dinner at local restaurant
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch, Dinner (À la carte welcome dinner featuring Peking Roast Duck and local delicacies)
days.description: Meet your guide at 08:00 for a full day through Beijing's major sites. You'll see Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City first, then head to the Temple of Heaven. By evening, catch the acrobatic show at the Red Theater followed by dinner with Peking Roast Duck and other local dishes.

days.title: Beijing
included: Guided hike on Mutianyu Great Wall
Round-trip cable car rides or chairlift and toboggan
Red wine toast at Great Wall
Photo stop at Bird's Nest and Water Cube
Visit local family in traditional courtyard
days.description: Head out early for the 1.5-hour drive to Mutianyu Great Wall. You can take the cable car or chairlift up the ramparts and choose the toboggan option on the way down if you want. After returning downtown, stop at the Bird's Nest and Water Cube Olympic venues for photos, then do a rickshaw tour through historic Hutong alleys and visit a local family's traditional courtyard home.

days.title: Beijing to Xi'an
days.description: Start the morning at the Summer Palace, which showcases classical Chinese garden design. After lunch, head to the train station for the high-speed train to Xi'an, which takes 4.5 to 5.5 hours. Your Xi'an guide meets you upon arrival and drives you to your hotel.

days.title: Xi'an
included: Guided tour of Terracotta Army Museum
Guided tour of Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
Tang Dynasty Music and Dance Show
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch, Dinner (Traditional dumpling dinner)
days.description: Begin at the Terracotta Army Museum to see the First Emperor's mausoleum and the 2,200-year-old figures. You can visit the home of the original discoverer and try making a small terracotta warrior yourself. Later, go to the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda. For dinner, try dumplings followed by the Tang Dynasty Music and Dance Show.

days.title: Xi'an
included: Shadowboxing masterclass at City Wall Park
Ascend Xi'an City Wall for panoramic views
À la carte local food lunch
Guided tour of Shaanxi History Museum
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch (À la carte local food lunch)
days.description: Start with a shadowboxing class at City Wall Park to experience local morning traditions. Then climb the Xi'an City Wall for views across the ancient capital. Walk through the Muslim Quarter for snacks and souvenirs, pass the Bell and Drum Towers, and have lunch with local options. Finish the afternoon at the Shaanxi History Museum to see important artifacts.

days.title: Xi'an to Guilin
days.description: After breakfast, your guide takes you to the airport for your flight to Guilin. Once you arrive, a local guide and driver pick you up and bring you to your hotel. After settling in and resting, you'll head out to see the Reed Flute Cave and Elephant Trunk Hill.

days.title: Guilin - Yangshuo - Guilin
included: 4-hour Li River cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo
Walking tour of West Street in Yangshuo
days.description: Take a 4-hour Li River cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo, watching the karst landscape pass by. After arriving in Yangshuo, walk through the busy West Street and take a relaxing drive through the countryside. You'll see rural scenery along the 'Ten-mile Gallery' and encounter local farmers with buffalo in the fields, then return to Guilin by car.

days.title: Guilin to Shanghai
days.description: Your guide escorts you to Guilin Airport for the flight to Shanghai. When you land, a Shanghai guide and driver meet you and take you to your hotel.

days.title: Shanghai
included: Visit traditional bazaar surrounding Yu Garden
Pan-fried buns lunch at century-old restaurant with coffee
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch (Pan-fried buns at a century-old restaurant with delivered coffee)
days.description: After breakfast, check out the classical Yu Garden and the traditional bazaar around it. Then go to Shanghai Museum, which has a strong collection of ancient Chinese art. Grab lunch with pan-fried buns at a century-old restaurant your guide recommends. Later, walk the Bund to see the older Western-style buildings, then take a Huangpu River cruise to see the modern skyline before heading back to your hotel.

days.title: Shanghai
days.description: Check out of your hotel and make your way to the airport on your own for your flight home. Both Pudong and Hongqiao airports in Shanghai are easy to reach by metro or taxi.

name: 10 Day Wild Irish Experience - Small Group Tour

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
It’s an intimate small group journey, which transforms from a bus trip to road trip, complete with like-minded travellers that become friends. Unlike the big groups, we can easily get to those magical, hard to reach places, such as secluded beaches or dramatic cliff tops. 

This tour takes you through centuries of Irish history and to some of the most stunning natural highlights that southern Ireland has to offer. You also get the chance to experience the imposing Rock of Cashel, ancient site of Glendalough, the dramatic Cliffs of Moher, the harbour town of Dingle, the savage beauty of Connemara,  overnight at the edge of the tranquil Killarney National Park, drive the tourist trail of The Ring Of Kerry and old Gaelic Peninsula of Dingle. 

This trip will give you the chance to explore the true hidden gems of the old west Clare, the Kingdom of Kerry and the medieval city of Kilkenny. Explore the Aran islands by bike, bus or foot and enjoy an impromptu music session in lively Doolin. 

Our tours include everything you need for a stress - free trip: accommodation, transport, Irish tour guide, breakfast, and a few key cultural inclusions that are simply not to be missed.

days.title: Dublin to Westport
included: Visit Clonmacnoise Monastic Site - ancient Christian settlement with towers and crosses
optional: Cycle part of the Great Western Greenway
days.start_point: 17 Moore Lane, Dublin, D01, Ireland (Point A Dublin, Parnell Street- Main Entrance - Please arrive 15 mins before departure, 08:30)
days.description: You'll leave Dublin heading west through Ireland's heartlands, and your first stop is Clonmacnoise where you can walk around the monastic site to see the ancient towers and carved crosses. From there, it's on to Westport, a pleasant town sitting at the foot of Croagh Patrick. You'll have the afternoon to yourself, so you might wander the colorful streets, pop into shops or cafes, or settle into a traditional pub for some live music and a drink.

days.title: Westport to Clifden
included: Scenic drive through Sky Road into Clifden
days.description: After a hearty Irish breakfast, you'll start with a walking tour through Westport's Georgian streets where your guide shares stories about local saints and pirates. Then you'll head to Croagh Patrick for views across Clew Bay and its 365 islands, followed by the National Famine Memorial. Later you'll travel through Doolough Valley to Killary Harbour and the village of Leenane. In the afternoon, the route takes you along the Sky Road into Clifden with dramatic coastal views, and you'll end the evening listening to traditional music in a local pub.

days.title: Clifden
optional: Gentle hike around Diamond Hill in Connemara National Park
days.description: You'll have the full day to explore Connemara without worrying about packing or moving hotels. After breakfast, you can head into Connemara National Park and take an optional gentle walk around Diamond Hill if you're interested, with sweeping views across mountains, bogs, and the Atlantic. Next you'll see Kylemore Abbey, one of Ireland's iconic landmarks, where you can check out the Victorian walled gardens reflected in the tranquil lake. During the afternoon, you'll travel through Inagh Valley and along the Sky Road before heading back to Clifden.

days.title: Clifden to Lahinch
optional: Explore Inis Móhr (Aran Islands) - Ferry from Rossaveal €55 return, pony & trap €50pp, bike rental €25-€45, or local bus €20-€25, rejoin group in Doolin after island adventure
days.description: Starting south from Connemara along the Wild Atlantic Way, you'll pass through tranquil lakes and green farmland before reaching Galway. There you'll have time to walk the cobbled streets, see the street performers and colorful shopfronts, and explore the Latin Quarter at your own pace, grabbing local seafood where you like. In the afternoon, the route heads into the Burren Region's distinctive limestone landscape. You'll stop at Dunguaire Castle for views over Galway Bay and the Aran Islands, take a short walk across the rocky terrain, and then continue to the seaside town of Lahinch.

days.title: Lahinch to Dingle
included: Traditional sheepdog demonstration on family farm
days.description: You'll travel the Ring of Kerry, the famous 180km loop around the Iveragh Peninsula with dramatic mountains, emerald fields, and sweeping coastal views. Your local guide will bring the landscape to life with stories about history, folklore, and Irish character from ancient chieftains to rural Kerry life. You'll have plenty of stops to capture photos of rugged cliffs, glacial valleys, peaceful lakes, and the small villages along the route. When weather cooperates, you might catch distant views of the Skellig Islands before arriving in Killarney.

days.title: Dingle
included: Slea Head Drive with scenic stops
optional: Dingle Sea Safari (€65) - RIB boat adventure along Dingle Bay's dramatic coastline
Sea Kayaking (€55) - Paddle around Dingle Harbour and explore secret sea caves
Dick Mack's Brewery Tour (€25) - Craft beer tour with tastings in the taproom
Guided Horse Ride (€55) - Trot along Ventry Beach or ride into surrounding hills
Dingle Tasting Tour (€80) - Three-hour food and drink experience through Dingle's culinary highlights
days.description: You'll spend the day driving the Slea Head Drive with the wild Atlantic Ocean on your left and green fields rolling on your right. Along the way, you'll find hidden beaches, ancient beehive huts, and dramatic cliff views while your guide shares stories about Gaelic culture and island life. There's plenty of time for photos and quiet moments to take things in. After lunch, you'll have the afternoon to explore Dingle town at a relaxed pace, checking out the lively pubs, artisan shops, and catching some traditional music.

days.title: Dingle to Killarney
included: Ring of Kerry scenic drive with photo stops
days.description: The day starts at the Cliffs of Moher, where you'll walk the cliffside paths with views out to the Aran Islands and take photos of the cliffs rising over 700 feet above the Atlantic. After that, you'll cross the River Shannon by ferry and watch for dolphins in the water. Then it's south through County Kerry's lush pastures toward the Dingle Peninsula. You'll stop to watch a traditional sheepdog demonstration on a family farm where border collies work the flock, and later you'll arrive in colorful Dingle, a town known for its music scene and character.

days.title: Killarney
included: Guided tour of Killarney National Park
days.description: You'll wake in Killarney, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and ancient woodland. The day is yours to spend however you like. You might relax in town or head into Killarney National Park to explore. There are horse-drawn jaunting car tours available, bike rentals through scenic trails, or you can visit Ross Castle on the lake or the 19th-century Muckross House with its gardens. If you want a real Kerry adventure, the Gap of Dunloe and Lakes Tour combines hiking, boating, and valley views. In the evening, you could catch Celtic Steps, a show with Irish dance and traditional music.

days.title: Killarney to Kilkenny
days.description: After leaving Killarney, you'll travel east through the Golden Vale's rolling farmland and colorful villages to reach Blarney Castle and its gardens. You'll climb the winding stone steps and kiss the legendary Blarney Stone, then explore the surrounding gardens with their fern walks, waterfalls, and ancient druid stones. From there, you'll continue through County Tipperary to the Rock of Cashel, one of Ireland's striking heritage sites perched on a limestone outcrop with old towers and chapels. Later you'll arrive in medieval Kilkenny, known for its lively streets, artisan crafts, and historic character.

days.title: Kilkenny to Dublin
optional: Visit Kilkenny Castle (€8) - Self-guided tour of 12th century castle
St. Canice's Cathedral & Round Tower (€7) - Self-guided tour with cathedral and round tower views
Smithwick's Brewery Tour (€25) - Guided tour of historic brewery established 1710
Medieval Mile Museum (€7) - Historic exhibition including 13th century chamber
Ros Tapestry Exhibition (€8/€7) - Large-scale embroidered tapestry depicting Norman history
days.description: You'll have free time in Kilkenny to explore the Medieval Mile's historic architecture, browse artisan boutiques, and stop at cosy cafes for a scone or souvenir if you like. There's the option to visit Kilkenny Castle, climb St. Canice's Cathedral's round tower for city views, or check out the Smithwick's Experience to learn about Irish brewing. You could also see the Medieval Mile Museum or the Ros Tapestry Exhibition. After lunch, you'll relax as you head north through scenic Kildare and Wicklow counties, Ireland's horse country, arriving back in Dublin between 4:00 and 5:00 pm.

days.title: Beijing
days.start_point: Beijing, China (24-hour Airport Pick-up, 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive in Beijing at whatever time works for you. The hotel team will be waiting at either Beijing Capital or Daxing Airport to pick you up and drive you downtown to check in.

days.title: Beijing
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch, Dinner (A la carte welcome dinner featuring Peking Roast Duck and local delicacies)
days.description: Meeting the group at 08:00, you'll start with a guided tour hitting Beijing's main attractions. Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City's halls come first, then the Temple of Heaven. By evening you're watching an acrobatic show, and dinner features Peking Roast Duck along with other local specialties as your official welcome meal.

days.title: Beijing
included: Mutianyu Great Wall visit with round-trip cable car or chairlift
Hiking along the Great Wall ramparts
Red wine toast at Great Wall
Photo stop at Olympic venues (Bird's Nest and Water Cube)
Visit a local family in traditional courtyard
days.description: The day takes you to Mutianyu for a full experience on the Great Wall. You can use the cable car or chairlift to get up top, then hike the ramparts and take in the views. On the way back, you'll stop for photos at the Bird's Nest and Water Cube. Later there's a rickshaw tour through the old Hutong alleys and a visit to a local family's traditional courtyard home.

days.title: Beijing to Xi'an
days.description: Start the morning at the Summer Palace, an imperial garden with plenty to see. After lunch, you're heading to Beijing railway station to board a high-speed train bound for Xi'an, which takes about 4.5 to 5.5 hours. When you arrive, your guide and driver will be there to take you to the hotel.

days.title: Xi'an
included: Visit home of the Terracotta Army's original discoverer
Craft a mini terracotta warrior in a traditional workshop
Tang Dynasty Music and Dance Show
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch, Dinner (Gourmet Dumpling Dinner)
days.description: You'll begin at the Terracotta Army Museum to see the 2,200-year-old sculptures from the First Emperor's mausoleum. Then visit the home of the original discoverer and try making your own mini terracotta warrior in a workshop. Later comes the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, a Buddhist monument worth seeing. For dinner, you'll have a gourmet dumpling meal while watching a Tang Dynasty Music and Dance Show.

days.title: Xi'an to Shanghai
included: Shadowboxing masterclass at City Wall Park
Ascend Xi'an City Wall for panoramic views
Pass by Bell and Drum Towers
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch (A la carte local food lunch in Muslim Quarter)
days.description: This morning includes a shadowboxing masterclass at City Wall Park, experiencing traditional wellness like locals do. You'll walk up the Xi'an City Wall for views of the ancient city, then head through the Muslim Quarter to browse snacks and souvenirs while passing the Bell and Drum Towers. Lunch is a la carte local food, and after that you fly to Shanghai where your guide meets you at the airport and takes you to the hotel.

days.title: Shanghai
included: Explore traditional bazaar near Yu Garden
days.meals: Breakfast (Western buffet breakfast), Lunch (Pan-fried buns at a century-old restaurant with coffee)
days.description: Starting with Yu Garden, a classical Chinese garden, you'll also check out the nearby traditional bazaar. The Shanghai Museum is next, one of China's four largest. For lunch you're having pan-fried buns at a century-old restaurant plus coffee your guide orders. The afternoon includes a walk along the Bund to see the Western architecture, followed by a Huangpu River cruise to take in Shanghai's modern skyline before heading back to rest.

days.title: Shanghai
days.description: Check out of your hotel and head to the airport on your own for your flight home. Shanghai has two options: Pudong and Hongqiao airports, and both are easy to reach by metro or taxi.

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Explore the essence of North India on this 5-day Golden Triangle tour, covering three of the country’s most captivating cities—Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur. Perfect for first-time visitors or travelers with limited time, this compact journey blends history, culture, and architecture into one unforgettable experience.


Start in Delhi, where you’ll witness a fusion of old and new—from Mughal landmarks like Jama Masjid and Red Fort to the colonial charm of India Gate and Rajpath. In Agra, stand in awe before the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World, and visit the grand Agra Fort. Finally, immerse yourself in the regal beauty of Jaipur, the Pink City, known for its royal palaces, colorful bazaars, and the majestic Amber Fort.


Tour Highlights:


Explore the vibrant contrasts of Old and New Delhi


Visit the Taj Mahal at sunrise for the best views and photos


Discover the architectural grandeur of Agra Fort


Ride an elephant or jeep to Amber Fort in Jaipur


See Jaipur’s Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and local handicrafts


Enjoy comfortable transportation and expert local guides throughout


Ideal for travelers short on time but big on discovery, this tour offers a rich taste of India’s Golden Triangle in just five memorable days.

days.title: Delhi
days.start_point: New Delhi, Delhi, India (Pickup will be from either airport OR your prebooked hotel . , 09:00 - 11:00)
days.description: You'll arrive in Delhi and get settled at your hotel. From there, head into Old Delhi to see Raj Ghat, which is Mahatma Gandhi's memorial site, then walk through the Red Fort and check out Jama Masjid. After that, move to New Delhi where you'll find Humayun's Tomb, the Qutab Minar tower, and you'll pass by Rashtrapati Bhawan (the presidential residence) during a drive. End the day at India Gate memorial.

days.title: Agra
days.description: The drive takes you to Agra where you'll check into your hotel. Once settled, you can see the Taj Mahal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that's a masterpiece of Mughal architecture built as a mausoleum. Later, visit Agra Fort, another UNESCO site that shows off the history and palatial structures of Mughal rulers.

days.title: Agra to Jaipur
optional: Visit Fatehpur Sikri complex including Darbar-e-Aam
Explore Panch Mahal at Fatehpur Sikri
days.description: You're driving to Jaipur, and along the way there's a stop at Fatehpur Sikri, a well-preserved 16th-century ghost city that Emperor Akbar built. Spend time walking through the Darbar-e-Aam, palaces, Panch Mahal, and other structures that showcase Mughal design. Then continue on to Jaipur for check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Jaipur
optional: Jeep ride to Amber City Fort
Explore Amber Fort complex including gateways, courts, and palaces
days.description: After breakfast, head north about 11 km from Jaipur to Amber City Fort, which sits up in the Aravalli hills. You'll take a jeep ride up to explore the massive gateways, courtyards, and palatial structures. Back in Jaipur proper, visit the City Palace (still used by the royal family), the Jantar Mantar royal observatory, and the Hawa Mahal with its distinctive 1043 small windows.

days.title: Jaipur to Delhi
days.description: You'll drive back to Delhi and head to the airport for your departure flight.

reviews.reply:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. However, we would like to clarify that several allegations mentioned in this review are factually incorrect.

This tour was clearly marketed and operated as a Guaranteed Departure tour, which means the tour operates even with a minimum of 01 passenger. This condition is transparently mentioned in the tour description. Traveling solo in such cases does not mean the tour is “not real” or misleading; it simply reflects the guaranteed nature of the departure, which many travelers specifically prefer for flexibility and certainty.

Regarding communication, the itinerary was shared in advance, and hotel details are routinely provided once confirmed as per standard industry practice. At no point was information intentionally withheld. Our team remained available throughout the tour, and any queries raised were responded to promptly.

Concerning shopping visits, we categorically deny the allegation of “tourist scams.” All visits were to government-approved or long-established local artisan outlets, and guests are never obligated to make purchases. As also mentioned by the guest, one of our guides clearly informed in advance about such a visit, which demonstrates transparency—not malpractice.

Guide and driver arrangements were exactly as per the tour inclusions. Drivers in India are primarily responsible for safe transportation and punctuality, not guided commentary, which is why local licensed guides are provided city-wise. English proficiency can vary slightly by region, but all guides are licensed professionals. Notably, the guest themselves acknowledged that two guides were very clear and professional.

Regarding evenings, the tour is designed to conclude sightseeing by late afternoon to allow guests personal time for rest, exploration, or dining—this is standard practice and not a lack of support. Emergency and assistance contacts are always available.

We do appreciate the positive remarks about our driver and the final guide, which reflect the professionalism of our on-ground team.

While we respect every traveler’s opinion, we must firmly state that the claim of misleading marketing or lack of transparency is unfounded. We stand by the integrity of our tour operations and the accuracy of our tour descriptions.

We wish the guest the very best in their future travels.

intro:
Dive into the heart of India’s vibrant culture, royal legacy, and architectural wonders on this captivating journey through the iconic state of Rajasthan, paired with a visit to the breathtaking Taj Mahal.


This tour brings to life the rich tapestry of India—from the grandeur of palaces and forts to the colorful chaos of traditional markets. Begin in the capital city of Delhi, where Mughal and colonial history meet. Stand in awe before the Taj Mahal, the symbol of eternal love. Then, head into Rajasthan, where every city tells a story—Jaipur's royal splendor, Jodhpur's blue-hued alleys, Udaipur’s romantic lakes, and the golden desert charm of Jaisalmer.


Expect camel rides, cultural performances, traditional cuisine, and warm local hospitality as you explore this unforgettable land of kings and colors.


Tour Highlights:


Marvel at the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World


Explore Jaipur’s Amber Fort, City Palace, and bustling bazaars


Stroll through the blue streets of Jodhpur


Enjoy a romantic boat ride on Lake Pichola in Udaipur


Discover the golden dunes of Jaisalmer and its historic fort


Experience folk dances, camel safaris, and local arts


A perfect blend of history, culture, and royal elegance, this tour offers a true taste of Colorful India and the regal spirit of Rajasthan. This tour is a guaranteed departure, so even if you are the only one booked onto this tour, you will still be guaranteed to depart!

days.title: Delhi
optional: Visit Raj Ghat - Mahatma Gandhi's Memorial on the banks of the Yamuna River
Explore Red Fort - 17th century fortress with red sandstone walls, palaces and gardens
Visit Jama Masjid - India's largest mosque completed in 1656
See Humayun's Tomb - 16th century Mughal architecture
Visit Qutab Minar - 72.5m high tower of victory
Drive past Rashtrapati Bhawan - Official residence of the President of India
See India Gate - 42m monument commemorating soldiers
days.start_point: New Delhi, Delhi, India (Pickup will be from Delhi airport OR Prebooked hotel , 09:00 - 11:00)
days.description: You'll arrive in Delhi and get settled at your hotel. After that, head into Old Delhi to see Raj Ghat where Gandhi's memorial sits, then move on to the Red Fort with its imposing walls and Jama Masjid. The afternoon takes you to New Delhi where you can walk through Humayun's Tomb, check out Qutab Minar, pass by Rashtrapati Bhawan, and finish at India Gate before heading back for the evening.

days.title: Delhi to Agra
optional: Visit Agra Fort - medieval fortress with palaces, wells and mosque
See Taj Mahal - iconic mausoleum and UNESCO World Heritage Site
days.description: The drive to Agra takes most of your morning. Once you check in, you'll have time to explore this former Mughal capital sitting on the Yamuna River. Start with Agra Fort, originally built in brick with palaces, wells, and a mosque inside its walls. Then see the Taj Mahal, the white marble structure built as a tomb for Mumtaz Mahal and overlooking the river below.

days.title: Agra to Jaipur
optional: Visit Fatehpur Sikri - deserted medieval city with Darbar-e-Aam, palaces, and Panch Mahal
days.description: You'll head toward Jaipur with a stop at Fatehpur Sikri, a 16th century city built by Emperor Akbar that was mysteriously left empty after just 15 years due to water shortages. Wander through the Darbar-e-Aam, explore the palaces, and see the five-story Panch Mahal. Later you'll continue driving to Jaipur and check into your hotel for the night.

days.title: Jaipur
included: Excursion to Amber Fort with elephant ride to and from the top of the hill
optional: Browse markets for textiles, gems, carpets and handicrafts
days.description: This day focuses on Jaipur's highlights. You'll head out to Amber Fort just outside the city and ride an elephant up the hill to explore it. Back in the city, see the City Palace with its blend of Rajasthani and Mughal styles, walk through the Central Museum, and check out Jantar Mantar observatory. The Hawa Mahal with its distinctive honeycombed facade comes next. Your afternoon is yours to wander the markets hunting for textiles, gems, carpets, and local crafts.

days.title: Jaipur to Bikaner
included: Sightseeing of Bikaner including Junagarh Fort
days.description: You'll drive to Bikaner and get checked in at your hotel. After settling down, you can start exploring the city by visiting Junagarh Fort and then heading to the Camel Breeding Farm to see how these animals are raised and trained in this desert region.

days.title: Bikaner to Jaisalmer
days.description: The drive to Jaisalmer takes you further into the Thar Desert. Once you arrive, check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day settling in and maybe wandering the immediate area to get oriented to this desert city.

days.title: Jaisalmer
included: Evening drive to sand dunes with sunset viewing
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, head to Jaisalmer Fort (also called Sonar Kila), sitting about 30 meters above the city with an entire neighborhood built inside its walls. Walk through traditional havelis like Patwon ki Haveli and Salim ji ki Haveli. Visit Gadi Sagar Lake in the afternoon. Later you'll drive out to the sand dunes for sunset, take a camel ride, and stay overnight at a desert camp.

days.title: Jaisalmer to Jodhpur
days.description: You'll drive to Jodhpur by way of Osian and check into your hotel. Jodhpur's old city gets its nickname the Blue City from the blue-painted houses throughout. The city is ringed by a 10 kilometer wall with 101 bastions and seven gates. See Mehrangarh Fort perched on a steep hill with its ornate latticed windows, then visit Jaswant Thada, a white marble structure built to honor a former ruler.

days.title: Jodhpur to Udaipur
days.description: Today you're heading to Udaipur with a stop at Ranakpur along the way. After the drive, check into your hotel and relax after a full day of travel.

days.title: Udaipur
included: Evening boat ride on Lake Pichola
days.description: You'll explore Udaipur starting with Sahelion-Ki-Bari garden, which has open lawns and shaded walking paths. The Folk Art Museum holds traditional clothing, ornaments, puppets, masks, and musical instruments. Next is the City Palace, India's largest with contributions from four generations of Maharajas and decorated with peacock mosaics and tiny painted details. Stop by a traditional painting school to see the intricate miniature work. By evening, take a boat ride on Lake Pichola to see the Lake Palace, once a summer retreat and famous from James Bond films.

days.title: Udaipur
days.description: You'll get a timely transfer to Udaipur airport for your flight out, marking the end of your trip through Rajasthan and Delhi.

intro:
Begin your journey in Cairo, Egypt, where history unfolds before you. Wander at the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Valley of the Kings. Explore the Great Temple of Abu Simbel and the Karnak Temples; Each represents a testament to the majesty of the ancient wonders of Egypt.

­ 

Embark on a five-day Nile cruise between Luxor and Aswan, guided by expert Egyptologists. Gain insights into Egypt’s ancient history while enjoying local hospitality, and relax as you sail through timeless wonders and the magic of ancient civilizations at every stop.

­ ­

days.title: Cairo
optional: Earlier transfers before the trip starting for extra charge
days.start_point: Egypt (Arrival transfer from Cairo Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at Cairo airport where a representative meets you for your transfer to the hotel. After settling in, spend the evening taking in views of the city from your accommodation.

days.title: Cairo
included: Visit Great Pyramids of Giza (Cheops, Chefren, Mykerinus)
days.description: Start the day exploring the Great Pyramids of Giza complex, which includes the pyramids of Cheops, Chefren, and Mykerinus along with the Sphinx and Valley Temple. Later, head to the Grand Egyptian Museum to walk through its collection spanning 5,000 years of Ancient Egyptian civilization.

days.title: Cairo to Luxor
included: Visit Karnak Temple - Great Hypostyle Hall with statues of Ramses II and obelisks
Visit open-air temple complex of Amun
optional: Luxor city tour by horse carriage around Luxor city
days.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Luxor, then board your 5-star river cruise. Check out Karnak's Great Hypostyle Hall with its granite statues of Ramses II, obelisks, and the open-air temple complex of Amun. By evening, visit the illuminated Luxor Temple with its soaring columns and statues.

days.title: Luxor to Edfu
days.description: Start by visiting the Valley of the Kings and its 64 tombs and chambers. From there, explore the Colossi of Memnon and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut located beneath the cliffs at Deir el Bahari. After touring these monuments, sail to Edfu and enjoy a leisurely dinner on the ship.

days.title: Edfu to Kom Ombo
days.description: Visit the Edfu Temple, one of Egypt's best-preserved temples dedicated to the falcon god Horus, then explore the grounds. Head back on board for a relaxing lunch. Later sail towards Kom Ombo to see the temple complex dedicated to Sobek and Horus before returning to the ship for dinner.

days.title: Kom Ombo to Aswan
optional: Great Temples of Abu Simbel early morning tour
days.description: You have the option to take an early morning tour to the Great Temples of Abu Simbel, the magnificent sanctuaries built for Ramses II and Queen Nefertari (relocated in 1968 to prevent submersion). In the afternoon, there's an optional tour to the Nubian Village available. Return to the ship before dinner.

days.title: Aswan to Cairo
days.description: After breakfast you'll disembark from the cruise. Visit the Philae Temple on Agilkia Island (relocated during Aswan Dam construction in the 1960s) and check out the High Dam, constructed between 1960-1970 to increase hydroelectric power and regulate Nile flooding. Transfer to Aswan airport for your evening flight back to Cairo, then settle in for the night.

days.title: Depart Cairo
days.description: Have breakfast at your Cairo hotel, check out, and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight.

Known for being a destination that fulfills every traveler's dream, the country boasts stunning beaches, breathtaking mountain vistas, age-old sites, diverse wildlife, and a colorful cultural mosaic. Guided by an expert familiar with the deep-rooted history and customs of Sri Lanka, you'll explore a variety of intriguing and important locations. days.title: Negombo/Colombo to Sigiriya
included: Visit Golden Cave Temple at Dambulla
optional: 4x4 safari in the evening at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco National Park
days.start_point: Colombo, Sri Lanka (Any Hotet at Colombo, Negombo or Airport)
days.description: Your tour leader meets you at the airport and drives you toward Sigiriya, which is about 3 hours and 20 minutes away covering 146 km. On the way, you'll stop at the Golden Cave Temple in Dambulla to walk around and see the site. Depending on where elephants are spotted that day, there's a chance for a 4x4 safari in one of the national parks before evening. You'll settle in at your hotel for the night.

days.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
included: Visit Hindu temple on Kandy city tour
Watch Traditional Kandyan Cultural Dance Performance
Visit Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
landmarks: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
days.description: Head out early to climb Sigiriya Rock while it's still cool, then come back down for breakfast at your hotel. After that, you'll drive about 2 hours and 30 minutes to Kandy (86 km) with several stops along the way including Nalanda Gedige, a spice garden in Matale, and a gem museum. That evening, you'll explore a Hindu temple during a Kandy city tour, watch a traditional Kandyan cultural dance performance, and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll head to Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens in Kandy and walk through the grounds. Then you'll drive to Nuwara Eliya, which takes about 3 hours to cover 77 km. Along the route, you'll stop at Ramboda Falls and visit a tea factory and tea plantation to see how tea is grown and processed. You'll spend the night in Nuwara Eliya.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella
included: Scenic train ride from Nanu Oya to Ella
Evening hike up Little Adam's Peak
optional: Visit Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya (time permitting)
Explore The Grand Hotel, Nuwara Eliya (time permitting)
Visit Nuwara Eliya Post Office (time permitting)
Private vehicle transfer Nuwara Eliya to Ella (if train tickets unavailable)
days.description: You'll board a scenic train from Nanu Oya heading to Ella, traveling through tea plantations and misty mountains along one of the world's most famous rail routes. If your train leaves in the afternoon, you'll have time to check out Gregory Lake and The Grand Hotel in Nuwara Eliya first. Once you arrive in Ella, head out for an evening hike up Little Adam's Peak where you'll get panoramic views across the hill country.

days.title: Ella to Tissamaharama
optional: Udawalawe National Park Safari (alternative to Yala)
days.description: Start by visiting Rawana Waterfall and Buduruwagala Rock Temple as you make your way toward Tissamaharama. Later in the evening, you'll go on a 4x4 safari through Yala National Park, Sri Lanka's most popular wildlife park along the Indian Ocean coast. You might spot wildlife during your drive through the park.

days.title: Tissamaharama to Mirissa
optional: Visit local buffalo farm and learn traditional Sri Lankan buffalo curd-making
Boat ride on Tissamaharama Lake to observe natural surroundings and local birdlife
Nilwala Crocodile Safari in Matara to explore river environment and observe wildlife
days.description: Start with breakfast at your hotel before driving toward Mirissa on a scenic 120 km route that takes around 2 hours. Along the way you'll have chances to stop at a local buffalo farm to watch traditional curd-making, or take a boat ride on Tissamaharama Lake where you can spot local birds. There's also the Nilwala Crocodile Safari in Matara if that interests you. Once you reach Mirissa, check in at your beach hotel and relax by the ocean for the rest of the evening.

days.title: Mirissa to Colombo/Negombo Airport
included: Blue whale watching from Mirissa Port
optional: Visit Sea Turtle Hatchery & Rescue Center
days.description: Get going early at 6:30 AM for blue whale watching from Mirissa Port. Return to your hotel for breakfast, then check out. Depending on your flight time, you might visit the Sea Turtle Hatchery & Rescue Center, take a boat safari on the Madu River, or see Galle Dutch Fort, which dates back to 1588 and was later strengthened by the Dutch starting in 1649. You'll then transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport in Colombo or Negombo, which is about 3 hours away covering 180 km.

name: Japan Classic 10 Day - One Life Adventures

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro:
Japan is a place where the past and future collide – think samurai culture, ancient shrines, and cutting-edge cities that never sleep. Whether you’re a foodie, into anime, a solo traveller, or just love a good cultural deep dive, this is the trip you’ve been waiting for.


Learn to roll sushi like a pro, spar with a samurai descendant in a Kendo class, and explore Kyoto’s Gion District, where you might just spot a Geisha. You’ll even spend a night in a traditional Japanese temple (yes, it’s as cool as it sounds). Voted the #1 small group tour in the world, this adventure is everything you’ve dreamed of and more.

days.title: Tokyo
days.start_point: サクラホテル日暮里, 千駄木3-43-15, 東京都, Tokyo Prefecture 113-0022, Japan (Sakura Hotel, Nippori Reception)
days.description: You'll arrive in Tokyo and get settled into your hostel. After you drop off your bags, there's a welcome dinner with the group featuring Japanese cuisine. Later in the evening, head over to Senso-ji Temple. It's worth visiting at night when the crowds thin out, so you can actually see the temple and walk around without fighting through masses of people.

days.title: Tokyo
included: Visit to Meiji Shrine in Yoyogi Park
days.description: Start the day with a Japan Orientation Briefing where you'll pick up some basic customs and useful phrases. Then walk through Meiji Shrine in Yoyogi Park, which is a peaceful spot in the middle of the city. After that, check out Harajuku with its quirky shops and bright streets. By evening, head to Akihabara to see the neon lights, wander through shops and arcades, and hit up one of the Maid Cafes if that appeals to you.

days.title: Tokyo
included: Private sushi making class (includes Miso soup, three types of sushi, and Teriyaki)
Visit to Omoide Yokocho alley in Shinjuku
days.description: After breakfast, you'll take a private sushi making class and learn to prepare Miso soup, three different types of sushi, and some Teriyaki techniques. In the evening, take the train to Shinjuku to catch the Tokyo skyline. Grab dinner nearby, then walk over to see the famous Shibuya Pedestrian Crossing. You can also check out Omoide Yokocho alley, a little narrow street with lots of character and restaurants.

days.title: Tokyo to Hakone
included: Romance Car train journey to Hakone
Exploration of Hakone and surrounding areas
optional: Owakudani visit (not advisable for those with asthma/respiratory conditions)
days.description: Hop on the 'Romance Car' train for a scenic ride to Hakone, a mountain town, and check in at your mountain guesthouse. Spend the day exploring the area using different transport options and trying the local food. You might get a view of Mt. Fuji if weather cooperates. Later, gather for a family group dinner where you can play some games and get to know people better.

days.title: Hakone to Takayama
included: Overnight stay at temple in Takayama
days.description: Experience the shinkansen bullet train for the first time, watching them zip by on the platform before you board. Keep your eyes open for Mt. Fuji as you travel. You'll arrive in Takayama, a UNESCO World Heritage town, and check into a temple for the night. In the afternoon, visit a local brewery to sample sake and then try some famous Hida beef for dinner.

days.title: Takayama to Kyoto
included: Morning walk around old town Takayama
Visit to Miyagawa River morning market
Gion District walking tour with local guide
days.description: In the morning, walk through Takayama's old town and village, stopping by the morning market along the Miyagawa River. Later, take the bullet train to Kyoto. Once you arrive, go on an evening walking tour of the Gion district with a local guide. This is the area known for traditional Geisha entertainment, and you might spot one if luck's on your side.

days.title: Kyoto
included: Early morning visit to Fushimi-Inari Shrine with red torii gates
Traditional Tea Ceremony with kimono rental option
days.description: Wake up before dawn and take the subway to Fushimi-Inari Shrine. By arriving early, you'll beat most of the tourist crowds and can explore the mountain's red gate corridors on your own. Head to Kiyomizu-dera temple next, a wooden complex built high on the mountainside with bamboo all around. Later, participate in a traditional Tea Ceremony and rent a kimono. You'll have the rest of the day free to check out whatever interests you.

days.title: Kyoto
included: Traditional Kendo class with Bushido instructor
days.description: Start by visiting the Golden Pavilion, a gold-covered building reflected in a lake. Then head to Daitoku-ji, a quiet temple complex with lots of greenery and history. In the afternoon, attend a traditional Kendo class in a dojo where an instructor descended from Samurai will teach you this respectful martial art and explain the Bushido traditions behind it.

days.title: Kyoto to Osaka
included: Traditional Japanese boat ride through valleys
days.description: Take a train to Arashiyama, a town with mountains surrounding it and a river running through. Walk through the bamboo forest, climb up Monkey Mountain, and experience a traditional Japanese boat ride through the valleys. Then head to Osaka and explore Dotonbori, known as the 'kitchen of Japan' where you'll see incredible food, crowds, lights, and colors. Wrap up the evening with karaoke.

days.title: Osaka
days.description: After recovering from last night's karaoke, it's time to say goodbye to your group and the friends you've made. The tour ends here, and you'll head off having experienced so much of what Japan has to offer.

name: Italy By High-Speed Train

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Private Tour
attributes.tip: Travel exclusively with your friends and family

attributes.tip: Independent travel, featuring selected guided excursions

intro: Begin an unforgettable journey through Italy’s most iconic cities, where history, art, and culture intertwine. This carefully designed itinerary starts in Rome, the Eternal City, where you’ll explore the magnificent Vatican and its historic streets. Travel by high-speed train to Florence, the birthplace of the Renaissance, and enjoy the stunning landscapes of Tuscany, with stops in Siena, San Gimignano, and Pisa. Your adventure then takes you to the magical canals of Venice, where a guided tour of St. Mark’s Basilica and the Doge’s Palace will immerse you in the city’s rich history. From world-renowned landmarks to charming local experiences, this trip provides the perfect balance of guided exploration and personal discovery, showcasing the beauty and heritage of Italy.

days.title: Rome
days.description: You'll arrive in Rome and make your own way to the hotel. Once you're settled in, spend the rest of the day walking around and getting a feel for the city. Start with whatever catches your eye, whether that's wandering through neighborhoods, grabbing an early dinner, or just soaking in the atmosphere.

days.title: Rome
included: Skip-the-line small group tour of Vatican Museums
optional: Independent exploration of Rome city center
days.description: Your driver picks you up at the hotel in the morning for a small group tour of the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with skip-the-line access. You'll walk through the Gallery of Tapestries, the Geographical Maps, and Raphael's rooms before reaching the Sistine Chapel itself. After the guided portion wraps up, head back into central Rome on your own to explore further, then return to your hotel independently.

days.title: Rome to Florence
days.description: Travel to Roma Termini train station and take the high-speed train to Florence. When you arrive, head to your hotel near Santa Maria Novella Train Station. The afternoon is yours to wander around Florence at your own pace and start getting familiar with the city.

days.title: Tuscany Day Tour
included: Scenic stop at Florence's panoramic viewpoint
Visit Siena central square and cathedral
Traditional homemade lunch at family vineyard in Chianti
Exploration of San Gimignano medieval town
optional: Shopping for local souvenirs in San Gimignano
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional homemade lunch in Chianti at family vineyard)
days.description: A full-day guided tour takes you into Tuscany with a local guide and driver. First stop is one of Florence's best viewpoints for photos and perspective. From there, you'll head to Siena for a walking tour of the historic center, including the famous central square and the cathedral. Later, you'll have a traditional homemade lunch and wine tasting at a family vineyard in Chianti. The tour finishes with time in the medieval town of San Gimignano before driving back to Florence.

days.title: Florence to Venice
days.description: Head to Florence Santa Maria Novella Train Station and board the high-speed train to Venice. You'll arrive at Venice Santa Lucia Train Station and then make your own way to the hotel. Get settled in and you're free for the evening.

days.title: Venice
included: Skip-the-line guided tour of St. Mark's Basilica
Guided exploration of 8,000 square meters of golden mosaics
Visit Horses of St. Mark's Basilica
Ascent to balcony for views of St. Mark's Square and Venetian lagoon
days.description: A full-day small group tour covers Venice's main sights with skip-the-line access. You'll visit St. Mark's Basilica and walk through 8,000 square meters of golden mosaics, see the famous Horses of St. Mark's, and climb to the balcony for views over the square and lagoon. Then it's on to the Doge's Palace where you'll learn about how Venice was governed, and you'll cross the Bridge of Sighs to see the historic prisons. The guide shares context on Venetian politics and history throughout.

days.title: Venice
days.description: Have breakfast before the tour service ends for the day.

intro:
Discover India's vibrant culture with the Golden Triangle Tour! Visit Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur to explore their rich heritage. Add Ranthambore for a wildlife adventure. Here's a sneak peek.

­ 

Explore the Golden Triangle of India

Delhi: Kick off your adventure in the lively city of Delhi. Immerse yourself in its rich history by visiting iconic landmarks such as the Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and India Gate. Enjoy the bustling markets of Chandni Chowk and the peaceful surroundings of Humayun's Tomb.

­ 

Agra: Make your way to Agra to witness the breathtaking Taj Mahal, a symbol of love and architectural wonder. Don't miss exploring the Agra Fort and, if time allows, the picturesque Mehtab Bagh for a different perspective of the Taj Mahal.

­ 

Jaipur: the Pink City, offers a royal experience with grand forts, palaces, and landmarks like Amber Fort, City Palace, and Hawa Mahal. Enjoy shopping for traditional handicrafts and jewelry in local markets.

­ 

Ranthambore: Conclude your journey with an exciting wildlife experience at Ranthambore National Park. Discover famous tigers on safari tours, spot wildlife in their habitat. Prepare for an adventure in India's Golden Triangle!🐅🕌🇮🇳

days.title: Delhi
days.start_point: New Delhi, Delhi, India (Pickup is offered from hotel, airport, railway station, or other requested pickup location in Delhi, Noida, or Gurugram, 08:00 - 13:00)
days.description: Your driver meets you at Delhi Airport and takes you straight into the capital. Start in Old Delhi where you'll take a cycle-rickshaw through Chandni Chowk's crowded markets, then see Jama Masjid and the Red Fort up close. After that, head to New Delhi to check out Lotus Temple, Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar, India Gate, and Rashtrapati Bhavan. By evening you'll settle into your hotel.

days.title: Delhi
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, you'll go to Gurudwara Bangla Sahib to see the beautiful Sikh temple and its sacred Sarovar pool while learning about Sikh traditions. From there, head to Gandhi Smriti museum where you can explore Mahatma Gandhi's life and his role in India's independence. Back at your hotel by afternoon, you'll have time to relax.

days.title: Delhi to Agra
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch at a local restaurant with authentic Mughlai flavors)
days.description: Following breakfast, your drive to Agra takes about 3 hours. Once there, you'll walk through Agra Fort to see its grand Mughal architecture, then move on to Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb with its detailed marble inlay work. You'll grab lunch at a local restaurant serving authentic Mughlai food. Later in the evening, you'll head to Mehtab Bagh to watch the sunset and take in the atmosphere around the Taj Mahal before returning to your hotel.

days.title: Agra to Ranthambore
included: Explore Fatehpur Sikri monuments including Buland Darwaza and Jama Masjid
days.description: Head out early to catch the Taj Mahal at sunrise, which gives you that quiet moment before crowds arrive. Once you're done there, you'll head back for breakfast and a chance to rest up a bit. After that, you're driving through Rajasthan's open landscape toward Ranthambore, but you'll stop at Fatehpur Sikri along the way. Take time to walk through the red-sandstone structures here, particularly the Buland Darwaza gate and the Jama Masjid, both impressive from an architectural standpoint. By evening you'll reach Ranthambore and get settled into your hotel, giving you time to relax before the wildlife safari starts.

days.title: Ranthambore
included: Morning jungle safari in shared Gypsy/canter
days.description: Rising early, you'll head out on a morning jungle safari in an open Gypsy or canter with a naturalist guide through forests, lakes, and grasslands. Keep your camera ready for chances to spot Royal Bengal tigers, leopards, sloth bears, striped hyenas, deer, wild boars, and birds. Back at the hotel for breakfast and some free time. Later you'll do an afternoon safari, and if it's cooler season, relax by a campfire in the evening.

days.title: Ranthambore to Jaipur
included: Guided tour of Albert Hall Museum
days.description: After breakfast, you'll have a comfortable 3-hour 25-minute drive from Ranthambore to Jaipur, Rajasthan's famous Pink City. Once you check into your hotel, your expert guide will meet you and walk through Jaipur's royal heritage including the City Palace, the UNESCO-listed Jantar Mantar, and the Albert Hall Museum. After sightseeing, you'll head back to your hotel to relax and rest.

days.title: Jaipur to New Delhi
included: Visit to Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
days.description: Start with breakfast and then meet your guide to explore the majestic Amber Fort, a hilltop fortress that represents Jaipur's royal heritage. You can take a jeep ride up to the fort if you'd like. From there, you'll continue to Hawa Mahal, the iconic Palace of Winds, with a photo stop at the serene Jal Mahal. Later, you'll depart Jaipur for New Delhi in a comfortable drive of approximately 4 hours 30 minutes, arriving at New Delhi Airport in time for your onward flight.

intro: Specially designed for first time travelers to India, classic introduction to the rich culture, tradition, and history, Golden Triangle and Ganges travel package is a must for all those who have been traveling to India for the first time; history buffs and spiritually inclined people. As the name says, in this tour you will be not only visiting the golden triangle attractions (Delhi, Agra and Jaipur) and river, Varanasi and  From architectural marvels to natural beauty to rejuvenating location to colorful rural life, the golden triangle tour encompasses it all. Such is this tours beauty that Photographers and culture lovers won't be disappointed at all.Classical India tour takes you through the hubs of Indian culture and heritage. Covering some of the most famous and exotic destinations of the country, the trip is designed to give you a complete traveling experience in terms of shopping, dining, sightseeing and entertainment while giving you an in depth tour of Indian history and culture.The tour combines the spiritual attractions of the famous Hindu pilgrimage city of Varanasi.

days.title: Delhi
included: Warm welcome at Delhi International Airport in traditional Indian style
Private car transfer from airport to hotel
days.start_point: Indira Gandhi International Airport, New Delhi, New Delhi, Delhi, India (We will arrange your pick up either from Indra Gandhi International Airport or your Pre booked accommodation.)
days.description: You'll land at Delhi International Airport where the WTX team greets you in traditional Indian style. A private car takes you to your hotel, giving you time to settle in and rest after your flight.

days.title: Delhi
included: Guided panoramic tour of Old and New Delhi
Rickshaw ride (tri-cycle tour) at Chandni Chowk market in Old Delhi
Visit Raj Ghat (memorial to Mahatma Gandhi)
days.description: After breakfast, head into Old Delhi for a rickshaw ride through the busy Chandni Chowk market. You'll see the Jama Mosque, one of Asia's largest ancient mosque complexes, and the Red Fort from 1648. By afternoon, check out New Delhi's landmarks: Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, President's House, and Qutub Minar before heading back to your hotel.

days.title: Delhi to Jaipur
included: Road transfer from Delhi to Jaipur
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive toward Jaipur, the 'Pink City' founded in 1727. Once you arrive and check in, you can see the city's distinctive pink-washed buildings and notice how it's surrounded by hills with forts and palaces. The city layout itself reflects careful urban planning from centuries ago.

days.title: Jaipur
included: Car/Battery Rikshwa ride in Jaipur to climb Amer Fort
optional: Elephant ride to Amber Fort (approximately INR 2500 per elephant, direct payment basis)
Shopping at colorful markets of textiles, gems, carpets, and handicrafts
days.description: After breakfast, head to Amber Fort just outside the city. You get to choose between an elephant ride or jeep ride up to the fort. Back in the city, you'll tour City Palace, Central Museum, Jantar Mantar, and Hawa Mahal in the afternoon. Later, the afternoon is yours to wander the markets for textiles, gems, carpets, and handicrafts.

days.title: Jaipur to Fatehpur Sikri to Agra
included: Visit Buland Darwaja (world's tallest door at Fatehpur Sikri)
Road transfer from Jaipur to Agra
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive toward Agra. Along the way, stop at Fatehpur Sikri, the old Mughal Dynasty town built in red sandstone, where you can see the Buland Darwaja, the world's tallest door. Continue on to Agra, which sits beautifully on the Yamuna River. Check in to your hotel and take it easy.

days.title: Agra to Varanasi
included: Tonga ride (horse carriage) to reach near Taj Mahal
Overnight train transfer from Agra/Delhi to Varanasi (2 AC)
optional: Shopping in local markets of Agra
days.description: After breakfast, tour Agra Fort, built by Akbar in 1565. You'll explore the fort's historic structures and get views of the Taj Mahal from inside. Spend the afternoon shopping in local markets. Later, visit the Taj Mahal, one of the seven wonders of the world. By evening, you'll head to the railway station to board an overnight train to Varanasi.

days.title: Varanasi
included: Private car transfer from railway station to hotel
Ganga Aarti ceremony on Ganges river
days.description: You'll arrive at Varanasi railway station in the morning and head to your hotel to check in. After freshening up, go to Sarnath, one of Buddhism's four most sacred sites where Buddha taught after enlightenment. Return to Varanasi for a city tour: Alamgir Mosque, Dasaswamedh Ghat, and Bharat Mata Temple. In the evening, watch the Ganga Aarti ceremony on the river.

days.title: Varanasi
included: Private car transfer from hotel to Varanasi airport
days.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Varanasi airport for your onward flight.

days.title: Kathmandu
days.meals: Dinner (Traditional Nepali dinner with dance performances at Nepali Restaurant)
days.description: You'll arrive at Kathmandu airport where staff will greet you with traditional Nepali flowers. The evening includes a welcome dinner at a local Nepali restaurant with traditional food and dance performances to kick off your trip.

days.title: Bhaktapur - Nagarkot
included: Walking tour of Bhaktapur ancient city
Visit to Dattatreya Square Picture Gallery
Visit to Bell of Barking Dogs
days.description: After breakfast, you'll walk down to the medieval city of Bhaktapur to see its ancient architecture and temples like the 55 Window Palace, Lion Gate, and Nyatapola Temple. Then it's about a 40-minute drive to Nagarkot where you can catch sunset views of Everest, Lantang, Annapurna and other peaks.

days.title: Nagarkot - Trishuli River
included: Sunrise viewing from hotel or view tower
days.description: Wake early to watch sunrise from your hotel or view tower, then have breakfast. After that, you'll drive 4 hours to Trishuli River Tented beach camp for a 3-hour rafting adventure on Class 3-4 rapids. Later, spend the evening at the river beach swimming, playing games, or relaxing.

days.title: Chitwan National Park
days.description: You'll drive 3-4 hours after breakfast to reach Chitwan National Park and check in at the resort. There's a briefing on facilities and the daily schedule, lunch at 1 PM, a village tour at 4 PM, then a Tharu dance and culture show at 7 PM before dinner at 8 PM.

days.title: Chitwan National Park
included: Canoe ride along Elephant breeding center
4WD jeep safari at Chitwan National Park
Slides presentation about flora and fauna of National Park
days.description: Start with breakfast at 7 AM, then canoe along the Elephant breeding center at 7:30 AM. After lunch at noon, you'll do a 4WD jeep safari through Chitwan National Park at 1 PM. A slides presentation about the park's wildlife happens at 7 PM before dinner at 8 PM.

days.title: Chitwan - Pokhara
days.description: Early bird watching starts at 5:30 AM after tea or coffee, breakfast at 6:30 AM. Pack your things and take a 4-hour tourist bus ride to Pokhara at 7:30 AM. Check in at your hotel, then head to Davi's Fall waterfall 2km from the airport. Later, visit the Lakeside area in the evening.

days.title: Pokhara - Dhampus
days.description: You'll drive from Pokhara to Phedi (950m elevation) in one hour, then start hiking to Dhampus (1650m). The trek takes about four hours and you'll be going through the foothills with changing landscapes throughout.

days.title: Sarangkot - Pokhara
days.description: Rise early to watch the sunrise and see panoramic views of the Annapurna foothills, then trek back to Pokhara over about 4 hours. In the evening, head to Phewa Lake (Phewa Tal), the valley's largest lake, where you can go boating and watch birds with mountain reflections in the water.

days.title: Pokhara - Kathmandu
days.description: After breakfast, you'll take a 7-hour drive back to Kathmandu and check in at your hotel. Later, visit Swayambhunath, a 2,000-year-old Buddhist monument on a hilltop about 3km from the city center with temples, pagodas, and red-faced monkeys around the hemispherical stupa.

days.title: Kathmandu
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll visit Pashupatinath, one of Hinduism's holiest shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva, located 5km east of the city with temples and hermitages. Then head to Boudhanath, the world's largest Buddhist shrine about 2km north with its dome-shaped structure and Buddha eyes. The afternoon and evening are free for shopping and relaxing in Thamel.

days.title: Kathmandu
days.description: Your final day is open for last-minute shopping or a spa visit if you'd like. Later, you'll get a transfer from your hotel to the airport to catch your international flight home.

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships
