name: Splendour of Sri Lanka - (8 Days and 7 Nights tour in Sri Lanka)

attributes.name: Safari
attributes.tip: Track iconic wildlife on unforgettable game drives

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Set off on the 'Splendour of Sri Lanka,' an extraordinary 8-day excursion that masterfully combines historical richness with the splendor of nature, perfectly harmonizing city adventures with tranquil times on sandy shores. Relish the authentic and heartfelt hospitality found in the delightful accommodations scattered throughout Sri Lanka. Known for being a destination that fulfills every traveler's dream, the country boasts stunning beaches, breathtaking mountain vistas, age-old sites, diverse wildlife, and a colorful cultural mosaic. Guided by an expert familiar with the deep-rooted history and customs of Sri Lanka, you'll explore a variety of intriguing and important locations. More than just a holiday, the 'Splendour of Sri Lanka' tour is set to become a collection of joyous memories that will last a lifetime. As a destination that's gentle on the wallet, Sri Lanka offers exceptional experiences without the hefty price tag.

days.title: Negombo/Colombo to Sigiriya
included: Visit the Golden Cave Temple at Dambulla
optional: 4x4 safari in the evening at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco National Park
days.start_point: Colombo, Sri Lanka (Tour Start, 08:00 - 09:00)
days.description: Your tour leader meets you at the airport and drives you toward Sigiriya, which takes about 3 hours and 20 minutes covering 146 km. During the journey, you'll stop at the Golden Cave Temple in Dambulla to walk through the caves and see the Buddha statues. Later in the afternoon or evening, depending on where the elephants are that day, you'll head out for a 4x4 safari at one of the nearby parks like Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco National Park to spot wildlife.

days.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
included: Kandy city tour with Hindu temple visit
optional: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
landmarks: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
days.description: Get up early to climb Sigiriya Rock and take photos before the heat gets intense. After coming back down, you'll have breakfast at your hotel, then head out toward Kandy, which is about 2 hours and 30 minutes away. Along the route, you stop at Nalanda Gedige for its historical significance and the Matale Spice Garden to learn about local spices. Once in Kandy, you'll do a city tour that includes visiting a Hindu temple for some cultural insight. By evening, you'll watch the traditional Kandyan cultural dance performance and go to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens and the Gem Museum and Workshop, both in Kandy. Then you'll travel to Nuwara Eliya, which is about 3 hours away. During the drive, you'll stop at Ramboda Falls, visit a tea factory, and walk through a tea plantation to see how the tea is grown and processed. You'll be staying overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella
included: Scenic train ride from Nanu Oya to Ella
Evening hike up Little Adam's Peak
optional: Nuwara Eliya Post Office visit (time permitting)
Buduruwagala Rock Temple entrance (950 LKR per person)
days.description: Your day starts early if you're catching the morning train from Nanu Oya station. The train ride itself is the main event here, winding through tea plantations and mountain terrain for several hours. If your departure is later in the afternoon, you'll have time to check out Gregory Lake for a walk around the water, stop by The Grand Hotel to see the colonial architecture, and pop into the historic Nuwara Eliya Post Office before heading to the station. Once you arrive in Ella, there's still daylight left to hike up Little Adam's Peak, which takes about an hour and gets you high enough to see across the hill country. The views from up there are really something, especially in the late afternoon light.

days.title: Ella to Tissamaharama
optional: Evening 4x4 safari in Yala National Park
days.description: You start by visiting Rawana waterfall and the Buduruwagala Rock Temple to walk around and see the carved Buddha figures. From there, you travel toward Tissamaharama, covering 88 km in roughly 2 hours. Once you arrive and settle in, you'll head out in the evening for a 4x4 safari through Yala National Park, which is Sri Lanka's largest park and sits along the Indian Ocean coast, giving you chances to spot wildlife as the day winds down.

days.title: Tissamaharama to Mirissa
optional: Local buffalo farm visit and curd-making experience
Whale watching boat tour (65 USD per person)
Snake Farm visit (3,000 LKR per person)
days.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel, then head out on a 2-hour drive covering 120 km from Tissamaharama down to Mirissa. During the journey, you can stop at a local buffalo farm if you'd like to see how they make traditional Sri Lankan buffalo curd and learn about village life. Another option is taking a boat ride on Tissamaharama Lake to watch for birds, or you could do the Nilwala Crocodile Safari near Matara if wildlife spotting interests you. Once you reach Mirissa and check into your beach hotel, the rest of your evening is yours to relax and take in the ocean views from the shore.

days.title: Mirissa
optional: Watch sunset from Coconut Tree Hill
days.description: Start very early, around 6:30 AM, to go whale watching from Mirissa. You'll come back to your hotel after that and spend the rest of the day exploring Parrot Rock and catching the sunset from Coconut Tree Hill. The afternoon and evening are free for swimming or just lounging at your beachfront hotel. You're staying overnight in Mirissa.

days.title: Mirissa to Colombo/Negombo/Airport
optional: Visit Sea Turtle Hatchery & Rescue Center
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel and check out. Depending on when your flight departs, you might visit the Sea Turtle Hatchery and Rescue Center, take a boat safari on the Madu River, and explore the Galle Dutch Fort, which was originally built by the Portuguese in 1588 and then strengthened by the Dutch starting in 1649. After these stops, you'll be driven to Bandaranaike International Airport, which is about 3 hours and 45 minutes away for your flight home.

intro:
Embark on a 8-day adventure in Egypt to explore the ancient pyramids and temples that have captivated travelers for centuries. This tour takes you through the heart of Egypt, from the bustling city of Cairo to the serene Nile River and beyond.


Your journey begins in Cairo, where you'll visit the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx. You'll also have the opportunity to explore the Egyptian Museum, home to an impressive collection of artifacts from ancient Egypt.


Next, you'll board  cruise ship for a journey down the Nile River. Along the way, you'll visit temples dedicated to gods and goddesses such as Karnak and Luxor. You'll also have a chance to explore lesser-known sites like Edfu and Kom Ombo.



Throughout your journey, you'll be accompanied by knowledgeable guides who will share their expertise on ancient Egyptian history and culture. With comfortable accommodations and delicious meals included, this adventure is sure to be an unforgettable experience.

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo, Cairo, Egypt (Cairo International Airport)
days.description: You'll land at Cairo International Airport where someone from Truly Egypt Tours meets you. An air-conditioned vehicle takes you to your hotel, and your guide will handle check-in and go over what's coming up during the trip, including the Nile cruise and pyramid visits.

days.title: Cairo to Luxor
days.meals: Breakfast (5-star hotel breakfast at Cairo accommodation), Lunch, Dinner
days.description: After a 5-star breakfast at your Cairo hotel, you fly to Luxor. Once you arrive, your guide takes you through Karnak and Luxor temples before heading to your Nile cruise boat. Meals are included throughout the day as part of the full-board package.

days.title: Luxor to Edfu
included: Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut tour
days.description: This morning starts on the West Bank of Luxor where you'll see the Valley of the Kings with its 64 pharaonic tombs. You'll also visit the Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon before returning to your cruise boat. From there, you sail toward Edfu and pass through the Esna Lock.

days.title: Edfu to Aswan
included: Temple of Horus in Edfu guided tour
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Gourmet lunch onboard while cruising), Dinner
days.description: Breakfast comes early on your cruise, then you head to the Temple of Horus in Edfu. After that, you'll see Kom Ombo with its two temples dedicated to Sobek and Horus. Lunch is onboard while you cruise south toward Aswan, where you'll arrive by evening.

days.title: Aswan
days.description: Following breakfast, you explore Aswan's Old Dam and the Aswan High Dam, both significant structures in Egypt's history. Next, you take a boat to Philae Temple on Agilika Island, which honors the goddess Isis. Back on your cruise boat, you'll have a quiet night.

days.title: Aswan to Cairo
optional: Abu Simbel temples tour (scenic 3-hour desert drive from Aswan, visiting Great Temple of Ramses II and Temple of Hathor)
landmarks: Temple of Hathor at Abu Simbel
days.description: After breakfast, you have the option to drive 3 hours through the desert to Abu Simbel and see Ramses II's twin temples with the Hathor temple. These sites were moved in the 1960s to higher ground. Later you return to Aswan and fly back to Cairo for the night.

days.title: Cairo
included: Egyptian Museum (or new Grand Egyptian Museum) tour
days.description: Your day focuses on Giza where you'll see the Great Pyramid, Pyramid of Khafre, Pyramid of Menkaure, and the Great Sphinx. Then you spend time at the Egyptian Museum (or the newer Grand Egyptian Museum) looking at Tutankhamun's items and thousands of other artifacts. You return to Cairo for the evening.

days.title: Cairo - Departure
days.description: A vehicle from Truly Egypt Tours takes you to Cairo International Airport for your departure. If you want to stay longer or need custom arrangements, the tour company can help set that up for you.

intro: Chocolate and Cheese. Alps and Alp horns. Precision timepieces and timeless scenery. There is so much to yodel about in sweet and scenic Switzerland. With snow-dusted peaks in view from Zurich to Geneva to Lucerne, this uplifting tour of Switzerland has many elevating experiences in store. A stroll through the13th-century Gruyères Castle, a drive through the picturesque vineyards of the “Swiss Riviera,” and a tasting at the delectable Maison Cailler chocolate factory are just the beginning of your delightful ascent. You’ll also visit the resort towns of Gstaad and Interlaken before heading via mountain train to the “Top of Europe,” the nickname for Jungfraujoch, Europe’s highest railway station at more than 11,000 feet. This Alpine wonderland of ice and snow, complete with multiple viewing terraces and an Ice Palace, is not just high in elevation—it’s the highlight of this spectacular Swiss journey.PLUS, your tour includes your choice of excursions in Geneva so you can plan your day your way.

days.title: Zurich
days.description: You'll arrive in Zurich and check into your hotel. This evening at 6 pm, there's a welcome dinner where you can meet your tour director and fellow travelers. It's a good chance to settle in and get oriented before your week begins.

days.title: Zurich - Biel/Bienne - Neuchâtel - Geneva
included: Orientation walk of Zurich's Old Town
days.description: Start the morning with an orientation walk through Zurich's Old Town, passing the Fraumünsterkirche. Then you'll head to Biel/Bienne, a town known for watchmaking, where you have free time to wander around. After that, continue on to the lakeside town of Neuchâtel for lunch and a stroll along the waterfront promenade. You can see the medieval castle and cathedral from there. By evening, you'll arrive in Geneva.

days.title: Geneva
included: Sightseeing tour with Local Guide featuring Reformation Park and Old Town walk
Globus choice excursion: Geneva's humanitarian history tour with Red Cross and Geneva Convention sites
Globus choice excursion: Mini-train ride through Old Town with landmark commentary
days.description: Start your day in Geneva with a guided tour through Reformation Park, where you'll learn about the city's religious history and see monuments dedicated to key figures from that era. After that, head into the Old Town and wander through the narrow streets and historic squares at your own pace. Later in the afternoon, you can choose how to spend your time from the included options: take a humanitarian-focused walking tour that highlights Geneva's role in international aid and peacekeeping, or hop on a scenic mini-train that winds through the historic neighborhoods and gives you views you might miss on foot. By evening, you'll have free time to grab dinner somewhere local, stroll along the lake, or simply relax at your accommodation.

days.title: Geneva - Évian-les-Bains - Gruyères - Broc
included: Visit Maison Cailler Swiss chocolate factory with tasting
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Local specialties with traditional meringue and double crème in Gruyères), Dinner
days.description: You'll travel to Évian-les-Bains, a spa town in France where you can explore its mineral water heritage. Then head to the hilltop village of Gruyères for lunch featuring local specialties, including traditional meringue with double crème. After eating, visit Gruyères Castle and have time to walk around the village. To wrap up the day, stop at the Maison Cailler Swiss chocolate factory in Broc for a chocolate tasting.

days.title: Gruyère Area - Gstaad - Interlaken - Grindelwald
days.description: You'll travel through alpine scenery, starting with a stroll around Gstaad, a winter resort town. Continue to Interlaken, one of Switzerland's oldest resorts, where you'll have free time to explore on your own. After that, head to Grindelwald for the afternoon, a popular base for getting out into the Bernese Oberland region.

days.title: Grindelwald - Jungfrau
included: Mountain train ride to Jungfraujoch summit
days.description: A mountain train takes you up to Jungfraujoch, the summit of the Jungfrau Massif known as the 'Top of Europe'. You'll get a Jungfrau Passport and explore the Alpine Sensation, visit the Ice Palace with its ice sculptures, and catch the 360 degree Panorama cinematic experience. There's an ultrafast lift to the Sphinx Observatory, followed by lunch. Before heading back, stop at the world's highest chocolate shop.

days.title: Grindelwald - Bern - Lucerne
days.description: You arrive in Bern, Switzerland's capital, for a guided sightseeing tour with your local guide. Visit the Bear Park to see Pyrenean brown bears, then go to the Rose Garden for city views. Walk through the UNESCO-listed Old Town with its decorative fountains and the Zytglogge clock tower. Later, continue on to Lucerne, arriving in the late afternoon with time to yourself.

days.title: Lucerne
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Farewell dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: A walking tour shows you Lucerne's key sights, including the Lion Monument, a rock relief that Mark Twain described as the 'saddest sculpture in the world'. You'll also see the Chapel Bridge, a 14th century covered wooden bridge crossing the River Reuss from the Old Town and Europe's oldest of its kind. It's also Lucerne's most photographed landmark. The afternoon is free to explore on your own. Tonight, you'll have a farewell dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Lucerne - Zurich Airport
days.description: Your trip ends after breakfast this morning. You'll get a complimentary transfer to Zurich Airport in time for flights departing at 10 am or later. If you'd like to stay longer, extra nights in Zurich are available.

intro: Machame Route now vies with – and indeed over the last few years has overtaken – the Marangu Route as the most popular trail. Machame is also the regarded by many guides as the most enjoyable, though it is longer and, according to most, more arduous. Despite this, the success rate on the Machame Route is higher than on the Marangu Route, possibly because the Machame is a day longer at six days and five nights (assuming you take the Barafu Route to the summit) which gives trekkers more time to acclimatize. An extra acclimatization day can – and usually is -taken in the Karanga Valley. The Machame Route also gives you the option of taking the Western Breach / Arrow Glacier Route to the summit

days.title: Moshi to Machame Camp
included: Guided hike from Machame Gate to Machame Camp through rainforest
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch box for the first day)
days.start_point: Moshi, Kilimanjaro, Tanzania (The Better inn , 09:00)
days.description: Your drive from Moshi takes about 50 minutes to reach Mount Kilimanjaro National Park Gate, taking you through Machame village along the way. Once you arrive at the gate, you'll start trekking through rainforest on a winding trail that has some muddy sections. The path climbs steadily from the gate as you make your way to Machame Camp, where you'll spend your first night at around 9,380 feet.

days.title: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
included: Guided hike from Machame Camp to Shira Camp through moorland
days.description: After breakfast, you continue moving upward out of the rainforest and into moorland terrain. The day involves crossing a steep rocky ridge that's covered with heather, and then you'll pass through a river gorge valley. By evening you'll reach Shira Camp at approximately 12,600 feet, where you can rest and acclimatize before the next day.

days.title: Shira Plateau to Barranco Camp
included: Guided hike from Shira Camp via Lava Tower to Barranco Camp
days.description: Starting from Shira Plateau, you trek east up a ridge toward Kibo peak, then turn southeast toward Lava Tower, which locals call the Shark's Tooth. You'll continue on to Arrow Glacier at 16,000 feet before descending to Barranco Hut. It might feel strange that you're ending at roughly the same elevation where you started the day, but this acclimatization day is critical for your body to adjust to the altitude.

days.title: Barafu Camp to Summit to Mweka Camp
included: Guided summit attempt from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak and descent to Mweka Camp
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch at Barafu during descent), Dinner (Last dinner on the mountain)
days.description: The final descent takes you from the mountain through rainforest down to Mweka Park Gate, where you'll receive your summit certificates. After that, there's about another hour of driving to reach Mweka Village, where a vehicle picks you up and drives you back to your hotel in Moshi.

days.title: Mweka Camp to Moshi
included: Guided hike from Mweka Camp to Mweka Park Gate
days.description: After breakfast at Barranco, you begin a steep ascent past the Barranco Wall and into Karanga Valley campsite. From there you connect with the Mweka Trail and keep climbing toward Barafu Hut. This completes the South Circuit, giving you views of the summit from different angles. You'll see both Mawenzi and Kibo peaks from camp, and you'll rest here in preparation for summit day.

days.title: Barranco Camp to Barafu Camp
included: Guided hike from Barranco Camp via Karanga Valley to Barafu Camp
days.description: Summit day starts very early, with departure between midnight and 2am. You'll ascend steeply between Rebmann and Ratzel glaciers, climbing through heavy scree until you reach Stella Point on the crater rim at 18,600 feet. If weather cooperates, you'll catch the sunrise from this altitude, then continue another hour or so to Uhuru Peak at 19,345 feet, Africa's highest point. After celebrating at the summit, you descend to Mweka Hut with a lunch stop at Barafu along the way, finishing with your last dinner on the mountain.

intro: Embark on a captivating journey with our 9-Day Nile Jewel, Nile Cruise & Red Sea adventure tour, commencing and concluding in Cairo! This thoughtfully curated 9-day package invites you to explore Cairo, Egypt, and traverse through six other enchanting destinations within the country. Immerse yourself in the splendors of this small group tour, which not only encompasses accommodation in premium hotels but also features an expert guide, inclusive meals, seamless transport, and a host of additional amenities. Discover the beauty of Egypt with us on this meticulously planned and enriching excursion.

days.title: Cairo
days.description: When you land at Cairo airport, a representative will be waiting to handle check-in and get you through customs. From there, you'll head to your hotel to drop off luggage and rest up for the days ahead.

days.title: Cairo

included: Morning tour of the High Dam of Aswan

days.description: After checking out following breakfast, you'll head to the airport for your flight to Aswan. Once there, you'll tour the High Dam and then visit the Temple of Philae (a really beautiful spot on the water). A stop at a perfume factory rounds out the afternoon before boarding your 5-star Nile cruise for lunch and dinner, settling in for your first night on the water.

days.title: Aswan
optional: Abu Simbel Tour by Road (4 AM departure with breakfast box) - $150 (Local payment)
days.description: This day on the cruise gives you some downtime after breakfast and before lunch, so you can relax on deck or explore the ship. The afternoon brings sailing along the Nile toward Kom-Ombo Temples, which you'll tour before continuing south to Edfu. Dinner happens on board with an overnight stay on the cruise.

days.title: Edfu to Luxor
included: Horse carriage ride to Nile cruise
optional: Sound & Light Show at Karnak Temple - $65 (Local payment)
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast on board Nile Cruise), Lunch (Lunch on board Nile Cruise), Dinner
days.description: You'll explore the Edfu Temple in the morning, then take a horse carriage ride back to rejoin your cruise for breakfast. As you sail toward Luxor with lunch on board, you'll pass through the Esna Lock (a pretty interesting experience if this is your first time). Around 5 PM you'll dock in Luxor for an evening tour of Luxor Temple on the East Bank before returning to sleep on the cruise.

days.title: Luxor to Hurghada
optional: Hot Air Balloon Ride over the West Bank (early morning with breakfast box) - $165 (Local payment)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch at a local restaurant), Dinner
days.description: After breakfast you'll leave the cruise and head to the West Bank, starting at the Colossi of Memnon before spending time in the Valley of the Kings exploring royal tombs. There's a stop at an Alabaster factory to see local craftwork, then you'll finish at the Temple of Hatshepsut. Following lunch at a local spot, you'll ride an air-conditioned bus to Hurghada (takes about 4 hours) and check into your hotel there.

days.title: Hurghada
optional: Giftun Island Snorkeling Trip (Full-Day Excursion with Snorkeling, Fishing, and Lunch Included) - $65 (Local payment)
days.description: After breakfast, the day is yours to shape however you want. You can go snorkeling or scuba diving if you're into water activities, spend time swimming or relaxing on the beach, or just hang out at your hotel with food and drinks. You'll stay another night in Hurghada.

days.title: Hurghada to Cairo
optional: Flight Upgrade from Hurghada to Cairo (Morning Domestic Flight) - $140
Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) tour (requires flight upgrade) - $125 (Local payment)
days.description: The basic option has you on a 6 to 7 hour bus ride back to Cairo from Hurghada. If you prefer, you can upgrade to a morning flight instead, which gets you to Cairo much faster and gives you time to visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before checking into your hotel for the night.

days.title: Cairo Departure
optional: Extra Night in Hurghada (All Inclusive, Twin Sharing) - $125
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to the airport for your flight home, wrapping up your Egypt trip. Before leaving, you have options to add on tours to Jordan, Israel, Morocco, or Dubai, or you could extend your time in either Cairo or Hurghada if you want more relaxation.

intro: Join this interesting five-day tour and get closer to Greece's beautiful history and mythology, while exploring its most beautiful cities. Explore the charming capital of Greece and admire the imposing Acropolis, visit the world-famous Meteora monasteries, see ancient Greek remains and catch sight of the birthplace of the Olympic Games. Indulge in delicious food, admire stunning landscapes, get in touch with culture, and befriend the happy locals while enjoying this memorable cultural trip in Greece.

days.title: Athens to Cape Sounio
included: Cape Sounio and Temple of Poseidon sightseeing
Walk at leisure on the rocky promontory of Sounio
days.start_point: Athens International Airport Eleftherios Venizelos (ATH) Διεθνής Αερολιμένας Αθηνών Ελευθέριος Βενιζέλος, Αττική Οδός, Spata-Loutsa, Αττικη, Greece (Pick up at Athens Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at Athens airport and get a luxury car transfer to your hotel. During the afternoon, head along the coastal road past some nice beaches to Cape Sounio, where the white marble Temple of Poseidon sits on the rocky promontory. Take time to walk around the area before returning to your hotel for the evening.

days.title: Athens to Olympia
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, you'll drive along the coast to the Corinth Canal for a quick stop. From there, head to the Theatre of Epidauros to see the ancient structure known for its acoustic properties, then pass through Nafplion. Continue on to Mycenae and explore the archaeological site with the Tomb of Agamemnon. Later, drive through Central Peloponnese via Tripolis and Megalopolis, eventually reaching Olympia where you'll spend the night.

days.title: Olympia to Delphi
included: Olympia Archaeological Site visit with Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus
days.description: Grab breakfast at your hotel, then visit the archaeological site in Olympia with the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus and the Ancient Stadium, plus check out the Archaeological Museum. You'll drive through the plains of Eliad and Achaia, then cross the Rion-Antirion bridge that spans the Corinthian Bay. Pass through towns like Nafpaktos and Itea before arriving in Delphi, where dinner's waiting for you.

days.title: Delphi to Kalambaka
days.description: Start with breakfast at your hotel, then visit the archaeological site and museum in Delphi. Later, you'll depart for Kalambaka, a small town at the foot of the Meteora rock formations where you'll stay overnight.

days.title: Kalambaka to Athens
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, visit the Meteora monasteries that sit atop towering rocks. You'll see Byzantine art in these ancient monastic communities before heading back to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae, stopping briefly at Leonidas' Monument. You'll arrive in Athens and transfer to the airport after 20:00 for your departure.

intro:
Experience the richness of Egyptian culture and beauty with like-minded travelers, Spend an unforgettable holiday and discover the Pharaonic ancient civilization where will cross the desert to watch the landmarks of the Pharaonic and Egyptian lifestyle, also on the River Nile bank will watch the landmarks from the crossing city of Luxor, Aswan up to Abu Simble, and enjoy with a private guide to explain to you the history of the places what will visit starting from Luxor and ending in Aswan, onboard fand selling on the Nile with a delicious meal.

­ 

We are currently offering up to 50% savings on this adventure for departures up to December 2026. You have one free amendment on either the departure date, or to switch to another Egypt Best Holidays adventure (you will pay the price difference if applicable). Amendments can be made up to 55 days before your departure date. After an amendment fee would apply. All our tours include a FREE transfer from either Luxor Airport, local railway station, or hotels at the beginning and end of your adventure with us. Your well-being is our priority, and we ensure health and safety measures are in place for your peace of mind.

Tipping in Egypt 

Despite how commonplace tipping is in Egypt, it can still seem confusing to understand how much to tip for which services. Though common advice says to tip 10 percent to 15 percent of your total tour budget, it may not always be obvious how much to tip for a service — or even when to tip at all.

How much to tip while traveling?

  • Driver: 2-3$ per day per couple
  • Guide: 5-6 $ per day per couple
  • Cruise ship: 3 $ per person per night

days.title: Arrival in Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo International Airport (CAI), Airport Rd, Al Shorouk, Cairo 11, Egypt (We pick up all travelers.pick up available 24 hours ,, 00:00 - 00:00)
days.description: You'll arrive at Cairo International Airport where a representative meets you in arrivals. A private air-conditioned car takes you to your hotel, and you'll check in when the desk opens at 14:00 (though early check-in might be possible if you arrive sooner). This is your settling-in day, so you can rest and get oriented after your journey.

days.title: Cairo
included: Visit Giza Pyramids - Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos
Visit Valley Temple of King Chephren
Visit Saqqara Step Pyramid of King Zoser
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at your hotel), Lunch (Full meal at local restaurant (beverages not included))
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel at 09:00, your guide meets you for a full-day tour covering Cairo's pharaonic sites. You'll see the Giza Pyramids complex including the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, plus the Valley Temple and the Sphinx. Following lunch at a local restaurant, you head to Saqqara to walk through the Step Pyramid of King Zoser. The tour runs from 09:00 to 16:00, ending back at your hotel.

days.title: Cairo to Luxor
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast box at your hotel), Lunch (Lunch onboard at 13:00), Dinner (Dinner on board)
days.description: You have breakfast at your hotel, then check out and transfer by car to Cairo Airport for your domestic flight to Luxor. Once you arrive in Luxor, your representative meets you and takes you to your 5-star Nile Cruise for boarding around noon. Lunch is at 13:00 onboard, and at 14:00 your guide leads you to explore the East Bank, visiting Karnak and Luxor Temples. You return to the cruise for dinner and spend the night onboard.

days.title: Luxor (West Bank) to Edfu
included: Cruise sailing from Luxor to Edfu
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast around 07:00), Lunch (Lunch onboard at 13:00), Dinner (Dinner onboard at 20:00)
days.description: Your day starts early with breakfast around 07:00, then at 08:00 you meet your guide to explore the West Bank of Luxor. You'll visit the Valley of the Kings to see pharaonic tombs carved into the cliffs and the colossal Memnon statues, then explore the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. Back on the cruise for lunch at 13:00, and at 14:00 the ship leaves Luxor heading toward Essna. You'll cross the lock around 20:00 as you continue to Edfu, where you spend the night onboard.

days.title: Edfu - Kom Ombo
included: Visit Edfu Temple (Horus temple) by horse carriage or bus with guide
Visit Kom Ombo Temple (double temple dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris)
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast on board at 7:00 AM), Lunch (Lunch at 1:00 PM), Dinner (Dinner at 8:00 PM)
days.description: You'll start this day quite early, heading out at 4:30 AM by horse carriage or bus to reach Edfu Temple, the massive structure built for Horus. The ride back gets you to the boat by 6:30 AM, giving you time for breakfast. After that, you'll sail toward Kom Ombo, and later at 5:00 PM you'll visit the double temple there, which is dedicated to both Sobek and Haroeris. Back on the cruise by 7:00 PM, dinner happens at 8:00 PM as you sail overnight toward Aswan, arriving around 11:00 PM.

days.title: Abu Simbel Excursion
included: View four colossal statues of Ramesses II
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast box), Lunch (Lunch at 13:00), Dinner (Dinner on board)
days.description: This is an early start. You'll get a breakfast box at 03:30 when you meet your guide at the hotel lobby. From there, you travel about 350 km by air-conditioned coach to Abu Simbel to see one of Egypt's most impressive sites. You'll explore the Great Temple of Abu Simbel, carved into living rock by King Ramesses II around 1264 BC, and see the four colossal seated statues on its facade. After the tour, you return to your Nile Cruise by noon. Lunch is at 13:00 with the rest of the day free. You stay onboard overnight.

days.title: Aswan to Cairo
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast after cruise disembarkation), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant in Aswan)
days.description: You disembark from the Nile Cruise and have breakfast, then meet your guide to explore Aswan's highlights. The itinerary includes the High Dam, the unfinished obelisk, and Philae Island. In the afternoon you have lunch at a local restaurant in Aswan, then transfer to Aswan Airport for your domestic flight back to Cairo. Your driver meets you upon arrival and takes you by car to your hotel in Cairo for the night.

days.title: Cairo
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at your hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, your full-day tour begins at 09:00 exploring Cairo's cultural heritage. You visit the Egyptian Museum of Antiquities to see over 250,000 artifacts spanning 5,000 years, including the Tutankhamun collection with treasures and jewelry buried for over 3,500 years. Then you explore the Coptic area, visiting the Church of Abu Sergah, St. Barbara Church, the Hanging Church, and the old Jewish Synagogue of Ben Ezra. Lunch at a local restaurant follows, then you return to your hotel. The tour runs from 09:00 to 16:00.

days.title: Departure from Cairo
days.description: You have breakfast at your hotel one last time, then check out and meet your driver at the lobby. The car takes you to Cairo International Airport for your final departure.

name: 4-Day Classic Inca Trail to Machu Picchu - Small Group & Vistadome Train

attributes.name: Hiking & Trekking
attributes.tip: Conquer epic trails and breathtaking landscapes

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

intro:
Our best-selling Classic Inca Trail is an unforgettable way to reach Machu Picchu: on foot, along original Inca paths, and through the legendary Sun Gate.


Over four incredible days, cross high mountain passes, walk through cloud forest, and explore remarkable Inca sites hidden along the trail. Each morning begins with coffee or coca tea delivered to your tent, while our trekking chefs prepare fresh, hot meals throughout the journey.


Travel in a small group with an expert local guide and hike lighter with porter service for up to 7 kg / 15 lb of your belongings. Enjoy premium tents, a private portable toilet tent at camp, and a satellite phone carried for emergency coordination. After visiting Machu Picchu, relax aboard the panoramic Vistadome train.


As a 100% Peruvian local tour operator, we manage the permits, transportation, camping logistics, and trail support while following responsible trekking practices and fair porter welfare standards.

.

Tour Highlights

  • Hike the complete Classic Inca Trail from Km 82
  • Enter Machu Picchu through the Sun Gate
  • Enjoy three nights of authentic camping in the Andes
  • Wake up with hot coffee or coca tea served at your tent
  • Hike lighter with porter service for up to 7 kg / 15 lb
  • Travel in a small group with an expert local guide
  • Return aboard the panoramic Vistadome train

days.title: Cusco to Km 82 - Patallacta - Ayapata
included: Guided hike from Km 82 through Urubamba River valley
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at Ollantaytambo), Lunch (Fresh lunch with local ingredients at Hatunchaca), Snack (Daily snacks and hot drinks), Dinner (Freshly prepared dinner)
days.start_point: Cusco, Cusco, Peru (Hotel Pickup from Cusco’s historic center, with later pickups in Urubamba and Ollantaytambo., 04:00 - 04:30)
days.description: Your pickup happens around 4:30 AM from your Cusco hotel, then you're heading to Ollantaytambo for breakfast and to grab any last-minute supplies. From there, you'll travel to Km 82 (Piscacucho) where the Inca Trail officially starts. After meeting your guides and porters, the hiking begins through Andean terrain alongside the Urubamba River. You'll pass through Willkarakay and Patallacta before stopping for lunch at Hatunchaca. By late afternoon, you'll reach Ayapata campsite at 3,300m where your tent and warm water are waiting, followed by a hot dinner.

days.title: Ayapata to Dead Woman's Pass - Runkurakay - Chaquicocha
included: Guided hike to Dead Woman's Pass (4,215m)
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast with freshly brewed coffee or coca tea), Lunch (Well-earned lunch in Pacaymayo Valley), Snack (Daily snacks and tea time), Dinner (Dinner at camp)
days.description: Start with freshly brewed coffee or coca tea before tackling the trek's toughest section. The day involves a steady climb toward Dead Woman's Pass at 4,215m, the trail's highest point. After resting and taking in the views, you'll head down into Pacaymayo Valley for lunch. The afternoon brings another climb up to Runkurakay Pass at 4,000m, where you'll explore several Inca sites including Runkurakay, Sayacmarca, and Conchamarca. You'll finish at Chaquicocha campsite, which offers sunset views and stargazing if the weather cooperates.

days.title: Chaquicocha to Phuyupatamarca - Intipata - Wiñay Wayna
included: Guided tour of Wiñay Wayna archaeological site
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at camp), Lunch (Lunch at final campsite area), Snack (Daily snacks and tea time), Dinner (Special farewell dinner with trekking team)
days.description: This section feels noticeably different from the previous days because you're walking through cloud forest with orchids and moss-covered trees, plus stone tunnels that frame views of the Vilcabamba mountains. You'll visit Phuyupatamarca (City in the Clouds) and then descend along original Inca steps to Intipata's terraces. After lunch at the final campsite, you'll have time to rest before your guide takes you through Wiñay Wayna, one of the most striking archaeological sites on the trail. Back at camp, you'll have tea and dinner, plus a special farewell celebration with your trekking team before the final push to Machu Picchu tomorrow.

days.title: Wiñay Wayna to Sun Gate - Machu Picchu - Cusco
included: Guided tour of Machu Picchu (Route 3-B for 2026 departures)
optional: Huayna Picchu Mountain hike (requires separate Route 3-A ticket, must be booked well in advance, only possible if entry time and return train schedule are compatible)
days.description: You'll need to wake very early for breakfast at camp before heading to the final trail checkpoint. Once it opens, the hike to Intipunku (Sun Gate) happens, and this is where you get your first real view of Machu Picchu spreading out below. Your guide leads you down the ancient path through panoramic viewpoints, then along the official route through the archaeological complex. You'll see buildings, terraces, water channels, and sacred spaces at your own pace. After exploring, a shuttle bus takes you down to Aguas Calientes where you can grab lunch on your own. Then it's the included Vistadome train ride back to Ollantaytambo or your confirmed station, finishing with a final transfer to your Cusco or Sacred Valley hotel.

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

intro:
The Salkantay Trek is the second most popular route to Machu Picchu – after the Inca Trail – and it’s not difficult to see why. You will see Humantay Lake, snow-capped mountains, and the cloud forest. You will prepare a Pachamanca barbecue, visit organic coffee farms, camp at Llaqtapata, and finish the trek at Machu Picchu.

.

Highlights of the Salkantay Trek

  • Hike one of the best and most complete trekking adventures in Peru
  • Enjoy our exclusive Salka Glamp Campsite and stay in Andean huts
  • Pachamanca barbecue, and visit an organic coffee farm
  • Enjoy stunning views of Machu Picchu from the Llactapata Inca site
  • Return on the Panoramic Vistadome train

days.title: Cusco to Humantay Lake - Salka Glamp Campsite
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Freshly prepared lunch at Soraypampa), Dinner (Hearty dinner at Salka Glamp Campsite)
days.start_point: Cusco, Cusco, Peru (From your Hotel, 04:30)
days.description: You'll start early with a pickup from your Cusco hotel, then drive about 3 hours through Andean valleys to reach Mollepata for breakfast. After meeting your trekking team at the trailhead, the hike takes you to Humantay Lake, a turquoise alpine lake sitting at 4,200m/13,780ft. From there you'll head down to Soraypampa for lunch, and then climb up to Salka Glamp campsite at 4,150m/13,615ft. Once you settle into your glamping dome, you can enjoy hot drinks and dinner while the stars come out above you.

days.title: Salka Glamp to Salkantay Pass - Collpapampa
included: Visit small lake at base of Salkantay (conditions permitting)
Trek through cloud forest to Collpapampa
days.description: Coca tea or coffee arrives at your tent along with views of Savage Mountain. You'll climb for about 2 hours to reach Salkantay Pass at 4,630m/15,190ft, which is the highest point on this trek and gives you views of glaciers and sometimes a small lake. The descent takes 3 hours down to Wayracmachay where lunch happens, and as you go lower the landscape shifts into cloud forest with warmer, denser vegetation. By late afternoon you'll arrive at Collpapampa and settle into Andean huts for the night.

days.title: Collpapampa to Llactapata
included: Hike through river valley with waterfalls and plantations
Organic coffee farm experience and coffee tasting
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional Pachamanca barbecue at Lucmabamba), Dinner
days.description: This day follows a river valley through some of the trek's best scenery, with small bridges, waterfalls, and plantations growing passion fruit, bananas, and coffee. After hiking and a short vehicle transfer, you'll reach Lucmabamba for lunch, then participate in a traditional Pachamanca barbecue where you help bury food with hot stones and learn about local coffee cultivation and roasting. In the afternoon, you'll walk along the original Inca Trail for 3 hours to Llactapata, a small archaeological site with your first distant view of Machu Picchu across the valley. You'll camp nearby with the mountain on the horizon.

days.title: Llactapata to Aguas Calientes
included: Walk alongside railway line through cloud forest
optional: Visit hot springs in Aguas Calientes
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Final lunch with trekking chef at hydroelectric station), Dinner
days.description: After coffee or coca tea, watch the sunrise over Machu Picchu if the weather cooperates. Breakfast done, you'll descend 2 hours to the hydroelectric station for your final lunch with the trekking chef before saying goodbye to porters and staff. Then it's a 3-hour walk along the railway line through cloud forest next to the Urubamba River, with stops at places like Mandor's botanical gardens to spot birds. By afternoon you reach Aguas Calientes and check into your 3-star hotel, where you can visit the hot springs, walk around town, or rest before dinner.

days.title: Aguas Calientes - Machu Picchu - Cusco
included: Early morning bus to Machu Picchu
Guided tour of Machu Picchu (2–3 hours)
Visit temples, plazas, and viewpoints at Machu Picchu
Private vehicle transfer from Ollantaytambo to Cusco

days.description: This is the main event. After an early breakfast at your hotel, you'll take one of the first buses up to Machu Picchu so you can see it in morning light before crowds get thick. Your guide walks you through main temples, plazas, and viewpoints for 2 to 3 hours, explaining the construction and why the site was abandoned. You'll follow Circuit 2 route or the best available option depending on ticket availability. Later you head back down to Aguas Calientes, grab your bags, and board the Vistadome panoramic train to Ollantaytambo to see rivers, canyons, and villages. A private vehicle meets you at the station for the drive back to Cusco, arriving in early evening.

You'll have a picnic lunch set up under a croton tree so you can keep watching wildlife while you eat. This area is known for the massive migration of wildebeest and zebras that cross the Mara River. There's also the option to visit a Maasai village or take a hot air balloon safari if those interest you.

days.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru National Park
included: Game drives in Lake Nakuru National Park
optional: Private 4x4 Land Cruiser Jeep upgrade for safari game drives
Private 4x4 Minivan upgrade for safari game drives
Private safari game vehicle with driver guide for families/groups
days.meals: Breakfast (Extravagant breakfast at Masai Mara hotel), Dinner (Evening meal at Lake Nakuru hotel)
days.description: After breakfast at your Masai Mara hotel, you're heading to Lake Nakuru National Park. Once you arrive, you'll get right into game drives. The park is known for its colorful bird species like kingfishers, herons, and eagles, plus you might spot flamingos. If you're lucky, you'll see predators including lions and leopards. The park also has rare black and white rhinoceroses. In the evening, you'll head back to your hotel for dinner and spend the night.

days.title: Lake Nakuru to Amboseli National Park
included: Game drives in Amboseli National Park
Wildlife viewing with Mount Kilimanjaro backdrop
optional: Private 4x4 Land Cruiser Jeep upgrade for safari game drives
Private 4x4 Minivan upgrade for safari game drives
Private safari game vehicle with driver guide for families/groups
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at approximately 6 am), Lunch (Lunch at Amboseli), Dinner (Dinner at Amboseli lodge)
days.description: This morning starts early with breakfast around 6 am, then you're driving to Amboseli National Park. You'll stop during the day to grab lunch, and afterward, there are game drives in the afternoon. The main highlight here is seeing African elephants roaming freely with Mount Kilimanjaro in the background (assuming the weather cooperates). After the drives wrap up, you'll return to your lodge for dinner and overnight stay.

days.title: Amboseli National Park
included: Full day safari game drives in Amboseli National Park
Wildlife viewing (elephants, lions, buffalo, antelopes, birds)
optional: Optional 6 am morning nature walk in Amboseli ($35 per person for Mount Kilimanjaro views and animal walk)
Private 4x4 Land Cruiser Jeep upgrade for safari game drives
Private 4x4 Minivan upgrade for safari game drives
Private safari game vehicle with driver guide for families/groups
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast starting at approximately 5:45 am), Dinner (Dinner at Amboseli lodge)
days.description: You'll start quite early with breakfast around 5:45 am. After that, there's an optional guided nature walk at 6 am where you'll be out among the wildlife with views of Mount Kilimanjaro if conditions are right. During the walk, you'll follow animal paths and see giraffes, zebras, elands, and buffalo, plus smaller creatures like antilions and dung beetles. Later in the day, you're doing full safari game drives throughout Amboseli. You should spot elephant herds, lions, various antelopes, and lots of birds like pelicans, kingfishers, herons, and eagles. Then it's back to your lodge for dinner and overnight.

days.title: Amboseli National Park to Nairobi
included: Final wildlife viewing in Amboseli National Park
Shared transfer from Amboseli to Nairobi
days.description: You'll have an early breakfast at 6 am and then take one last game drive in Amboseli to catch final wildlife sightings and views of Mount Kilimanjaro. After that, you'll travel back to Nairobi by shared transfer, arriving in the afternoon around 4 PM. The driver will drop you off wherever you prefer in the city center, at your hotel, or at the airport.

name: Philippines West

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: We could tell you The Philippines is home to more beauty than you'd find in a copy of National Geographic, or tell you that the sand is so golden you'll have to put your sunglasses on to be able to see straight but hey you'll have to experience the West of the Philippines for yourself! Jump into legendary crystal clear waters of Palawan, bathe under waterfalls in Port Barton or learn the local ways with a cooking class off the beaten track at our exclusive Isla Experience in El Nido. Head to Coron and hang back with the sand between your toes or dive deep to explore the local shipwrecks. Whatever your thing is, you'll find epic fun, new friends for life and an authentic experience only TruTravels can bring on this 10-day Island hopping tour.

days.title: Manila
days.description: You'll arrive in Manila and get settled at your hotel. After checking in, take some time to relax and get your bearings. Then you'll meet up with the rest of your tour group for dinner. Once you've eaten, head out into Makati to check out some of the district's popular bars and nightlife spots with your new travel companions.

days.title: Manila to Puerto Princesa to Port Barton
included: Lunch with a local family in Port Barton
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch with a local family, featuring delicious Filipino cuisine)
days.description: Fly from Manila to Puerto Princesa, then transfer by private minivan to Port Barton, a quiet fishing village on Palawan's coast. Along the way, you'll stop for lunch with a local family and get a real sense of how people live here. After checking into your beachfront hotel, stick around to watch the sunset, then head out for dinner.

days.title: Port Barton
included: Island hopping tour in Port Barton
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch in a small fishing village)
days.description: Start early on a traditional long tail boat for island hopping around Palawan. You'll explore coral reefs, spot sea turtles, and stop at several beaches with white sand. Lunch happens at a small fishing village, and afterward, you have free time to relax on the beach or hang out with your group. You'll be back at Port Barton by evening.

days.title: Port Barton to El Nido
days.description: Travel to El Nido, the main town in Palawan. Spend your afternoon walking around, doing some shopping, and checking into your accommodation. At dinner with your travel group, you can catch the famous El Nido sunset from the town. It's known as one of the best sunsets around, so plan to be outside to see it.

days.title: El Nido
days.description: Board traditional Banca boats for a day of island hopping. You'll paddle through crystal clear blue lagoons, kayak between islands, and snorkel in the Philippine Sea. The day includes stops at several pristine beaches where you can swim or sunbathe. You'll grab lunch with local fishermen, then head back around sunset. The evening is yours before you meet up for dinner.

days.title: El Nido
days.description: Travel to Daracotan Island for something different. You'll snorkel around shipwrecks and take a guided walk around the island to meet some of the locals. They'll tell you about the community and how tourism affects life here. In the evening, participate in a traditional cooking demonstration where you'll help prepare Filipino dishes, eat together, then relax around a bonfire with drinks.

days.title: Daracotan Island (Castaway Experience)
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Dinner featuring Filipino dishes prepared during the cooking demonstration)
days.description: Get your adrenaline going with a zipline experience that takes you across the coast from one beach to another. The views are pretty incredible while you're up there. Afterward, head to Nacpan Beach, one of the nicest beaches in the Philippines, surrounded by tall palm trees. Spend the rest of your day there with your travel group.

days.title: Daracotan Island to Coron
days.description: Sail around Coron to see some of the world's most beautiful beaches and turquoise lagoons. You'll stop at several pristine beaches where you can swim, take photos, or just relax on the sand. By afternoon, you'll head back to Coron to shower and freshen up before dinner.

days.title: Coron
days.description: Keep the morning low-key with snorkeling or just lounging on the beach to soak in your final island hours. Later, catch the ferry to Coron and spend the afternoon browsing local shops or resting at your hotel. As evening rolls around, head out to experience Coron's nightlife with your group.

days.title: Coron (Departure)
days.description: Check out of your hotel this morning and say goodbye to your tour group. Your Tru team will be there if you need help arranging onward travel. This is a good time to think back on everything you did over the past 10 days and the people you met along the way.

qa.question: when is your most popular month to go to the Philippines, if you can give specifics to what week of the month it would be great
qa.answer: Our most popular month to visit the Philippines is February. Specifically, the 2nd and 3rd weeks of February are the overall sweet spot.This window falls right in the prime dry season with sunny skies and comfortable temperatures.The ocean conditions are calm and clear, making it ideal for island hopping and snorkeling. Visiting during these weeks also avoids the major holiday travel rush of late December and early January. March (particularly the first two weeks) is another extremely popular alternative for great beach weather.

qa.question: How does the cancellation policy works? Payments
qa.answer: Cancellation policy depends on the number of days before the tour you cancel the tour. If it's more than 60 days you will just lose your deposit. If it's less than 60 days the cancellation charge is the entire tour cost.

qa.question: Do you offer any extra activities on top of the ones listed? We are mostly interested in diving.
qa.answer: The Philippines East Tour provides a little more time for diving than the West Tour. The West tour is quite busy. If you do want to dive on this tour most guests choose to miss one day of the itinerary to dive either in El Nido or Coron. In terms of optional activities, the main free time is usually during the travel day to El Nido. If guests arrive early afternoon, which they mostly do, they normally spend the time grabbing lunch, getting massages, doing nail spa treatments, exploring the town, doing the canopy walk or going out for sunset drinks. However, On the Philippines East tour you have the opportunity to dive in either Moalboal or Boracay and a number of guests take up this option. Or why not do the Philippines Island Hopper trip and combine both and get the best of both worlds? L

name: 8 Days Small Group Sicily Highlights (Max 8 Guests)

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
-Visit world famous monuments and little-known corners of Sicily’s most stunning towns

-Enjoy 5 Sicilian Meals included in price in different great locations

-Get a full immersion to reach history, traditions and culture of UNESCO island

-Be always accompanied by licensed guides who knows it best

-Experience Sicily though its gastronomy, wines, art and music

-Get an authentic lifestyle experience and feel like you’ve lived in Sicily the whole life

days.title: Catania to Taormina
days.start_point: Catania, Italy (Arrival transfer from Catania–Fontanarossa Airport)
days.description: After arriving at Catania airport, you'll get a ride to your hotel in Taormina. Later in the evening, a local guide takes you on a food and wine tour through town where you'll taste local specialties and hear about Taormina's culinary history from the people who make it. Once the tour finishes in the town center, you have the rest of the night to wander around on your own.

days.title: Taormina
included: Godfather vs Mafia Tour with visit to Savoca and Forza d'Agro
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Pasta lunch with bruschetta and cannolo on extraordinary terrace)
days.description: You'll start with breakfast, then head out to the mountain villages of Savoca and Forza d'Agro with a mafia guide exploring Godfather filming spots and local history. After an aperitif at the famous Vitelli bar and a pasta lunch with bruschetta and cannolo on a terrace, you take an easy walk through Taormina with a local guide learning about Greek, Roman, Arab, Byzantine and Norman heritage plus local traditions. The day ends at the impressive Greek Theatre before heading back to your hotel.

days.title: Taormina
included: Visit to Mt. Etna base camp at 1,900 meters
Winery visit with wine tasting and lunch
optional: Ascent to 3,000 meters via cable car and Jeep with Alpine Guide
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Wine tasting with pairing cold appetizers and lunch at Etna winery)
days.description: Your Mount Etna adventure starts at Refuge Sapienza (1,900 meters/6,233 feet) where you'll see the extinct Silvestri craters and have time to walk on old lava flows. If you want, you can pay extra to continue by cable car and Jeep up to 3,000 meters/9,843 feet for a 45-minute walk through a lunar landscape with an English-speaking Alpine Guide, but this part is optional. From there, you visit a winery on Etna's slopes known for volcanic wines and organic food, having wine tasting with cold appetizers and lunch before returning to your hotel.

days.title: Taormina to Syracuse
included: Traditional fresh fish lunch in Marzamemi
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional fresh fish lunch in a family taverna overlooking the sea in Marzamemi)
days.description: After breakfast, you travel to the UNESCO heritage town of Noto and take an easy walk with a local guide through the baroque architecture, tasting the famous Modica chocolate along the way. Next you head to the fishing village of Marzamemi for fresh seafood lunch overlooking the sea at a family taverna. Then you transfer to your new hotel in Syracuse with the evening free to explore this romantic town on your own.

days.title: Syracuse
days.description: This morning starts with a walking tour of Ortigia, Syracuse's historic old town. You'll see the Apollo Temple, walk down Via Cavour with its local artists and aristocrats, find the Archimede Fountain, and explore the Jewish district from the 3rd century BC. The tour builds to Duomo Square, one of Italy's most beautiful squares, where you'll see the Cathedral and Church of St. Lucy while your guide shares insights into local lifestyle and traditions. After that, the rest of the day is yours to explore Syracuse at your own pace.

days.title: Syracuse to Palermo
included: Fresh seasonal lunch in local taverna
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Fresh seasonal lunch in local taverna)
days.description: You say goodbye to Syracuse and head toward Palermo, passing through the ancient Temple Valley. After about 2 hours of driving, you reach the UNESCO heritage site where a local guide gives you a 2-hour tour. Following that, you have fresh seasonal lunch at a local taverna. Then you continue to Palermo with the evening free to relax and explore Sicily's capital.

days.title: Palermo
days.description: A local expert guide leads you on a 2-hour walking tour discovering Palermo's beauty. You'll walk through the authentic old town checking out Martorana Church, Piazza Pretoria, Quattro Canti, and the Cathedral while learning about this capital's diverse heritage. After the tour ends, the evening is free so you can relax and explore Palermo at your own pace.

days.title: Palermo
days.description: You'll have breakfast at your hotel, and then your driver collects you and takes you to Palermo airport according to your flight time, typically 3 hours before departure.

name: 3-Days Iguazu Falls Tour of the Argentinian and Brazilian Side

attributes.name: Nature & Wildlife
attributes.tip: Explore untamed landscapes teeming with wildlife

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Discover Iguazu Falls, a stunning natural wonder straddling Argentina and Brazil. Immerse yourself in a pristine jungle where vibrant wildlife thrives amidst cascading waters. 

­ 

Our exclusive 3-day, 2-night package includes optional economy-class flights (with private transfers in Buenos Aires), and transfers in Iguazu for a seamless journey. 

­ 

Enjoy guided tours with expert local guides providing insightful commentary and uncovering hidden wonders. Customize your experience with private tours and stay in a 4-star hotel. 

­ 

Explore both the Argentine and Brazilian sides of the falls, marvel at panoramic viewpoints like Devil's Throat, and opt for exhilarating boat rides along the Iguazu River. 

­ 

Each moment promises adventure and enchantment, showcasing why Iguazu remains a cherished marvel of Earth's natural wonders, evoking a deep appreciation for our planet's splendor.

­ 

*IMPORTANT NOTES*:

  • Not wheelchair accessible
  • Children must be accompanied by an adult
  • Please bear in mind that beginning and ending time may vary according to flight availability.
  • Optional flights are confirmed in economy class subject to availability. A supplement applies if a higher booking class is required due to lack of availability.
  • To Include Optional Private Transfers in Buenos Aires, the Optional Extra "Transfers in Buenos Aires" must be selected. 
  • This package is non-refundable and cannot be modified or canceled.
  • Important update: Starting April 10th, 2025, Brazil will require a visa for visitors from the USA, Canada, and Australia. For more information, visit Brazil Visa Information.
  • Please remember to bring your passport with you for the excursions, as it is necessary to cross the border.
  • Rates are per person. If you are a solo traveler, you will have single occupancy. If there are two or more travelers, you will have double or triple occupancy. If single occupancy is required, we can certainly provide a quote.
  • Accommodation will be on either the Brazilian or Argentine side of the Falls, depending exclusively on hotel availability at the time of booking
  • If you are booking your flights independently, please contact us to confirm the tour schedules.
  • Rates do not apply to special dates such as Christmas and new year

days.title: Arrival at Iguazu
days.start_point: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Buenos Aires Centrally Located Accommodation)

days.title: Iguazu National Park (Argentine Side)
included: Iguazu National Park walking trails (upper and lower)
Ecological train ride to Devil's Throat canyon
optional: Motorboat ride on Iguazu River with panoramic views and shower under falls
days.description: Head into Iguazu National Park on the Argentine side, where you'll walk both the upper and lower trails to see the falls from different angles. name: Spirits Of Vietnam, Cambodia & Thailand In 16 Days

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided
attributes.tip: Independent travel, featuring selected guided excursions

intro:
Spirits Of Vietnam, Cambodia & Thailand In 16 Days gives travelers the best experience the three countries can offer. Start your journey in Hanoi, a beautiful city with French colonial buildings and a bustling atmosphere. Spend overnight on a cruise, be captivated by scenic Halong Bay, and head to the most romantic town in Vietnam - Hoi An, followed by "Pearl of the Orient" - Ho Chi Minh. Then head to Siem Reap and visit the ancient capital of the Khmer Empire. Wrap up your adventures with a beach break at Thailand's largest island with its stunning sceneries and warm gentle sea. These wonders will amaze you and leave you speechless.

Top it all, by choosing this tour you will contribute to the local community. From each trip booked on Tour Radar, we donate $20 to our foundation which helps to maintain the projects we run for developing a safe and green environment for children and our environmental protection initiatives. you could find more details and reports on our social media.

days.title: Hanoi
days.start_point: Noi Bai International Airport, Sóc Sơn, Huyện Sóc Sơn, Hanoi 140800, Vietnam (Noi Bai Intenational Airport Pick Up)
days.description: Your private driver meets you at Hanoi airport and takes you to your hotel in the city center, right near the Old Quarter. The rest of your day is open so you can either get some rest after the flight or head out on your own to start getting a feel for the city.

days.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay
included: Cruise through Halong Bay karst islands
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch served while cruising through Halong Bay islands), Dinner
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and head for Halong Bay. Your cruise team picks you up from the hotel lobby between 8:00-9:00 am (exact time confirmed the day before). You arrive at the jetty around noon, board your vessel, and have lunch while the boat cruises through the karst islands. This afternoon you can swim, kayak, or visit caves depending on what your boat offers. By evening you'll watch the sunset and have dinner as the boat settles into a scenic anchorage for the night.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
days.meals: Breakfast (Served while vessel cruises back toward port), Lunch (Early lunch before disembarking)
days.description: Start your morning watching the sunrise over Halong Bay while you have breakfast as the cruise heads back to port. An early lunch happens before you disembark. Your driver then takes you back to Hanoi where you have the rest of the day free to explore however you like.

days.title: Hanoi to Hoi An
days.description: You have the morning in Hanoi before your driver takes you to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. When you land, your driver is there to pick you up and transfer you to your hotel in Hoi An. The rest of your day is yours to do what you want.

days.title: Hoi An
included: Cycling trip through countryside and rivers
Bamboo basket boat trip in Cam Thanh Eco-Village
Traditional net fishing experience with local fishermen
optional: Purchase handmade nipa palm leaf crafts
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Delicious lunch at local restaurant)
days.description: Your English-speaking guide meets you at the hotel around 8:00 am for a cycling trip through the countryside and rivers around Hoi An. You'll pedal through villages, take in the scenery, and get friendly waves from locals before heading to the Eco-Village of Cam Thanh. There you'll get into a traditional Vietnamese bamboo basket boat to navigate the coconut palm waterways, chat with local fishermen, and try your hand at traditional net fishing. You might spot purple crabs in the canals and can pick up handmade gifts made from nipa palm leaves if you want. Lunch at a local restaurant happens before cycling back to your hotel.

days.title: Hoi An
optional: Bicycle rental and cycling around town
Walk through Old Town with lantern lighting
days.description: You have the full day free to explore Hoi An at your own pace. Rent a bike from your hotel and cycle around town toward the riverside or beach where small cafes serve refreshing fruit drinks. The water here is warm and good for swimming. If custom clothing, bags, or shoes interest you, tailor shops can make them overnight. As evening comes, walk through the Old Town area and watch as shop owners light their lanterns, creating this almost magical feel. Don't miss the colorful street performances that happen in the evenings.

days.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City
optional: Explore remaining time in Hoi An
days.description: Spend your last hours in Hoi An before your driver takes you to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Your driver picks you up when you land and transfers you to your accommodation. The evening and rest of your day are free to relax and settle in.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Mekong Delta
included: Explore Unicorn Island with orchards and folk songs
Hand-rowed sampan trip through Thoi Son canal
optional: Relax in hammock instead of cycling
days.description: You leave Ho Chi Minh City and head to My Tho, a town on the Mekong River's left bank. Start by visiting Vinh Trang Pagoda, a beautiful temple from the late 19th century. Then board a traditional sampan and cruise past the Four Island Groups (Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Tortoise islands). Stop at Unicorn Island to walk along country lanes, check out fruit orchards, taste tropical fruits, and hear folk songs from local performers. You'll visit a fruit plantation, then take a hand-rowed sampan through Thoi Son canal to see rural life. A family business and honeybee farm come next where you can sample honey tea and watch coconut candy being made. Lunch at a local spot happens before cycling around Tan Thach village to meet people and experience daily Mekong Delta life (or relax in a hammock if preferred). Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the evening.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi Tunnels
included: Guided tour of Cu Chi Tunnels
Exploration of underground system including weapon factories, field hospitals, kitchens, and living quarters
Taste manioc (staple food of Cu Chi soldiers)
optional: Fire AK47, MK16, or machine gun at shooting range
days.description: Head out early for a 1.5-hour drive to the Cu Chi Tunnels, a historic war site 60 km from Ho Chi Minh City. This 220 km-long underground network was crucial during the Vietnam War and shows incredible resilience and ingenuity. Your guide walks you through the legendary history, then you'll watch a documentary about tunnel construction and the fierce battles fought here. Explore the underground system including weapon factories, field hospitals, kitchens, and living quarters. If you're brave enough, you can crawl through tunnels to experience what guerrilla fighters faced. Taste manioc, the staple food soldiers ate during the war. Optional shooting at the nearby range lets you try an AK47, MK16, or machine gun if you want extra excitement. You return to Ho Chi Minh City by evening.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Siem Reap
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel and take some rest before your driver takes you to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. When you arrive at Siem Reap Airport, your driver picks you up and transfers you to your accommodation. The rest of your day is free to relax and adjust.

days.title: Siem Reap
included: Visit South Gate of Angkor Thom
Visit Terrace of the Leper King
days.description: Spend the full day exploring the Angkor area. Begin at the South Gate of Angkor Thom, known for its colossal stone faces, then visit Bayon Temple with its impressive carvings, Royal Enclosure, Phimeanakas, Elephant Terrace, and Terrace of the Leper King. Next, head to Angkor Wat, the largest temple at Angkor from the 12th century covering about 210 hectares. Walk through its massive galleries, columns, libraries, pavilions, courtyards, and ponds. Finally, visit Ta Prohm, the jungle-covered temple where enormous fig trees and giant creepers wrap around stone structures, showing nature reclaiming human creation.

days.title: Siem Reap
days.description: After breakfast, head to the Floating Villages on Tonle Sap Lake and take a traditional wooden boat ride to see how communities live along the lake's edges. You'll see stilted houses, large fish traps, and learn how the local economy connects to the lake's fish, wildlife, and seasonal water changes. During wet season, this becomes one of Asia's largest freshwater lakes. On your way back, visit Western Baray, a massive 8 by 2.3 km water reservoir that historically supplied irrigation for Angkor's agriculture.

days.title: Siem Reap to Phuket
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel and relax before your driver takes you to the airport for your flight to Phuket. Your driver picks you up when you arrive at Phuket Airport and takes you to your accommodation. The rest of your day is free to do as you like.

days.title: Phuket
optional: Phi Phi Maya Bay + Pileh Cove + Bamboo Island speedboat tour (USD 75 per person) - includes snorkeling gear, life jacket, breakfast snacks and drinks, lunch, swimming and snorkeling at Bamboo Island, Pileh Lagoon, Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, and Viking Cave sightseeing
days.description: You have a free day to enjoy Phuket however you want. There's an optional group speedboat tour available (USD 75 per person) departing at 7:30 am from your hotel lobby if you're interested. This full-day excursion includes snorkeling gear, a speed boat to Bamboo Island (arriving 10:00 am), swimming and snorkeling, lunch at a beachside restaurant on Phi Phi Don Island, time in the emerald lagoon at Pileh Cove, Maya Bay with its famous white sand and limestone mountains, Monkey Beach, Viking Cave viewing, and return by 5:15 pm. Note that the schedule can shift based on weather and tide conditions.

days.title: Phuket
days.description: You have a free day to explore Phuket however you choose. The island has diverse landscapes including famous sandy beaches, forested hills, mountains, limestone cliffs, low plains, lagoons, and thick tropical vegetation. You might spend time relaxing on the beaches, hiking to a waterfall for a picnic, or taking a boat trip to nearby islands.

days.title: Phuket Departure
days.description: Enjoy a healthy breakfast on your final morning of the trip. After checking out of your hotel, you'll have time to visit local markets and pick up souvenirs for people back home. Later, head to the airport and board your flight back home. Your trip ends.

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships
