intro:
Your Best Of Vietnam In 14 Days tour begins in Hanoi, where rich history, culture, and stunning landscapes await. Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, a private driver will greet you and transfer you to your hotel in the heart of Hanoi. After checking in and settling down, take some time to rest and recover from your journey. Once you're refreshed, feel free to explore Hanoi at your own pace. Wander through the vibrant streets, visit historic sites, and immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the city, where traditional architecture blends seamlessly with modern charm.

From here, you’ll embark on a journey through Vietnam’s most iconic destinations, from the breathtaking landscapes of Sapa to the UNESCO World Heritage site of Halong Bay. Explore the ancient town of Hoi An, discover the bustling life in Ho Chi Minh City, and cruise the Mekong Delta. Each destination offers a unique experience, from cultural tours and nature hikes to relaxing beach days and thrilling boat rides.

Get ready to dive into the heart of Vietnam, where every day brings new adventures and unforgettable memories!

Top it all, by choosing this tour you will contribute to the local community. From each trip booked on Tour Radar, we donate $20 to our foundation which helps to maintain the projects we run for developing a safe and green environment for children and our environmental protection initiatives. you could find more details and reports on our social media.

days.title: Hanoi
optional: Explore Hanoi Old Quarter at your own pace
days.start_point: Noi Bai International Airport, Sóc Sơn, Huyện Sóc Sơn, Hanoi 140800, Vietnam (Noi Bai International Airport Pick Up )
days.description: Your private driver picks you up at Hanoi airport and takes you to your hotel in the city center. Since the Old Quarter is basically right there, you can either wander around and check things out or take it easy after your flight, whatever works best for you.

days.title: Ninh Binh - Tam Coc - Mua Cave
included: Buffet lunch at Ninh Binh Excursion Restaurant
1.5-hour bamboo boat ride in Tam Coc
Climb Mua Cave (Dragon Peak) with nearly 500 steps
days.meals: Lunch (Buffet lunch at Ninh Binh Excursion Restaurant (5-star) featuring local dishes such as goat meat, spring rolls, fish, chicken, fried rice, and vegetable salad, with vegetarian options available)
days.description: After your hotel pickup, head to Ninh Binh province and visit Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital. You'll spend time cycling through the village to see how locals live, then have lunch at a 5-star restaurant with buffet options. Next comes a 1.5-hour bamboo boat ride through Tam Coc's karst landscape, followed by climbing nearly 500 steps up Mua Cave for views of the area. From there, it's back to Hanoi for the evening.

days.title: Hanoi to Sapa
days.description: Grab an early breakfast at the hotel and finish checking out. A limousine bus takes you on a scenic 6-hour drive through the mountains to Sapa. Once you arrive, you'll be taken to your accommodation. The rest of your day is yours to walk around this charming mountain town at whatever pace feels right.

days.title: Sapa - Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van
included: Visit Y Linh Ho village (Hmong minorities)
View rice terraces and mountain landscapes
Overnight stay at Dzay local house with local experience
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch in Lao Chai village nearby the river), Dinner
days.description: After breakfast, meet your guide at 9:30 am to start a 12 km trek visiting Y Linh Ho and Lao Chai villages where Hmong minorities live. You'll see rice terraces and mountain views throughout the walk. Lunch happens in Lao Chai village by the river, then you continue hiking to Ta Van village. You'll stay overnight at a homestay here to experience the Dzay people's daily life and traditions.

days.title: Ta Van - Giang Ta Chai - Sapa - Hanoi
included: Trek to Giang Ta Chai village (Red Dao minority)
Trek through bamboo forest (Hoang Lien National Park)
days.description: Start with breakfast at your homestay before trekking to Giang Ta Chai village of the Red Dao minority. The route takes you through a bamboo forest in Hoang Lien National Park, past a waterfall and rattan bridge with breaks to enjoy the scenery. You'll have lunch at a scenic spot, then move on to Su Pan village. After that, it's a drive back to Sapa and a limousine bus return to Hanoi.

days.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay
included: Cruise on Ha Long Bay to explore limestone rocks and karst grottoes
Kayaking or swimming near floating villages and shops
optional: Optional activities on boat in evening
days.description: Have breakfast before heading out on a scenic drive to Ha Long Bay, crossing the Red River Delta with its bright green rice paddies. Once there, you'll cruise around the bay to see limestone rocks and karst caves. Seafood lunch is served on the boat, then you visit a well-known limestone cave for kayaking or swimming near floating villages and shops. Return to the boat for an early dinner and relax, with optional activities available onboard.

days.title: Ha Long Bay to Hanoi
included: Tai Chi lesson (optional) or hearty breakfast
Visit limestone cave with stalagmites and stalactites
days.description: Wake early for either a Tai Chi lesson or a hearty breakfast depending on what you prefer. The boat stops at a limestone cave to see stalagmites and stalactites, then sets sail back to the main harbor. You'll arrive back in Hanoi around 5:00 pm and have the rest of the evening free to do whatever you'd like.

days.title: Hanoi to Hoi An
days.description: Start with breakfast at your hotel, then you have the day to wander around Hoi An at your own pace. The afternoon works well for checking out the city's main sights on foot. Stop and grab a Banh Mi sandwich somewhere, then continue exploring. After dark, head through the lantern market to see how local artisans craft traditional paper lanterns by hand. Later in the evening, catch the free Vietnamese folk dancers and musicians performing traditional pieces at the outdoor theatre on Nguyen Thai Hoc street from 9-10 pm. By the end of the night, you'll light a candle and set it in the water.

days.title: Hoi An
included: Vietnamese folk dancers and musicians performance at outdoor theatre (free, 9-10 pm)
optional: Custom tailoring services at one of 400+ tailoring shops in Hoi An
Banh Mi sandwich at Madam Khanh's stand
Explore Old Town and lantern market
days.description: You have free time to wander Hoi An and see Japanese merchant houses, pagodas, temples, and antique warehouses, or just relax at a riverside cafe along the Thu Bon River. There's an optional morning eco-tour from 8:30 am to 1:00 pm where you visit a colorful local market, ride a bamboo basket boat through a coconut forest, try fishing, and take a cooking class making 5 Vietnamese dishes. The afternoon is yours to explore more or take it easy.

days.title: Hoi An
optional: Explore Japanese merchant houses, pagodas, temples, and antique warehouses
Relax at riverside café along Thu Bon River

Local Market, Basket Boat, Fishing & Cooking Experience eco-tour (8:30 am - 1:00 pm) including: visit colorful local market, experience bamboo basket boat through Cam Thanh Eco-Village and nipa palm forest, learn fishing techniques, receive handmade gifts from nipa palm leaves, learn traditional Vietnamese cooking methods, prepare and enjoy 5 Vietnamese dishes
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, fly to Ho Chi Minh City. Check in at your hotel and have the rest of the day free to rest and recover from your travels.

days.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City
days.description: Hotel pickup happens at 7:20 am followed by a hearty breakfast before you head to the Mekong Delta. Travel to My Tho on the Mekong River's left side, then board a sampan to cruise around four islands: Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Tortoise. At Unicorn Island, you'll walk country lanes and see orchards with tropical fruits, plus listen to local folk music. A hand-rowed sampan takes you through Thoi Son canal where you visit family businesses and a honey-bee farm with honey tea and coconut candy workshops. Lunch is at a local restaurant, then you cycle around Tan Thach village in the afternoon to meet people and experience everyday delta life. Get back to Ho Chi Minh around 5:30 pm.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Mekong Delta
included: Sampan cruise around four islands (Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Tortoise Islands)
Stop at Unicorn Island with orchards and tropical fruits
Folk song music performance by local people
Hand-rowed sampan through Thoi Son canal
Visit honey-bee farm with honey tea and coconut candy workshop
Meet local villagers and experience Mekong delta daily life
optional: Hammock relaxing for those unable to join cycling trip
days.description: At 8:00 am, head out to see the Independence Palace, also called Reunification Palace, a major landmark designed by architect Ngo Viet Thu. You'll also see beautiful French Colonial structures like Notre Dame Cathedral and the historic Central Post Office. The War Remnants Museum is next, with extensive exhibits from both Indochina wars. Your guide takes you back to your hotel or meeting point by noon.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
included: View French Colonial structures including Notre Dame Cathedral and Central Post Office
days.description: Enjoy a healthy breakfast on your last day. Finish packing and check out of your hotel, then visit local markets to pick up souvenirs. After that, head to the airport for your flight home.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel and enjoy some free time before a private cab takes you to the airport. You'll fly to Hoi An, check into your hotel, and have the rest of the day to rest and settle in.

name: 6-Days trip to Easter Island

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

intro:
Get ready for a unique experience visiting Easter Island!

The island is located more than 3700 km off the coast of Chile, in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, Rapa Nui or Easter Island, also known as "The Belly Button of the World" is the most insular island in the world.

The island is considered the largest archaeological museum site of the world, and it is definetely a place full of fascinating mystery! We invite you to come and explore the entire Rapa Nui culture, its moai, meadows, and its people.

days.title: Easter Island
optional: Lunch at a local restaurant in Hanga Roa
Visit Tahai to watch the sunset behind the moai statues
days.start_point: Easter Island, Chile (Aiport in Easter Island)
days.description: You'll land at Mataveri Airport and get greeted with a flower necklace before heading to your hotel on a shared transfer. After settling in, the afternoon is open for you to get oriented. Take a walk through Hanga Roa downtown and grab lunch somewhere there, then make your way to Tahai along the coast. It's only about a 25-minute walk from where you're staying, and you'll catch the sunset with the moai statues right in front of you. This gives you a nice first look at what you came here to see.

days.title: Ahu Tongariki - Rano Raraku - Anakena Beach
included: Explore Rano Raraku volcano and moai quarry
Lunch in a Rapa Nui family house
Visit Te Pito Kura and Paro moai
Visit Ahu Nau-Nau and Anakena Beach
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch in a Rapa Nui family house where you will learn about different local trees, flowers and typical vegetation of the island)
days.description: This full day takes you through Easter Island's main archaeological spots. You'll start at Ahu Akahanga, then head to Rano Raraku volcano where almost 400 moai are in different stages of carving. From there, go to Ahu Tongariki, which is the largest restored platform on the island. Around midday you'll have lunch at a local Rapa Nui family house where they talk about native trees and what grows here. Later in the afternoon, check out Te Pito Kura and the Paro moai, then finish up at Anakena Beach. You'll get about 30 minutes to swim in the clear water near Ahu Nau-Nau before the day wraps up.

days.title: Orongo - Rano Kao - Ahu Akivi - Puna Pau
included: Visit Vinapu platform with carved rocks
Guided tour of Orongo ancestral village
Visit Ana Te Pahu lava tube cave
days.description: Split your day between spiritual and astronomical sites. The morning covers Orongo and Rano Kau where the ceremonial village sits, and you'll see the island's widest crater and carved rocks with moai remains. They'll explain the bird-man competition that happened in this spot. After lunch, your afternoon includes Ahu Akivi with its 7 moai made for the island's first explorers, Puna Pau quarry where the red scoria headdresses come from, and Ana Te Pahu cave formed by lava flows where people actually lived in ancient times.

days.title: Easter Island Free Day with Optional Activities
optional: Rapa Nui Traditional Polynesian Show with Dinner (approximately 4 hours with round-trip hotel transfers)
Navigation to the Motus (boat trips to Motu Kao Kao, Motu Iti and Motu Nui with marine fauna viewing)
Snorkeling (all equipment included: fins, diving goggles, diving suit, floats and ladders)
Half Day Horseback Riding (3 hours, minimum 2 people, maximum 5 people)
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, the day opens up for what interests you. Optional activities include sunrise or sunset visits to Tahai or Tongariki, a traditional Polynesian show with dinner, boat trips to nearby motus, snorkeling with equipment, horseback riding, or surfing lessons. Talk with your guide about what's available and costs.

days.title: Easter Island Free Day
days.description: You'll have breakfast at your hotel and then the day is open. Explore Easter Island however you'd like, or arrange optional activities through your guide if something catches your interest.

days.title: Easter Island Departure
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, you'll transfer to Mataveri Airport for your flight back to Santiago. This concludes the tour.

name: Amazing Vietnam Super Save Package In 10 Days

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided

intro:
Amazing Vietnam Super Save Package offers a wonderful mix of tropical beaches, post-colonial charm, a string of world heritage sites, stunning scenery, cuisine that enchants visitors, and a home-grown flair for hospitality. Start your trip from the North, where you will be welcomed by the locals with a warm attitude in the Hanoi countryside, Ninh Binh. Be ready to be amazed by the spectacular Halong Bay - one of the seven wonders of nature. Then head to Hoi An, an ancient lantern town that sits peacefully by the Thu Bon river. The essence of its tranquillity will cherish your leisure time. Travel to the south and explore the mighty Mekong delta, which is known as the 'rice bowl of Vietnam', and the mysterious underground system in Cu Chi Tunnels. 

Top it all, by choosing this tour you will contribute to the local community. From each trip booked on Tour Radar, we donate $20 to our foundation which helps to maintain the projects we run for developing a safe and green environment for children and our environmental protection initiatives. you could find more details and reports on our social media.

days.title: Hanoi
days.start_point: Noi Bai International Airport, Sóc Sơn, Huyện Sóc Sơn, Hanoi 140800, Vietnam (Noi Bai International Airport)
days.description: Your rep meets you at Hanoi airport with a sign and takes you by private driver to your hotel in the city center. From there, you can explore on your own time. Try some traditional egg coffee at a local café, walk through the bustling markets, or just get a feel for Hanoi's energy and rhythm.

days.title: Hanoi - Ba Vi District
included: Harvest tea leaves on traditional 30-year-old tea plantation
Learn tea production process at workshop
Cooking class with local host family
Visit local workshops in Moc village
Cycling trip across rice fields and villages
Traditional foot soak with herbs following Muong ethnic minority recipes
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Vietnamese dishes prepared during cooking class with local host family)
days.description: After breakfast, head out to Ha Long Bay by shuttle. You'll board your cruise around noon, greeted with a welcome drink and lunch. The afternoon is yours to relax on deck or try activities the boat offers. Before dinner, watch the sunset from your anchored boat, then settle in for the night sleeping aboard.

days.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay
included: Boat cruise through Ha Long Bay
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Served onboard as cruise begins journey through islets), Dinner
days.description: Start this morning at the local market in Hoi An where you'll talk with vendors about the ingredients they're selling and what goes into Vietnamese cooking. From there, head out on a bamboo basket boat through the nipa palm forest in Cam Thanh Eco-Village. You'll get to try fishing with nets and see if you can catch some purple crabs in the canal. After lunch, you'll learn traditional Vietnamese cooking methods and prepare five dishes yourself in a cooking class. Spend the evening enjoying what you've made, then settle in for the night in Hoi An.

days.title: Ha Long Bay to Hoi An
optional: Stroll through lantern-lit streets of Hoi An
days.description: Head out at 8am toward Cu Chi Tunnels, about 60km away. You'll walk through the intricate underground network from the Vietnam War, crawl through tunnels, see hidden entrances and trapdoors, and learn how soldiers used smokeless stoves to cook. Try some simple wartime foods while you're there. You'll be back in Ho Chi Minh City by early afternoon with time to explore.

days.title: Hoi An
optional: Ba Na Hills – Golden Bridge Full Day Tour (USD 80 per person)
days.description: Travel to My Tho on the Mekong River and visit Vinh Trang Pagoda from the late 1800s. Board a sampan to see the four islands (Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, Tortoise), stopping on Unicorn Island to walk through orchards and taste tropical fruits. There's local folk music, visits to fruit plantations and a honey-bee farm with honey tea and a coconut candy workshop. After lunch at a local restaurant, cycle around Tan Thach village before heading back to Ho Chi Minh City.

days.title: Hoi An
included: Local market tour and experience with local sellers
Bamboo basket boat tour through Eco-Village Cam Thanh nipa palm forest
Fishing experience with net throwing and purple crab catching
Vietnamese cooking class and preparation of 5 Vietnamese dishes
Handmade gift shopping from nipa palm leaves (hats, watches, rings)
days.description: Wake up for your last morning in Vietnam and have breakfast while you think back on everything from the cities to the countryside. If there's time, take a walk through Ho Chi Minh City streets or stop at a local market to grab last-minute items like Vietnamese coffee, lacquerware, or handmade crafts. Your driver will take you to Tan Son Nhat International Airport at the scheduled time for your flight out.

days.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City
optional: Leisurely morning stroll through ancient town
Explore Ho Chi Minh City's bustling streets
days.description: Wake up and eat breakfast on the cruise as it heads back to port. You'll explore a limestone cave with stalactites and stalagmites inside. After returning to the mainland, the shuttle takes you back to Hanoi for a rest, then you'll fly to Da Nang and transfer to Hoi An. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day wandering at your own pace.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Cu Chi
included: Explore Cu Chi Tunnels underground network
Learn about wartime cooking methods with smokeless stoves
Taste simple wartime foods like cassava
optional: Shoot AK-47 rifle at designated shooting range (paid separately)
days.description: Spend your last morning in Hoi An however you like. Take a walk through the ancient town, sit by the river with Vietnamese coffee, or relax at your hotel. When it's time, your private driver takes you to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. After landing, transfer to your hotel downtown and explore on your own.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Mekong Delta
included: Sampan cruise around four islands (Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, Tortoise)
Enjoy folk song music by local people
Hand-rowed sampan trip through Thoi Son canal
Honey tea and coconut candy workshop
optional: Hammock relaxing for those unable to join cycling
days.description: You'll get picked up at 8am for a day in rural Vietnam. Start by harvesting tea leaves on a 30-year-old plantation, then cook traditional Vietnamese dishes with a local family. Next you'll check out workshops that make local products, cycle through rice fields, and wrap up with a traditional herbal foot soak. The shuttle brings you back to Hanoi around 4pm.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
optional: Leisurely stroll through Ho Chi Minh City streets
Shop for lacquerware or handmade crafts
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel, then the day is open for you to explore Hoi An at your own pace. If you want to do something organized, there's an optional full-day ba na hills tour that includes the Golden Bridge, cable cars, French Village, and Fantasy Park.

intro: In addition to its beautiful beaches, Yucatan boasts an impressive cultural and historical heritage as the repository of treasures of Maya civilisation such as Palenque, Tulum, Chichen Itza and Uxmal. Travel back in time to appreciate the everlasting greatness of these ancient cities reclaimed from the jungle and discover the beauty of the colourful colonial towns of Izamal and Merida. Join this memorable eight-day tour and see a mesmerising part of impressive Mexico.

days.title: Cancun
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional de Cancún (CUN), Carr. Fed. Cancún - Chetumal Km 22, Benito Juárez, Quintana Roo 77569, Mexico (Pick up at Cancun International Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at Cancun International Airport and get picked up for transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is open, so you can either kick back and settle in or head out and get a feel for the area.

days.title: Cancun - Ria Lagartos - Cenote - Valladolid
included: Boat trip through Ria Lagartos Biosphere Reserve mangroves (approximately 2 hours) to observe flamingos, birdlife and crocodiles
Mayan mud bath with mineral-rich white mud
days.description: Head north to Ria Lagartos Biosphere Reserve for a boat trip through mangroves where you'll spot pink flamingos and crocodiles. Next comes a Mayan mud bath using mineral-rich white mud, followed by a lagoon dip. You'll cool off with a cenote swim, then travel to Valladolid for a walking tour that covers Mayan culture and the town's historic architecture.

days.title: Valladolid - Chichen Itza - Izamal - Merida
included: Guided tour of Chichen Itza archaeological site
Merida historic downtown tour including Paseo de Montejo, Plaza Grande, Cathedral, Casa de Los Montejo, Government Palace and City Hall
optional: Free time to explore Merida on your own
landmarks: Convent of St Anthony of Padua
days.description: After breakfast, you're heading to Chichen Itza to see major Maya structures including the Temple of Kukulkan, Great Ball Court, Skull Platform, Sacred Cenote, and Temple of the Warriors. From there, move on to Izamal to visit the Convent of St Anthony of Padua, built on a former Maya pyramid. Grab lunch on your own, then continue to Merida for a downtown tour covering Paseo de Montejo, Plaza Grande, the cathedral, Casa de Los Montejo, and both the Government Palace and City Hall.

days.title: Merida - Uxmal - Campeche
included: Guided tour of Uxmal UNESCO World Heritage Site
days.description: Starting with breakfast, you'll explore Uxmal, a UNESCO site with the 35-metre Pyramid of the Magician, the ornately carved Nunnery Quadrangle, Governor's Palace, and the Great Pyramid rising from the jungle. Stop at a Cacao Museum to learn how ancient Mayans used the plant, then head to Campeche for check-in.

days.title: Campeche - Palenque
included: Panoramic tour of Campeche historic coastal city
Walking tour to see old city walls and St Francis' Cathedral
days.description: After breakfast, take a panoramic tour of historic Campeche, driving past the old town's pastel colonial houses, arcades, and bell-gabled churches. Walk through to see the old city walls and St Francis' Cathedral. Later, you'll travel to Palenque in Chiapas, a significant site of the Ch'ol Maya people in Mexico's southern region.

days.title: Palenque
included: Guided tour of Palenque UNESCO World Heritage Site including Temple of the Inscriptions, Palace, Temple of the Count and Temple of the Cross
days.description: On a guided tour of Palenque (B'aakal in ancient Maya), you'll see the Temple of the Inscriptions, the Palace, Temple of the Count, and Temple of the Cross. Later in the day, visit a waterfall to experience some of Mexico's natural landscape.

days.title: Palenque - Becan - Chetumal
days.description: Following breakfast, head east to Becan, an ancient Maya ceremonial centre and city that still holds many mysteries. Take time to see the main structures before continuing to Chetumal, the capital of Quintana Roo state, for your check-in.

days.title: Chetumal - Bacalar - Tulum - Cancun
days.description: After breakfast, visit the small town and lagoon of Bacalar, known as the 'Lagoon of Seven Colours' for its different shades of blue, and stop for photos. Continue north to Tulum, one of the last Maya cities built and inhabited, where ancient ruins sit above aqua waters and white sand beaches. From there, head to Cancun for drop-off at your extension hotel.

qa.question: How strenuous is this tour? We are in our seventies and are limited in our physical activities.

Considering that you have shared you are seventy years old and have limited physical activity, we kindly recommend carefully evaluating your comfort level and endurance for this type of tour. Our goal is for you to feel safe, comfortable, and able to fully enjoy the experience.

intro: Get to know the softer side of the huge and bustling capital of Mexico during this five-day guaranteed departure tour. See the main attractions of Mexico City and venture into a boat ride through the canals of Xochimilco or Colonial Rome. It was one of the first residential districts of the city and today it is one of the most popular colonies. Let all this beauty amaze you as you approach the culture of Mexico, the mariachi scene and the interesting history.

days.title: Mexico City
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional de la Ciudad de México (MEX), Capitán Carlos León S/N, Mexico City, Distrito Federal 15620, Mexico (Pick up at Mexico City International Airport (AICM), 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive at Mexico City International Airport and get picked up for a transfer to your hotel. After settling in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and explore whatever catches your eye in the neighborhood around where you're staying.

days.title: Mexico City
included: National Palace visit with Diego Rivera murals
Plaza Garibaldi visit with mariachi performances
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at the hotel), Dinner (Dinner at Bellini revolving restaurant with one local drink included, offering traditional Mexican and international flavours with panoramic views overlooking the city)
days.description: Following breakfast, join a guide for a city tour covering the historic center, Zocalo, Metropolitan Cathedral, and National Palace to see the Diego Rivera murals. Then head to the Anthropological Museum where you'll have free time starting around 2 pm. Later in the evening, dinner happens at Bellini, a revolving restaurant with views across the city (one local drink is included). After that, you'll go to Plaza Garibaldi to catch mariachi performances and traditional dancing, plus another included traditional drink.

days.title: Mexico City - Xochimilco - Coyoacan
included: Frida Kahlo Museum (The Blue House) entrance and visit
optional: Mariachi band entertainment on trajinera (hired for visitors)
Lunch purchase from trajinera vendors during cruise
days.description: This full day covers several areas of Mexico City. You'll drive along Insurgentes Avenue, passing the bullfighting ring and the University of Mexico campus with the 1968 Olympic Stadium. Then it's out to Xochimilco's canals where you'll take a traditional trajinera boat through the floating gardens, and local vendors sell food from their boats if you want lunch. Later, head to Coyoacan to walk through the colonial neighborhood with its sixteenth-century buildings and the Church of San Bautista, then visit the Frida Kahlo Museum housed in the Blue House.

days.title: Mexico City - Teotihuacan - Mexico City
included: Plaza de las Tres Culturas visit and panoramic view
Basilica of Guadalupe entrance and atrium visit

intro: If you are planning to visit India for the first time, there is no better option than the Golden Triangle Tour - Covering Delhi, Agra and Jaipur.

days.title: New Delhi to Agra
days.start_point: New Delhi, Delhi, India (Pick-up from New Delhi Airport or Delhi Hotel , 08:00 - 13:00)
days.description: Your driver will collect you from New Delhi Airport, the railway station, or your hotel and take you to Agra on the expressway, which takes about 3.5 hours. Once you arrive, settle into your hotel and grab lunch. The afternoon focuses on two sites: head to Baby Taj Mahal first to see its detailed architecture up close, then move to Mehtab Bagh later for sunset views of the Taj Mahal across the water.

days.title: Agra to Jaipur
included: Tuk Tuk or Battery Buses at Taj Mahal
optional: Visit Fatehpur Sikri en route to Jaipur
days.meals: Breakfast (Daily Breakfast at Hotel), Lunch (1 Lunch during Agra sightseeing)
days.description: Start early to catch the sunrise at Taj Mahal. You'll have time to walk around this UNESCO World Heritage Site before the crowds arrive. After that, head to Agra Fort, which dates back to 1080 AD and has some impressive architecture and views. Around midday you'll drive toward Jaipur (about 5 hours total), with an option to stop at Fatehpur Sikri along the way if you want to see the red sandstone city that Emperor Akbar built. You should arrive in Jaipur by evening and get checked into your hotel.

days.title: Jaipur
days.description: Following breakfast, spend the morning at Amber Fort, then walk through City Palace and visit Jantar Mantar observatory. Later in the day, make stops for photos at Jal Mahal and Hawa Mahal. Both palaces show off different sides of Jaipur's architectural style and give you good material for photos throughout the day.

days.title: Jaipur to New Delhi
days.description: After breakfast, check out The Albert Hall Museum to see its collection. From there, head back to New Delhi (roughly a 5.5 hour drive). You'll reach your New Delhi hotel by evening and check in for the night.

days.title: New Delhi
days.description: Your guide takes you through New Delhi's major landmarks after breakfast, starting with Humayun's Tomb and moving to Jama Masjid. You'll see India Gate, then head to Lotus Temple and Gurudwara Bangla Sahib with its Sarovar pool. After that, visit Raj Ghat, Gandhi's memorial, and drive past the President's House, Parliament, and Government Secretariat. In the evening, transfer to the airport, railway station, or your hotel.

intro:
Explore magnificent Turkey with 10 Days customized package by plane from/to Istanbul. - Begin your journey by understanding the architectural marvels and historical significance of City of the World’s Desire Istanbul

- Experience the sensation of troglodytic living in a cave hotel

- Staying in characteristic hotels in Istanbul, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia

- Enjoy the mineral-rich springs of Pamukkale’s striking travertine terraces

Dress Code & Recommendations

days.title: Istanbul
days.start_point: Istanbul, Turkey (Istanbul / SAW Airport)
days.description: Your driver will meet you at Istanbul/SAW Airport and take you to your hotel. After you check in, you'll have the evening to settle in and rest up before your tour starts tomorrow.

days.title: Istanbul
days.description: Your full-day Istanbul tour kicks off at 09:16. You'll start at Hagia Sophia, the massive Byzantine religious center, then head to Topkapi Palace, which served as the former imperial residence and Ottoman government seat. From there, you'll see the ancient Hippodrome built by Roman Emperor Septimus Severus back in 203 AD. Next comes the Blue Mosque with its six minarets and dome. You'll finish up at the Grand Bazaar, which has 18 entrances and over 4,000 shops to walk through.

days.title: Istanbul to Kusadasi
included: Guided tour of Spice Bazaar (Egyptian Bazaar)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and meet your guide for a half-day Istanbul tour. You'll explore the Spice Bazaar with its aromatic herbs and spices, then take a traditional Bosphorus cruise past Dolmabahce Palace, Rustem Pasa Mosque, Rumeli Fortress, and Yildiz Palace's parks. Later, you'll drive to the airport for your flight to Izmir. Your driver will meet you there and transfer you to your hotel in Kusadasi for the night.

days.title: Kusadasi
included: Guided tour of House of Virgin Mary
Guided tour of Temple of Artemis (Artemision)
days.description: You'll meet your guide for a full-day tour of ancient Ephesus. First you'll visit the House of Virgin Mary, a church built on 1st century AD foundations where Mary is believed to have spent her final days. Then you'll explore the ancient city of Ephesus itself, one of the best-preserved classical cities with impressive monuments including the third-largest library of the ancient world and the largest Roman theatre on the Asian continent. You'll also see the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. After a full day, you'll return to your hotel in Kusadasi.

days.title: Kusadasi to Antalya
included: Guided tour of Hierapolis ancient city
days.description: After breakfast you'll check out and meet your guide for a full-day tour. You'll visit Pamukkale, the UNESCO World Heritage terraces formed by warm spring water containing calcium bicarbonate, known as the earliest spa on earth. Then you'll explore the ancient city of Hierapolis with its massive necropolis and the Sacred Pool with thermal waters over Roman ruins. Later, you'll drive to Antalya and check in for the night.

days.title: Antalya
included: Free exploration of Kaleiçi old town
One-hour sightseeing boat tour along Antalya coastline
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional Turkish cuisine at local restaurant)
days.description: Your guide will meet you at 09:00 for a city tour. You'll head to Karpuzkaldiaran and Duden Waterfalls to see the cascading water and green surroundings while exploring park paths and scenic viewpoints. You'll grab lunch at a local restaurant with traditional Turkish cuisine. After that, you'll spend 1 to 1.5 hours in Kaleiçi, Antalya's old town, discovering narrow stone streets, Hadrian's Gate, the Clock Tower, Kesik Minare, boutiques, art galleries and souvenir shops. You'll finish with a one-hour sightseeing boat tour along the coastline, admiring the cliffs, city skyline and turquoise Mediterranean. The tour ends around 16:00.

days.title: Antalya to Cappadocia
optional: Cappadocia Sunset Quad Safari (available if flight is in the morning)
Turkish Bath in Antalya (available if flight is in the afternoon)
days.description: You'll meet your guide for a full-day Cappadocia tour. First you'll explore Goreme Museum with its rock-cut churches featuring colorful frescoes from the 9th century. Then you'll visit Devrent Valley, famous for its quirky animal-shaped rock formations, and Pasabagi (Monks Valley) with its hermitage sites. You'll stop in Avanos for typical Turkish lunch and get to try pottery-making with local experts. Later you'll continue to Goreme Panorama for panoramic views of the fairy chimneys and visit Uchisar, the natural highest rock castle offering magnificent panoramic views. You'll return to your hotel by evening.

days.title: Cappadocia
included: Guided tour of Uchisar Rock Castle
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Typical Turkish lunch in Avanos)
days.description: After breakfast you'll check out and explore more of Cappadocia's unique landscape. You'll visit Rose Valley with its pink-tinted ridges, especially beautiful at sunset, and see Cavusin village surrounded by the Red Valley, famous for its rock churches and houses carved into massive formations. You'll walk through Pigeon Valley, named for its countless man-made dovecotes carved into volcanic tuff. Then you'll explore the Underground Cities, a 15,000-person refuge with eight stories of bedrooms, churches, meeting halls and storage rooms connected by 30km of corridors. You'll also visit Ortahisar, known for its friendly inhabitants, picturesque stone houses, churches and castle-like rock formation. Later, you'll drive to Kayseri Airport for your 1 hour 30 minute domestic flight back to Istanbul, where your driver will meet and transfer you to your hotel.

days.title: Cappadocia to Istanbul
days.description: After breakfast at the hotel, you'll check out according to your flight departure time and transfer to Istanbul Airport. Your tour ends.

days.title: Istanbul

intro:
Get ready for an amazing adventure with our 7-day Cusco travel package! You'll get to experience some of the most stunning destinations that Peru has to offer, including Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake, and Rainbow Mountain.

­ 

Subject to Availability:


Entrance tickets to Machu Picchu via the classic route (Circuit 2) are subject to availability. If tickets for Circuit 2 are not available at the time of your reservation, we will offer alternative circuits, such as Circuit 1 or 3, based on the available options. Additionally, please note that a private guide will be required in Machu Picchu, which will incur an additional cost.


You'll start your journey in Cusco, where you can explore the city and visit iconic landmarks like Sacsayhuaman and Qorikancha. From there, you'll venture into the Sacred Valley of the Incas, where you can soak up the breathtaking scenery and discover the unique Maras Moray.

­ 

Next up, get ready to tick off one of the Seven Wonders of the World from your bucket list, as you make your way to the legendary Machu Picchu. Marvel at the ancient ruins and learn about the fascinating Inca civilization that once thrived there.

­ 

But the adventure doesn't stop there! You'll also get to witness the enchanting Humantay Lake and the mesmerizing Rainbow Mountain, both of which offer spellbinding views that will leave you breathless.

­ 

Get ready to make unforgettable memories and discover the enchanting beauty of Peru with our 7-day Cusco travel package. Join us for an adventure of a lifetime that you'll cherish forever!

days.title: Cusco
included: Cusco City Tour with professional guide
days.start_point: Plaza de Armas de Cusco, Plaza de Armas, Cusco, Cusco, Peru (We'll be there to pick you up from the airport when you arrive, and from your Cusco hotel for all your tours too. Easy peasy!)
days.description: A KANTU PERU TOURS representative meets you at the airport and drives you to your hotel in Cusco. After you check in and rest for a bit, you'll get picked up around 12:30-13:00 for a city tour. The afternoon takes you through the Cathedral, Qoricancha (Temple of the Sun), Sacsayhuaman fortress, Q'enqo (Temple of the Puma), Tambomachay water temple, and Puca Pucara red fortress. You'll wrap up around 18:30 back in the city center.

days.title: Sacred Valley to Aguas Calientes

Visit Ollantaytambo with Temple of the Sun
days.description: The day starts at 8:00 a.m. with a stop at the Sacred Valley viewpoint for great views, then you'll head to the Inca site of Pisac where your guide explains the details. From there, it's on to Urubamba for an Inca buffet lunch, followed by a visit to Ollantaytambo and the Temple of the Sun. Later in the afternoon, you'll take a train from Ollantaytambo station (about 1 hour 45 minutes) down to Aguas Calientes, where your local Machu Picchu guide will reach out with information about tomorrow.

days.description: After breakfast, you'll take a bus for roughly 30 minutes to reach the Machu Picchu entrance (make sure you have your original passport). You get that iconic first look at Machu Picchu, then a guided tour walks you through the highlights like the main square, sundial, and Temple of the Condor. Following the tour, you'll head back to Aguas Calientes for lunch at a local restaurant (your own expense). By mid-afternoon, you're at the train station to board back to Ollantaytambo (arriving around 20:00-22:00), where your representative takes you to Cusco.

days.title: Moray and Maras Salt Mines
included: Visit Chinchero Highlands with weaving demonstration
Moray Maras Tour with professional guide
days.description: Starting at 8:00 a.m., you'll travel through the Chinchero Highlands (about 45 minutes) to this colorful town and watch local farmers do a weaving demonstration. Then it's roughly 30 minutes to Moray, an Inca agricultural laboratory with circular terraces, and you'll pass through large barley farmlands on the way. Next comes the impressive Maras Salt Mines with their distinctive small evaporation pools. You'll be back in Cusco city center around 14:00.

days.title: Rainbow Mountain
included: Guided hike to Rainbow Mountain (approximately 2 hours)
Rainbow Mountain Tour with professional guide
days.meals: Breakfast (Delicious breakfast in Cusipata before hike), Lunch (Delicious buffet lunch in Cusipata)
days.description: Pick-up is at 4:00 a.m. for a 3.5-hour drive through impressive landscapes, canyons, and past glaciers like Ausangate. Once you reach Cusipata (4,326 m / 14,189 ft), you'll have breakfast before a 2-hour hike to Rainbow Mountain (5,020 m / 16,466 feet). You'll spend time taking photos and taking in the natural surroundings, then hike back down to Cusipata for a buffet lunch. You arrive back in Cusco city center around 16:30.

days.title: Lake Humantay
included: Guided hike to Lake Humantay (approximately 2 hours)
Lake Humantay Tour with professional guide
days.meals: Breakfast (Delicious breakfast in Mollepata), Lunch (Buffet lunch in Mollepata)
days.description: Early pick-up at 4:00 a.m. for roughly a 3-hour journey to the lake region. You'll stop in Mollepata town for breakfast and to grab snacks and water, then continue 45 minutes to the Soraypampa trailhead. Your tour leader gives you a quick overview before you begin an approximately 2-hour uphill hike to Lake Humantay (that turquoise lake with glacier views). You can also rent a horse instead of hiking if you prefer. After exploring the lake and the landscape around it, you descend back to your transportation for lunch. You'll arrive in Cusco city center around 18:30.

days.description: Depending on your flight departure time, staff pick you up from your hotel 2 hours 30 minutes before departure and take you to the airport. Services end once you're dropped off.

intro:
Asian Heritage and Treks, a renowned touring company known for providing exceptional travel experiences, organizes and facilitates The Nepal Highlights Tour Package. Asian Heritage and Treks is committed to showcasing Nepal's rich cultural heritage and natural beauty, ensuring that every aspect of your journey is seamless and memorable.

The Nepal Highlights Tour Package is a specially designed tour that will give you a comprehensive introduction to Nepal. It is one of Nepal's most popular tour packages. We begin the Nepal Highlights tour in Kathmandu (including its sister cities, Patan and Bhaktapur) and travel to Bandipur, Chitwan National Park, Lumbini, and finally Pokhara.

­

The Nepal Highlights Tour Package starts in Kathmandu. We travel to Chitwan, a flatland in the south of the country. In Chitwan National Park, we will participate in activities such as jungle safaris, bird watching, and canoeing on the Rapti River. Chitwan National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. After Chitwan, we will travel to Lumbini, the birthplace of "Lord Gautam Buddha," also known as the "Light of Asia." We will visit Lumbini's Maya Devi Temple, Ashoka Pillar, and Lumbini Museum.

­ 

After a peaceful stay in Lumbini, we will travel to the enchanting lakeside city of Pokhara. You can see the majestic mountain on the horizon and reflect on the famous Phewa Lake. The next morning, we drive to Sarangkot to witness the breathtaking sunrise. This location provides a panoramic view of Mt. Annapurna, Nilgiri, Glacier Dome, Fishtail Mountain, and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges.

days.title: Kathmandu
days.start_point: Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM) त्रिभुवन विमानस्थल, त्रिभुवन विमानस्थल, Kathmandu, Bagmati, Nepal (Arrival)
days.description: You'll arrive at the airport where your Asian Heritage Treks & Travel representative meets you for the transfer to your hotel in Thamel. The drive takes you past Pashupatinath Temple, Narayanhity Royal Palace Museum, and the Garden of Dreams, so you'll get your first real sense of Kathmandu's layout right away. After checking in, the rest of the day is yours to wander Thamel's streets at your own pace and settle into the neighborhood.

days.title: Kathmandu
days.description: After breakfast, you'll have a guide and driver with you for the day exploring Kathmandu's main sites. Start with the intricate temples at Kathmandu Durbar Square, then head to Swyambhunath (Monkey Temple) for views across the city. From there, you'll continue to Pashupatinath Temple to observe traditional Hindu cremation ceremonies along the river. Later, Boudhanath Stupa, dating back to 600 A.D., gives you a quieter spiritual space before heading back to your hotel to rest.

days.title: Patan and Bhaktapur
days.description: Your guide drives you to Patan first, where you'll see Krishna Temple and Patan Durbar Square, then check out the Patan Museum to understand the city's history. You'll also stop at the Golden Temple and Banglamukhi Temple before heading to Bhaktapur to admire the wood-carved architecture and visit Nyatapola Temple. The afternoon includes a traditional pottery-making class at Pottery Square where you'll design and decorate your own pot with patterns.

days.title: Kathmandu to Chitwan
optional: Explore local market and streets of Chitwan
days.description: You'll drive about 150 to 160 kilometers southwest toward Chitwan, and the landscape gradually shifts to denser forest as you travel. After checking into your hotel, you have time to relax and walk through the local market and streets. In the evening before bed, there's a Tharu cultural program performance to give you a taste of local traditions.

days.title: Chitwan
days.description: The entire day focuses on Chitwan's wildlife. Start with a jeep safari through the community forest section to look for one-horned rhinos, wild boar, deer, and leopards. You'll cross the Rapti River into the main national park where Royal Bengal Tigers inhabit the highland areas with tall bushes, plus wild elephants and other animals roam around. Lunch happens back at your hotel, then the afternoon includes a guided Tharu village tour and canoeing on the Rapti River to spot Marsh Mugger and Gharial crocodiles.

days.title: Chitwan to Lumbini
included: Visit Elephant and Crocodile Breeding Center
days.description: Begin early with a bird-watching tour along the Rapti Riverbank while your guide explains different species and their seasonal migration patterns. Next, visit the Elephant and Crocodile Breeding Center to see how these animals are protected and learn about their life cycles. Then you'll travel 150 kilometers to Lumbini, check in, and rest before visiting Maya Devi Temple, Ashoka Pillar, and the Lumbini Museum in the late afternoon.

days.title: Lumbini to Pokhara
optional: Stroll around lakeside street of Pokhara
Walk along the bank of Phewa Lake
days.description: You'll travel 210 kilometers northwest to Pokhara, check into your hotel, and take time to rest. By afternoon, head out for a leisurely walk around the lakeside street and explore the banks of Phewa Lake at a relaxed pace.

days.title: Pokhara
days.description: Start before sunrise with a drive to Sarangkot to catch the first light hitting the mountains and see views of Annapurna, Fishtail, Dhaulagiri, and surrounding peaks. You'll drive back to your hotel, then head to World Peace Stupa about an hour away for different perspectives of the same ranges. The hike down to Phewa Lake takes 40 to 60 minutes, then you'll take a boat to Barahi Temple in the lake. Later, check out Devi's Fall, Gupteswor Cave, and Seti Gorge before returning to rest.

days.title: Pokhara to Kathmandu
optional: Stroll around downtown area of Thamel
days.description: After breakfast you'll drive back to Kathmandu from Pokhara, and the route includes a stop at Bandipur, a charming old Newari town worth a quick look. Once in Kathmandu, check into your hotel and relax. In the evening, take a walk around Thamel's downtown area to reorient yourself.

days.title: Kathmandu
optional: Flight over the mountains (Everest flight) (approximately 1 hour)
Stroll around the streets of Thamel
days.description: Your trip ends today. After breakfast, your representative picks you up in a private van for the transfer to Kathmandu Tribhuvan International Airport, departing about three hours before your scheduled flight home or to your next destination.

days.title: Kathmandu Departure
days.description: This day is free in Kathmandu. You can rest and relax, or walk through Thamel's streets on your own. Many travelers use this time to shop for souvenirs and gifts. This marks the end of the Nepal Highlights Tour.

intro: Experience the biggest stars of the East African savanna. The mighty Lion, the majestic Elephant, the rare and powerful Black Rhino, the graceful Leopard, and the stoic Cape Buffalo. There is no better way of experiencing a classic Safari adventure.

days.title: Kilimanjaro Airport to Moshi
days.start_point: Moshi, Kilimanjaro, Tanzania (kilimanjaro airport)
days.description: You'll land at Kilimanjaro Airport and move through customs, where your driver meets you holding a sign with your name. The drive takes you to Moshi for check-in, giving you time to settle in and rest after travel.

days.title: Lake Manyara National Park
included: Game drive in Lake Manyara National Park
Wildlife viewing including tree-climbing lions, buffalo, impala, giraffe, bushbuck, waterbuck, hippos, elephants, blue monkeys, velvet monkeys, and olive baboons
days.description: Morning drive brings you to Lake Manyara National Park. You'll spend the day exploring different habitats like groundwater forests, acacia woodlands, and open plains. Game viewing lets you spot tree-climbing lions, buffalo, giraffes, hippos, and various monkey species throughout the park.

days.title: Lake Manyara to Serengeti National Park
included: Game drive en route to Serengeti National Park
optional: Visit Masaai Village and participate in tribal activities
Visit Olduvai Gorge museum (Cradle of Humanity)
days.description: After breakfast, you head toward Serengeti National Park. On the way, you can choose to visit either a Maasai village to learn about local culture and join in activities, or Olduvai Gorge to see the museum dedicated to human origins. Later you'll do a game drive on your way to camp.

days.title: Serengeti National Park
included: Full day game drive in Serengeti National Park
Wildlife viewing including wildebeest, zebra, antelope, lion, cheetah, and other plains game
days.description: You start with a morning game drive, then head toward Ngorongoro Crater. After descending into the 600m deep crater that spans 16km across, you'll see around 20,000 large animals including black rhinos, lions, cheetahs, zebras, and gazelles. Stop by Makat Soda Lake to watch flamingos and other birds before driving to your lodge in the afternoon.

days.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
included: Morning game drive to Ngorongoro Crater
Game drive and exploration in Ngorongoro Crater
Wildlife viewing including black rhinos, lions, cheetahs, elands, zebras, gazelles, and flamingos
days.description: Morning drive takes you to Tarangire National Park. The Tarangire River runs through the park and acts as the only permanent water source during dry seasons, which draws hundreds of animals to the area. Spend the day viewing wildlife and birds across savanna plains, swamps, hills, and distinctive baobab trees.

days.title: Tarangire National Park
included: Full day game drive in Tarangire National Park
days.description: You have a relaxed morning in Moshi before your driver transfers you to Kilimanjaro Airport for your flight home.

days.title: Materuni Coffee Farm and Waterfall
included: Coffee farm visit and learning about coffee production
Coffee roasting and preparation experience (Chagga method)
days.description: This full day in Serengeti focuses on wildlife viewing. You'll watch massive herds of wildebeest, zebra, and antelope during the migration season. The landscape shifts from grassy plains to woodland areas, and you'll look for lions and cheetahs around the kopjes and rock formations.

days.title: Hot Springs
included: Swimming and relaxation at Hot Springs
days.description: Driving from Moshi toward Mt Kilimanjaro's slopes, you reach the village of Materuni. At a local coffee farm, you'll learn about growing, harvesting, and processing coffee, then try roasting and preparing it the Chagga way. After that, you hike about 45 minutes through hills and valleys past banana and coffee plantations to reach Materuni Falls, which drops 200 feet into a valley. Swimming and soaking in the natural pool follows, with your guide explaining local plants used for food and traditional medicine.

days.title: Departure from Moshi
days.description: The drive from Moshi to the Hot Springs takes roughly an hour on a bumpy, winding road that gives you authentic views of Tanzanian countryside. When you arrive, you'll swim and relax in the natural hot springs, have lunch, and spend time soaking in the sun.

name: Morocco 7 Days Tour From Casablanca

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Embark on an unforgettable 7-day journey through Morocco, starting from the vibrant city of Casablanca. This tour offers a perfect blend of cultural discovery, historical exploration, and breathtaking natural landscapes. As you travel across the country, you’ll experience the rich diversity that makes Morocco unique, from its bustling cities to its serene deserts and majestic mountains.


Discover Morocco’s fascinating history as you stroll through ancient medinas, where narrow alleys lead to colorful souks filled with spices, textiles, and handcrafted treasures. Explore stunning architectural landmarks, including intricate palaces, grand mosques, and centuries-old kasbahs that tell the story of Morocco’s past.


The adventure continues with scenic drives through diverse landscapes—lush valleys, rugged mountain passes, and the golden dunes of the Sahara Desert. Experience the thrill of a camel trek at sunset, and spend a magical night in a traditional desert camp under a sky full of stars, accompanied by the rhythmic sounds of Berber drums.


Throughout the journey, you’ll be immersed in Moroccan culture, meeting friendly locals, savoring delicious traditional dishes, and enjoying the country’s warm hospitality. This 7-day tour is more than just a trip; it’s an authentic Moroccan experience filled with memories you’ll cherish forever.

days.title: Casablanca - Rabat - Chefchaouen
optional: Explore Chefchaouen's blue-painted streets and alleys
Enjoy local food and culture in Chefchaouen
days.start_point: Casablanca, Casablanca-Settat, Morocco (Pick you up from your hotel Or Airport )
days.description: Your journey starts at the Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca, where you'll see the ornate architecture and oceanfront setting of this significant religious site. From there, you'll drive to Rabat and spend time at Bab Challah, the Mausoleum of Mohammed V, and walk through the Oudaya Kasbah with its narrow streets and views over the river. After grabbing lunch, it's on to Chefchaouen where you'll have the afternoon and evening to walk around the blue-painted buildings and streets before settling into your accommodation.

days.title: Chefchaouen - Volubilis - Fes
included: Explore Chefchaouen's blue-painted streets and alleys
Guided tour of Volubilis Roman ruins
days.description: You'll start slow in Chefchaouen, exploring the blue-painted medina at your own pace and checking out the 15th-century kasbah and Great Mosque. Later in the day, you'll drive to the Roman ruins at Volubilis to see mosaics, archways, and columns from centuries past. Then it's a drive to Fes where you'll stay overnight in a traditional riad, giving you a chance to settle in and rest before a full day of exploration tomorrow.

days.title: Fes
days.description: A local guide will show you around Fes for the entire day. You'll enter the medieval Medina through the Blue Gate near the Royal Palace and walk through areas like the Medrasa Bouanania and Najjarine Fountain. The guide will explain the ancient leather tanning process, and you'll visit the Quaraouin Mosque and University. Later you'll see the Jewish Quarter and climb to a viewpoint overlooking the entire Medina before heading back to your riad.

days.title: Fes - Ifrane - Cedar Forest - Midelt - Ziz Valley - Merzouga
included: Visit Cedar Forest and see Barbary macaques
optional: Feed Barbary macaques in Cedar Forest
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Traditional Moroccan dishes such as tagine, couscous, salads, and other local specialties)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive south through Imouzzer to Ifrane, which has Alpine-style architecture that feels out of place in Morocco. Stop at the Cedar Forest to see Barbary macaques in their natural habitat, then continue to Midelt for lunch and some free time. The drive continues through the Tizi-n-Tilghmt pass and along the Ziz Valley before you reach Merzouga in the afternoon. You'll trade your vehicle for camels and ride through the sand dunes, watching the sunset from a high point, then arrive at a desert camp for traditional Berber music and dinner.

days.title: Merzouga - Rissani - Erfoud - Todra Gorges - Dades Valley
optional: Browse Rissani market for traditional goods
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Traditional Moroccan cuisine prepared with local ingredients)
days.description: Rise early to catch the sunrise over the dunes and have breakfast before leaving the camp. You'll visit Rissani, the former capital, and browse its souk (open three days a week) with local goods and crafts. Stop in Erfoud to check out fossilized marble workshops, then drive through palm groves and reach the Todra Gorges with its tall red cliffs ideal for rock climbing if you're interested. After lunch at a local spot, you'll continue to Dades Valley, seeing the unusual 'Monkey Fingers' rock formations and valley views before arriving at your hotel for dinner.

days.title: Dades Valley - Ait Ben Haddou - Ouarzazate - High Atlas Mountains - Marrakech
included: Guided tour of Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah
optional: Explore Rose Valley products and annual Rose Festival (May)
days.description: Starting with breakfast at your riad, you'll head to Kalaa Magouna to explore the Rose Valley and see the rose production (the annual Rose Festival happens in May if you're traveling then). The route takes you through palm groves near Skoura and on to Ouarzazate where you can visit movie studios used for major films. You'll spend time at Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO site with impressive mud-brick buildings that appeared in several blockbuster films. Then it's a drive toward Marrakech through the Tizi-N-Tichka pass with lunch and photo stops along the way.

days.title: Marrakech - Casablanca
optional: Explore additional Marrakech attractions (if time available)
days.description: After breakfast at your riad, you'll spend the morning in Marrakech visiting the Majorelle Gardens, the Koutoubia Minaret, the Saadian Tombs, and the Bahia Palace. Your afternoon plans depend on your flight time or how you want to finish the tour. If you're flying later, you'll have more time to explore further; if you'd rather head back to Casablanca, you'll take the highway there to wrap up.

name: 7-Day Ireland to Island Small Group Tour of Ireland

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Get more from your small group tour with the Ireland to Island experience. Featuring Ireland and two of its most famous islands this tour never disappoints. Visit the UNESCO World Heritage site and Puffin sanctuary, Skellig Michael, delve into Ireland’s past by visiting the Rock of Cashel steeped in 1000 years of history and explore the beautiful seaside village of Cobh, the final port of the marvellous Titanic. Explore Killarney National Park and visit the jaw dropping sights of The Cliffs of Moher. Sail across Galway Bay to the spectacular Aran Islands and soak up the atmosphere in the artsy city of Galway. Of course, no trip to Ireland is complete without a trip to one of our famous distillers, so let’s meet the makers of our beloved Jameson!

days.title: Dublin to Cobh
included: Guided tour of Rock of Cashel including round tower and Cormac's Chapel
Midleton Distillery tour and whiskey tasting
optional: Explore Cobh waterfront and vibrant streets at leisure
days.start_point: Ashling Hotel, Parkgate St, Dublin, D07, Ireland ( The Ashling Hotel Dublin,10 - 13 Parkgate St, Stoneybatter, Dublin 8, D08 P38N, 08:00)
days.description: Start heading south from Dublin toward Cork, and your first stop is the Rock of Cashel, where you'll see the medieval fortress with its round tower and ancient chapel ruins scattered across the hilltop. From there, head to Midleton Distillery for a whiskey tour and tasting to learn about Irish whiskey production. By evening, you'll arrive in Cobh, a colorful harbour town where you can settle in and explore the waterfront.

days.title: Cobh to Waterville
included: Blarney Castle and Gardens tour including kissing the Blarney Stone
Ring of Kerry scenic drive with stops in Kenmare
optional: Lunch in Blarney area (not included in tour price)
days.description: Begin at Blarney Castle where you'll kiss the famous Blarney Stone and walk through its gardens and Rock Close. After grabbing lunch in the area, you'll travel into the Ring of Kerry, stopping in Kenmare, a charming town with local shops and cafes. The drive continues through scenic coastal and mountain landscapes, ending in Waterville, a peaceful fishing village where you can relax by the water.

days.title: Skellig Michael and Killarney
included: Skellig Michael landing tour with exploration of beehive huts and monastic site
optional: Alternative experience if weather prevents Skellig Michael landing (specific alternative not detailed)
Traditional Irish music and pubs in Killarney (not included in tour price)
days.description: Travel out to Skellig Michael, a UNESCO World Heritage Site off the coast, to explore the island with its beehive huts and ancient monastic ruins sitting on the cliffs. The boat ride itself offers great views of the coastline. Later, you'll head to Killarney for the evening, where you can enjoy traditional Irish music, good food, and check out the lively pubs in town.

days.title: Killarney National Park
included: Kayaking on the Lakes of Killarney with views of Ross Castle
Muckross House and Gardens guided tour
optional: Explore Killarney town at your own pace instead of kayaking
Traditional music, boutique shopping, and dining in Killarney (not included in tour price)
days.description: This morning, choose either a kayaking adventure on the Lakes of Killarney with Ross Castle's walls rising around you, or spend time exploring Killarney town on your own. In the afternoon, visit Muckross House and its gardens, then take a walk to Torc Waterfall. By evening, head back into Killarney to enjoy traditional music and dinner at one of the local restaurants.

days.title: Cliffs of Moher and Doolin
included: Cliffs of Moher guided hike with local guide on off-the-beaten-path trails
optional: Traditional Irish music and pubs in Doolin (not included in tour price)
days.description: Start the day watching a traditional sheepdog demonstration to see how farmers and dogs work together. Then you'll take the Shannon Ferry crossing into County Clare and explore the Burren National Park with its unusual limestone landscape. After that, hike the Cliffs of Moher with a local guide who'll take you along quieter trails away from the crowds. By evening, settle into Doolin, a colorful village known for its pubs and traditional music sessions.

days.title: Aran Islands and Galway
included: Cliffs of Moher cruise on return journey
optional: Traditional music, boutique shopping, and dining in Galway (not included in tour price)
days.description: Set sail to Inis Oírr, the smallest and most remote of the Aran Islands, and bike around exploring stone walls, white-sand beaches, and ancient ruins while experiencing how locals live. After returning from the island, you'll take a Cliffs of Moher cruise to see those cliffs from the ocean, which gives a completely different perspective. Later, travel to Galway, a vibrant city with medieval streets, bohemian shops, traditional music venues, and lively atmosphere.

days.title: Galway to Dublin
included: Walk Talk Taste Tour of Galway (guided food and culture experience)
optional: Browse local boutiques for Claddagh rings and woollen shawls
Dining and entertainment in Dublin (not included in tour price)
days.description: Spend your morning and early afternoon exploring Galway's bohemian streets at your own pace, checking out boutiques and soaking in the atmosphere. Then join the Walk Talk Taste Tour, a guided culinary walk where you'll sample local produce and learn about the city's history through its food and culture. In the early evening, head back to Dublin, wrapping up your week of Irish exploration.

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

intro:
Enjoy  the timeless experience that is a Nile cruise as you sail from Aswan to Luxor on an indulgent ship as you discover ancient Egypt’s highlights. 

Discover unique treasures from the Egyptian bazaars.
Step back in time and learn all about the ancient world.

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo, Cairo, Egypt (We will pick you up from anywhere Cairo , 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive in Aswan and transfer to your 5-star Nile cruise ship for check-in. After resting a bit, your tour guide will go over what's coming up on the itinerary. The rest of the day you'll see Aswan's highlights including the Temple of Philae, the Unfinished Obelisk, and the Aswan High Dam. Back on the ship for lunch, and if you're interested, there's an optional afternoon visit to a Nubian village.

days.title: Cairo - Aswan
optional: Flight upgrade from Cairo to Aswan with 1 night hotel accommodation
Upgrade train to sleeping train (Cairo-Aswan/Luxor-Cairo round trip)
days.description: Early morning brings an optional trip to Abu Simbel to see the temples built by Ramesses II and Queen Nefertari. In the afternoon, the ship sails toward Kom Ombo where you'll visit the temple dedicated to gods Sobek and Horus and check out the mummified crocodile museum. From there, you'll continue sailing to Edfu for the night.

days.title: Aswan
days.description: You'll arrive in Edfu early and take a traditional horse carriage ride to the Edfu Temple, the second largest temple in the country. After that, the cruise heads to Luxor and pulls in during the afternoon. In the late afternoon, you'll explore the East Bank temples including the massive Karnak Temple Complex and the Luxor Temple.

days.title: Aswan - Kom Ombo - Edfu
optional: Early morning trip to Abu Simbel Temple
days.description: Early risers can take an optional sunrise hot air balloon ride over Luxor's West Bank for some great views. Then you'll head out to explore the West Bank, walking through the Valley of the Kings where 63 pharaohs were buried, seeing the Temple of Hatshepsut, and viewing the Colossi of Memnon. After returning to the ship and checking out, you'll transfer to the train station for an overnight trip back to Cairo.

days.title: Edfu - Luxor
included: Visit Edfu Temple by horse carriage
days.description: Your plane lands at Cairo airport and a representative meets you to help with immigration and customs. From there, you'll head to your apartment hotel in Cairo for check-in. Breakfast is already included at the hotel, so you can settle in and rest after your journey.

days.title: Luxor
optional: Sunrise hot air balloon ride over West Bank
Flight upgrade from Luxor to Cairo with 1 night hotel accommodation

intro:
Important Itinerary Change from 01 January 2027

Starting 01 January 2027, this package tour will be modified. and it will become one day longer than the current itinerary.  The tour will have one additional night in Konya to make Cappadocia to Pamukkale itinerary easier and It will also visit the Covent of Mevlana, the father of Whirling Dervishes.

Please note that until 31 December 2026, all tours will continue to run according to the existing itineraries as advertised. The new itineraries will only take effect on the website and in our bookings from 01 January 2027 onward.

Important trip notes

(*) This itinerary you are reading now is a draft and subject to change. Upon your booking, definitive information and a custom itinerary for your name, including hotels, meeting locations, times, emergency phone numbers, flight details, etc., will be clearly described in the trip document, which will be sent to you via email or uploaded to your dashboard. Please carefully review the trip document and you are welcome to ask any questions you may have. Any other document is not valid.

(*) The schedule and/or the order of the visits are subject to change based on the arrival day of the passenger or any other momentary reason without a prior notice

(*) Upgrade to Cave Hotel in Cappadocia. Please consult to our team

Guide language selection : Please mention it during your booking process if you prefer an English speaking guide or Spanish Speaking guide. The default language is English.

In case there are less then 6 people, we may combine both groups into one bus while reserving a dedicated guide for each language.

Spanish guided departures follow Çanakkale - Bursa - Istanbul itinerary .English guided departures follow Çanakkale - Gallipoli - Istanbul ­ itinerary

The Spanish itinerary doesn't visit Topkapı Palace in Istanbul and they visit Balat and Golden Horne.

days.title: Istanbul to Ankara
days.start_point: Istanbul, Turkey (Pick-up from Istanbul Hotels, 11:45 - 12:30)
days.description: Your hotel pickup happens between noon and 1 PM, then you'll travel to Ankara by deluxe coach. The route crosses over the iconic intercontinental bridge that connects Europe and Asia. Once you arrive in Ankara, Turkey's capital, you'll have dinner at your hotel and settle in for the night.

days.title: Ankara to Cappadocia via Salt Lake
included: Visit underground city with stables, common rooms, meeting room and family rooms
days.description: After breakfast, you'll explore Ankara's main attractions starting with the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations, which houses artifacts spanning from Palaeolithic through Urartu periods. You'll also visit the Ataturk Mausoleum before heading toward Cappadocia. Along the way, there's a stop at an underground city that Christian communities built centuries ago for protection from Arab raids. You'll see the stables, common areas, and family quarters carved into the rock. By evening you'll arrive in Cappadocia for overnight accommodation.

days.title: Cappadocia
included: Visit Goreme Valley with fairy chimneys and cave churches
Stop at troglodyte village of Uçhisar
Time at artisan workshops (carpets and onyx-stone jewelry)
optional: Hot air balloon tour - early morning departure from hotel, aerial views of Cappadocia, rock formations, fairy chimneys, natural formations, and lunar landscapes
days.description: After breakfast, you spend the day exploring Cappadocia's unique geology and history. The Goreme Valley is on the agenda with its distinctive fairy chimneys and cave churches featuring 10th-11th century paintings. From there, you'll check out the troglodyte village of Uchislar, wander through the scenic Avcilar area, and see Derbent valley's rock formations. There's time at local artisan workshops where you can see carpet making and onyx jewelry work. Dinner happens at your hotel. If you want, an optional hot air balloon tour launches early the next morning to see the landscape from above.

days.title: Cappadocia to Pamukkale via Sultanhani
included: Free time in Pamukkale with natural pools and travertine waterfalls
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll travel toward Pamukkale with a stop to see the Sultanhan Caravanserail, a medieval Seljuk inn that's well-preserved. When you reach Pamukkale, you'll have free time to explore the Cotton Castle with its natural hot spring pools and the white petrified travertine waterfalls. Dinner and accommodation are at your hotel in the evening.

days.title: Pamukkale to Izmir via Ephesus
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to Selcuk to spend time at the archaeological area of Ephesus, an ancient city built around the Temple of Artemis. You'll walk through the Odeon, Temple of Hadrian, House of Love, Library of Celsus, Agora, Marble Street, and the massive ancient theater. There's a visit to the House of the Virgin, thought to be where the Mother of Jesus spent her final years. Later, you'll stop at a leather production center before continuing to Izmir, Turkey's third-largest city. You'll have dinner and stay overnight at your hotel.

days.title: Izmir to Çanakkale via Pergamon and Troy
days.description: You'll depart after breakfast heading to Pergamon, now called Bergama, to see the Asclepion ruins—the most significant ancient hospital in Asia Minor with its therapeutic facilities. From there, you'll continue to Troy, the famous archaeological site from Homer's Iliad. The day finishes in Canakkale with dinner and overnight accommodation at your hotel.

days.title: Çanakkale to Istanbul via Gallipoli and ANZAC Cove
included: Ferry crossing of Dardanelles Strait by car
Visit Turkish and Allied trenches and tunnels
Visit Chunuk Bair New Zealand Memorial
days.description: After breakfast, you'll cross the Dardanelles Strait by car ferry to reach the Gallipoli Peninsula. The rest of the day focuses on the historically significant WWI Gallipoli Battlefields, where you'll visit Brighton Beach, Beach Cemetery, ANZAC Cove, Ariburnu Cemetery, the ANZAC Commemorative Site, Respect to Mehmetcik Statue, Lone Pine Australian Memorial, Johnston's Jolly, Turkish and Allied trenches and tunnels, the 57. Regiment Turkish Memorial, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair New Zealand Memorial. You'll return to Istanbul late, arriving between 8 PM and 9 PM, where a transfer takes you to your hotel to conclude the tour.

name: Central Asia - 5 Stans

attributes.name: City & Culture

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships
