intro:
5 Stans – 19 Days Tour

Kazakhstan: Almaty 

Kyrgyzstan: Bishkek - Issyk Kul - Grigorevka Gorge

Uzbekistan: Tashkent - Samarkand - Bukhara - Khiva

Turkmenistan: Mary - Ashgabat - Dashoguz.

Tajikistan:  Khujand

 .

You are touring with a USA based company with over 15 years of experience, not having to make your payment to a foreign private party via unsecure payment methods. East Site is the only travel agency in US with its own tour operating office based in Central Asia. We are not a third party; we actually operate each tour we sell. East Site is licensed and certified to operate tours.

.

All itineraries are well planned by guides with over 20 years of experience in the area. We are making sure that while on our tour nothing slips from your enjoyment and you get the most complete impression of the place you came to visit. Not just history, present day life and architecture, we also focus attention on cultures, customs, and traditions while interacting with local people.

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing
included: Falcon farm excursion with show program
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: Starting with breakfast, you'll spend the day checking out Almaty's main sights like Panfilov Park and Zenkov Wooden Cathedral. You'll also see St. Nicholas Cathedral, visit museums focused on national instruments and state history, and browse the Green Bazaar. Before dinner, there's a short show at a falcon farm.

days.title: Almaty to Bishkek
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive about 3 hours to Bishkek on the new highway, taking in the landscapes as you cross into Kyrgyzstan. Once you check in at your hotel, you'll explore the Central Museum, Panfilov Park, and the local bazaar before having dinner and catching a folk show.

days.title: Bishkek to Issyk Kul Lake
included: Lunch with Kyrgyz family in Tokmon
Visit local museum in Cholpon Ata
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch with Kyrgyz family in Tokmon city), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll head to Issyk Kul Lake after breakfast, stopping at Burana Tower in Tokmok along the way. Lunch happens with a Kyrgyz family, then you'll drive through Boom Canyon to reach the lake. After checking in, you'll see local petroglyphs and visit a museum in Cholpon Ata.

days.title: Issyk Kul to Tashkent
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant)
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll spend a relaxing morning in Grigorevka Gorge, about 45 miles from Cholpon-Ata. After lunch you'll head back to Bishkek and then to the airport for your flight to Tashkent (QH409 at 19:20). You'll arrive in Tashkent and transfer to your hotel with an introduction to Uzbekistan.

days.title: Tashkent Sightseeing
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast you'll walk through Tashkent's old city, visiting the Khast Imam Complex where the world's oldest Koran is kept, the Chorsu Bazaar, and Madrasah Kukeldash. The afternoon takes you to the modern section with Independent Square, A. Navoi Theatre Square, and museums dedicated to Amir Temur and handcraft art before dinner.

days.title: Tashkent to Samarkand
included: Visit Paper Mills Factory with presentation of paper production from mulberry tree
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll take a train to Samarkand after breakfast, a roughly 3-hour trip through Syrdarya and Jizzakh provinces. Once you arrive in the afternoon and check in, you'll have lunch before visiting the Paper Mills Factory, Afrasiyob Museum, and Ulugbek's Observatory built in 1428-1429.

days.title: Samarkand Full Day Sightseeing
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant with famous Samarkand round bread (non)), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: The full day is devoted to Samarkand's most important sites. You'll see Registan Square, Gur Emir Mausoleum, Shaki Zinda Necropolis, and Bibi-Khanum Mosque. At the central bazaar Siyobian, you'll try the famous Samarkand round bread before heading back for dinner.

days.title: Samarkand to Bukhara
included: Visit Abdulla's pottery house with presentation and tea
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast you'll leave Samarkand and head toward Bukhara, stopping to see the medieval ruins of Caravanserai Rabat-i-Malik. In Gijduvan, you'll visit Abdulla's pottery house for a presentation and tea. Upon reaching Bukhara and checking in, you'll visit the Chor Minor memorial before dinner.

days.title: Bukhara Full Day Sightseeing
included: Visit Kalon Complex with minaret, mosque and madrasah
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll explore Bukhara's heritage after breakfast with stops at the Samanid Dynasty Mausoleum, Chashma Ayub Mausoleum, Bolo-Khauz Mosque, The Ark Fortress, Kalon Complex, Magoki Attori Mosque, various madrasahs, and the Lyabi Khauz complex. The day finishes with dinner and a show.

days.title: Bukhara to Mary via Turkmenistan Border
included: Visit Museum of Decorative Applied Art
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll continue exploring Bukhara with a half-day of sightseeing including the former summer palace Sitora-i-Mokhi-Khosa and the Museum of Decorative Applied Art. Then you'll drive about 1.5 hours toward the Turkmenistan border, cross the Floating Bridge, traverse the Kara Kum Desert, and reach Mary for check-in and dinner.

days.title: Mary to Ashgabat
included: Visit United Museum of History, Ethnography, Flora and Fauna of Mary
Visit Orthodox Church built by Russians at end of XIX century
Visit Regional Mosque of Mary Province
Visit Convention and Conference Center Ruhiyet Koshgi
Visit Central Park and Monument of Mollanepes
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll journey through desert landscapes to Old Merv, a significant Great Silk Road location with extensive ruins like Gyz Gala, Oglan Gala, and Soltan Sanjar Mausoleum. After lunch, you'll take a walking tour of Mary City visiting museums, the Orthodox Church, and monuments before heading to the airport for your flight to Ashgabat.

days.title: Ashgabat Full Day Sightseeing
included: Visit Complex of Monuments of Oguz Han and Sons
Visit Tombs of Turkmenbashy and family
Visit Alem Culture and Recreation Center
Visit Park dedicated to Turkmen horses
Visit Monument for Victims of Earthquake of 1948
Night tour with stop near Palace of Happiness
landmarks: Monument for Victims of Earthquake of 1948
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast you'll explore Ashgabat, recognized by Guinness as the Most-White Marble City. You'll visit the Complex of Oguz Han, tombs of Turkmenbashy, Old Nissa ruins, and newer attractions with monuments and parks. The afternoon includes museums, bazaars, and a mountain health path tour followed by a folk show.

days.title: Ashgabat to Dashoguz
included: Visit Hippodrome of Ashgabat to see Turkmen horses Akhalteke
Walking tour of Park of Independency
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll visit Ashgabat's famous bazaars including Altyn Asyr Oriental Bazaar and Jygyldyk Bazaar after breakfast. At the Hippodrome, you'll see Turkmen horses of the Akhalteke breed. Following lunch and a visit to the National Museum of History, you'll check out the Arch of Neutrality and Park of Independency before heading to the airport for your flight to Dashoguz.

days.title: Dashoguz to Khiva via Koneurgench
included: Walk through Ichan Kala - old walled city of Khiva
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast you'll drive 75 miles to Koneurgench to explore the ancient city including Portal of Caravansaray, Mamun Minaret, mausoleums, academy, and Kutlug Timur Minaret. You'll return to Dashoguz for lunch, then cross back into Uzbekistan to reach Khiva. Check in and walk through the historic walled city Ichan Kala before dinner and a show.

days.title: Khiva to Tashkent
included: Visit Ichan Kala UNESCO World Heritage Site
Visit Islam Khodja Minaret and Madrasah
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: You'll have a full day exploring Khiva's UNESCO World Heritage Site Ichan Kala after breakfast, visiting madrasahs, Kelta Minar, Kunya Ark, Pakhlavan Mahmud Mausoleum, Islam Khodja Minaret, Djuma Mosque, and Tash Hovli Palace. After lunch and dinner, you'll transfer to the airport for your evening flight back to Tashkent (departing 20:40, arriving 22:10).

days.title: Tashkent to Khujand, Tajikistan
days.meals: Breakfast (Early breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: After an early breakfast you'll drive to the Oybek border checkpoint and cross into Tajikistan. You'll proceed to Khujand, the country's second largest city founded around 2,300 years ago during Alexander the Great's era. After checking in, you'll begin exploring the city and have dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Khujand Full Day Sightseeing & Return to Tashkent
included: Visit Sheikh Muslihiddin Mosque and Mausoleum
Visit Museum of Archaeology and Restoration
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel), Lunch (Lunch at local restaurant), Dinner (Farewell dinner at local restaurant)
days.description: Following breakfast you'll continue exploring Khujand's ancient sites including Timurmalik Fortress, archaeological and history museums, and the famous Panjshanbe market. You'll also visit Sheikh Muslihiddin Mosque and the Museum of Archaeology. After lunch, you'll transfer back to Tashkent, rest at your hotel, then enjoy a farewell dinner with a show.

intro:
Discover Asia in this well planned 9 days itinerary around Thailand. Bravo Indochina Tours designs this tour to include all the highlights of amazing Thailand. Begin with comprehensive touring in Bangkok. With your own private guide, enjoy a fascinating, private long-tail boat tour through Bangkok’s canals.Spend several days in rural Chiang Mai in northern Thailand before flight to Phuket, It is the biggest Island of Thailand and doing some beach activities there such as swimming and boating

*

days.title: Bangkok
days.start_point: Suvarnabhumi Airport Moo 1 Bang Chalong Bang Phli, 10540, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan, Thailand (GATE 3-4 to see Bravo Indochina Tours Logo )
days.description: You'll land at Suvarnabhumi airport and meet your greeter at Gate 3-4, then head to your hotel for check-in. The afternoon and evening are yours to get settled and explore Bangkok at whatever pace feels right.

Visit Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha)
Speedboat ride through canals and Chao Phraya River to Thonburi

days.description: After breakfast, you'll fly north to Chiang Mai. Once you land, your guide meets you and takes you to your hotel for check-in. Later that morning or early afternoon, head to Doi Suthep Temple sitting high on a hill with views across the city and housing a sacred relic of Lord Buddha. Back at the hotel you can rest before the evening Khantoke Dinner from 7:00 to 9:00 PM, which serves northern Thai food and includes hill tribe dancing performances.

days.title: Bangkok
included: Boat tour at Damnern Saduak Floating Market
Visit coconut farm and taste coconut juice
Browse seasonal fruits at the market
days.description: You'll get picked up from your hotel between 8:00 and 8:20 AM for a half-day at Elephant Jungle Sanctuary, which is run ethically with rescued elephants living freely. During your time there, you'll learn about elephant behavior and conservation while watching them, and then have Thai buffet lunch. Morning, afternoon, or full-day options are available depending on your preference.

days.title: Bangkok to Chiang Mai
included: Visit Wat Phrathat Doi Suthep temple
Khantoke Dinner with hill tribe dancing
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Khantoke Dinner (northern welcome dinner) with hill tribe dancing, 7:00-9:00 PM)
days.description: Hotel pickup happens between 8:25 and 8:40 AM, then you'll spend the morning visiting Bangkok's major temples: the Emerald Buddha Temple, Grand Palace, and Wat Pho. You'll walk through the historic Amulet Market and Tha Thien Market, grab lunch with local street food, then board a speedboat for a ride through the canals and Chao Phraya River. The day wraps up at Wat Arun temple by late afternoon.

days.title: Chiang Rai
included: Visit Blue Temple (Wat Rong Suea Ten)
days.description: Your hotel pickup is between 7:00 and 7:15 AM, and then you're driven to Damnern Saduak Floating Market. From there, you'll take a boat through the small canals to see how locals live, stop at a coconut farm to try fresh coconut juice, and browse seasonal fruit like rambutan, mangoes, and papaya. You'll be back at your hotel around midday with the rest of the day free to rest or shop around.

days.title: Chiang Mai
included: Elephant Jungle Sanctuary tour (half-day experience with rescued elephants)
Learn elephant behavior and personal history
optional: Upgrade to full-day tour instead of half-day
Choose morning tour instead of standard timing

days.description: Your hotel pickup happens at 7:00 AM, then you'll drive through rice fields heading toward Mae Kachan Hot Spring where you can soak and relax for a bit. The route takes you to the White Temple (Wat Rong Khun) afterward, which is really worth seeing up close. Around 12:30 PM, lunch is set menu style at a local spot. After eating, you'll head to the Blue Temple (Wat Rong Suea Ten) and then to the Black House (Baan Dam Museum) to check out the art installations and structures there. By late afternoon, the driver brings you back to Chiang Mai.

days.title: Chiang Mai to Phuket
days.description: Have breakfast at the hotel and free time before your transfer to the airport for the flight to Phuket. Once you arrive, you'll be met and transferred to your hotel where you can check in and have the rest of the day to yourself.

You'll visit Phi Phi Ley to swim and snorkel at Maya Bay, Pi Leh Lagoon, and Viking Cave (national park entrance included in the tour). Lunch happens at a local restaurant on Phi Phi Island, then you'll spend the afternoon on the beach and exploring Khai Island before heading back to Phuket around 4:00 PM.

days.description: Breakfast is at the hotel with free time until your transfer to Phuket airport for your flight back to Bangkok.

intro:
Enjoy this relaxing 7-day tour of the south & west coast of Ireland. Discover the rugged beauty of the Wild Atlantic Way, the world-famous Cliffs of Moher, and the Dingle Peninsula. Explore as much of Ireland as possible in just one week. Experience amazing castles and historic sites and so much more!


This immersive cultural & historical tour allows you, to connect with the history of ancient Ireland by exploring many castles, small towns and villages bursting with myth and mystery, experience waves crashing against rugged cliffs. This is an easy-going experience, making it the perfect Ireland tour for people of every age and fitness levelsThis tour small group tour takes you through centuries of Irish history and to some of the most stunning natural highlights the south-west of Ireland has to offer. You also get the chance to experience the imposing Blareny Castle & Gardens, Rock of Cashel, the dramatic Cliffs of Moher, the harbour town of Kinsale, the beauty of Old Head, tranquil Killarney National Park, the tourist trail of The Ring Of Kerry and old Gaelic Peninsula of Dingle. Our tours include everything you need for a stress - free trip: accommodation, transport, Irish tour guide, breakfast, and a few key cultural inclusions that are simply not to be missed.

days.title: Dublin to Kinsale
included: Guided tour of Rock of Cashel
days.start_point: 17 Moore Lane, Dublin, D01, Ireland (Point A Hotel Dublin, Parnell Street- Main Entrance - Please arrive 15 mins before departure, 08:30)
days.description: Start early and head to Blarney Castle to kiss the stone and see the castle gardens, then check out the Blarney Woollen Mills if you want. After that, you'll drive southwest toward Kerry and the Ring of Kerry route, stopping in Kenmare and taking in Molls Gap and Ladies View viewpoints. Killarney National Park is next, where you'll see the thousand-year-old yew tree at Muckross Abbey, visit Torc Waterfall, and walk through the Muckross House Gardens. By evening, you'll catch Celtic Steps The Show, which combines Irish dance with traditional music.

days.title: Kinsale to Killarney
included: Kiss the Blarney Stone at Blarney Castle
Guided exploration of Killarney National Park
Visit Muckross Abbey and 1,000-year-old yew tree
optional: Homemade scones with coffee in Blarney village
days.description: Spend your morning wandering around Killarney Park and town at your own pace. After lunch, you'll head west to a family farm by the sea for a sheepdog demonstration where border collies work sheep, and you can help bottle-feed baby lambs. The afternoon takes you to Dingle, a small coastal town with traditional pubs, good restaurants, and live music sessions where locals and visitors mix throughout the evening.

days.title: Killarney to Dingle
optional: Horse-drawn carriage ride around Killarney National Park - €20.00 to €30.00
Bike ride around Killarney National Park trails - €20.00 to €55.00
Open boat through 3 lakes of Killarney with hiking, biking, or pony & trap option
days.description: Today is the Slea Head Drive, a scenic route that National Geographic called the most beautiful place on earth. You'll have wild Atlantic Ocean on one side and green fields on the other, with chances to stop at secluded beaches, ancient stone huts, and views of the Blasket Islands. There's plenty of time for photos and exploring cliff tops. After lunch back in Dingle, you can relax or choose from optional activities like sea safaris, sea kayaking, brewery tours, distillery visits, or guided horse rides. Evening brings more time in Dingle's craft shops, pubs, and music sessions.

days.title: Dingle
optional: Dingle Sea Kayaking around harbor and sea caves - €55.00
Dick Macks Brewery Tours with beer sampling - €25.00
Dingle Distillery Tours with whiskey & gin sampling - €25.00
Guided horse ride near Ventry along beach or mountain - €55.00
Hiking suitable for all fitness levels in and around Dingle
days.description: You'll leave Dingle early and take a ferry across the Shannon River mouth, and you might spot dolphins during the crossing. The Cliffs of Moher are next, with short walking trails, shops, and a museum about the cliffs and local wildlife. Then you'll see Poulnabrone Portal Dolmen, an ancient stone tomb from around 2000 to 2500 BC. Following the Coast Road gives you views toward Galway Bay and the Aran Islands. Later, you'll walk through the Burren's stark landscape before arriving in Galway to explore its colorful streets, listen to street musicians, and try local oysters.

days.title: Dingle to Galway
included: Coast Road scenic route with Galway Bay views
days.description: You're staying a second night in Galway, so no packing. The day takes you through Connemara where you'll see native Connemara Ponies, wild sheep, and Irish cattle. You'll drive alongside lakes to the Killary Fjord lookout and stop at a fairy tree to learn some folklore. Kylemore Abbey and its gardens take about 2.5 hours to explore properly, including the Neo-Gothic Church and Victorian Gardens. The drive back to Galway passes through Inagh Valley, and you'll catch views of Galway Bay and the Wild Atlantic Way. By evening, you'll have time for dinner and pub experiences with traditional Irish music.

days.title: Galway
included: Explore Kylemore Abbey and gardens (approximately 2.5 hours)
Experience Galway Bay and Wild Atlantic Way views
optional: Full day on Inis Mor (Gaelic-speaking island) - €40 return boat trip (40 minutes each way) plus €20 to €25 for island exploration by bus with local guide or by bike
days.description: You'll head south from Dublin into Ireland's historic interior. The Rock of Cashel comes first, where you can walk around the ancient seat of the Kings of Munster with its views across the Golden Vale. From there, it's on to Cahir Castle, one of the country's largest medieval fortresses, giving you a real sense of how substantial these structures are. Later in the day, you'll reach Kinsale, a harbor town where you can see Charles Fort and take the Scilly Walk along the water before settling in for the evening.

days.title: Galway - Clonmacnoise - Dublin
included: Guided tour at Clonmacnoise monastic settlement
Travel through Ireland's hidden heartlands with scenic countryside views
days.description: You'll head back to Dublin from Galway this morning, stopping along the way for a guided tour of Clonmacnoise. This sixth-century monastic settlement sits in some of Ireland's quieter countryside, surrounded by patchwork fields, old stone bridges, and small cottages dotting the landscape. The route takes you through rural areas that don't see as many visitors, giving you a real sense of the Irish midlands. From there, you'll continue on to Dublin and arrive back in the evening.

intro:
­Embark on an unforgettable journey through Morocco, starting in the vibrant city of Marrakesh. From there, we'll explore the historic village of Ait Benhaddou, the mesmerizing dunes of Merzouga, and the imperial city of Fes. We'll wander through the blue streets of Chefchaouen, discover the charm of Rabat, and conclude our adventure in the cosmopolitan city of Casablanca. Join us for an immersive experience through the diverse landscapes and rich culture of Morocco!

­

days.title: Marrakech
optional: Explore old medina and narrow alleyways
days.start_point: Marrakesh, Marrakech - Tensift - Al Haouz, Morocco (marrakesh airport)
days.description: You'll land at Marrakech Airport and head to your hotel to settle in for the night. If your flight gets in early enough, there's time to walk through the old medina and check out Djamaa El Fna square, where you'll find the narrow winding streets that make up this historic part of the city.

days.title: Marrakech to Ouarzazate - Roses Valley - Dades Valley
days.description: You'll cross the High Atlas Mountains through Tizi n'Tichka Pass, heading toward Ait Benhaddou where you can walk through the UNESCO heritage village known for its kasbah architecture and movie filming locations. From there, continue to Ouarzazate, Morocco's film production center, then drive through the Roses Valley where Damaskina roses grow throughout the region. You'll arrive in Boumalne Dades for the night.

days.title: Dades Valley to Toudra Gorge - Erfoud - Merzouga
included: Camel trek in the Sahara Desert
optional: 4WD transfer to Berber camp (extra cost) - available for those unable to ride camels
days.description: Head east toward the Sahara, passing the Toudra Gorges, which rivals the Grand Canyon in scale and drama. The route takes you to Erfoud, known for its fossils and fossilized marble deposits. After lunch in Rissani (cost on your own), you'll transfer to camels and ride across the sand dunes to reach a Berber camp in the Sahara where you'll sleep overnight.

days.title: Merzouga to Fes
days.description: Following breakfast and a shower at the Berber camp, you'll drive through Errachidia and into the Ziz Valley, which is lined with thousands of date palm trees on both sides. Then you'll cross through the High and Middle Atlas Mountains that form the barrier between the Sahara and Morocco's interior regions. By evening, you'll reach Fes, the country's oldest capital, where you'll stay the night.

days.title: Fes
optional: Traditional meal and live Moroccan entertainment in the city
days.description: A guided tour takes you through Fes, the oldest and largest medieval city in the world. You'll walk the medina's narrow streets, navigable only by donkeys and bikes, seeing dye-pits, tanneries, pottery workshops, and eating spots along the way. Later that evening, you'll experience traditional Moroccan entertainment with live music, belly dancing, and magicians performing at a local venue.

days.title: Fes to Chefchaouen
included: Explore medina with white and blue-washed walls
days.description: After breakfast, drive south toward Chefchaouen, the blue city tucked in the Rif Mountains near the Mediterranean. You'll wander through the medina with its distinctive white and blue-washed buildings, check out local handicraft markets, and find great photo spots of the town and mountain surroundings. Dinner is at your own cost at a local restaurant.

days.title: Chefchaouen - Rabat - Casablanca
days.description: You'll travel south to Rabat, Morocco's official capital, for a guided tour that covers the Royal Palace, Hassan Tower, and Oudaya Kasbah. Then head on to Casablanca, the country's economic center, where you'll spend the night.

days.title: Casablanca
days.description: You'll transfer to Mohamed V Airport in Casablanca for your departure flight. Extensions to Egypt, Dubai, Jordan, and Israel are available if you want to keep traveling.

intro:
We welcome you on this classic journey from Kathmandu to Everest Base Camp!

On the Everest Base Camp Trek, we experience astounding mountain views, get glimpses of the life of the world-famous mountain climber Sherpa, enter Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO world heritage site, and take an excursion tour to world-famous high-altitude Buddhist monasteries.

Nothing beats the thrill and sense of accomplishment that grip hikers upon seeing the power and grace of the mighty mountain up close.

Our guided trek will take you through the beautiful Sherpa villages. A delightful trip begins with a scenic mountain flight from Kathmandu to Lukla. Lukla is a gateway to the Everest region.  This trek involves hiking across steep and uneven terrain at high altitudes, reaching a maximum elevation of 5,545 meters. But make no mistake—the challenge is part of Everest's indefinable allure, drawing visitors from all walks of life to experience the rugged wilderness of the Khumbu for themselves. 

While it's essential to be in reasonable physical condition before attempting the Everest Base Camp Trek, you'll be pleased to learn that this non-technical hike requires no special mountaineering skills.

Most trekkers prepare for their adventure with endurance-building exercises such as walking, running, and swimming. Your experienced guide from Alpine Ramble Treks will also keep a close eye on your progress, adjusting your pace and allowing plenty of time to acclimate to ensure a successful and satisfying hike.

However, this incredible short trek is designed for those travel enthusiasts with a short period off their busy working schedules. It's a moderate-to-strength walk, which is not impossible to do with positive encouragement and determination.

On these 10 Nights and 11 Days, the Everest Base Camp trek includes the Kala Patthar, one of the best viewpoints to see the magnificent mountain views of Everest and many others, and the brilliant sunrise view over Everest.

The Everest Base Camp Trek is a real adventure, fully deserving of the almost mythical reputation it enjoys among enthusiastic trekkers.

Reaching the foot of the world's highest mountain is absolutely within the reach of most travelers in reasonable physical shape who have the passion to reach their goal. Here at Alpine Ramble Treks, we hope that our Complete Guide to the Everest Base Camp Trek has dispelled some of the mystique of this world-class hiking itinerary—without sacrificing any of the mysterious allure that characterizes each step of its steep, winding, and breathtakingly beautiful footpath. We hope to see you on the trail! Advenutre now or Never!

days.title: Kathmandu to Lukla
included: Scenic flight from Kathmandu to Lukla
Trek from Lukla to Phakding via Cheplung village
View of Mt. Khumbila sacred mountain
days.start_point: Kathmandu, Bagmati, Nepal (we will be picked you up from your respective hotel , 05:00 - 07:00)
days.description: Your guide picks you up early from the hotel for a scenic flight to Lukla. After landing, you'll trek down to Phakding, walking through mountain villages and following the Dudkosi River as it winds through forests. The trail down takes about 4 hours with gradual descents, so the terrain is manageable even though you're covering good distance.

days.title: Phakding to Namche Bazaar
included: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar
days.description: After breakfast in the mountains, you'll trek for 6 hours toward Namche Bazaar. The trail passes through pine forests and crosses the Dudh Koshi River at Monjo, then enters Everest National Park. From there you'll cross suspension bridges and climb steeply through rhododendron forests to reach Namche, a busy Sherpa town where the mountain views really start to open up.

days.title: Namche Bazaar
optional: 2-hour hike to Everest View Lodge (3,900m) with panoramic mountain views
days.description: Today you stay in Namche Bazaar to let your body adjust to the altitude. There's plenty to do if you want it, like visiting the Sherpa Museum to learn about mountaineering history and local traditions. If you're feeling up for it, a 2-hour hike gets you to Everest View Lodge at 3,900 meters/12,795 feet for panoramic views of Everest and the surrounding peaks, then you head back the same way via Syangbuche.

days.title: Namche Bazaar to Tengbuche
included: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Tengbuche
Views of Thamserku, Kusum Kangri, and Kantega
days.description: After breakfast, you'll trek along a narrow hilltop that passes stupas and gives you views of Thamserku, Kusum Kangri, and Kantega. The terrain flattens out for a couple hours, then you descend to the river at Phunki Tenga. After that it's a climb through rhododendron woods up to Tengbuche, so the full day on the trail is about 5 to 6 hours.

days.title: Tengbuche to Dingbuche
included: Trek from Dingbuche toward Sherpa villages of Labuch and Gorakshep
Return trek from Everest Base Camp to Gorakshep
days.description: Start with a hearty breakfast, then trek through Sherpa villages of Labuch and Gorakshep via the Khumbu Glacier. You'll drop your bags at Gorakshep and grab lunch before heading to Everest Base Camp at 5,364 meters/17,598 feet. Spend time there, then walk back to Gorakshep through rocky terrain, moraines, and glaciers, so the whole thing is about 5 hours of walking.

days.title: Gorakshep to Labuche
included: Views of Nuptse and surrounding peaks
days.description: The trek today has stops so you can take in views of Mt. Tawache, Ama Dablam, and Nuptse. You'll pass Pokalde at 5,741 meters/18,838 feet and Kongma-Tse at 5,820 meters/19,095 feet, plus a mani-prayer stupa along the way. From Pheriche it takes about 2 hours to get going, and the total walking time comes to roughly 5 hours.

days.title: Labuche to Lukla
included: Visit to Sagarmatha National Park office
days.description: On this final trekking day, you'll walk downhill for several hours. Cross twin suspension bridges and head toward the Sagarmatha National Park office, passing through villages including Manjo, Jorsalle, and Ghap before reaching Lukla. The descent takes a good chunk of the day but the terrain is much lower now.

days.title: Lukla to Kathmandu
days.description: Enjoy the mountain views one last morning before boarding a small airplane for the 35-minute flight back to Kathmandu. You'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel once you land. If you want to extend your time in the region, optional activities are available like Chitwan jungle safari, river rafting, shopping tours in Kathmandu, or mountain biking.

days.title: Lukla to Namche Bazaar
included: Trek from Lukla to Namche Bazaar
days.description: During this trek you'll continually go up and down as you work toward Namche Bazaar. The trail crosses the Dudh Kosi River and passes Tengboche Monastery, then climbs to Phungethata before reaching Namche Bazaar. The walk takes about 5 to 6 hours total with terrain that varies quite a bit.

days.title: Namche Bazaar to Lukla
included: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Lukla
Visit to Sagarmatha National Park office
days.description: On the final trekking day, you'll walk downhill for several hours. Cross twin suspension bridges and reach the Sagarmatha National Park office, then continue through villages like Manjo, Jorsalle, and Ghap before finally reaching Lukla. The whole day comes to about 6 to 7 hours of walking.

days.title: Lukla to Kathmandu
days.description: Enjoy the mountain views during your final morning in the Everest region. Board a small airplane for the 35-minute flight back to Kathmandu. Once you land, you'll be met and transferred to your hotel. Optional activities such as Chitwan jungle safari, river rafting, shopping tours, or mountain biking can be arranged if you want to extend your stay.

intro: This five-active desert adventure is for lovers of nature who want to include some activities during their holiday in Morocco. From Marrakech to the Sahara Desert, including quad biking, camel trekking, horseback riding, hiking, trekking, camping, and meeting locals in tents or caves to share their life experiences.

days.title: Marrakech to Dades Valley
included: Drive through Atlas Mountains with scenic stops
Visit agricultural terraces and Berber villages
Visit Amridil Kasbah in Skoura Oasis
Drive through Roses Valley to Dades Valley
days.description: Your guide picks you up from your riad in Marrakech and you'll drive through the Atlas Mountains with views of agricultural terraces and Berber villages along the way. There's time for photos at several stops before reaching Ouarzazate for lunch. From there, you'll head to Skoura Oasis to see Amridil Kasbah, then continue on to Dades Valley, passing through Roses Valley before settling in for the night.

days.title: Dades Valley to Merzouga
included: Hike through Dades Valley and canyon
Visit Tinghir Oasis with abandoned Kasbahs and Ksars
days.description: After breakfast, you'll start with a 2 hour hike through the valley and explore a canyon. The route takes you to Tinghir Oasis where you can see lush greenery and abandoned Kasbahs and Ksars. Rock climbing in Todra Gorges is available if that interests you. Later you'll drive to Merzouga to see the highest sand dunes, then spend the night in either a glamping tent or desert guesthouse depending on the season.

days.title: Merzouga Desert Safari
included: Desert camp overnight with campfire experience
days.description: This morning you can choose between visiting a local market, hiking, or off-road driving in the area. After lunch featuring Berber pizza, you'll ride camels into the Sahara Desert and watch the sunset from the dunes. By evening you'll arrive at your desert camp where you'll enjoy local music around the campfire, stargaze, and experience the quiet of the desert.

days.title: Merzouga to Ouarzazate
included: Camel ride back to Merzouga or quad biking in sand dunes
Drive through Draa Valley and Anti Atlas Mountains
days.description: Rise early to watch the sunrise and try sandboarding if you'd like. You'll head back to Merzouga either by camel or by 4x4 with an hour of quad biking in the sand dunes. From there, the drive takes you to Ouarzazate through Draa Valley and the Anti Atlas Mountains, and you'll spend the night in a riad.

days.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
included: Horseback riding in rocky desert at Ait Benhaddou
Explore Ksar streets with local artisanal shops and bazaars
Drive through High Atlas Mountains back to Marrakech
days.description: After breakfast, you have free time to visit the Cinema studios if that interests you. Then you'll drive to Ait Benhaddou for horseback riding through the rocky desert and through Ksar streets where you can see local artisanal shops and bazaars. By midday, you'll start the drive back to Marrakech through the High Atlas Mountains with views of Berber villages along the route.

intro:
Explore the top-visited UNESCO Sites of Turkey with 8 Days customized package. Visit Istanbul; where Asia Meets Europe and was the capital of 3 different Empires walk on the historical peninsula and visit the monuments among such as Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, enjoy cruising on Bosphorus, Discover Cappadocia; The land of beautiful horses and the home of the Fairy Chimneys. Walkthrough underground cities and see ruck-cut churches, storage rooms. Visit Pamukkale; the Pools of Heaven on Earth and the biggest necropolis in the western mediterranean. Ephesus; An Archeological treasure, The best-preserved classical city in the western Mediterranean and one of the seven churches of revelation. walk on the ancient streets where mother Mary, St John w3alked Learn history about early Christians, Byzantines, Ottomans, and Modern Turks from your expert local Guide. Tasty amazing foods from Turkish cuisine and experience the life of locals.

­ 

Good to Know:

When comparing our programs, services and prices with other operators, please consider that our tours are in the form of small groups, hotels are ‘’special class’’ that centraly located,  has a characteristic structure of the regions (not hotels where large groups stay), "planes" are used between destinations to facilitate transportation and the restaurants are "Family-owned local restaurants" that gives opportunity to taste local flavors through Anatolia.

****The Cleopatra Pool in Pamukkale is currently closed for maintenance. Unfortunately, the local municipality has not yet announced a specific reopening date, and we are still waiting for an official update**

days.title: Istanbul
days.start_point: Istanbul, Turkey (Upon your arrival at IST/SAW Airport)
days.description: Your driver will pick you up at Istanbul Airport and take you straight to your hotel. Once you check in, you'll have time to settle in and rest after your arrival.

days.title: Istanbul
included: Guided tour of Blue Mosque (Mosque of Sultan Ahmet)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch in a local restaurant)
days.description: Meet your guide in the hotel lobby for a full day exploring Sultanahmet. You'll start at the Blue Mosque with its distinctive blue tiles and 6 minarets, then head to the Hippodrome to see the remaining columns from ancient chariot races. After that, walk through Topkapi Palace to see its collection of antiques and treasures. Following lunch, you'll visit Hagia Sophia, an incredible architectural achievement. The day wraps up at the Grand Bazaar, a massive covered market with over 5000 shops to browse through.

days.title: Istanbul to Izmir
days.description: Your guide meets you for a half-day morning tour starting at the Spice Bazaar where you can take in the scents and sights of aromatic spices and herbs. Then you'll enjoy a Bosphorus cruise with views of where Europe and Asia meet. After the tour ends, you'll head to the airport for a 1 hour 30 minute domestic flight to Izmir. Your driver picks you up and takes you to Kusadasi for hotel check-in.

days.title: Kusadasi - Pamukkale
included: Guided tour of Hierapolis ancient city
days.description: Your guide picks you up for a full-day tour to Pamukkale, known locally as the Pools of Heaven. You'll explore the unique white terraces created by warm mineral-rich spring water, then visit the ancient city of Hierapolis with its impressive necropolis containing 1200 gravestones. The Sacred Pool is next, where ancient Roman ruins sit beneath thermal waters. By evening you'll return to Kusadasi for your overnight stay.

days.title: Kusadasi - Ephesus - Cappadocia
included: Visit to House of Virgin Mary
days.description: After breakfast and checking out, you'll meet your guide for a full day at Ephesus. You'll visit the House of Virgin Mary, believed to be her final residence, then explore Ancient Ephesus, one of the best-preserved classical cities in the Eastern Mediterranean. The Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, is on your itinerary as well. After lunch and finishing the tour, you'll drive to Izmir Airport for a 1 hour 30 minute flight to Kayseri, then continue to your Cappadocia hotel.

days.title: Cappadocia
included: Traditional Turkish lunch and pottery-making experience in Avanos
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Typical Turkish lunch with pottery-making experience in Avanos)
days.description: Your guide takes you on a full-day tour of Cappadocia's distinctive fairy chimneys. Starting at Goreme Museum with its rock-cut churches featuring colorful frescoes, you'll then explore Devrent Valley to see oddly shaped rock formations. Next comes Pasabagi (Monks Valley) with its hermitage, followed by a typical Turkish lunch and pottery-making workshop in Avanos. You'll take in panoramic views of the fairy chimneys and finish at Uchisar, a natural rock castle offering magnificent views. Then back to your hotel.

days.title: Cappadocia - Istanbul
days.description: After breakfast and checkout, your guide leads you through Cappadocia's most dramatic landscapes. You'll see Rose Valley with its pink-tinted rocks, explore Cavusin village with rock-cut houses and churches in Red Valley, and hike through Pigeon Valley past historic dovecotes. Then you'll descend into the Underground Cities where thousands of Christians once took shelter. Before heading to the airport, you'll visit Ortahisar's castle-like rock formation and its charming village. A 1 hour 30 minute flight takes you back to Istanbul, where your driver transfers you to your hotel.

days.title: Istanbul
days.description: After breakfast and checking out of your hotel, you'll be transferred to Istanbul Airport according to your international flight departure time. Your tour ends here.

name: Kilimanjaro climb machame route 6 days

attributes.name: Hiking & Trekking
attributes.tip: Conquer epic trails and breathtaking landscapes

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro: Almighty Kilimanjaro leads treks up the Machame, a beautiful route up Kilimanjaro that allows you to experience the southwest and south sides of the mountain, since you go up one way and down another. All your equipment and supplies are carried by porters and a cook prepares all your meals. Unlike the Marangu Route where you sleep in huts, on the Machame you sleep in tents (tents are included), and the porters will pitch your tent for you. Meals are served in a dinner tent or on a blanket outside. This makes the Machame, which is referred to as the "Whiskey Route," better suited to more adventurous hikers, and it also rewards you with better views than the Machame Route. From late afternoon sunsets at Shira, to the misty revelations of Kibo's great Barranco Wall, the Machame Route offers the spunky hiker a continuous scenic slide show. The Machame Route is normally completed in 6 days, and this greatly helps your acclimatization. The Machame Route takes you high to Lava Tower (4,630 m/15,190 ft) on day 3 then brings you down for an overnight at Barranco Camp (3,950 m/12,960 ft). This intermediate ascent and descent is the secret to a successful acclimatization, and is the reason that this route has a high success rate.

days.title: Moshi to Machame Camp
included: Hike from Machame Gate through rainforest to Machame camp (approximately 7 hours, approximately 18 km)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch pack provided at the gate), Dinner
days.start_point: Moshi, Kilimanjaro, Tanzania (at the hotel in moshi, 08:00 - 09:00)
days.description: Your climbing adventure kicks off early with a briefing and breakfast before heading out on a 45-minute drive from Moshi to Machame village. Once guides and porters have your equipment sorted, you'll start hiking through rainforest toward Machame Gate and continue climbing to Machame camp. The trail gets muddy and slippery, so watch your footing. Lunch comes as a packed meal at the gate, and the porters will have hot water ready plus dinner waiting when you reach camp before settling in for the night.

days.title: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
included: Hike from Machame camp through forest to moorland zone
Rocky ridge ascent to Shira plateau
Hike to Shira camp (approximately 6 hours, approximately 9 km)
days.description: After an early breakfast, you'll climb for about an hour through forest until the landscape transitions into moorland. From there, it's a 2-hour gradual climb through moorland terrain that brings you to the rocky ridge of the Shira plateau with nice views of the Western Breach and its glaciers. You'll make it to Shira campsite where the porters have hot water and dinner ready. Another cold night ahead, so bundle up in your tent.

days.title: Shira Plateau to Barranco Camp
included: Hike through semi-desert landscape to Lava Tower (approximately 5 hours)
Full day hike (approximately 7 hours, approximately 15 km)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch served in designated area before Lava Tower), Dinner
days.description: This morning heads into semi-desert landscape with a challenging 5-hour push to Lava Tower at 4,630m/15,190 ft, which is the toughest day yet. Altitude might catch up with some climbers here, causing breathlessness and headaches. After lunch, you'll descend roughly 680m over about 2 hours down to Barranco camp. The views of the Western Breach and Breach Wall are really something, and you'll catch a memorable sunset before dinner and overnight.

days.title: Barranco to Barafu Camp
included: Hike from Barranco through alpine desert to Barafu camp (approximately 7 hours, approximately 13 km)
days.description: The hike takes you through alpine desert terrain toward Barafu camp, situated on a narrow, stony ridge that's fully exposed to strong winds. Once you arrive, spend time getting familiar with the camp area before dark falls. Lay out your gear including ski sticks, thermal clothing, headlamp, and fresh camera batteries. Head to bed around 7 p.m. so you can grab about 5 hours of rest before the summit push begins.

days.title: Summit Attempt and Descent
included: Ascent from Barafu camp through scree to Stella Point (approximately 6 hours)
Final ascent from Stella Point to Uhuru Peak on snow (approximately 2 hours)
Descent from Uhuru Peak to Barafu camp (approximately 3 hours)
Descent from Barafu to Mweka camp (approximately 8 hours total descent, approximately 23 km descent)
days.meals: Breakfast (Tea and biscuits before summit push), Dinner
days.description: Around 11:30 p.m. you'll rise for tea and biscuits, then start the summit push. The ascent heads northwest through heavy scree toward Stella Point on the crater rim over roughly 6 hours, which is the most demanding stretch both mentally and physically. You'll reach Stella Point at 5,685m/18,650 ft in time to catch the sunrise, then continue for about 2 hours on snow to Uhuru Peak at 5,895m/19,341 ft. After taking in your achievement, descend around 3 hours back to Barafu to collect gear, then keep going down to Mweka camp for dinner and overnight.

days.title: Mweka Camp to Moshi
included: Descent from Mweka camp to Mweka Gate (approximately 3 hours, approximately 15 km)
Walk from Mweka Gate to Mweka village (approximately 1 hour)
Transfer from Mweka village to Springlands Hotel
Transfer from Springlands Hotel to Moshi
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Hot lunch at Springlands Hotel)
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll descend roughly 3 hours from Mweka camp through forest to Mweka Gate, then continue about 1 hour on a normally muddy path to Mweka village. From there, it's a drive to Springlands Hotel for a well-deserved hot lunch and to freshen up. Later you'll head back to Moshi for a hot shower and overnight at the hotel. Your summit certificate gets handed over here, and this is when you'll typically give tips to the guides, porters, and crew.

name: Athens, Santorini & Mykonos with 3 Guided Tours | SemiPrivate | 10 Days

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided
attributes.tip: Independent travel, featuring selected guided excursions

intro:
Discover the best of Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini on this 10-day island escape, starting and ending in the Greek capital.

­ 

Stay in carefully selected 3- or 4-star accommodations, depending on your chosen category, with daily breakfast included.

­ 

Join three half-day guided group tours in Athens (Day 2), Mykonos (Day 4), and Santorini (Day 7). On the remaining days, you’ll travel independently, allowing you to enjoy Greece at your own rhythm without being part of a large group.

­ 

All transfers and ferry tickets are included for a smooth and worry-free experience.

­ 

Relax on golden beaches, wander through picturesque villages, and witness Santorini’s world-famous sunsets —the perfect blend of guidance and freedom to explore.

days.title: Athens
days.start_point: Πρόσβασης (Αφίξεις), 190 04 Spata-Loutsa, Greece (Athens International Airport Eleftherios Venizelos, 00:00 - 23:00)
days.description: Your representative meets you at Eleftherios Venizelos Airport and takes you to your hotel. After settling in, the rest of your day is open, so you can wander around Athens on your own schedule and get a feel for the city.

days.title: Athens
included: Half-day City Group Tour - Acropolis & Acropolis Museum (5 hours)
Visit Parliament and Unknown Soldier memorial
days.description: Following breakfast at your hotel, you'll join a guided tour that covers Athens' main historical sites. The group visits the Panathenaic Stadium, then moves through the Temple of Olympian Zeus and Hadrian's Arch before heading up to the Acropolis to see the Parthenon and related structures. The tour wraps up at the new Acropolis Museum, and then you're back at your hotel.

days.title: Athens to Mykonos
optional: Fast Ferry Upgrade: Upgrade from standard ferry to fast ferry for Piraeus - Mykonos route (approximately 4 hours faster)
days.description: An early pickup at 06:00 AM takes you to Piraeus port for the ferry to Mykonos. When you arrive, semiprivate transport brings you to your hotel. From there, the day is yours to do what you'd like around the island.

days.title: Mykonos
included: Visit Panagia Tourliani Monastery panoramic viewpoint
optional: Entrance fee to Panagia Tourliani Monastery in Ano Mera (not included)
days.description: This 4-hour evening group tour shows you Mykonos from different angles. You'll visit several beaches around the island, then check out Ano Mera and its 16th-century Panagia Tourliani monastery. A stop gives you views of the windmills and harbor before heading into Chora for the evening, where you'll walk through the old port, see Paraportiani church, and explore Little Venice and the narrow shopping streets.

days.title: Mykonos
days.description: You have the full day to explore Mykonos however you'd like. Walk through the white-painted backstreets and check out local churches and museums, or shop the boutiques and cafes on Matoyanni Street. Spend time at the beaches, whether the busy areas or more quiet spots, and don't skip Little Venice with its colorful 18th-century buildings.

days.title: Mykonos to Santorini
optional: Fast Ferry Upgrade: Upgrade from standard ferry to fast ferry for Mykonos - Santorini route (approximately 4 hours faster)
days.description: This is another free day in Mykonos until your transfer to the port for the ferry to Santorini. Once you reach Santorini, semiprivate transport takes you to your hotel, where you can relax for the rest of the evening.

days.title: Santorini
included: Stop near Monastery of Prophet Elias for panoramic views
days.description: After breakfast, you have the morning free. Your 6-hour semi-private tour picks you up later and starts in Megalochori, a village with cobblestone streets and neoclassical buildings. You'll drive through Pyrgos and stop near the Monastery of Prophet Elias for the views, then visit a modern winery for wine tasting. The tour ends in Oia where you walk the marble lanes and see cave houses before watching the famous Santorini sunset over the sea.

days.title: Santorini
days.description: Santorini is yours to explore at your own pace. Spend time on the black sandy beaches and soak in the island's character, and make sure you get to Fira town with its white houses, tight alleyways, and cafes that sit on the cliff edge with sea views.

days.title: Santorini to Athens
optional: Ferry ticket replacement: Upon request and with a supplement, the ferry ticket from Santorini to Piraeus can be replaced with a domestic flight
days.description: Semiprivate transfer picks you up for the drive to Santorini port and the ferry back to Piraeus. After an overnight crossing, you arrive and a private car takes you to your Athens hotel, arriving around 23:00 hours.

name: Bali Classic 12 Day - One Life Adventures

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro: Bali is often called the Island of the Gods, and once you’re here, you’ll understand why. It’s a spiritual playground packed with adventure, and our 12-day group tour lets you dive into it all – from sunrise volcano treks to surfing the world’s best beaches. Explore the iconic temples and rice terraces of Ubud, snorkel with sea turtles, and meet the mischievous monkeys of the sacred forest. If Bali isn’t on your Southeast Asia itinerary, it’s time to rethink your plans.

days.title: Canggu
optional: Surfing at Echo Beach or Batu Balong
Explore local restaurants, hip bars, and markets in Canggu
days.start_point: FRii Bali Echo Beach, Jl Pura Batu Mejan, Badung, Bali 80363, Indonesia (Rooftop 6pm for Welcome Dinner)
days.description: You'll arrive in Canggu and check into your hotel, which sits right in the middle of town and puts you within walking distance of Echo Beach and Batu Balong. After settling in, meet up with your group for sunset drinks on a rooftop, then head to a welcome dinner at the hotel to kick things off.

days.title: Canggu
days.description: This day is all about surfing. There's an optional guided lesson available from an instructor at a local spot that doesn't get overrun with tourists. The rest of your time is open, so you can hang out on the beach, try a yoga or workout class, or paddle out again if you want more waves. At dinner, you'll go through your surf photos from the day and celebrate your last night in Canggu.

days.title: Canggu - Pemuteran
included: Coffee tour with family home visit to see how coffee is traditionally made
days.description: You'll drive from Canggu to Pemuteran, passing through rural Bali with rice fields and greenery around you the whole way. Along the drive, stop at Banyumala Waterfalls, then meet a local family who'll show you their coffee-making methods passed down through generations. Check in at your eco-lodge and spend the evening on the beach, walking around the village, or relaxing at your place.

days.title: Pemuteran - Menjangan Island
included: Visit to Biorock coral planting project
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch on the island (if tide allows))
days.description: Spend the full day snorkeling the reefs around Menjangan Island in Bali West National Park. You'll see tons of different underwater life throughout the day. When the tide cooperates, grab lunch on the island itself, and you might catch sight of the native deer. Later, visit the Biorock Project to see the largest coral planting operation in the world.

days.title: Pemuteran - Ubud
days.description: Leave Pemuteran and head to Ubud, a town packed with art galleries and surrounded by jungle. Once you arrive and check in, the afternoon and evening are yours to wander through busy markets, check out quiet temples, or simply sit and take in the vibe of the place.

days.title: Ubud
included: Participate in water purification ceremony at Sacred Water Temple
optional: Visit coffee plantations to try specialty coffee
days.description: Start your day at Monkey Forest Temple where you'll get up close with local primates in their natural habitat. From there, head to Tegallalang Rice Terraces to walk through the iconic green rice paddies and take photos. Later, you'll participate in a water purification ceremony at a sacred water temple, which is a meaningful experience. The afternoon is flexible, so you can choose how to spend it. Some options include visiting coffee plantations to learn about Balinese coffee production, trying out the famous Instagram swing if you're into that, taking a yoga class, or getting a relaxing massage. It's nice to have the freedom to pick what appeals to you most after the morning activities.

days.title: Ubud - Mount Batur
included: Hike Mount Batur with sunrise viewing
days.description: Get up early and hike Mount Batur on a fairly short but steep route so you can grab the best spot for sunrise. Once the sun comes up, enjoy a coffee and take in the views. From the crater's edge, you'll see a full 360-degree view of Batur Lake and all the villages and landscapes surrounding it. Spend the rest of the day back in Ubud taking it easy.

days.title: Ubud - Sanur - Nusa Penida
days.description: Travel to Sanur and take a quick ferry over to Nusa Penida. Check into your boutique hotel and start exploring the island's highlights. Visit Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel Billabong, which are all famous photo spots. Wrap up the day watching the sunset at Crystal Bay.

days.title: Nusa Penida - Snorkeling
included: Snorkel tour of Nusa Penida with opportunity to see Manta Rays
days.description: Board a private boat and explore Nusa Penida's tiny bays and inlets. Your captain will guide you to the best spots for snorkeling where you can see Manta Bay, colorful fish, turtles, and more. The main event is Manta Bay itself, which has some of the highest concentrations of manta rays anywhere. Later on, head to Diamond Beach Viewpoint on the east side of the island.

days.title: Nusa Penida - Gili T Island
included: Sunset beach clean with Gili Eco Trust
days.description: Take a short ferry from Nusa Penida to Gili T, known for great snorkeling, sea turtles, and a lively nightlife scene. Check in and have lunch, then get around the island by bike since cars aren't allowed here. Relax at the hotel's beach club pool overlooking the water, then join a sunset beach cleanup with the Gili Eco Trust. Your evening is free to catch a movie on the beach or explore Gili T's nightlife.

days.title: Gili T Island
included: Private island hopping and snorkelling trip around Gili Islands
days.description: Set out on a private boat trip to see all the main attractions around Gili T, including swimming with turtles and checking out the famous underwater statues and coral formations. The evening is yours to walk around, try different restaurants, and visit some of the reggae bars in the area.

days.title: Gili T Island - Canggu
days.description: Board a boat back to mainland Bali from Gili T. You'll be driven back to Canggu where everything started. Say goodbye to the group, then decide what's next: stay in nearby spots like Seminyak or Uluwatu to extend your time, or head to the airport for your flight home.

qa.answer: We haven't sent any info or emails our for this tour yet, so you've not missed anything! qa.question: I am reaching out because I am very interested in your "Bali Classic 12 Days" tour. I am a 21-year-old solo traveler. I would like to ask if there are any male travelers already booked for this departure (June 1st to June 12th). To be honest, I have seen some tours with only female participants, and I would simply prefer to be in a mixed group with other male travelers as well.
qa.answer: For your date we currently have 5 female and 2 males signed up so with you joining that would take it to 5/3 split. Bali does tend to attract more female guests, however, your selected date would the best for gender split at this moment.

qa.question: Is it possible to do the tour in Spanish? I'm asking because I'm from Mexico and all the audience that follow me on social media are mexicans and latinos, and they look for trips in spanish.
qa.answer: Our local Bali guides don't speak Spanish I'm afraid but they do speak great English. Hopefully you can bridge that gap and help some of your followers with translating some of the fun facts as you adventure around the island. It wouldn't be the first time for us to see that happen as long as the host (you) is confident in doing so. Do let us know if you feel up to that and are happy with the local Balinese guide to show you the true beauty of their country. A friendly heads up, most if not all tour guides in Bali that are not Indonesian locals, may be guiding without the correct permits and could be a risk for your group. We highly recommend using a local guide and fingers crossed the travellers English is good enough to understand our guide and learn all about the interesting culture and traditions here.

intro:
Ready to explore the largest game park in Kenya?Tsavo East National Park is a historic reserve with a storied past of ferocious lions and great natural features. Its distinctive red-dust soil attracts lively herds of elephants who enjoy rolling around in the rosy-coloured earth. Sister park Tsavo West National Park contrasts with its green hills and springs filled with hippos and crocodiles. All the big game are here but you’ll also find baboon, monkey, and the smaller bushbaby and dik-dik.


Not far off is Amboseli National Park, a smaller reserve but with just as much wildlife. The families of elephants are so populous here the park has been called, ‘The Land of the Giants’. And another giant dominating the landscape is Africa’s tallest peak, Mt. Kilimanjaro which stands like a giant, iconic monument at the park’s southern boundary. A busy wildlife refuge, you may find hyena, fox, jackal, monkey and all kinds of birdlife in the park’s marshes. Don’t be surprised to see pelican, kingfisher, heron and harrier eagle alighting upon this landscape.

Optional Hot air balloon flight ($450 per person)

days.description: Meet your safari driver early in the morning for the drive to Amboseli National Park. Once you check in at your lodge, you'll have lunch before heading out for an afternoon game drive. This is when you'll start looking for elephants and catch views of Mount Kilimanjaro in the distance. After returning to the lodge, dinner and overnight stay.

included: Full day game drive in Amboseli National Park
optional: Optional Masai village visit (USD 20 per person)
Optional Hot air balloon flight ($450 per person)

days.description: This day is dedicated to game drives throughout Amboseli National Park. After an early breakfast, you're out looking for large herds of elephants, lions, wildebeest, giraffes, zebras, and antelopes. Lunch happens either at the lodge or as a picnic out in the grasslands. Then it's back out for an afternoon game drive before heading to the lodge for dinner.

days.title: Amboseli to Tsavo West National Park
included: Afternoon game drive in Tsavo West National Park
optional: Optional Masai village visit (USD 20 per person)
Optional Hot air balloon flight ($450 per person)
days.description: After breakfast, you check out and head toward Tsavo West National Park with an en-route game drive along the way. Once you arrive at the lodge and have lunch, you'll rest a bit before an afternoon game drive. Keep your eyes open for lions, elephants, buffaloes, rhinos, zebras, and crocodiles at Mzima Springs. Dinner and overnight back at the lodge.

days.title: Tsavo West to Tsavo East National Park
included: Afternoon game drive in Tsavo East National Park
optional: Optional Masai village visit (USD 20 per person)
Optional Hot air balloon flight ($450 per person)
days.description: Starting with an early breakfast and checkout, you travel to Tsavo East National Park with another en-route game drive. Check in at your lodge, grab lunch, and take some time to rest. Later in the afternoon, you head out for a game drive where you can spot lions, elephants, rhinos, and buffaloes. Return for dinner and overnight.

days.title: Tsavo East National Park to Mombasa
included: Extensive game drive in Tsavo East National Park
optional: Optional Masai village visit (USD 20 per person)
Optional Hot air balloon flight ($450 per person)
days.description: Begin with an early breakfast, then spend the day on an extensive game drive through Tsavo East National Park. You'll see the Yatta Plateau, which is one of the world's longest lava flows. Afterward, you'll be transferred to Diani or take the SGR train to Mombasa, ending your safari experience.

name: The Magic of Morocco Tour 9 Days From Casablanca

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Embark on an unforgettable 9-day journey through the heart of Morocco, starting from the vibrant city of Casablanca. This tour takes you on an adventure filled with rich culture, stunning landscapes, and historical wonders. Explore the imperial cities of Rabat, Fes, and Marrakech, each offering unique architecture, bustling medinas, and fascinating cultural sites.


Venture into the breathtaking Sahara Desert, where you’ll experience a magical night under the stars in a luxury desert camp, complete with a camel trek across the golden dunes. Discover the scenic beauty of the Atlas Mountains, traditional Berber villages, and the enchanting Todra Gorges.


This tour blends Morocco’s diverse heritage, from ancient medinas and majestic palaces to serene desert landscapes and lively souks, offering an authentic Moroccan experience you’ll cherish forever.

days.title: Casablanca
days.start_point: Casablanca, Casablanca-Settat, Morocco (Pick you up from the Airport Casablanca or Hotel)
days.description: Your driver meets you at Mohamed V Airport in Casablanca or Marrakech Airport, handles your luggage, and takes you to your Casablanca hotel. If you've already checked in early, they can pick you up at a time that works for your schedule to begin the tour.

days.title: Casablanca - Rabat - Chefchaouen
days.description: Start in the morning at Hassan II Mosque, Morocco's largest with ocean views. Drive to Rabat to see the Royal Palace gates, Mausoleum of Mohammed V, and Kasbah of the Udayas. After lunch at a local spot, head toward Chefchaouen with stops along the way. You'll arrive in the late afternoon and walk through the blue-painted medina streets.

days.title: Chefchaouen - Volubilis - Fes
included: Visit Kasbah in Outa el Hammam
days.description: After breakfast in Fes, drive toward Merzouga through Ifrane with its village charm. Stop in the Cedar Forest to see Barbary apes. Visit Azrou, a Berber village, then grab lunch in Midelt. Drive through Ziz Gorge and Ziz Valley, passing through Erfoud and Rissani. Arrive in Merzouga for mint tea, then ride a camel (or car) to a desert camp.

days.title: Fes
included: Visit ancient fortress with panoramic views
days.description: Spend a relaxed morning walking Chefchaouen's blue streets and narrow alleyways. Check out the 15th-century Kasbah at Outa el Hammam square and the Great Mosque with its octagonal minaret. Then drive to Volubilis, a UNESCO site with Roman ruins, mosaics, and columns. Continue to Fes for the night at a traditional riad.

days.title: Fes - Ifrane - Cedar Forest - Midelt - Ziz Valley - Merzouga
included: Visit Cedar Forest in Middle Atlas Mountains
Explore Ziz Gorge and Ziz Valley
optional: Car ride to desert camp instead of camel ride
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch in Midelt), Dinner (Dinner at desert camp - Berber-inspired with local dishes like tagine, couscous, and fresh salads), Breakfast (Breakfast at desert camp - Berber-inspired with local dishes)
days.description: A local guide shows you around Fes. See the Royal Palace Gate and enter the medieval medina through Bab Boujlould. Walk narrow alleyways to the 14th-century Medersa Bouanania and Najjarine Fountain. Visit the tanneries, Quaraouin Mosque and University, the Jewish quarter, and end with views from an ancient fortress.

days.title: Merzouga - Rissani - Erfoud - Todra Gorges - Dades Valley
included: Watch Sahara Desert sunrise over Erg Chebbi dunes
Camel ride from desert camp to Merzouga village
days.meals: Breakfast (Traditional Berber breakfast at desert camp), Lunch (Lunch in the heart of Todra Gorge), Dinner (Dinner at Dades Valley guesthouse - Moroccan specialties including grilled meats, hearty stews, and local bread)
days.description: Wake early to watch sunrise over Erg Chebbi's sand dunes, then have a Berber breakfast at camp. Ride back to Merzouga village. Drive to Todra Gorges for lunch surrounded by rock walls. In the afternoon, go through Dades Valley with dramatic formations. Stay overnight at a guesthouse overlooking the valley.

days.title: Dades Valley - Ouarzazate - Ait Ben Hadou - Marrakech
included: Visit Berber women's cooperative for Argan oil production
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at accommodation in Dades Valley)
days.description: After breakfast, travel through Dades Valley toward Marrakech on the 'Way of the Thousand Kasbahs'. Visit Kalaat M'Gouna in the Rose Valley to see a cooperative. Stop at Ait Benhaddou Kasbah, a 19th-century fortified settlement. Cross Tizi n'Tichka Pass in the High Atlas. Learn about argan oil at a women's cooperative before reaching Marrakech.

days.title: Marrakech
included: Explore souks near Djemaa el-Fna Square
days.meals: Breakfast (Traditional Moroccan breakfast at riad - includes variety of bread, pastries, fruits, yogurt, and hot beverages like tea or coffee), Lunch (Lunch at a local restaurant near Djemaa el-Fna Square)
days.description: After breakfast at your riad, a local guide takes you through Marrakech. Visit Majorelle Gardens, Koutoubia Mosque, Saadian Tombs, and Bahia Palace. Have lunch near Djemaa el-Fna Square. Wander the souks for textiles, pottery, jewelry, and leather. Spend the afternoon exploring at your own pace.

days.title: Marrakech or Casablanca - Departure
days.description: Your last day depends on your flight time. With an evening flight, you can explore more of Marrakech, revisit spots you liked, or shop. If leaving from Casablanca instead, you'll drive 3 hours via highway where the tour ends at your hotel or airport.

reviews.reply:
Dear Bridget,
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us.
First of all, we are very happy to hear that you appreciated your driver and the punctuality throughout the trip. We will gladly share your kind words with him, as providing reliable and attentive service is very important to us.
At the same time, we are truly sorry to learn that several aspects of the tour did not meet your expectations. We sincerely apologize for the issues related to the accommodations, room arrangements, and some of the guided visits. This is certainly not the experience we aim to provide to our travelers.
Regarding the room configurations, we completely understand how frustrating and uncomfortable this situation must have been for your group, especially after confirming your requests in advance. We also regret that some accommodations lacked the comfort and privacy you expected, particularly during such a demanding itinerary with long travel days.
We also take your comments about the guides very seriously. Professionalism, engagement, and quality explanations are standards we expect from every guide we work with, and your feedback will be carefully reviewed internally.
Morocco is a destination that often involves long drives to experience the diversity of landscapes and cities, but we understand that the quality of rest and accommodations plays a major role in enjoying the overall journey.
Thank you again for your honest feedback. It helps us identify areas where improvements are needed, and we truly appreciate you sharing your experience with us.
Best regards,
Morocco Tours

Marja

It’s wonderful to know that the desert experience was a highlight for you, with music, dancing, and meeting such nice people along the way.
Thank you again for your trust, and we hope to welcome you back for another amazing adventure in Morocco!
Kind regards,Hassan

days.title: Dublin

days.description: You'll start exploring Dublin on your own using a Hop-On, Hop-Off bus that lets you get on and off whenever you like. days.title: Dublin
included: Panoramic Dublin city tour with local guide
Visit to Little Museum of Dublin
Dinner at Merry Ploughboy Pub with traditional music and step-dancing show
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Irish specialties at Merry Ploughboy Pub with traditional music and step-dancing)
days.description: This morning you'll explore Dublin with your included vouchers. At 2:00 PM your hotel is the meeting point for a panoramic tour with a local guide who'll drive you through the city showing Trinity College, Georgian townhouses, and the River Liffey. After that you'll visit the Little Museum of Dublin in a Georgian townhouse that covers the city's modern history. Back at the hotel you'll have a welcome drink with your group, then head to Merry Ploughboy Pub for Irish food with traditional music and step-dancing.

days.title: Dublin to Killarney
included: Photo stop at Rock of Cashel
Visit to Blarney Castle with option to kiss the Blarney Stone or explore gardens
days.description: You'll travel through countryside toward Blarney Castle with a photo stop at the Rock of Cashel ruins sitting on a hilltop. At Blarney you can climb the winding staircase to kiss the Blarney Stone or walk through the gardens. Then it's on to Killarney, a friendly lakeside town, where you'll have dinner at your hotel.

days.title: Killarney
included: Shopping at Moriarty's in Gap of Dunloe
Visit to Skellig Experience visitor center
Stop at Moll's Gap for panoramic views
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Casual lunch at cozy restaurant)
days.description: Start at Moriarty's shopping location in the Gap of Dunloe, then drive the famous Ring of Kerry, a winding 100-mile route with coastal and mountain views and lots of places to stop and take photos. Grab casual lunch at a cozy restaurant along the way. You'll head to Valentia Island to see the Skellig Experience visitor center, which tells about Skellig Michael island (a Star Wars filming spot and former home to early Christian monks). Later you'll stroll through the colorful village of Sneem and stop at Moll's Gap for views of Ireland's highest mountains. At a farm you'll watch sheepdogs herding sheep. You're back in Killarney by evening with free time.

days.title: Killarney to County Clare
included: Medieval-style feast at castle with period entertainment
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Medieval-style feast of traditional Irish fare at castle with songs and harp music)
days.description: You'll take a ferry across the River Shannon and drive along the County Clare coast to the Cliffs of Moher, a sandstone wall that rises almost 700 feet above the Atlantic. After that you'll continue to your hotel. In the evening you'll have a medieval-style dinner of traditional Irish food at a castle with performers dressed as lords and ladies singing and playing harp music.

days.title: Limerick to Galway to Dublin
included: Free time in Galway for shopping and exploration
days.description: You'll drive to Galway, a vibrant artistic city where you have free time to shop, watch street performers, see medieval buildings, or sit in a pub or café. Later you'll travel across the country back to Dublin, where you can pick your own restaurant for dinner or explore the city's famous pubs.

days.title: Dublin
days.description: Your tour ends after breakfast.
