name: Inca Adventures - 7 Days (Lima, Paracas, Ica, Cusco, Machu Picchu & Rainbow Mountain) - With Domestic Flights

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro:
An adventure that will lead you through the historic area of Lima, through the Paracas peninsula, the arid deserts of Ica and its Huacachina in the Peruvian coast.

Then geography will radically change to reach the Andes and contemplate the imposing Inca culture. Of course, we will visit one of the 7 Wonders of the World: Machu Picchu! Also one of the natural wonders of Peru: The Mountain of Colors.

Our package compresses the best of these regions in just seven days, you can take a look at the wonders that Peru.

­ 

Key features of this trip:

  • Climb from Lima's Pacific coastline to Rainbow Mountain's 5,020 m / 16,466 ft summit in one week, combining desert oases, Inca archaeology and glacier landscapes with domestic flights and zero backtracking 
  • Experience Paracas marine wildlife and Huacachina desert thrills in a single day, from Humboldt penguins and sea lions to adrenaline dune buggy rides across golden sand dunes 
  • Explore Machu Picchu with bilingual guide for two hours, then ride the panoramic train through Sacred Valley cloud forest with Andean peaks visible through oversized windows 
  • Walk through Moray's circular terraces and descend to Maras salt mines where over 3,000 evaporation ponds are still harvested by local families using Inca techniques 
  • Travel with maximum 16 participants, all airport transfers and domestic flights included, three-star hotels in Miraflores, Cusco and Aguas Calientes with entrance tickets pre-secured

days.title: Lima
included: Visit to Parque del Amor with panoramic Pacific Ocean views and 'El Beso' sculpture
Complimentary drone video recording and professional editing
Walk to Parque Intihuatana natural viewpoint
Panoramic visit to Huaca Pucllana pre-Inca archaeological site
Artisanal ice cream tasting with traditional Peruvian flavors
Walk through El Olivar Park historic olive grove
Visit to Central Reserve Bank of Peru Museum (BCRP) with pre-Hispanic collections
Guided walk through Plaza Mayor viewing Government Palace, Lima Cathedral, Municipal Palace, and Union Club
Guided visit to Church and Convent of Santo Domingo
optional: Visit to Handicraft Market for textiles, ceramics, Peruvian silver, and souvenirs
Guided tasting of wines, piscos, and cocktails
landmarks: Central Reserve Bank of Peru Museum
Church and Convent of Santo Domingo
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez (LIM), Av. Elmer Faucett s/n, Callao, Lima Province, Peru (When you arrive in Lima and later in Cusco, a member of the Waman Adventures team will be waiting for you at the airport to assist you and transfer you to your hotel., 05:00 - 22:00)
days.description: You'll arrive at Jorge Chávez International Airport and get transferred to your hotel in Miraflores. After settling in, the afternoon brings a guided city tour where you'll see Parque del Amor, the pre-Inca ruins at Huaca Pucllana, and El Olivar Park. Then you'll head into Lima's Historic Center to check out the Central Reserve Bank Museum, Plaza Mayor, and the Church of Santo Domingo, which is on UNESCO's list.

days.title: Paracas - Ica - Huacachina
included: Ballestas Islands boat tour observing Humboldt penguins, sea lions, pelicans, and the Candelabrum geoglyph
Guided visit to local vineyard in Ica
Dune buggy ride on Huacachina sand dunes
Free time to explore Huacachina oasis and take photos
days.description: This is an early start heading south along the coast to Paracas for a boat tour. You'll spot Humboldt penguins, sea lions, and pelicans near the Candelabrum geoglyph. From there, you'll travel inland to Ica for vineyard and pisco tasting. By late afternoon, you're at the Huacachina oasis where sand dunes surround you completely. There's time for dune buggy rides and optional sandboarding before heading back to Lima in the evening.

days.title: Lima to Cusco
days.description: You'll head to the airport in Lima for a flight to Cusco, the ancient Inca capital high in the Andes. After landing, a guide will meet you and take you to your hotel in historic Cusco. The rest of the day is for resting and letting your body adjust to the high altitude before exploring tomorrow.

days.title: Chinchero - Maras - Moray
included: Visit to Chinchero traditional Andean town with Inca walls and colonial church
Stop at local textile interpretation center with demonstration of ancestral weaving and dyeing techniques
Visit to Moray archaeological complex of circular terraces
Visit to Maras salt mines with 3,000+ salt evaporation ponds
days.description: After breakfast, you'll visit several Sacred Valley sites starting with Chinchero, where you'll see Inca walls and a colonial church. Next is a textile center to watch local women demonstrate traditional weaving using natural dyes. Then you'll check out Moray's circular terraces that the Incas used for crop research. The Maras salt mines come next, with over 3,000 evaporation ponds still in use. By late afternoon, you're at Ollantaytambo train station for the scenic ride to Aguas Calientes.

days.title: Machu Picchu
included: Guided tour of Machu Picchu citadel with explanation of Inca architecture, engineering, religion, and daily life
optional: Hike to Huayna Picchu (pre-booking required, USD $90 per person ticket only)
Hike to Machu Picchu Mountain (pre-booking required, USD $90 per person ticket only)
days.description: A shuttle bus takes you from Aguas Calientes to Machu Picchu, one of the New Seven Wonders. You'll get a two-hour guided tour learning about Inca architecture, engineering, religion, and how people lived there. Optional hikes up Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain are available if you want more. After lunch, you'll head back by bus, then take the train to Ollantaytambo and drive to Cusco.

days.title: Rainbow Mountain
included: Moderate two-hour hike to Rainbow Mountain
Summit views of glaciers, valleys, llamas, alpacas, and Ausangate Mountain
optional: Horses available along the route for an additional fee
days.meals: Breakfast (Traditional breakfast in Cusipata), Lunch (Buffet lunch in Cusipata)
days.description: You're heading out before dawn to Cusipata for breakfast, then to Pulawasipata to hike up to Rainbow Mountain at 5,020 meters. The moderate two-hour hike rewards you with panoramic views of glaciers, valleys, llamas, alpacas, and Ausangate Mountain. After hiking back down, you'll have a buffet lunch in Cusipata before returning to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Cusco
days.description: The morning is free for you to rest at your hotel or walk around Cusco on your own. When it's time, you'll get your boarding passes and transfer to Cusco Airport for your domestic flight to Lima, where you'll connect to your international flight home.

intro:
Explore Peru’s capital, high Andes and Lake Titicaca in ten days, combining Lima, the coastal desert of Paracas and Huacachina with Cusco, Machu Picchu, Rainbow Mountain, Humantay Lake and the Route of the Sun to Puno. This itinerary is designed for travellers who want a complete, well structured journey, with domestic flights, airport transfers, guided tours and handpicked three star hotels included.


Key features of this trip:

  • Summit two glacier landscapes back-to-back, trekking Rainbow Mountain at 5,020 m / 16,466 ft with Ausangate views and turquoise Humantay Lake at 4,200 m / 13,779 ft, both with traditional breakfasts and buffet lunches 
  • Travel the Route of the Sun from Cusco to Puno with stops at Andahuaylillas baroque chapel, Raqchi Temple of Wiracocha, La Raya Pass at 4,338 m / 14,232 ft and Pukara Museum 
  • Navigate Lake Titicaca by speed boat to Taquile Island with UNESCO-recognized textiles and Uros floating islands built from totora reeds, with traditional lunch by local families 
  • Explore Paracas marine reserve, tour an Ica vineyard with pisco tasting, and ride dune buggies across Huacachina oasis surrounded by towering sand dunes 
  • Fly Lima–Cusco to maximize highland time, travel by tourist-class bus with reclining seats, staying in three-star hotels throughout with daily breakfast

days.title: Lima
included: Airport pick-up from Gate 3 and transfer to hotel in Miraflores
Visit to Parque del Amor (Love Park) with panoramic Pacific Ocean views and El Beso sculpture
Complimentary professional drone video recording and editing of your visit
Walk to Parque Intihuatana natural viewpoint
Panoramic visit to Huaca Pucllana pre-Inca archaeological site with privileged viewing point
Artisanal ice cream tasting with traditional Peruvian flavors (lúcuma, cherimoya, Peruvian coffee)
Walk through El Olivar Park (400-year-old olive grove)
Visit to Historic Center of Lima (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
Visit to Central Reserve Bank of Peru Museum (BCRP) with pre-Hispanic ceramics, textiles, metalwork and gold vault
Exterior viewing of Plaza Mayor landmarks (Government Palace, Lima Cathedral, Municipal Palace, Union Club)
Guided visit to Church and Convent of Santo Domingo with colonial architecture and relics
optional: Visit to Handicraft Market for textiles, ceramics, Peruvian silver and souvenirs
Guided tasting of wines, piscos, and cocktails with insight into Peru's winemaking and distillation traditions
landmarks: Church and Convent of Santo Domingo
Central Reserve Bank of Peru Museum (BCRP)
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional Jorge Chávez (LIM), Av. Elmer Faucett s/n, Callao, Lima Province, Peru (When you arrive in Lima and then in Cusco, one member of Waman team will be waiting for you at the airport., 05:00 - 22:00)
days.description: You'll land at Jorge Chávez International Airport and get transferred to your hotel in Miraflores. Once you've settled in, the afternoon kicks off with a city tour covering Lima's key spots. Start at Parque del Amor for those coastal views, then swing by Huaca Pucllana with its pre-Inca ruins. The historic center gets plenty of attention too, including the Central Reserve Bank Museum, Plaza Mayor, and the Church and Convent of Santo Domingo. You'll grab some artisanal ice cream along the way, and there's a chance to try wine and pisco if that interests you.

days.title: Lima to Paracas - Ica - Huacachina
included: Hotel pick-up between 4:00 and 4:30 a.m. and drive to Paracas
Speedboat tour of Ballestas Islands with observation of Humboldt penguins, sea lions, pelicans and guano birds
View of the Candelabrum geoglyph on the desert hillside
Guided visit to local vineyard in Ica
Dune buggy ride across the Huacachina desert
Free time to explore the oasis, take photos, shop for local handicrafts or relax by the lagoon
optional: Sandboarding (available during dune buggy experience for those who wish to try it)
days.description: You're up early for pick-up between 4:00 and 4:30 a.m. for a full day of desert and coastal adventures. Head south to the Paracas Peninsula and board a speedboat to explore Ballestas Islands, where you'll spot Humboldt penguins, sea lions, and pelicans, plus see the mysterious Candelabrum geoglyph. From there, move inland to Ica for vineyard tours with wine and pisco tasting before lunch. Next comes Huacachina Oasis surrounded by golden dunes, where you'll ride a dune buggy and can try sandboarding if you want. You'll catch the sunset from the dunes before driving back to Lima, pulling in around 10:00 to 11:00 p.m.

days.title: Lima to Cusco
included: Hotel pick-up in Lima and private transfer to Jorge Chávez International Airport
Flight from Lima to Cusco with aerial views of the Andes
Meeting with Waman Adventures representative at Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport in Cusco
Private transfer to hotel in historic center of Cusco (approximately 15-20 minutes)
Guide tips about the city and altitude acclimatization recommendations
Free afternoon to rest and acclimatize
days.description: You'll head to Jorge Chávez International Airport from your hotel for a flight to Cusco with impressive aerial views of the Andes (about 1 hour 15 minutes). When you land at Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport, a Waman Adventures representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel in the historic center (15-20 minutes). Your guide shares tips about the city and how to adjust to the altitude. The afternoon is free for resting and light exploration as you acclimatize.

days.title: Cusco - Sacred Valley
included: Hotel pick-up in Cusco between 7:00 and 7:30 a.m.
Visit to Chinchero village with Inca walls and colonial church
Demonstration at local textile interpretation center showing ancestral weaving and dyeing techniques using natural materials
Visit to Moray archaeological site with circular agricultural terraces
Visit to Maras salt mines with over 3,000 salt evaporation ponds
Assistance to hotel in Aguas Calientes
Free time to rest or explore the town
days.description: After breakfast, pick-up happens between 7:00 and 7:30 a.m. for a full day exploring the Sacred Valley. You'll visit Chinchero, a colorful Andean village with impressive Inca walls and a colonial church where local women show ancestral weaving and dyeing techniques using natural materials. Continue to Moray with its circular terraces that created microclimates for Inca agricultural experiments. Then explore the Maras salt mines with over 3,000 evaporation ponds still used by local families. Finish with a transfer to Ollantaytambo train station and board the train to Aguas Calientes, arriving in the evening with free time to rest or explore.

days.title: Aguas Calientes - Machu Picchu
included: Hotel pick-up between 6:00 and 6:30 a.m. in Aguas Calientes
Walk to CONSETTUR bus station and shuttle bus to Machu Picchu (approximately 30 minutes)
Registration at Machu Picchu with passport and entrance ticket
Guided tour (approximately 2 hours) of iconic and historically significant areas of Machu Picchu citadel
Guide explanation of Inca architecture, engineering, culture and spiritual worldview
Shuttle bus return from Machu Picchu to Aguas Calientes
Afternoon train from Aguas Calientes to Ollantaytambo
Meeting with Waman Adventures representative at train station
Private transfer to hotel in Cusco
optional: Entrance and hike to Huayna Picchu Mountain (USD $90 per person for ticket only)
Entrance and hike to Machu Picchu Mountain (USD $90 per person for ticket only)
days.description: One of the most exciting days awaits. Pick-up happens between 6:00 and 6:30 a.m., then you'll walk to the CONSETTUR bus station and take a shuttle (about 30 minutes) to Machu Picchu. After registering with your passport and ticket, you get a two-hour guided tour through the citadel's iconic areas, learning about Inca architecture, engineering, culture, and spiritual beliefs. If you booked an optional hike like Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, you can do that after the guided tour. You'll take the bus down to Aguas Calientes for lunch at a local restaurant (not included), then board the afternoon train back to Ollantaytambo. Meet your Waman Adventures representative for a private transfer back to Cusco, arriving in the evening.

days.title: Cusco - Rainbow Mountain
included: Hotel pick-up in Cusco between 3:50 and 4:30 a.m.
Drive (approximately 2 hours) to Cusipata with traditional breakfast
Transfer (approximately 45 minutes) through valleys and herds of llamas and alpacas to Pulawasipata trailhead
Moderate two-hour hike to Rainbow Mountain with views of colored slopes, Andean villages, and local shepherds in traditional clothing
Time at summit to admire panoramic scenery and take photographs, including views of Ausangate Mountain
Descent along the same path back to Pulawasipata
Transfer to Cusipata for buffet lunch
Return to Cusco in the afternoon with drop-off in city center
optional: Horse rental along the route for additional optional fee
days.description: Pick-up is very early between 3:50 and 4:00 a.m. for the two-hour drive to Mollepata, passing through valleys and traditional Andean landscapes. You'll have breakfast in Mollepata to prep for the hike. Continue by private transport for about one hour to Soraypampa trailhead, with views of the Vilcabamba mountain range. Hike uphill for two hours to Humantay Lake, a turquoise glacial lagoon surrounded by dramatic landscapes, Andean flora and fauna, and glacier-covered peaks. Spend 30 to 40 minutes at the lake resting, enjoying a snack, and photographing the turquoise waters. Descend back to Soraypampa, then return by transport to Mollepata for a well-earned buffet lunch before heading back to Cusco and dropping off near the city center.

days.title: Cusco - Humantay Lake
included: Drive (approximately 2 hours) to Mollepata through valleys and traditional Andean landscapes
Private transport (approximately 1 hour) to Soraypampa with views of Vilcabamba mountain range
Two-hour uphill hike to Humantay Lake surrounded by dramatic landscapes, Andean flora and fauna, and glacier-covered peaks
Time at lake (30–40 minutes) to rest, enjoy a snack, take photos and appreciate the turquoise waters
Descent back to Soraypampa along the same path
Return by transport to Mollepata for buffet lunch
Afternoon return to Cusco with drop-off near city center
optional: Horse rental along the route for additional optional fee
days.meals: Breakfast (Warm, local style meal in Mollepata), Lunch (Buffet lunch)
days.description: You're picked up very early between 3:50 and 4:30 a.m. for the drive to Cusipata (about two hours), where you'll have traditional breakfast. Continue for about 45 minutes through valleys and alpine meadows with llamas and alpacas visible, arriving at Pulawasipata trailhead. The moderate two-hour hike to Rainbow Mountain offers stunning views of the colored slopes, Andean villages, and local shepherds in traditional clothing. You'll spend time at the summit taking in panoramic views and photos, with views of Ausangate Mountain (the region's highest peak). Descend the same path back to Pulawasipata, then transfer to Cusipata for a buffet lunch before heading back to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Cusco to Puno
included: Hotel pick-up in Cusco between 6:00 and 6:10 a.m.
Transfer to bus station in Cusco
Tourist class bus departure around 7:00 a.m. toward Puno
Visit to Andahuaylillas 17th-century church with baroque decoration, gold leaf altars and Cusco School paintings
Visit to Raqchi archaeological site dedicated to Wiracocha with large temple, stone base, adobe walls, ceremonial fountains and storage buildings
Stop at La Raya Pass (4,338 m / 14,232 ft) with views of Chimboya Mountain and high plateau
Visit to Pukara Lithic Museum with pre-Incan sculptures, ceramics and monolith 'Hatunñaqaq' (Supreme Decapitator)
Transfer to hotel in Puno (arrival around 5:00 p.m.)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Buffet lunch with regional dishes at La Pascana restaurant in Sicuani)
days.description: You're picked up between 6:00 and 6:10 a.m. for transfer to the bus station, departing around 7:00 a.m. on a comfortable tourist bus heading to Puno along the Route of the Sun. Visit Andahuaylillas, a 17th-century church often called the 'Sistine Chapel of America' for its baroque decoration and Cusco School paintings. Continue to Raqchi, an archaeological site dedicated to the god Wiracocha with a large temple, stone base, adobe walls, ceremonial fountains, and storage buildings. Stop for a buffet lunch at La Pascana restaurant in Sicuani with regional dishes (cold drinks aren't included). At La Raya Pass (4,338 m / 14,232 ft), the highest point on the route, you'll see the boundary between Cusco and Puno. Visit the Pukara Lithic Museum with pre-Incan sculptures and ceramics. You'll arrive in Puno around 5:00 p.m. and transfer to your hotel.

days.title: Puno - Lake Titicaca
included: Hotel pick-up in Puno between 7:30 and 8:00 a.m.
Motorboat boarding and navigation on Lake Titicaca
Visit to Uros floating islands with explanation of island, house and reed boat construction using totora
Learning about Uros daily life, traditional fishing practices and cultural symbolism
Motorboat journey (approximately 2.5 hours) across Lake Titicaca to Taquile Island with Andean mountain range views
Guided walk on Taquile Island along stone pathways, terraces and viewpoints
Learning about Taquile community's social organization and textile traditions (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage)
Traditional lunch prepared by local families with fresh regional ingredients
Free time to enjoy views and local atmosphere
Return motorboat navigation to Puno in the afternoon
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Traditional lunch prepared by local families based on fresh regional ingredients)
days.description: Pick-up happens between 7:30 and 8:00 a.m. for transfer to the main port on Lake Titicaca, the world's highest navigable lake. Board a motorboat and visit the Uros floating islands, learning how inhabitants build islands, houses, and reed boats from totora reeds, plus their daily life and traditional fishing practices. Continue by boat (approximately 2.5 hours) toward Taquile Island with views of the Andean mountain range. At Taquile, take a guided walk along stone pathways, terraces, and viewpoints while learning about the community's social organization and textile traditions (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage). Enjoy traditional lunch prepared by local families with fresh regional ingredients. You'll have free time to enjoy the views and local atmosphere before returning to the boat. Head back to Puno in the afternoon and transfer to your hotel.

days.title: Puno to Juliaca Airport
included: Hotel pick-up in Puno at agreed time

days.description: You'll transfer from Puno to Juliaca Airport according to your flight schedule for your domestic flight to Lima. Pick-up from your hotel happens at the agreed time, and you'll be transferred to Juliaca Airport. Our staff helps with check-in for your flight from Juliaca to Lima, where you'll connect with your international flight home (not included in the package).

qa.question: Do we get a plane from the same airport we came too in Lima? Flights / Transfers

On Day 1, we recommend arriving in Lima around 11:00 AM. This will give you enough time to transfer to your hotel in Miraflores and join the Lima City Tour. On Day 10, we recommend booking your international departure flight from Lima at 23:00 . qa.question: Do you arrange for international flights on request? Flights / Transfers

qa.question: Can I spend an extra night in Lima at the end of the trip, flying home the following morning? Could I be dropped off at a hotel instead of the airport and have transportation to the airport the next morning? Flights / Transfers

It is located just 7 minutes from the international airport, making it by far the most convenient option. Most hotels in the Miraflores area are approximately one hour from the airport, depending on traffic, so staying near the airport helps avoid unnecessary stress before an early flight. In addition, the Holiday Inn Lima Airport offers several great benefits, including: Breakfast available from 4:00 AM, ideal for early departures. Complimentary shuttle service between the hotel and the airport, available 24 hours a day.

attributes.name: City & Culture

attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

intro:
Discover the best of Vietnam with our 10-day tour package. From the bustling city of Hanoi to the tranquil waters of Halong Bay, the historic town of Hoi An, and the vibrant metropolis of Ho Chi Minh City, this tour will take you on an unforgettable journey through Vietnam's rich culture and stunning landscapes.


1. Explore Hanoi's iconic landmarks, including Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Temple of Literature, and Hoan Kiem Lake.

2. Experience the breathtaking natural beauty of Halong Bay on an overnight cruise and enjoy a seafood dinner on board.

3. Discover the charming town of Hoi An and take a boat trip on the Thu Bon River to see the skilled woodworkers and shipbuilding families of Kim Bong Village.

4. Visit the ancient ruins of My Son Sanctuary and learn about the fascinating history of the Champa Kingdom.

5. Immerse yourself in the fascinating history of Ho Chi Minh City, including a tour of the Cu Chi Tunnels and a visit to the War Remnants Museum.

6. Cruise along the Mekong Delta and experience the local culture, cuisine, and way of life of the people who live along the river.

days.title: Hanoi
days.start_point: Noi Bai International Terminal 2, Sân Bay Quốc Tế Nội Bài, Huyện Sóc Sơn, Hanoi 140800, Vietnam (Pick up at airport is included)
days.description: You'll arrive in Hanoi today at whatever time works for you. A Legend Travel Group driver meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Once you've checked in, the afternoon and evening are completely open. Rest up if you need it, or head out to get a feel for the city on your own.

days.title: Hanoi
included: Visit Ho Chi Minh complex and mausoleum
Visit Vietnam Ethnology Museum or Women's Museum
days.meals: Breakfast (At the hotel), Lunch (Delicious Vietnamese cuisine at a local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, a minivan picks you up around 8:30 or 9:00 am for the 3.5-hour drive to Halong City. The route takes you through countryside and rice paddies. Once there, you board an authentic Chinese junk and cruise through Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You'll check out Amazing Cave, take a swim in the clear waters, and have lunch on the boat. Later in the day the junk anchors for the night in a quiet spot where you can have dinner and either swim in phosphorescent water or spend time on deck watching the stars.

days.title: Halong Bay
optional: Swim in phosphorescent water at night
Sleep under the stars on the top deck
days.meals: Breakfast (At the hotel), Lunch (Selection of the freshest seafood served on board), Dinner (Served on board as the sun sets over the bay)
days.description: Wake early to catch the sunrise and eat breakfast on deck as you cruise past thousands of islands. A floating fishing village visit comes next, where local fishermen share their stories. Lunch happens on board before you head back to Halong City pier around 3:30 or 4:00 pm. From there it's a drive back to Hanoi and then directly to the airport for your flight to Hoi An. Upon landing, you're transferred to your hotel with the rest of the evening free to wander the ancient town.

days.title: Halong Bay - Hanoi - Hoi An
included: Sunrise viewing cruise through Halong Bay islands
optional: Explore Hoi An Ancient Town independently
days.meals: Breakfast (Served on the boat), Lunch (Served on board as you cruise back to Halong City pier)
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, a guided tour takes you through Hanoi's main sights. You'll see the Tran Quoc Pagoda on Golden Fish Island and then visit the Ho Chi Minh complex, which includes his mausoleum and the historic homes where he lived. Next comes the One Pillar Pagoda, one of the city's most distinctive structures. Following lunch at a local spot, you'll head to the Temple of Literature, the country's first university, and wrap up at Hoa Lo Prison, historically called the Hanoi Hilton. You're back at your hotel by evening.

days.title: Hoi An
included: Visit temple in Hoi An center
Visit pagoda dedicated to sailors and fishermen
Visit chapel with origins dating back to the 1700s
Boat trip on Thu Bon River to Kim Bong Village
optional: Leisurely explore Hoi An Ancient Town independently in the evening
days.description: Today is a full day exploring Hoi An. You'll visit temples with gilded statues that show Chinese and Japanese influences, and a pagoda built to honor sailors and fishermen. The Sa Huynh Museum near the famous Japanese Covered Bridge is on the itinerary too. In the afternoon, take a boat on the Thu Bon River out to Kim Bong Village on Cam Kim Island where you can watch skilled woodworkers and see traditional shipbuilding families. The evening is yours to explore the ancient town however you like.

days.title: My Son Sanctuary
included: Visit My Son Sanctuary UNESCO World Heritage site
Explore Cham civilization towers and sanctuaries
optional: Explore Hoi An shops and markets independently
days.description: After breakfast, a guided tour takes you through Ho Chi Minh City's main attractions. You'll see the Notre Dame Cathedral with its neo-Romanesque style, the historic Central Post Office that Gustave Eiffel designed, and the Reunification Palace, which carries significant meaning in Vietnam's history. Following lunch at a local restaurant, you drive about 75 km (roughly 1.5 hours) to the Cu Chi Tunnels. You explore over 200 km of underground tunnels that functioned as cities during the Vietnam War, with living areas, trap doors, weapon factories, and field hospitals inside. Learn about how they were built and what life was like there, try some simple war-era food, and go into the tunnels yourself to experience them. You return to your Ho Chi Mihn City hotel for the night.

days.title: Hoi An - Ho Chi Minh City
days.description: After breakfast, your guide picks you up at 8:00 am for the trip to My Tho, the capital of Tien Giang Province, about 75 km southeast of Ho Chi Minh City on the Mekong River. You'll explore one or two islands known for traditional handcrafts such as coconut candy and bee farms. The Vinh Trang Pagoda, the oldest pagoda in the Mekong Delta, is reached by boat and surrounded by beautiful gardens with intricate architecture and sculptures. After returning to Ho Chi Minh City, you check into your hotel for the night.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Cu Chi Tunnels
included: Learn about tunnel construction and history
Sample simple cuisine from the war period
days.meals: Breakfast (At the hotel), Lunch (At a local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, you head out at 8:00 am toward My Son, a UNESCO World Heritage site located 50 km southwest of Hoi An. This place ranks as one of Southeast Asia's greatest archaeological sites. You'll walk through a lush valley and see red brick towers and sanctuaries constructed between the 7th and 13th centuries by the Cham civilization. The intricate carvings and sculptures on the temples tell stories about their significance. You're back in Hoi An by 1:00 pm for lunch on your own, then the afternoon is free for shopping or exploring the town and its famous lanterns, tailor-made clothing, and handcrafted items.

days.title: Mekong Delta - My Tho
included: Visit traditional handcraft islands (coconut candy and bee farms)
Boat trip along the Mekong River
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, the morning is free in Hoi An. Use the time to relax or shop. Later, you're transferred to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. A driver meets you when you land and takes you to your hotel. From there, the day is yours. Check out cultural spots like the War Remnants Museum or Independence Palace, walk through local markets, or just take it easy at your hotel.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Departure
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel and then head to the airport for your international flight home or to wherever you're headed next. A Legend Travel Group driver takes care of the transfer to make sure your departure goes smoothly.

name: Totally Morocco Tour from Casablanca

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: The Totally Morocco Tour from Casblanca is a comprehensive journey through some of the country's most iconic destinations. Starting in Casablanca, the economic capital of Morocco. The tour will continue to Tangier, a city steeped in history and culture, with a visit to the historic medina and the American Legation Museum. You will then visit the charming mountain town of Chefchaouen, known for its blue-painted buildings and stunning views. Next, the tour will take you to Rabat, the political capital of Morocco, where you will visit the Royal Palace and the Hassan Tower. After Rabat, the tour will continue to the ancient Roman ruins of Volubilis and finally to the medieval city of Fez, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its intricate architecture and rich history. Additionally, this tour takes you on a journey through the country's most iconic destinations, including Merzouga Desert, Dades Valley, Ouarzazate, Kasbah Ait Benhaddou and ends back to Marrakech.

days.title: Casablanca
days.start_point: Casablanca, Grand Casablanca, Morocco (Casablanca)
days.description: Your guide meets you in Casablanca at 2pm to start exploring the city. The Hassan II Mosque is first on the agenda, and you'll walk through this massive structure before heading into the Habous quarter where traditional architecture and souks fill the narrow streets. From there, you'll see United Nations Square, check out the Central Market, and stroll down Mohammad V Avenue, which runs through the heart of the city. Plan for a few hours walking around and taking in the mix of old and modern Casablanca.

days.title: Casablanca to Tangier
included: Visit Cap Spartel with panoramic views of city and Mediterranean Sea
days.description: Your driver picks you up from your Casablanca hotel at 08:00 and takes you to the train station for the high-speed train to Tangier, which takes about 2 hours and 10 minutes. Once you arrive, a local guide will meet you at the station. From there, you'll walk through the narrow streets and check out the Kasbah, then head to Cap Spartel where you get panoramic views of the coastline. After that, you'll see Grand Socco square and explore the Caves of Hercules before settling in for the night in Tangier.

days.title: Chefchaouen - Rabat
included: Visit local souks to see traditional crafts (pottery, weaving, traditional clothing)
Visit city viewpoint with panoramic views of Chefchaouen and Rif mountains
days.description: At 09:00 you'll drive to Chefchaouen, the blue and white town in the Rif region. A guide takes you through the medina's narrow streets, past the Kasbah and Great Mosque, and into the local souks where you can see people doing traditional pottery and weaving work. Later in the afternoon, you'll head up to the city viewpoint for views of the town and the surrounding Rif mountains. By evening you'll drive back to Rabat for your overnight stay there.

days.title: Volubilis - Fez
included: Guided tour of Roman Ruins of Volubilis
days.description: Starting at 9am in Rabat, you visit the Royal Palace, Hassan Tower, and the Mausoleum of Mohammed V to get a sense of the city's historical importance. After that, you travel to Volubilis to see the Roman ruins from the 3rd century BC scattered across the site, including the Capitoline Temple, Basilica, and houses that belonged to wealthy residents. By late afternoon, you continue on to Fez for an overnight stay, arriving in the evening.

days.title: Fez
days.description: This day focuses on Fez's ancient medina, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with layers of history. You'll navigate narrow streets to find the Bou Inania Madrasa, the Dar Batha Museum, and Bou Jeloud Gardens. The Royal Palace is another significant stop, and throughout the medina you come across local souks where craftspeople work with pottery and leather, continuing traditions that have existed for centuries. Walking here takes time because the streets twist and connect in unexpected ways, so pace yourself.

days.title: Fez to Merzouga
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Traditional dinner with Berber rhythms)
days.description: Leaving medieval Fez behind, you drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains and down into the Ziz Valley, passing through Berber villages and varied landscapes. By afternoon, you reach Merzouga at the edge of the Erg Chebbi sand dunes. After getting settled, you head out on camel for trekking across the dunes and watching sunset paint the sand in different colors. Later, you'll have a traditional dinner with Berber music before spending the night in a nomad tent right in the desert, which gives you a real sense of what life out here feels like.

days.title: Boumalne Dades - Ouarzazate
optional: Sunrise viewing over Erg Chebbi sand dunes
days.description: An optional sunrise walk on the dunes is available for those who want to wake early and see the light change across the sand. Then you head toward Ouarzazate, driving through Boumalne Dades Valley where you stop to explore kasbahs, palmeries, and traditional houses while learning about the people living there. The Todra Gorges offers good hiking if you want to get out and walk, and there's a lunch break somewhere along the way. You arrive in Ouarzazate by mid-afternoon and visit the Atlas Film Studios, where filmmakers shot scenes for famous productions.

days.title: Ait Benhaddou - Marrakech
included: Guided Tour of Kasbah Ait Benhaddou
days.description: Driving through the Atlas Mountains, you reach Kasbah Ait Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site that looks like a fortress-town with its clay buildings stacked together. This kasbahs is one of Morocco's best-preserved, and it's been used as a filming location for movies including Gladiator and Game of Thrones, which tells you something about how it looks. From there, you continue toward Marrakech, arriving by evening in this vibrant southern city.

days.title: Marrakech
days.description: A full day exploring Marrakech starts with the Koutoubia Mosque, which has the city's tallest minaret and is the largest mosque here. You'll visit the Saadian Tombs, discovered in 1917 and decorated with intricate tilework from the 16th and 17th centuries. The Bahia Palace is next, a 19th-century structure with remarkable tile work and gardens throughout. Time in the souks lets you browse spices, textiles, pottery, and jewelry before lunch. After eating, you check out the Jardin Secret, a four-hundred-year-old garden showing Islamic design, then finish at Menara gardens with its large pond, olive groves, and views toward the Atlas Mountains in the distance.

days.title: Marrakech
days.description: Your last morning in Marrakech ends with an airport transfer arranged based on when your flight departs. The tour concludes as you head to the airport, marking the end of your Morocco journey.

intro:

days.title: Trogir to Split
included: Swimming stop in bay off island of Čiovo
Guided walking tour of UNESCO Split including Diocletian's Palace, Peristyle, Golden Gate, Venetian palaces
days.description: You'll board your ship in Trogir between noon and 2:00 pm, then settle into your cabin and grab a welcome drink with lunch. After that, the ship stops for a swim in a secluded bay near the island of Čiovo. Later you'll sail to Split, a UNESCO site, where you can walk through medieval streets and see Diocletian's Palace complex. Spend your evening strolling along the Riva waterfront.

days.title: Split to Hvar
included: Swimming stop in secluded bay en route to Hvar
Exploration of Hvar town with fortress, Cathedral of St. Stephan, Franciscan monastery, town loggia, Hektorovic Palace, arsenal, and theatre

days.description: Today the ship heads to Hvar island, famous for its lavender fields and pleasant weather. Along the way, there's a swimming stop in a secluded bay. Once in the port town, you can check out the fortress, visit the Cathedral of St. Stephan, walk through the Franciscan monastery, and see historic palaces that reflect the island's rich cultural background.

days.title: Hvar to Mljet
included: Swimming stop in bay on south coast of Korčula
Exploration of Mljet National Park and its two saltwater lakes
days.meals: Breakfast (Buffet breakfast (half board service)), Lunch (Three-course lunch (half board service))

Part of this area is a National Park with two saltwater lakes connected to the sea by a narrow channel. These lakes formed around 10,000 years ago, and you can explore this unusual geological feature during your time here.

days.title: Mljet to Dubrovnik
included: Guided walking tour of UNESCO Dubrovnik including medieval streets, red-roofed architecture, cultural and historical sites
days.meals: Breakfast (Buffet breakfast (half board service)), Lunch (Three-course lunch (half board service)), Dinner (Captain's dinner)
days.description: After a swimming break at the Elafiti Islands, you'll arrive in Dubrovnik around 4:00 pm. The medieval old town has characteristic red roofs and sits on the UNESCO list. Known as the 'Pearl of the Adriatic,' Dubrovnik offers great opportunities to explore its historic streets, sample the local cuisine and wines, and browse shops in the evening.

days.title: Dubrovnik to Korčula
included: Swimming and sunbathing at Elafiti Islands

days.meals: Breakfast (Buffet breakfast (half board service)), Lunch (Three-course lunch (half board service))
days.description: Start your day with swimming and sunbathing at the Elafiti Islands, then head toward Korčula island. The historic Old Town still has 13th-century Venetian fortifications surrounding it. Often called 'Little Dubrovnik' because of its fortress-like layout, this charming town is also where the famous explorer Marco Polo was born, making it worth exploring on foot.

days.title: Korčula to Brač

optional: Exploration of Brač island landscape and limestone formations

Brač is the largest island in the Adriatic, featuring distinctive limestone terrain with gullies, crevices, and coves. You'll stay overnight in one of the charming northern towns.

days.title: Brač to Trogir
included: Swimming stop in bay on island of Čiovo

days.meals: Breakfast (Buffet breakfast (half board service)), Lunch (Three-course lunch (half board service))
days.description: Leaving Brač, the ship stops for swimming in a bay off Čiovo island before heading back to your starting point. You can explore the UNESCO-listed town of Trogir, a small island with unique medieval heritage. Take time to see the Cathedral portal by Radovan and reliefs by Nicolò di Giovanni Fiorentino, both important works by famous sculptors.

name: Southern France Tour - Nice to Paris

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
This 8-day program from Nice to Paris will allow you to see some of the most picturesque parts of France.  Beginning on the French Riviera, your journey will take you through Nice, Marseilles, Provence, Lyon, Dijon, and finally, the famous city of France, Paris. Visit the Cote d'Azur, Lyon, Dijon, Paris, and Marseille, among many other places.


Important Trip Note:

Please note also that your tour guide might be changed once or several times during the tour. On some tours, according to the number of passengers, the service may be provided in bilingual (usually in English and Spanish), either accompanied by two tour leaders, one for each language, or a single tour leader for smaller groups explaining in both languages.

days.title: Nice
optional: Explore the old town of Nice
Visit MAMAC (Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art)
landmarks: MAMAC (Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art)
days.start_point: Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France (Pick up from Nice Airport (NCE))
days.description: You'll arrive in Nice and head to your accommodation to settle in. The rest of the day is yours to wander around at your own pace. The Promenade des Anglais runs right along the waterfront and makes for a pleasant walk, or you can check out the Matisse Museum if art's your thing. MAMAC is there too if you want contemporary work, and the old town has those narrow streets and local character that make for good exploring.

days.title: Nice - Saint Maxime - Saint Tropez - Marseille
included: Brief visit to Promenade des Anglais in Nice
Explore Saint Maxime harbor and historic center
Boat trip across the bay to Saint Tropez
optional: Picnic and walking in Saint Tropez
days.description: After breakfast, you'll walk along the Promenade des Anglais before driving to Saint Maxime, a coastal town where the harbor and 16th-century Square Tower in the historic center are worth a look around. Next comes a boat ride across the bay to Saint Tropez to see the luxury yachts in the harbor, then you'll have time for a picnic stroll. Later you'll drive to Marseille, France's second-largest city, known for its cultural scene and the historic old harbor area.

days.title: Marseille - Arles - Les Beaux - Avignon - Lyon
included: Entrance to Carrieres de Lumiere show
Visit Avignon and Palais des Papes
Funicular ride to Notre Dame de Fourviere, Lyon
days.description: Starting with breakfast, you're heading into Provence to visit Arles, a World Heritage site with Roman and medieval history plus connections to Van Gogh. After that, you'll explore Les Beaux at your own pace and see the entrance to Carrieres de Lumiere, an underground art and light show set in ancient quarries. In the afternoon, you'll stop in Avignon for lunch and a walk where you can see the Palais des Papes, the palace from when the city was the papal capital. By evening you'll reach Lyon to walk through the UNESCO historic district and take the funicular up to Notre Dame de Fourviere basilica for the views over the city.

days.title: Lyon - Tournus - Beaune - Savigny - Dijon
included: Visit Tournus and its stone gate and abbey
days.description: After breakfast, you're heading toward Burgundy and stopping in Tournus to see its impressive stone gate and abbey. Then it's on to Beaune for a relaxing walk and picnic lunch in this medieval city that's the center of Burgundy wine production. Next you'll visit Savigny Castle, a 15th-century fortress with museums covering motorbikes, racing vehicles, airplanes, and helicopters. You'll finish the day in Dijon, Burgundy's main city, where the vibrant streets and medieval and Renaissance buildings are throughout the center.

days.title: Dijon - Fontenay - Semur en Auxois - Vezelay - Paris
included: Admission to Fontenay Abbey (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
Visit Semur en Auxois medieval walled city
days.description: After breakfast, you'll visit Fontenay Abbey, a UNESCO World Heritage Cistercian site with admission included. From there it's on to Semur en Auxois, a medieval walled city worth walking through. Then you'll stop in Vezelay, one of France's most picturesque towns, which is famous as a starting point for the Camino de Santiago pilgrimage and has an impressive basilica. In the afternoon you'll head toward Paris, arriving around midday.

days.title: Paris - Versailles - Paris
included: Excursion to Versailles Palace and grounds
Panoramic city tour of Paris with native Parisian guide
optional: Entry inside the Palace of Versailles
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to the Palace of Versailles where you can explore the grounds or go inside this 17th-century château that was Louis XIV's official residence (note that entry tickets aren't included in the tour). You'll return to Paris around midday and then head to Montmartre, the bohemian neighborhood with small restaurants and street performers. After lunch, you'll take a panoramic city tour of Paris led by a native Parisian guide who can point out the main sights and neighborhoods.

days.title: Paris
days.description: You'll have breakfast and then the whole day to explore Paris however you like. Skip-the-line tickets and audio guide tickets for the Louvre Museum come with your tour, so you can head there whenever it suits you or save it for another time and just wander the streets instead.

days.title: Paris
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to the airport according to your flight schedule. Your tour services wrap up with your departure.

name: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire (with Materuni waterfalls, coffee tour) - 6 Days

attributes.name: Safari
attributes.tip: Track iconic wildlife on unforgettable game drives

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided

intro: Enjoy an adventure that takes you around the famous North Circuit parks; Serengeti, Ngorongoro, and Tarangire. Take a deep dive into Masai culture with a visit to a coffee farm, and Materuni waterfalls. It's a Tanzanian adventure you'll never forget!

days.title: Tarangire National Park
included: Game drive through Tarangire National Park with wildlife viewing (lions, cheetahs, leopards)
Visit to Tarangire River picnic site
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch at Tarangire River picnic site), Dinner
days.start_point: Arusha, Tanzania (Pick up from your accommodation)
days.description: Your guide and chef will pick you up from your hotel, then it's a 2-hour drive to Tarangire National Park where you'll meet your fellow travelers. Out on a game drive, you'll search for lions, cheetahs, and leopards before settling in at the Tarangire River for a picnic lunch with water and wildlife views. The afternoon brings more time exploring the park, and by evening you'll head to your campsite for dinner and overnight rest.

days.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park
included: Game drive in Seronera, Serengeti National Park
days.description: After breakfast, you'll spend roughly 6 hours driving from Mto Wa Mbu toward Serengeti National Park, stopping at Ngorongoro Crater viewpoint along the way to see the dramatic landscape below. You'll arrive late afternoon and head straight out on a game drive around Seronera to catch the sunset before settling into your campsite for the night.

days.title: Serengeti National Park
included: Early morning game drive in Serengeti
days.description: It's an early start with breakfast, then a morning game drive to spot wildlife across the park. You'll return to camp for lunch, followed by an afternoon game drive. Later that day, you'll drive 2 hours to Simba Campsite near Ngorongoro Crater's rim where you'll have dinner and sleep overnight.

days.title: Ngorongoro Crater
included: Descent into Ngorongoro Crater with game drive
Black rhino tracking in Ngorongoro Crater
Afternoon game drive in Ngorongoro Crater
days.description: After an early breakfast, you'll head down into Ngorongoro Crater to look for black rhinos and other animals. The crater floor's landscape makes wildlife relatively easy to spot. Following lunch, you'll continue exploring by game drive, then make your way back up the crater to your campsite for dinner and overnight stay.

days.title: Lake Manyara National Park to Arusha
included: Game drive in Lake Manyara National Park
days.description: Breakfast done, you'll head to Lake Manyara National Park known for flamingos and tree-climbing lions. A game drive lets you watch buffaloes, wildebeest, warthogs, monkeys, and birds, with a stop at the hippo pool for close views of hippos in the water. Evening brings a drive to Arusha where you'll stay overnight.

days.title: Materuni Village & Mount Kilimanjaro
included: Traditional Chagga lunch in Materuni village
Coffee grinding experience with traditional Chagga songs and dances
days.meals: Lunch (Traditional Chagga lunch in Materuni village)
days.description: You'll spend your day in Materuni village with the Chagga tribe near Mount Kilimanjaro. A 40-minute hike takes you to an 80-meter waterfall where your guide provides cultural context and you can swim if interested. Back in the village, there's a traditional Chagga lunch and local banana beer to try. After that comes a coffee tour covering cultivation, drying, roasting, and processing, where you'll help with hand grinding while enjoying Chagga songs and dances. Finally, transport to your accommodation or airport based on your flight schedule.

name: Best of the Azores: 7 days in São Miguel

attributes.name: Nature & Wildlife
attributes.tip: Explore untamed landscapes teeming with wildlife

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided
attributes.tip: Independent travel, featuring selected guided excursions

intro:
This journey will show you the best of  the last haven in Europe: The Azores.  

Feel the Nature around you and relax in the Azores, "Europe's Hawaii". Sao Miguel island is one of Portugal's best known secrets. It's luxurious green, hot thermal waters,  amazing vulcanic lagoons and the quality of the food will make you want to stay forever.

Let's us take you in a experience that comprises a hotel centrally located in Ponta Delgada, several day tours and a top up experience of your choice that will have you bragging about your trip for years.

The itinerary below is not enough for you?  You can add (or subtract) days and tours to this package to create your perfect experience, just let us know!


Important: this tour requires a minimum of 2 passengers.

days.title: Arrival in Ponta Delgada
optional: Explore Ponta Delgada's charming cafes and suggested spots
days.description: A driver picks you up at São Miguel Airport and takes you to your 4-star hotel in central Ponta Delgada. Once you're settled, the rest of the day is yours to wander around the city, check out the local cafes, and find some of those recommended spots that locals frequent.

days.title: Lagoa do Fogo and Sete Cidades Full-Day Tour
included: Visit traditional pineapple plantation and taste pineapple liquor
Vista do Rei viewpoint at Sete Cidades volcanic complex with twin lakes
Visit Santiago's lake in the crater
Visit Ribeira Grande town and historic center
optional: Visit Regional Liquor Factory and taste liquors
Thermal bath at Caldeira Velha natural reserve
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Regional restaurant lunch in Sete Cidades)
days.description: After breakfast you'll head to a traditional pineapple plantation to try pineapple liquor, then travel to viewpoints at Pico de Carão and Vista do Rei where you'll see the famous blue and green twin lakes at Sete Cidades volcanic complex. Lunch happens in Sete Cidades town. Later in the afternoon you'll drive along the coast to Capelas, an old whaling village, then stop at Ribeira Grande's historic center. From there you can choose to tour the Regional Liquor Factory or soak in a thermal bath at Caldeira Velha natural reserve before heading back to Ponta Delgada.

days.title: Vila Franca do Campo and Furnas Full-Day Tour
included: Taste Queijada da Vila local pastry
Visit Furnas valley and Furnas Lake
View Pico de Ferro viewpoint over Furnas valley
Visit Gorreana tea plantation and factory
days.description: After breakfast, you'll go to Vila Franca do Campo, which was São Miguel's first capital, and try Queijada da Vila, a famous local pastry. Then it's off to Furnas valley to see volcanic phenomena and fumaroles. You'll watch how the traditional Cozido das Furnas stew gets cooked using geothermal heat, and you can optionally visit Terra Nostra garden or take a thermal bath before lunch. After eating, explore more volcanic features in Furnas village, then head to Gorreana tea plantation where you'll taste black and green tea. The day ends at Santa Iria's viewpoint with views out over the north coast.

days.title: Whale Watching
included: Three-hour whale and dolphin watching boat trip
days.description: You'll head out on a three-hour boat trip to look for whales, dolphins, and other marine life in the waters around the Azores. The waters here are home to up to 28 species of cetaceans, so there's a good chance you'll see several different types. If luck is on your side, you might also spot turtles and seabirds during the excursion.

days.title: Ponta Delgada
days.description: This is a free day to wander around São Miguel at your own pace. You can take your time checking out whatever interests you and just enjoy the relaxed island atmosphere without any scheduled activities.

days.title: Nordeste Full Day Tour
included: Guided full-day tour of Nordeste region
Visit to Ribeira dos Caldeiroes waterfall (Veu da Noiva) and watermills
Viewpoint visits at Ponta do Sossego and Ponta da Madrugada
Return journey along south coast passing Lake of Furnas
optional: Serra Devassa Walking Tour (half-day alternative if full-day tour is unavailable due to weather or availability; 2h30 expected walking time, 5.5 km distance, easy difficulty level)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll explore the northern side of São Miguel with several stops planned. First, you'll see Veu da Noiva waterfall and its watermills at Ribeira dos Caldeiroes, then head to the charming village of Nordeste. From there, you'll visit scenic viewpoints at Ponta do Sossego and Ponta da Madrugada where there's a historic lighthouse. Lunch happens in Povoação village, and on the way back, you'll travel along the south coast past Lake of Furnas.

days.title: Departure from Ponta Delgada
days.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and a private transfer will take you to the airport for your departure.

name: W-Trek Standard + Puerto Natales 7 Days

attributes.name: Hiking & Trekking
attributes.tip: Conquer epic trails and breathtaking landscapes

attributes.name: Private Tour
attributes.tip: Travel exclusively with your friends and family

intro:
Torres del Paine is, without a doubt, one of South America’s most iconic landscapes. The legendary W Trek offers the perfect balance of challenge and comfort: enjoy 5 to 8 hours of world-class hiking through granite peaks and turquoise glaciers, then arrive each evening to a warm meal and a prepared bed. It’s the ultimate Patagonian adventure—without the heavy lifting.

Highlights: 

-Discover the towers that give the name to the National Park while you hike up

-Enjoy a warm gourmet meal in one of the best montain shelters you can find when you arrive after hours of great treks

-Hike up french valley surrounded by peaks with incredible shapes

-Walk along Grey lake and see the glacier while you advance. 

-Have the axhilarating feeling of doing one of the best treks you can do in South America

Age range: 18-70 years old (we advise older than 70 years old have to check their health condition with a doctor before deciding to book) 

Season: 1 Sep – 15 Apr

Countries visited: Chile 

Travel Style: Independent  

Trip Level: For middle level of fitness due to 5 days of trekking in Torres del Paine

Beware of visa needs (Chile)

days.title: Puerto Natales
days.start_point: Puerto Natales, Antofagasta, Antofagasta 1240000, Chile (Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive in Puerto Natales and head to your accommodation to get settled. After dropping your bags, take some time to watch the online briefing about the W Trek so you're prepared for the challenging days ahead.

days.title: Puerto Natales to Torres del Paine National Park
included: Park entrance and CONAF Administration Office paperwork
days.description: Head to the bus station in Puerto Natales and register by 2pm for your 2:30pm departure to Torres del Paine. The drive takes about 2 hours and passes through Cerro Castillo along the way. Once you reach Laguna Amarga, you'll complete your park entrance paperwork at the CONAF office, then transfer to Refugio Torre Central where you'll spend your first night on the trek.

days.title: Torres del Paine National Park - Base Torres Lookout Trek
days.description: You'll start early at 8am for a full day trek to Base Torres Lookout, covering 15 km with challenging terrain. After about 1.5 hours of climbing, you'll have views of surrounding lakes and Mount Almirante Nieto's hanging glacier. Walk through an old lenga forest to reach Refugio El Chileno, then continue up to Base Torres Lookout where the three towers come into view along with Nido de Condor and Glacier Torre. You'll return to Refugio Torre Central for the night.

days.title: Torres del Paine National Park - Refugio Central to Refugio Los Cuernos
included: Trekking from Refugio Central to Refugio Los Cuernos
days.description: This morning you'll start at 9am for a moderate 11 km trek from Refugio Central to Refugio Los Cuernos, taking about 5 to 6 hours total. You'll walk around the Macizo Paine base and circle Mount Almirante Nieto. After 30 minutes you reach the Atajo path and continue toward Los Cuernos with views of Lake Nordenskjöld, hanging glaciers, and local plants. Refugio Los Cuernos is known as one of the friendliest spots along the circuit, though Domo Frances is available as an alternative if needed.

days.title: Torres del Paine National Park - Francés Valley to Paine Grande
included: Trekking to Francés Valley and Británico Lookout
days.description: You're in for a long day starting at 8am with a 25.3 km trek covering Francés Valley and Paine Grande in 11 to 12 hours. Begin with a light 2-hour walk to Camp Italiano overlooking Lake Nordenskjöld. After that, leave your backpack and continue with a day pack up Francés Valley to the glacier lookout, which takes about 1.5 hours. Then climb to Británico Lookout for views of Paine Grande, Catedral, and other peaks. Head back to Camp Italiano and then continue on to Paine Grande Lodge for the night.

days.title: Torres del Paine National Park to Puerto Natales - Grey Glacier Trek
days.description: Starting at 9am, you'll trek 22 km over 8 to 9 hours to Grey Glacier Lookout on a moderately difficult route. The first viewpoint comes after about 1.5 hours, then you'll continue along the west bank of Lake Grey for another 1.5 to 2 hours to reach the main lookout with great glacier views. You'll return the same way to Pehoé and board a ferry at 6:30pm across Lake Pehoé, arriving in Puerto Natales around 10pm. From there, make your own way from the bus station back to your accommodation.

days.title: Puerto Natales
days.description: Have breakfast and check out from your accommodation. The tour services come to an end here.

name: Big Five Classic Safari in Tanzania **Sustainable Approach to Travel

attributes.name: Safari
attributes.tip: Track iconic wildlife on unforgettable game drives

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Book now your Big Five Luxury Safari with World Adventure Tours, and take a sustainable approach to your travels. We are a certified **Travelife Partner**. This safari features all of the popular Northern Circuit game parks.  Departures are every day.  The Big 5 Luxury Safari includes travel in custom-designed 4×4 safari vehicles with open roofs for game viewing.  This is a small group seat-in-vehicle safari with a maximum of 6 travelers per vehicle, all with window seats. Traveling for 7 days, the safari includes meals, accommodation, park entry fees, and a visit to Lake Manyara, Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater & Tarangire. The parks in this area are known for their stunning scenery, which includes vast grassy plains, towering mountains, sparkling lakes, and deep canyons. In addition to the natural wonders of the area, you can also experience the rich cultural heritage of the local people, including the Maasai and other tribes who have lived in the area for centuries. Many of the parks in the area are focused on conservation efforts to protect the wildlife and natural habitats of the region, so visiting these parks can also support important conservation initiatives.

days.title: Kilimanjaro Airport to Moshi
days.start_point: Moshi, Kilimanjaro, Tanzania (Kilimanjaro International Airport)
days.description: You'll land at Kilimanjaro Airport and work through customs. Your driver meets you with a name sign and takes you to Moshi for the night. It's a straightforward arrival day, so you can settle in and rest up before things get going.

days.title: Lake Manyara National Park
included: Game drive in Lake Manyara National Park
optional: Maasai Boma visit (at an additional fee)
days.description: Drive to Tarangire National Park in the morning. The Tarangire River runs through the park and serves as the only permanent water source during dry season, so animals congregate here. You'll see varied terrain with grassy plains, swamps, and striking baobab trees.

days.title: Lake Manyara to Serengeti National Park
included: Game drive en route to Serengeti
optional: Olduvai Gorge museum visit (at an additional fee)
days.description: After breakfast you'll drive toward Serengeti National Park. On the way, you can stop at Olduvai Gorge if you want to see where key discoveries about human evolution were made. Then continue on with a game drive to your camp in the Serengeti.

days.title: Serengeti National Park
included: Full day game drives in Serengeti National Park
days.description: This day is all about exploring the Serengeti on game drives. You'll travel through open grasslands, acacia savanna, and wooded areas. If the timing's right, you might see the Great Wildebeest Migration with massive herds of wildebeest and zebra. Lions and cheetahs are also out there hunting.

days.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
included: Morning game drive to Ngorongoro Crater
Game drive and exploration in Ngorongoro Crater
days.description: Start with a morning game drive, then head to Ngorongoro Crater. You'll descend 600 meters into the crater where about 20,000 large animals live, including lions, cheetahs, zebras, and some of Tanzania's remaining black rhinos. Stop at Makat Soda Lake to see flamingos and other birds before driving to your lodge.

days.title: Ngorongoro to Tarangire National Park
included: Game drive in Tarangire National Park
days.description: Head out early to Lake Manyara National Park for a game drive. You'll spot buffalo, impala, giraffes, hippos, and elephants moving through the park's different habitats, plus various monkey species. If you're interested, there's an option to visit a Maasai Boma and learn about local life before returning to your lodge.

days.title: Tarangire to Kilimanjaro Airport
days.description: Take a relaxed morning at your lodge. Later you'll transfer to Kilimanjaro Airport for your flight home, ending your Tanzania safari experience.

operator: Dimensione Sicilia - Dimsi Incoming Operator Srl

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: 8 days to enjoy the beauties of Sicily. You will travel with all the comforts: 4* hotel in half board basis, bus deluxe and a guide for the whole tour. You will taste the specialties of the island, visit the UNESCO World Heritage Sites and much more! A trip you cannot miss!

days.title: Catania
optional: Private transfer from Catania Airport to hotel (EUR 70 one way for max 2 people)
days.start_point: Catania, Italy (Your Hotel in Catania, 15:00 - 19:00)
days.description: You'll arrive at your hotel in Catania and have the rest of the day to settle in. Dinner is on your own, so it's a good chance to explore the neighborhood near your hotel or just relax after your journey.

days.title: Syracuse - Noto
included: Visit Archaeological Park of Neapolis in Syracuse
Walk through Latomie of Paradise quarries in Syracuse
Visit Ear of Dionysius in Syracuse
Visit Arethusa's Fountain in Ortigia, Syracuse
Explore baroque streets and architecture in Noto
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Dinner (Dinner in hotel)
days.description: After breakfast at the hotel, you're heading to Syracuse to walk through the Archaeological Park of Neapolis, where you'll see the Greek Theatre, Roman Amphitheater, and the Ear of Dionysius. Then you'll cross over to the island of Ortigia to check out the Cathedral and Arethusa's Fountain. Lunch is free here, so grab something you like. Later in the afternoon, it's a drive to Noto to see its elegant 18th-century baroque buildings before you head to Ragusa for dinner and the night.

days.title: Ragusa Ibla - Modica - Piazza Armerina
included: Explore Ragusa Ibla with its baroque churches and palaces
Visit Giardino Iblea in Ragusa Ibla
Visit Sabadì chocolate shop in Modica with tasting
Visit Villa Romana del Casale in Piazza Armerina
Explore Roman mosaics at Villa Romana del Casale
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Lunch (Lunch in a local restaurant), Dinner (Dinner in hotel)
days.description: Starting with breakfast, you'll explore Ragusa Ibla and walk past its baroque churches and elegant palaces, the same ones from the TV series Il Commissario Montalbano. You'll stop in Modica at the Sabadì chocolate shop to try some well-known artisan chocolate. After lunch at a local restaurant, you're driving to Piazza Armerina to see the Villa Romana del Casale and its extraordinary Roman mosaics. Then it's on to Agrigento for dinner and overnight.

days.title: Agrigento - Marsala - Salt Road
included: Visit Valley of the Temples in Agrigento
Explore Temple of Juno in Agrigento
Explore Temple of Concord in Agrigento
Explore Temple of Hercules in Agrigento
Walk through historic centre of Marsala
Visit Florio wine cellar in Marsala with wine tasting and light lunch
Visit Salt Road and Stagnone islands
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Lunch (Light lunch at Florio wine cellar with wines produced by the company)
days.description: You'll spend the morning at the Valley of the Temples, exploring the ancient Greek site of Akragas with its famous temples dedicated to Juno, Concord, and Hercules. From there, you're heading to Marsala to walk through its historic centre and visit the Florio wine cellar for tasting and light lunch. After that, you'll drive along the Salt Road to see the Stagnone islands and the old salt pans. The evening brings you to Palermo, where dinner is on your own.

days.title: Monreale - Palermo
included: View fountain in Pretoria Square in Palermo
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Lunch (Lunch break with local products)
days.description: After breakfast at the hotel, you're heading to Monreale to see the Arab-Norman Cathedral with its Byzantine mosaics and the medieval cloister. Then you'll travel to Palermo and see the Cathedral, a mix of Gothic, Baroque, and Norman styles, plus the Martorana Church and Cappella Palatina with their golden mosaics. Lunch features local products, and afterward you'll walk through the historic centre to see Teatro Massimo and the Renaissance fountain in Pretoria Square. Dinner and the night are at your hotel.

days.title: Cefalù - Catania
included: Visit Cathedral of Sant'Agata in Catania
View Elephant of lava stone in Catania
Walk Via dei Crociferi in Catania
Visit Monastery of San Benedetto in Catania
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Lunch (Lunch in a local restaurant to taste delights of Sicilian cuisine)
days.description: You're starting the day in the seaside village of Cefalù, where you can walk the cobbled streets or visit the Mandralisca Museum with its art and archaeology collection. There's a local lunch with Sicilian specialities. Later you're traveling to Catania to explore its historic centre with distinctive late-baroque lava stone architecture. You'll see the Cathedral of Sant'Agata and the famous Elephant symbol in Duomo Square, then walk along Via dei Crociferi and check out the Baroque Monastery of San Benedetto. Dinner is on your own at the hotel.

days.title: Etna - Taormina
included: Visit Crateri Silvestri on Mount Etna
Taste artisanal honey and local products at beekeeping company
days.meals: Breakfast (International breakfast in hotel), Lunch (Lunch in a restaurant in old town, tasting local specialities)
days.description: After breakfast, you're visiting Catania's historic fish market to see how locals shop. Then comes an excursion to Mount Etna, Europe's highest active volcano, where you'll visit the Rifugio Sapienza and explore the Crateri Silvestri, two ancient inactive craters. You'll also taste artisanal honey and local products. Later you're heading to Taormina for lunch with local specialities, then visiting the Greco-Roman Theatre with views of the sea and Mount Etna. You'll have free time to walk around Taormina's streets and shops before returning to Catania for dinner on your own.

name: NEW ZEALAND – 10 Days Highlights of North and South Islands

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro:
Marvel at the unrivaled views of the snow-capped mountains on the New Zealand Tour and indulge in the brilliance of the beautiful bioluminescence of glowworms at the Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Go bungee jumping at Queenstown and encounter the magnificent whales and dolphins at the waters of Kaikoura. Set out on the Hobbiton Movie Tour and go kayaking at the Bay OF Islands.

Highlights

Visited Places:

• Auckland

• Rotorua

• Christchurch

• Queenstown

• Franz Josef

Travel Experience:

• Pacific Ocean and the Tasman Sea

• Hobbiton Movie Set

• Waitomo Glowworm Caves

• Maori culture

• Rotorua sightseeing tour

• Southern Alps

• Adventure capital – Queenstown

• Milford Sound Nature Cruise

• Adventure capital – Queenstown

• Walking / Hiking

• Franz Josef Glacier

• TranzAlpine scenic train 


NOTE: The itinerary order may change as the day activities are subject to the availability and may be swapped.

days.title: Auckland
days.start_point: Auckland, Auckland, New Zealand (Auckland airport)
days.description: You'll get picked up at Auckland Airport and head to your hotel. After settling in, the rest of the day is yours to explore. Auckland's got plenty going on with its beaches, museums, and galleries scattered around the city, so you can wander at your own pace and get a feel for what makes it such a popular spot.

days.title: Auckland to Rotorua
days.description: Your guide drives out of Auckland toward Rotorua, showing you city highlights along the way. You'll pass through the Waikato Region and stop in Tirau before reaching Te Puia and Rotorua. There's a Maori cultural performance on the schedule, followed by a traditional Hangi buffet lunch, plus a visit to Mitai Maori Village and guided sightseeing around the area.

days.title: Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves
landmarks: Waitomo Big Bird & Miniature Animal Petting Farm
days.description: Head from Auckland through the Waikato Region to see two major attractions in one day. You'll check out Hobbiton, the fictional village from the films, then move on to Waitomo. Stop at the Big Bird and Miniature Animal Petting Farm, then take a guided tour through the Glowworm Caves. Bring comfortable walking shoes and a warm jacket for the cave section since it gets cool down there.

days.title: Auckland to Queenstown
optional: Queenstown Skyline Gondola Ride - $40 per person
days.description: You'll catch an early flight from Auckland down to Queenstown on the South Island. Someone from your hotel will pick you up at the airport and drive you there, so no need to worry about transport. After you've settled in and freshened up, the afternoon and evening are completely open. The town sits right on Lake Wakatipu with the Remarkables Mountain Range creating a nice backdrop, so there's plenty to walk around and get a feel for this place. It's known as the adventure capital for good reason, and you might want to grab dinner somewhere along the waterfront or just explore the main streets to see what catches your interest.

days.title: Queenstown - Mt Cook & Tasman Glacier
included: Free time to explore Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park
days.description: You'll join a small-group guided tour heading through the South Island's dramatic landscapes toward Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park. The drive takes you through the Kawarau Gorge and over the Lindis Pass with its high-altitude terrain and changing scenery. Along the way you'll stop at Lake Pukaki, which sits at the base of the mountains and gives you a real sense of the scale of what's around you. There's also a stop at High Country Salmon if you want to grab something to eat or just see what they do there. Once you reach Mount Cook, you'll have free time to explore on your own and walk out to the Tasman Glacier lookout, where you can see New Zealand's largest glacier spread out below you and get views across the surrounding peaks.

days.title: Milford Sound Nature Cruise
included: Milford Sound Nature Cruise with return luxury coach transfers
days.description: Travel by luxury coach from Queenstown to Milford Sound with a morning tea break in Te Anau. The coach winds along the Milford Road with photo stops and short walks. Once there, board a modern vessel for a 1 hour 40 minute cruise through the fiord to see waterfalls, rainforests, Mitre Peak, and Pembroke Glacier. Pack comfortable shoes, a waterproof jacket, warm layers, and insect repellent.

days.title: Queenstown to Franz Josef
included: Sightseeing on the way to Franz Josef
days.description: Travel by luxury coach from Queenstown to Franz Josef, passing Lake Dunstan, Lake Wanaka, and Lake Hawea. After morning tea in Makarora, you'll cross through Mount Aspiring World Heritage Park and the Haast Pass, moving through native beech forest and the Southern Alps. Stop at a boutique salmon farm on the Paringa River for afternoon tea before arriving in Franz Josef, where the famous glacier is waiting to explore.

days.title: Franz Josef Free Day
optional: Scenic cruise and rainforest walk – $95 / person
days.description: You have the day to yourself in the Franz Josef area. If you want to do something, there are optional activities like a scenic cruise on Lake Mapourika with a rainforest walk and kiwi sanctuary visit, or a kayak adventure across the lake to a private rainforest trail through the Okarito Kiwi Sanctuary. Otherwise, just relax and take in the surroundings at your own speed.

days.title: Franz Josef to Christchurch via TranzAlpine Train
days.description: Head to Greymouth train station to board the TranzAlpine scenic train. This 4.5 hour journey winds through the Southern Alps from Greymouth through Arthur's Pass to Christchurch, passing rugged peaks and vast beech forests. You'll get personal headsets with GPS-triggered commentary about the communities and places along the route, plus access to regular seating and open air viewing decks. The train arrives in Christchurch at 18:30 and you're transferred to your hotel.

days.title: Christchurch Departure
days.description: Have breakfast at the hotel this morning. Checkout is usually by 11am, so book your return flight around that time. Take a moment to think back on everything you've seen and done during the tour before you head out.
