name: Philippines Island Hopper

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro: This is the Philippines Island Hopper, AKA the best 17 days of your life! Is that dramatic? Nope! We've put together everything you could ever wish for in these epic 17 days. Walk high canopies for 10/10 views, Canyoneer in turquoise waterfalls at Kawasan Falls, snorkel shipwrecks in the deep blue in Coron, swim with turtles and experience the phenomenon of the sardine run in Moalboal, do it all! If you're looking for the ultimate barefoot beach babe vibe, we've got you. Fall asleep under the stars at our TruExclusive castaway experience, island-hop on traditional Banca boats or parasurf on the party hotspot Island of Boracay! From island hopping to paddle boarding, jaw dropping magenta sunsets to golden amber sunrises. The Philippines is calling you. The only question is…When shall we expect you there?

days.title: Manila
days.description: You'll land in Manila and check into your accommodation, then take some time to settle in. Later in the evening, the group meets up for dinner before heading out to check out the nightlife scene in Makati, which has plenty of bars and a real energy to it.

days.title: Manila to Puerto Princesa - Port Barton
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch with a local family, trying delicious Filipino grub)
days.description: After flying to Puerto Princesa, a private minivan takes you to Port Barton, a small fishing town that hasn't been overdeveloped. You'll have lunch with a local family and try authentic Filipino dishes. By evening, you're checking into your beachfront hotel, watching the sunset, then heading out for dinner and drinks.

days.title: Port Barton
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch in a small fishing village)
days.description: You'll board a longtail boat for island hopping around Port Barton. The day includes colorful reefs, chances to spot turtles, and visits to sandy beaches. Lunch happens in a fishing village, then you have free time to relax however you like before heading back to freshen up and explore the local bar and restaurant scene.

days.title: Port Barton to El Nido
days.description: Travel to El Nido and spend the morning walking around town doing some shopping. Once settled into your accommodation and freshened up, you'll have dinner with the group. Later, you'll head out to catch the sunset, which is known as one of the best around.

days.title: El Nido
days.description: You'll head out on traditional Banca boats for island hopping. The day involves paddling through clear blue lagoons, kayaking, and snorkeling in the Philippine Sea. A local-style lunch is served, and afterward you have time to relax on the beach before returning around sunset. Dinner with the group happens after you've had time to chill at the hotel.

days.title: El Nido
days.description: Start early with a zipline experience that takes you from beach to beach with great views. After the morning's adrenaline rush, head to Nacpan Beach, one of the Philippines' nicest beaches with palm trees lining the shore. Spend the rest of the day on the beach hanging out with the group.

days.title: El Nido to Coron - Daracotan Island
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Traditional local Filipino delicacies prepared during cooking demonstration)
days.description: Travel to Daracotan Island to start your castaway experience. You'll check out shipwrecks and take a guided tour of this small island with 88 residents. Meet a local family, learn about how tourism affects their community, and join in a traditional cooking demonstration. By evening, enjoy what you've prepared and wind down around a bonfire with beers.

days.title: Daracotan Island to Coron
days.description: Spend a relaxed morning on the island snorkeling or sunbathing before catching the ferry to Coron. The afternoon gives you time to relax or walk through local shops. Later, get ready to experience Coron's vibrant nightlife.

days.title: Coron
days.description: After your night out, you'll head out on a boat trip around Coron sailing through turquoise lagoons and visiting some of the world's best beaches. Spend time on the sand however you like, whether that's relaxing, taking photos, or just hanging out. Head back to Coron to freshen up before dinner.

days.title: Coron to Cebu City
days.description: Fly to Cebu and relax at the hotel to recover from the past few days. Connect to wifi and upload your photos from Palawan. In the evening, head out for drinks with the group.

days.title: Cebu City to Moalboal
included: Simala Church visit and walking tour
days.description: Head to Moalboal and visit Simala Church, a spectacular building that's a popular photography spot. After a walking tour and history lesson, the afternoon is yours to explore at your own pace. Grab an iced coffee, try a traditional Filipino massage, or wander around town with local recommendations.

days.title: Moalboal
included: Boat trip and Sardine Run viewing
days.description: Set out to sea for snorkeling at some of the Philippines' best spots. You'll see colorful corals and marine life, swim near fish, and encounter turtles in their natural habitat. In the afternoon, watch the Sardine Run as hundreds of thousands of fish school together. By evening, explore the local nightlife and have fun.

days.title: Moalboal to Boracay Island
days.description: Head out early for canyoneering at Kawasan Waterfalls, with options for adrenaline activities or more relaxed exploration. Float downstream, hop between rocks, and take in the natural beauty. Have a late lunch after, then travel to Boracay Island, known for white sand beaches, clear waters, beach clubs, and marine life.

days.title: Boracay Island
days.description: Arrive on Boracay in the late afternoon and check into your hotel for the final 3 nights. After settling in, explore the island and catch the sunset with golden oranges fading into purples. Have beers on the beach or join a sunset cruise for cocktails before hitting one of Boracay's top cocktail bars.

days.title: Boracay Island
days.description: Sleep in and grab a fruit smoothie whenever you wake up. Spend the morning and early afternoon at the beach soaking up sun or shopping for souvenirs. In late afternoon, try Paraw sailing on traditional outrigger boats that take you around the island. Watch another great sunset before heading out for dinner and beers with the group.

days.title: Boracay Island
days.description: Celebrate your last full day together on a boat party. Dance, swim in tropical waters, or relax on a floatie while taking in the scenery. In the evening, head out for a farewell dinner with sunset cocktails. Make the most of your final night, whether that's dancing, ordering extra desserts, or just enjoying time with everyone.

days.title: Boracay Island
days.description: It's time to say goodbye. The group gathers one last time, and staff are available to help with any onward travel arrangements. Share hugs, exchange contact info, and head off with memories from your 17 days in the Philippines.

qa.question: How difficult are the flights? Is it a standard airport with security or is it all handled by the tour? It seems like wasted time to be arriving early and waiting through security when on vacation Flights / Transfers
qa.answer: The internal flights on the tour are very straightforward and your Group Leader will help guide everyone through the process. They are standard domestic airports with normal security procedures, similar to any regular flight, but your guide will let you know what time to leave, help coordinate check-in, and make sure the group gets where they need to be. The airports used are generally quite small and easy to navigate, so it's usually a much smoother experience than large international airports. We do still recommend arriving with enough time for check-in and security, but the travel days are planned to keep things as stress-free as possible so you can enjoy the trip rather than worry about logistics!

qa.question: We are both healthy active travelers. Why is there an age restriction?
qa.answer: Our trips have an age guideline (typically 18–40), and for this particular tour it's something we stick to quite firmly. The Island Hopper is a very social, fast-paced experience with a big focus on group dynamics, so keeping everyone within a similar age range helps make sure the vibe is right for the whole group. intro: Enjoy five days tour visiting the best of Southern Spain (Andalucía Region) Including Cordoba, Seville, and Granada.

days.title: Madrid to Córdoba to Sevilla
included: Guided city sightseeing tour in Córdoba
Visit to the Mosque of Córdoba (entrance included)
Visit to the Jewish Quarter in Córdoba
days.start_point: Calle De Ferraz 3, 28008 Madrid, Madrid, Spain (VPT TOURS & ACTIVITIES, 07:30)
days.description: You'll leave Madrid early in the morning and head south through La Mancha toward Andalucía. The drive takes you through some classic Spanish countryside before arriving in Córdoba, where a guided tour focuses on the Mosque with its Gothic Cathedral interior and the Jewish Quarter. After that, it's on to Sevilla for dinner and your overnight stay.

days.title: Sevilla
included: Guided city sightseeing tour of Sevilla
Exterior viewing of Cathedral and Giralda bell tower
optional: Guadalquivir river boat ride with panoramic views of Gold Tower and Expo 92
days.description: Start with a guided tour of Sevilla covering María Luisa Park, Plaza de España, the Cathedral exterior, and the Giralda bell tower, plus the historic Santa Cruz neighborhood. The afternoon is free for your own exploration, though optional activities are available like a Guadalquivir river boat ride with views of the Gold Tower and Expo 92, or visiting the Maestranza bullring. An optional flamenco show is offered in the evening if you're interested.

days.title: Sevilla to Ronda to Costa del Sol
included: Visit to Ronda with free time
days.description: After breakfast, head toward the Route of the White Villages and Ronda with free time to walk around and see the area. From there, you'll continue on to Costa del Sol, arriving in time for dinner and an overnight stay.

days.title: Costa del Sol to Granada
days.description: You'll have breakfast before departing for Granada. The guided sightseeing tour covers the Alhambra and Generalife Gardens, both of which are significant historical sites. Dinner and your overnight stay are included. If you'd like, optional activities include visiting the Sacromonte caves and attending a gipsy flamenco show.

days.title: Granada to Toledo to Madrid
included: Panoramic view from Mirador del Valle
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll head out to Toledo, the historic Imperial City. Lunch is included, and you'll visit Mirador del Valle for views of the surrounding area, then walk through the old town. After that, it's the drive back to Madrid where the tour ends.

reviews.reply:
Thank you very much for taking the time to provide us with such a detailed account of your experience. We sincerely appreciate both your positive comments and the constructive criticism, as they allow us to review the different aspects of the tour and identify areas where we can improve.
We are pleased to know that you enjoyed many of the destinations visited, the local guides, the transportation and accommodation included in the programme, as well as the flamenco show in Seville. In particular, we are very happy to hear that you found the local guides knowledgeable and professional and that their explanations contributed positively to your experience.
Regarding the accompanying guide, we have reviewed your comments with her. She acknowledges that English is not her native language and that, although she has been studying and using English for many years and considers herself able to communicate effectively with international groups, she may have made mistakes or used expressions that were not sufficiently clear on some occasions. We understand your concern, particularly as you specifically requested an English-language tour, and we regret that you felt that the level of communication was not what you expected.
The accompanying guide's role is primarily to coordinate the group throughout the journey, assist with logistics, coordinate the visits with the local guides and provide general information and orientation at each destination. The detailed historical and cultural explanations of the cities and monuments are provided by the official local guides, who are specifically assigned for this purpose. Nevertheless, we understand that the accompanying guide also plays an important role in the overall experience, and we will take your comments into consideration when assigning guides to future bilingual or English-speaking departures.
With regard to the late arrival at the initial meeting point, the guide has confirmed that she arrived at approximately 8:00 a.m. rather than the scheduled 7:30 a.m. This was partly due to an internal communication error concerning the meeting arrangements, although she also acknowledges that she should have checked the recipient and details of the message more carefully. We sincerely regret this inconvenience and have noted the incident internally so that greater care is taken with this type of operational communication.
Regarding the use of Spanish during the tour, the guide has explained that whenever information was provided to Spanish-speaking passengers, she subsequently translated the relevant information into English. However, we understand your perception that the Spanish-speaking passengers may at times have received more direct attention, and we regret that this made you feel less attended to as an English-speaking passenger.
We would also like to clarify the comments regarding the information provided during the journey. The accompanying guide is not intended to replace the specialist local guides in each destination. Her role is to provide general orientation and information while coordinating the tour, whereas the included guided visits are specifically designed to provide the more detailed historical and cultural content. Nevertheless, we acknowledge your comments regarding the level of information you expected from the accompanying guide.
Regarding the Alhambra, we have carefully noted your comments, particularly concerning the Nasrid Palaces. The programme included the Alhambra visit as specified in the itinerary, but the Nasrid Palaces were not included in the visit contracted for this departure. We understand, however, that this distinction was not sufficiently clear to you before or during the tour, and we regret the disappointment this caused. We also regret that the explanation you received from the guide did not resolve your concern satisfactorily.
Your comments regarding the itinerary and the lack of detailed information about approximate timings and free time are also very valuable. We understand that, particularly in destinations such as Seville, having clearer information in advance would have allowed you to organise your personal time and optional visits more effectively. We will review how we communicate these operational details to passengers so that expectations are clearer before and during the tour.
We have also taken note of your comments regarding the hotel in Torremolinos, the meals, the situation in Toledo and the arrangements for returning to the hotel after the Seville visit. These comments will be shared with our Operations Department and the corresponding suppliers so that the different aspects can be reviewed.
We are particularly sorry to hear that the combination of these circumstances affected your overall impression of your first trip to Spain. Our intention is that passengers travelling with VPT can enjoy the convenience of a guided circuit while also having the opportunity to discover the destinations with the support of professional local guides and our tour coordination team.
At the same time, we appreciate your recognition of the positive aspects of the programme and, especially, your comments regarding the local guides and the destinations themselves.
Please accept our sincere apologies for the aspects of the experience that did not meet your expectations. Your feedback has been carefully noted and will be taken into consideration by our Operations Department when reviewing both the organisation of future departures and the communication of programme details to our passengers.
Thank you again for sharing your experience with us.
Kind regards,
Laura Goyoaga
VPT – Reservations Department

intro:
Book & Travel with Confidence – #1 Inca Trail Operator in Peru!

Experience the Classic Inca Trail – A Journey Through History

The Inca Trail is one of the most sacred and important paths from the Inca Empire, offering an unforgettable multi-day hike to Machu Picchu. This historic trek takes you through stunning archaeological sites and breathtaking natural scenery, blending cultural heritage with spectacular landscapes. As the only trail that connects directly to Machu Picchu, the Inca Trail gives you a unique opportunity to enter through the Intipunku (Sun Gate) and enjoy a comprehensive guided tour on the 4th day.

­ 

Why Choose Alpaca Expeditions for Your Inca Trail Adventure?

  • Personal Porter Service – Included at no extra charge.
  • Top-Quality Equipment – We provide the best gear for your trek.
  • Professional Guides & Staff – Led by experienced guides to ensure a safe, informative, and memorable journey.
  • Satellite Communication – Stay in touch during the trek with satellite phones.
  • Small Group Experience – Guaranteed for a more personalized adventure.
  • Exclusive Inca Trail Experience – Hike the iconic path to Machu Picchu with a full-guided tour.
  • Private Portable Toilets – Available only for our groups.
  • Customizable Meals – We accommodate all dietary restrictions.

Important Update for 2026: Inca Trail Permits Now Available

­ 

The Peruvian government has already released the 2026 Inca Trail permits, and spots are filling up fast. We offer daily departures, so you can choose the date that works best for you. Book now to secure your place and avoid missing out on this once-in-a-lifetime adventure!

days.title: Ayapata
included: Pick-up from hotel in Cusco, Urubamba, or Ollantaytambo
Hike to first campsite at Ayapata
Option to purchase energy drinks and snacks at small communities
optional: Purchase energy drinks, snacks, or forgotten items at small communities along the route
days.meals: Breakfast (Delicious breakfast prepared by your cook at Porter House), Lunch, Dinner
days.start_point: Cusco, Cusco, Peru (We pick you up from your hotel, 04:15)
days.description: Your team picks you up early from your hotel in Cusco, Urubamba, or Ollantaytambo and heads to the Porter House in Ollantaytambo for breakfast. You'll meet your porters and guides there, then drive to Km 82 where the trek begins. From there, hike for 2 hours to Patallacta, an old Inca checkpoint, followed by another 2 hours to lunch. After eating, trek 2.5 more hours to reach your first campsite at Ayapata by 5 PM. Settle in with hot drinks and snacks alongside your team, then sit down for dinner at 7:30 PM.

days.title: Ayapata to Chaquicocha
included: Hike to Dead Woman's Pass (4,215 meters)
Hike to Runcu Raccay (small Inca site)
Visit to Sayacmarca (impressive Inca village site)
Sunset viewing over Vilcabamba mountain range
Optional stargazing and Inca constellation tour
days.meals: Breakfast (Hot cup of coca tea to prepare for the day), Lunch, Dinner
days.description: Start early with coca tea to prepare for the longest day ahead. Hike about 4 hours to reach Dead Woman's Pass at 4,215 meters, the highest point on the trail. After stopping for views, descend 1.5 hours into Pacaymayu Valley for lunch and water refills. Then trek 2 hours over the second pass, visiting Runcu Raccay where you'll see two large waterfalls at this small Inca site. Continue for another hour to Sayacmarca, an impressive Inca village, and rest as the sun sets over the Vilcabamba mountains. Hike 20 minutes more to reach your second campsite at Chaquicocha. After dinner, there's optional stargazing where your guide can point out Inca constellations.

days.title: Chaquicocha to Wiñay Wayna
included: Hike through Cloud Forest and Inca flat sections
Views of Salkantay mountain and Vilcabamba mountain range
Ascent to Phuyupatamarka (Town in the Clouds)
First glimpse of Machu Picchu Mountain
Visit to Intipata (Terraces of the Sun)
Guided tour of Wiñay Wayna Inca ruins (1.5 hours)
Guide orientation and recap of trek information
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Final feast alongside porters and chefs)
days.description: You'll wake at 6:30 AM after yesterday's difficult hiking. Start with 2 hours on 'Inca flat' with gradual inclines as you enter the Cloud Forest and get views of Salkantay mountain, the second highest snow-capped peak in the Sacred Valley. The panoramic views of the Vilcabamba range continue as you ascend to Phuyupatamarka at 3,600 meters, where you'll see the Urubamba River below and your first glimpse of Machu Picchu Mountain. Descend a 3-hour flight of stone steps to your final campsite near Wiñay Wayna, stopping at Phuyupatamarka and Intipata ruins along the way. Reach camp around 1 PM for lunch and some rest. At 4:30 PM, your guide gives an orientation before you visit Wiñay Wayna ruins for 1.5 hours. Enjoy a final feast dinner with your porters and chefs, then get to bed early for sunrise at Machu Picchu tomorrow.

days.title: Wiñay Wayna to Sun Gate to Machu Picchu to Aguas Calientes to Ollantaytambo to Cusco
included: Early wake-up and breakfast at 4:00 AM
Views of mountains and Machu Picchu from Sun Gate
Trek down from Sun Gate to Machu Picchu
Private guided tour of Machu Picchu (2 hours)
Free time to explore Machu Picchu independently
Expedition class train from Aguas Calientes to Ollantaytambo
Return transfer from Ollantaytambo train station to hotel in Cusco
optional: Climb Huayna Picchu mountain (must be arranged minimum one month in advance) - $75 per person
Lunch at local restaurant in Aguas Calientes with guide (not included)
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at 4:00 AM before trek to Sun Gate)
days.description: Wake at 3:30 AM and eat breakfast at 4 AM. Wait at the checkpoint to be among the first trekkers when gates open at 5:30 AM. After saying goodbye to your porters and chefs, trek to the Sun Gate aiming to arrive by 6:30 AM for incredible views and your first look at Machu Picchu in daylight. Hike down for about 1 hour to reach Machu Picchu by 7:40 AM. Enjoy a 2-hour private guided tour of the Lost City, then receive your bus tickets to Aguas Calientes. You'll have plenty of free time to explore on your own or climb nearby mountains if pre-arranged. Optional lunch with your guide at a local restaurant costs extra. Collect your train tickets and board the Expedition class train back to Ollantaytambo (about 2 hours). Your driver meets you at the station for the drive back to your hotel in Cusco, arriving around 8 PM.

Any other circuit or tour could still be managed, but in the case of the Inca Trail, no exceptions or reintegration with permits from another agency are possible.

qa.question: My husband, Peter, will have turned 80 yrs of age by the time we come to Peru, and I will be 68 years of age. We note that you say for people up to 65. qa.answer: There is no problem with joining the trek. We will only ask for a medical certificate as a precaution, to consider any potential issues during the hike. intro: Fall for a small country with a big heart! Charming villages, picturesque vineyards and impressive architectural wonders await you on this wonderful 8-day tour to Portugal.

days.title: Lisbon
optional: Explore Lisbon's historic neighborhoods and vibrant culture
days.description: Your flight lands at Lisbon airport where local representatives meet you and drive to your hotel. The rest of the day is open for exploring the capital at your own pace. Take time to settle in and get your bearings in this riverside city.

days.title: Lisbon
included: Half-day guided tour of Lisbon including Edward VII observation deck
days.description: After breakfast, a half-day guided tour takes you to the Edward VII observation deck for city views, then through downtown Lisbon's Rossio and Praça do Comércio. Next you'll head to Belem to see the Tower of Belém, Monument of the Discoveries, and Jerónimos Monastery. Try the famous Pastéis de Belém while there. Your afternoon and evening are free, so consider walking through Alfama's narrow alleys with its colorful streetcars and old staircases.

days.title: Lisbon - Sintra - Cascais - Lisbon
included: Visit Cabo da Roca (westernmost point of European continent)
days.description: After breakfast, drive through old estates and villages to Cabo da Roca, Europe's westernmost point. Continue to Sintra to tour Pena Palace with its mix of Gothic and Manueline styles. Later, grab lunch on your own, then visit the Devil's Mouth cave and Guincho Beach. End by strolling through Cascais fishing town and passing through Estoril before heading back to Lisbon.

days.title: Lisbon - Tomar - Fatima - Batalha - Porto
included: Visit Convent of Christ in Tomar
days.description: After breakfast, drive to Tomar and see the Convent of Christ, showcasing elaborate Manueline architecture from Portugal's golden age. Next you'll reach Fatima, the pilgrimage site tied to the 1917 apparition that now draws millions of visitors yearly. Following lunch on your own, tour the Monastery of Batalha with its Gothic architecture before transferring to Porto for the night.

days.title: Porto
included: View São Bento Train Station tilework
Cross Luis I Bridge on foot
Porto wine tasting in historic wine cellars
days.description: After breakfast, a half-day guided tour starts at Bolhão Market, then moves to the Chapel of the Souls. Walk down Santa Catarina Street past the Majestic Café and see the tilework at São Bento Train Station. Head through Flores Street to the Stock Exchange Palace, stop by the Henry the Navigator statue, then explore Ribeira and cross the Luis I Bridge on foot. Wind down with port wine tasting in historic cellars. Your afternoon and evening are free to check out more of the city.

days.title: Porto - Douro Valley - Porto
included: One-hour traditional rabelo boat tour on Douro River
Winery visit with lunch and wine tasting with entertainment
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch at winery with wine tasting and entertainment)
days.description: Depart Porto and travel through the Douro region where olives, almonds, and grapes grow in the microclimate. Take a one-hour traditional rabelo boat tour on the Douro River, then visit a winery for lunch and wine tasting with live entertainment. Return to Porto in the evening.

days.title: Porto - Aveiro - Nazare - Óbidos - Lisbon
included: Explore Aveiro canals and city center
optional: Explore Óbidos medieval town and handicraft shops
days.description: After breakfast, head to Aveiro and Costa Nova to see the colorful striped fishermen's houses. Walk through Aveiro's canals and check out the iconic boats. Then continue to Nazare, a beach town with fresh seafood and cliffs, and grab lunch on your own. Head to Óbidos next, a medieval town where you'll wander cobblestone streets, browse handicraft shops, and see whitewashed houses with flowers. Return to Lisbon for the evening.

days.title: Lisbon
days.description: After breakfast, meet your local representative in the hotel lobby and head to Lisbon airport for your departure.

intro: Experience the vibrant energy of Rio de Janeiro's world-famous Carnival with an unforgettable guided tour by Bamba. Immerse yourself in iconic parades, dazzling samba shows, and authentic street parties. Uncover hidden gems with expert local guides, enjoy stunning city views from Sugarloaf Mountain, and relax on the beautiful Copacabana beach. Perfect for culture enthusiasts, this adventure promises an exhilarating blend of music, dance, and breathtaking sights in one of Brazil’s most captivating cities. Join the ultimate Carnival celebration now!

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
included: Samba Dance Class with Local Professional
Carnival Face Painting by Professional Makeup Artist
Guided Night Out in Lapa's Bloco Parties & Street Celebrations
optional: Arrive a day early for extra exploring and rest before festivities
days.description: You'll arrive in Lapa and meet your group at 6:00 PM for a briefing and welcome caipirinha. After that comes a samba dance class where a professional artist will paint your face. Then your guide takes you through Lapa's best bloco parties and street celebrations to experience Rio's legendary nightlife firsthand.

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
included: Scenic City Tour through Tijuca National Park to Corcovado Mountain
Visit to Christ the Redeemer Statue
Santa Teresa Neighborhood Exploration (Historic Mansions, Art Galleries, Vintage Trams)
days.description: Breakfast and a morning briefing get things started, then you head to Corcovado Mountain through Tijuca National Park to see the Christ the Redeemer statue. From there you'll walk through Santa Teresa's historic mansions and vintage trams, stop at the Selaron Steps for photos, and ride the cable car up Sugarloaf Mountain for panoramic views. In the afternoon, professional makeup and photography happen before you head to the Sambadrome Parade with thousands of revelers.

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
included: Morning Bloco Street Party in Santa Teresa (Optional Attendance)
5-Hour Sunset Boat Party Cruise on Guanabara Bay
optional: Sleep in and relax at hotel instead of attending morning bloco street party
days.description: After breakfast you can either join a bloco street party in Santa Teresa or sleep in at the hotel if you prefer. By afternoon you'll meet the group for included local lunch, then board a schooner for a 5-hour party cruise across Guanabara Bay. The open bar runs the first hour, and you can dance or relax as you like. You'll return to the marina just after sunset with views of Sugarloaf Mountain and Christ the Redeemer, then the group heads out for Rio's weekend Carnival nightlife.

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
included: 3-Hour Guided Favela Tour with Local Guide
Pacified Favela Community & Samba School History Tour
Group Sunset Drinks at Arpoador Rock
optional: Free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace
Join another high-energy street party with tour leader recommendations
days.description: Following breakfast, a local guide leads a 3-hour favela tour to a pacified community where you'll see Rio's views and learn about samba school history from the vibrant streets themselves. The tour wraps up with an açaí bowl. Later in the afternoon you can explore the city on your own or catch another street party. As evening comes, gather at Arpoador Rock with the group for cold drinks and sunset views over Dois Irmãos mountains, then refresh at your place or join your guide for more Carnival.

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
included: Morning Bloco Street Party (Final Carnival Immersion)
Final Evening Carnival Nightlife Experience with Tour Leader
days.meals: Dinner (All-You-Can-Eat Brazilian Churrasco BBQ with Perfectly Grilled Meats and Traditional Sides)
days.description: Your final morning features another bloco street party from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM in your brightest costume. Afterward you'll relax on Copacabana Beach to cool off in the sea, sunbathe with Sugarloaf Mountain in the distance, or soak up the beach vibe with new friends. Back at your accommodation in the late afternoon for downtime, then gather with the group for an all-you-can-eat Brazilian Churrasco BBQ dinner. Your tour leader takes you out for one last night of Rio's Carnival nightlife.

days.title: Rio de Janeiro
optional: Final stroll through Rio's colorful streets
days.description: Enjoy farewell breakfast and check out by 11:00 AM or midday (your tour leader will confirm the exact time). After that the day is yours to spend however you like. Take a final walk through Rio's colorful streets, revisit Lapa or Copacabana, or sit at a café with fresh juice. Walking works best during Carnival since city traffic gets heavy.

intro:
A city that simply oozes romance - the original city of love! Paris is the city of a thousand walks and is as close to perfection as is possible for a fabulous city break holiday. Paris' monument-lined boulevards, museums, nightlife, its romantic Seine river, colorful lifes, classical bistros, boutiques and much more. Paris is one of the world's best places for food and drink.

Our selection of 3*** city centered hotels  and guided visits of iconic areas such as Versailles Palace, Louvre Museum, Eiffel Tower, Seine Cruise etc during this 5-day  journey will make your trip unforgettable.

Paris is a city beyond compare.  "Once seen, never forgotten....."


Important Trip Notes

(*) This itinerary you are reading now is a draft and subject to change. Upon your booking, definitive information and a custom itinerary for your name, including hotels, meeting locations, times, emergency phone numbers, flight details, etc., will be clearly described in the trip document, which will be sent to you via email or uploaded to your dashboard. Please carefully review the trip document and you are welcome to ask any questions you may have. Any other document is not valid.

(*) This tour might be a combination of different programs. If applies there might be a change in the tour escort and passengers between the programs.

(*) During you stay in Paris, pick-up and drop-off to the hotels are not organized to to heavy traffic in Paris. Our hotels are located in the city center and Paris is the best city in the world in terms of public transport. We kindly request our customers to meet at the convenient meeting locations

(*) We have different accommodation categories 3-star, 4-star and 5-star hotels in Paris. If you want to upgrade you can ask during your booking.

days.title: Arrival in Paris
days.start_point: Paris, France (Pick-up from CDH or ORY Airports of Paris)
days.description: You'll arrive at the airport where a transfer is waiting to take you to your hotel in central Paris. Once you check in, the rest of the day is yours to get oriented and soak up the city's atmosphere. This is a good time to grab lunch nearby, wander around your neighborhood, or just rest after travel.

days.title: Paris Panoramic Tour and Seine Cruise
included: Panoramic bus tour of central Paris with English commentary
Bateaux Parisiens Seine River cruise (1 hour, English narration)
Eiffel Tower skip-the-line entrance and elevator to second-level observation deck (150 meters)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll board a panoramic bus tour with English commentary that takes you past major sites like the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées, and Notre-Dame. From there, you'll head to the Seine for a one-hour boat cruise. Later in the afternoon, you'll skip the lines and head up to the Eiffel Tower's second level at 150 meters high, where you can see across the entire city.

days.title: Paris - Versailles
included: Skip-the-line guided tour of Palace of Versailles with access to King's Grand Apartments (Apollo, Mars, Mercy, Venus rooms)
Guided tour of Queen's Grand Apartments including Coronation Room and Queen's Bedroom
Visit Hall of Mirrors with gardens
days.description: Meet at 8:15 am at Pullman Hotel Tour Eiffel and head out to the Palace of Versailles. You've got skip-the-line access, so you'll move through the King's and Queen's Grand Apartments without waiting around. The Hall of Mirrors is the centerpiece here with its 350 mirrors creating this incredible effect throughout the room, and the gardens extend out from the palace grounds. You'll be back in Paris by 12:30 pm, giving you the whole afternoon free to wander around the city on your own. Spend the night in Paris.

days.title: Free Time in Paris
optional: Disneyland Paris: 1 Day 2 Parks with round trip transport (€200 per person for children)
Mont-Saint-Michel Tour with lunch (Fridays only, 14 hours) - €250 per person
Loire Valley Castles: Chateau de Chenonceau and Chateau de Chambord with Clos Lucé castle and Leonardo da Vinci site (Wednesdays and Saturdays only, 13 hours) - €250 per person
Normandy D-Day Beaches with official guide (Saturdays only, 13 hours) - €250 per person
days.description: After breakfast, you have free time before heading to the airport. A private transfer will pick you up and take you to either CDG or Orly, depending on your flight. That wraps up your Paris trip.

days.title: Departure from Paris
days.description: Today is completely free to explore Paris however you like. If you want to venture out, there are optional full-day excursions you can book, including Disneyland Paris, Mont-Saint-Michel, Loire Valley Castles, or D-Day Beaches in Normandy. Otherwise, just wander the city at your own speed, check out neighborhoods you haven't seen yet, or revisit places you enjoyed.

intro: Experience the best of Italy with our 5-day tour starting from Rome. Explore the enchanting town of Assisi and its famous basilica of St. Francis, home to masterpieces by Giotto and Cimabue. Discover the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Siena, famous for the historic horse race, Palio. Immerse yourself in the beauty of Florence, the "Cradle of Renaissance," with its countless monuments, churches, and buildings, including the famous Duomo, Campanile tower, and Baptistery. Indulge in a typical Tuscan lunch in Piazza Santa Croce. Continue your journey to Bologna, Padua, and the majestic city of Venice, where you will stroll along its canals and visit iconic landmarks, such as the Palazzo dei Dogi and the legendary Bridge of Sighs. Taste the world-renowned wines of Montepulciano before concluding your trip in Rome. Viva la bella vita!

days.title: Rome to Assisi - Siena - Florence
included: Visit Basilica of St. Francis in Assisi
Explore Siena and Piazza del Campo (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
optional: Lunch in Assisi (available at own expense)
days.meals: Dinner (Dinner at hotel in Florence (until 23rd March 2026; from 30th March 2026, replaced with lunch in Assisi))
days.start_point: Roma, Rome, Italy (Rome)
days.description: Your coach picks you up from Hotel St. Martin at 7:15 am and heads toward Assisi. Once there, you'll walk through the medieval streets at your own pace and visit the Basilica of St. Francis to see works by Giotto and Cimabue. You'll have time for lunch on your own, then later move on to Siena where you can see Piazza del Campo and learn about the famous Palio horse race. By evening you'll check into your Florence hotel and have dinner before settling in for the night.

days.title: Florence
included: Explore Piazza della Signoria and Palazzo Vecchio
Lunch in typical Tuscan restaurant in Piazza Santa Croce
optional: Day trip to Pisa: tour Piazza dei Miracoli, see the Leaning Tower and Baptistery
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch in typical Tuscan restaurant in Piazza Santa Croce)
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, spend the day exploring Florence's Renaissance sites. You'll see the Duomo with Brunelleschi's dome, the Campanile tower, and the Baptistery with its bronze doors. Then check out Piazza della Signoria and Palazzo Vecchio before heading to the Basilica of Santa Croce. Grab lunch at a typical Tuscan restaurant in the piazza. In the afternoon, walk the cobblestone streets or take an optional trip to Pisa if you want to see the Leaning Tower. Dinner is on your own whenever you like.

days.title: Florence to Bologna - Venice
included: Walking tour of Bologna city center including Piazza Malpighi, Piazza del Nettuno, and Piazza Maggiore
Local Food Experience in Bologna (light street food lunch)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Local Food Experience in Bologna - light street food lunch)
days.description: After eating breakfast in Florence, you'll travel by coach to Bologna. The city center is yours to explore, starting around Piazza Malpighi and moving through Piazza del Nettuno and Piazza Maggiore. You can see Palazzo Podestà and the Basilica of San Petronio, which is the world's largest Gothic brick church. Stop somewhere local for a light lunch to try Bologna's food scene. Then it's off to Venice (Mestre) in the afternoon where you'll check in at your hotel.

days.title: Venice
included: Walking tour of Palazzo dei Dogi
Spritz or prosecco with tour leader
optional: Roam along Venice's canals at leisure
days.meals: Breakfast, Snack (Spritz or prosecco with tour leader)
days.description: Breakfast at your hotel starts the day, then you'll transfer to Piazza San Marco. A walking tour takes you through Venice's most iconic spots, including Palazzo dei Dogi and the Bridge of Sighs. After the tour, you'll have a complimentary spritz or prosecco with your tour leader. The rest of the afternoon is free to wander through Venice's canals on your own before heading back to your hotel.

days.title: Venice to Tuscany Wine Region - Montepulciano - Rome
included: Lunch in typical Tuscan restaurant in Montepulciano
optional: Wine purchases in local wine houses in Montepulciano
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Typical Tuscan lunch in Montepulciano)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll leave from Piazzale Roma heading toward Tuscany with its rolling hills, churches, castles, and vineyards. The first stop is Montepulciano, a medieval town known for its history and art, particularly for its 'Nobile' wine. You'll have a traditional Tuscan lunch at a local restaurant and free time to explore the town or pick up some wine if you want. Then it's the final drive to Rome where the tour ends.

name: New Zealand South Island Express (10 destinations)

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
This is the New Zealand you’ve always heard about – endless lakes, snow-capped mountains and pristine glaciers. Spend nine days discovering the best of the South Island with a passionate local leader at the helm. Encounter creativity and resilience in Christchurch, gaze up at the stars in Lake Tekapo, get your adrenaline pumping in Queenstown, take your time in postcard-pretty Wanaka and see the mighty Franz Josef glacier. With thrilling activities available around every corner, this adventure is sure to get your heart racing (and that’s just from the views!).

There are walking opportunities throughout this trip. We recommend you bring good quality walking shoes if you're keen to enjoy a hike or two., Multiple activities on this trip are subject to weather and water conditions and on occasion, may be cancelled for safety or operational reasons. In the case of cancellation, we will endeavour to find a suitable replacement activity., There are some long travelling days on this trip, but it’s all part of the adventure and a great way to get to know your fellow travellers.

days.title: Christchurch
days.description: You'll arrive in Christchurch and have the afternoon to wander around the city on your own. The Cardboard Cathedral is worth checking out if you want to see how the city has rebuilt since the 2011 earthquake. There's a welcome meeting at 6 pm where you'll meet your leader and the rest of the group, then the evening is yours to find somewhere to eat.

days.title: Christchurch to Lake Tekapo
included: Visit Church of the Good Shepherd at Lake Tekapo
days.description: This morning you'll explore Christchurch with a local guide before heading south toward Lake Tekapo. The drive takes you to a Dark Sky Reserve, and the lake itself is known for its bright turquoise color backed by mountains. You'll visit the Church of the Good Shepherd, and if the weather cooperates, there's stargazing later on since this area has some of the clearest night skies in the country.

days.title: Lake Tekapo to Queenstown
included: Drive through Mackenzie Basin and Southern Alps scenic route
days.description: There's an optional hike up Mt John early on if you want views of the Southern Alps, but it's not required. From there you'll drive through the Mackenzie Basin with its wide open tussock lands and stop for photos of the snow-capped peaks. Later you'll pass Kawarau Gorge where bungy jumping is available if that interests you, then continue to Queenstown for a two-night stay.

days.title: Queenstown
optional: Lord of the Rings 4WD Tour - NZD236
Horse Trek Lord of the Rings - NZD205
Milford Sound Coach-Cruise-Coach Day Trip - NZD156
days.description: You have a full day to choose your own adventure in Queenstown. If you're into action, options include paragliding, jet boating, mountain biking, or bungy jumping. For something different, Milford Sound offers a sailboat cruise with waterfalls and mountains, or there's a 4WD tour visiting Lord of the Rings filming locations. Wine lovers can tour the local vineyards in the region.

days.title: Queenstown - Arrowtown - Wanaka
optional: Guided e-bike Tour in Wanaka - NZD158
Mou Waho Island Cruise and Nature Walk - NZD251
days.description: After finishing up any remaining Queenstown activities this morning, you'll drive toward Wanaka over the scenic Crown Range. A stop in Arrowtown gives you a chance to walk through this historic gold-rush town with its period buildings and charm. Lake Wanaka is your destination for the night, surrounded by mountains and offering hiking trails, biking routes, or just a quiet spot at a cafe with views.

days.title: Wanaka to Franz Josef
optional: Morning bike ride on Lake Wanaka shores
Mou Waho Island Cruise and Nature Walk
days.description: The morning is free to spend however you like in Wanaka. You can bike along the lake shore, visit Mou Waho Island, or find a cafe to relax. Afternoon drives north show off some of New Zealand's best scenery, including waterfalls at Haast Pass and coastal views. Your leader will stop for photos along the way before reaching Franz Josef village.

days.title: Franz Josef
optional: Pounamu gallery visit and pendant carving
Heli Experience with Snow Landing - NZD294
days.description: Franz Josef village sits right under dramatic glacier-covered peaks. You'll visit a local gallery to learn about pounamu, or greenstone, which is important in Maori culture, and you can carve your own pendant to take home. In the afternoon, there's an optional activity to get closer to the Franz Josef Glacier, with kayaking over the glacial lake available if you want.

days.title: West Coast to Christchurch
days.description: The drive up the West Coast shows off incredibly lush green landscapes thanks to all the rainfall in this region, contrasting nicely with the ocean. There's a stop at a kiwi centre where you might see kiwi birds in a nocturnal house. After driving through Arthur's Pass with its mountain views and photo stops, you'll return to Christchurch for an evening meal and drinks with the group.

days.title: Christchurch
days.description: This morning marks the end of your New Zealand adventure. If you'd like to stay longer, contact your booking agent beforehand to arrange extra nights in Christchurch.

name: Croatia Sail Adventure

attributes.name: Sailing
attributes.tip: Catch the wind and set sail for new horizons

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
If floating above turquoise seas, wandering picturesque medieval towns, and long days under the Mediterranean sun sound like they would float your boat, Croatia is calling as your next summer escape. From the world-famous walled city of Dubrovnik to the lush green paradise of Mljet, our Croatia Sail Adventure covers the absolute best of Croatia over 10 blissful days. You’ll explore towns with ancient Roman roots, swim in hidden bays, feast on fresh seafood, discover epic waterfalls, sip tropical cocktails, check out the sights via bike and kayak and party the night away, all while sailing away on a premium boat. Oh, and did we mention you’ll be doing this with an experienced group leader and instant crew of new friends? Slap on your SPF and pack your swimmers, this is the sailing trip of a lifetime.  

+ Our tours are all 100% Carbon Neutral!

days.title: Split
optional: Explore Old Town of Split at leisure
days.description: You'll arrive in Split and settle into your hostel in the Old Town area. Once you get yourself sorted, take some time to relax and get your bearings before the group meets up. Then head out for dinner and drinks to start getting a feel for how locals do things here in Croatia.

days.title: Split to Makarska
included: Swim stop in the Adriatic Sea
days.description: The day starts with a walking tour showing you Split's main sights before you board your boat. Once onboard, you'll have a three-course lunch as you set sail into the Adriatic. Stop for a swim along the way, then head to Makarska, a resort town surrounded by mountains and beaches where the boat docks for the night.

days.title: Mljet National Park
included: Mljet National Park entrance and bike ride
days.meals: Breakfast (Hot buffet breakfast), Lunch (Three-course feast of locally sourced food (meat, seafood and fresh veg))
days.description: After a hot breakfast buffet, the boat sails to Mljet, a quiet island in the Adriatic. Your captain anchors in a hidden bay and you'll have time to swim. Later there's another three-course meal featuring local ingredients, and in the afternoon you can explore Mljet National Park by bike if you want to get active.

days.title: Dubrovnik
included: Dubrovnik Old Town guided walking tour
days.description: The boat travels overnight and arrives in Dubrovnik, the fortress city on Croatia's coast. Start your day with sea kayaking to see the views from the water, then take a guided walking tour through the Old Town. By evening, grab dinner at a local restaurant and check out what Dubrovnik's nightlife has to offer.

days.title: Trstenik
included: Swim stop in the Adriatic Sea
days.description: You'll sail past olive groves and vineyards to a clear blue-water anchorage where the day is yours to swim and relax on the boat. Later you dock in Trstenik, a quiet fishing village where you can walk around the streets at your own pace. That evening there's a captain's dinner onboard with drinks and games.

days.title: Korcula
days.description: The boat docks in Korcula, a town with a 15th century cathedral and marble buildings throughout. You'll get a guided tour of the main sights, then spend the afternoon wandering through the Venetian Old Town on your own. End the day with dinner and sunset cocktails on the edge of town.

days.title: Hvar
included: Swim stop in the Adriatic Sea
Hike up to the Spanish Fortress in Hvar
days.description: After a morning of swimming and snorkeling in the Adriatic, you'll sail to Hvar, a place where super-yachts gather and Renaissance history is everywhere. Head up to the Spanish Fortress perched above the terracotta rooftops for views across the coast. Spend the evening experiencing the Croatian scene with drinks and dancing.

days.title: Split
days.description: Your final day on the boat as you sail back to Split on the mainland. You'll have free time in the afternoon to walk around the city and explore before your sailing week wraps up.

days.title: Krka National Park
included: Krka National Park entrance and waterfall visit
days.description: Say goodbye to the boat and head to Krka National Park to see the waterfalls and cool off in the water. On the way back, stop in Skradin, an old town where you can grab lunch. Finish your trip with a final dinner and drinks to celebrate what you've done.

days.title: Split
days.description: Check out of your accommodation and get ready to head onward. Your group leader will be around to help if you need support getting to Split airport or figuring out your next move in Europe.

intro:
Experience the awe-inspiring beauty of Namibia with a visit to Sossusvlei and Swakopmund, two of the country's most iconic destinations.


Sossusvlei, located within the Namib-Naukluft National Park, is renowned for its towering red sand dunes, some of the highest in the world. Witness the surreal landscape as the sun casts ever-changing shadows over the rippling sands, creating a mesmerizing play of light and color. Climb to the top of the iconic Dune 45 for panoramic views of the surrounding desert, or explore the eerie beauty of Deadvlei, a stark white clay pan dotted with ancient camelthorn trees.


After immersing yourself in the otherworldly scenery of Sossusvlei, journey to the coastal town of Swakopmund for a complete change of scenery. Nestled between the Atlantic Ocean and the Namib Desert, Swakopmund offers a unique blend of natural beauty, adventure, and cultural charm. Explore the town's German colonial architecture, stroll along its palm-lined promenade, or indulge in a variety of thrilling activities such as sandboarding, quad biking, or skydiving over the desert dunes.


With its contrasting landscapes and diverse array of experiences, Namibia promises an unforgettable adventure for those seeking to explore the wonders of Sossusvlei and Swakopmund. From the ethereal beauty of the desert to the coastal delights of the seaside town, Namibia invites you to embark on a journey of discovery and exploration unlike any other.

days.title: Windhoek
days.start_point: Windhoek, Khomas, Namibia (Client can also be picked the Airport.)
days.description: You'll arrive at Hosea Kutako International Airport and meet your guide, then take a 45-minute transfer heading south toward Namib Naukluft Park. The drive takes you through Spreetshoogte Pass where you'll stop in Solitaire for refreshments and photos. After reaching your lodge, spend the afternoon by the pool and gather for dinner with a briefing about what's coming up on your trip.

days.title: Naukluft National Park
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll head into Naukluft National Park to see Sossusvlei's salt and clay pan surrounded by red dunes, then climb Dune 45 for panoramic views of the desert. From there, check out Deadvlei with its dead camel thorn trees standing against white earth, and walk through Sesriem Canyon that was carved by the Tsauchab River over millions of years. You'll return to the lodge for dinner.

days.title: Kuiseb Pass to Tropic of Capricorn
days.description: This morning takes you through Kuiseb Pass and Kuiseb Canyon with dramatic cliffs and rock formations where you might spot baboons, mountain zebras, and desert birds. Later you'll reach the Tropic of Capricorn at latitude 23.5 degrees south and stand at the signpost straddling the imaginary line between Earth's hemispheres to grab photos. By evening you'll arrive at your accommodation by the bay.

days.title: Walvis Bay and Swakopmund
included: Boat cruise on the Atlantic Ocean
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Light lunch during the boat trip)
days.description: Head out early to Walvis Bay for a morning boat trip on the Atlantic Ocean aboard a 25-person catamaran looking for sea lions, dolphins, pelicans, cormorants, and possibly Mola-Mola fish. A light lunch happens during the cruise. In the afternoon, explore Swakopmund's German-founded streets with time for shopping and walking around, then take a quad bike ride through the desert landscape before returning to your accommodation.

days.title: Windhoek to Airport
days.description: After a relaxed breakfast at your guesthouse, you'll drive back to Windhoek, arriving late morning or early afternoon. If there's time, explore the city with your guide or hit some shops before heading to the international airport for your flight home.

intro:
Discover Namibia's Natural Treasures - Etosha, Twyfelfontein, Swakopmund, and Sossusvlei Awaits You!

Calling all adventure-seekers and nature enthusiasts! Namibia, a land of striking contrasts and untamed beauty, beckons you to explore its most iconic destinations. From the captivating wildlife of Etosha National Park to the ancient rock engravings of Twyfelfontein, the coastal charm of Swakopmund, and the mesmerizing dunes of Sossusvlei, Namibia promises an unforgettable journey of discovery.

­ 

Etosha National Park - A Safari Paradise: Venture into the heart of the wild at Etosha National Park, where the African savannah comes to life. Witness the grace and power of lions, elephants, giraffes, and the elusive black rhino as they roam free in their natural habitat.

­ 

Twyfelfontein - Timeless Petroglyphs: Step back in time at Twyfelfontein, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where ancient rock engravings offer a glimpse into the rich cultural history of Namibia's early inhabitants. Marvel at the intricate details of these stone etchings, connecting you to a past that echoes through the ages.

­ 

Swakopmund - Coastal Charm and Adventure: Feel the refreshing ocean breeze as you arrive in Swakopmund, a coastal town where adventure meets relaxation. Embark on thrilling desert excursions, indulge in delectable seafood, and immerse yourself in the town's vibrant culture.

­ 

Sossusvlei - Nature's Majestic Canvas: Prepare to be humbled by the ethereal beauty of Sossusvlei, a mesmerizing landscape of towering red sand dunes and ancient clay pans. As the sun rises, the dunes come alive with a kaleidoscope of colors, painting a masterpiece that will leave you in awe.

­ 

Why Visit Namibia:

1. Unspoiled Wilderness: Namibia's vast and untouched landscapes offer an escape into nature, allowing you to connect with the raw beauty of Africa like never before.

2. Diverse Wildlife: Etosha National Park boasts an incredible diversity of wildlife, providing ample opportunities for unforgettable animal encounters.

3. Ancient History: Twyfelfontein's ancient rock art provides a fascinating glimpse into the lives and beliefs of Namibia's early inhabitants.

4. Adventure and Adrenaline: From thrilling desert activities in Swakopmund to scaling iconic sand dunes in Sossusvlei, Namibia offers adventure at every turn.

5. Stargazing Splendor: Namibia's vast and remote landscapes provide an ideal setting for stargazing, with the night sky ablaze with stars.

Plan Your Namibian Adventure Today: Seize the opportunity to explore Namibia's natural treasures and embrace the spirit of adventure that awaits you. Allow us to create a customized itinerary that showcases the very best of Etosha, Twyfelfontein, Swakopmund, and Sossusvlei. Let the wonders of Namibia inspire you, leaving you with cherished memories and a deep connection to this captivating land.

­ 

Unravel the secrets of Namibia - a land of wonder and exploration!

days.title: Windhoek
included: Afternoon Safari in Etosha National Park (if time allows)
days.start_point: Windhoek, Khomas, Namibia (Clients will be picked up from the Airport if requested, or any accommodation in Windhoek)
days.description: You'll arrive at Hosea Kutako International Airport where your guide meets you. On the drive to Etosha National Park, there's a stop at the craft market in Okahandja to pick up any last-minute items or gifts. Depending on when you land, you might have time for an afternoon safari to start seeing wildlife right away. Later in the evening, your group gathers together to go over what's coming up on the trip and get to know each other a bit.

days.title: Etosha National Park
included: Full Day Game Drive in Etosha National Park
days.description: This is a full day in Etosha National Park doing game drives around the waterholes and across the pan. You'll have chances to see springboks, zebras, and black-faced impala, and if you're lucky, leopards and lions too. Make sure you bring binoculars and your camera gear because the wildlife encounters can happen pretty quickly. There's a lot of ground to cover, so you'll spend most of the day watching and photographing animals in their natural habitat.

days.title: Kaokoland to Twyfelfontein
days.description: You'll head out to see a Himba village in Kaokoland to learn about how these nomadic pastoralists live and what their culture is like. It's good to bring some provisions or small gifts with you. After that, you continue on to Twyfelfontein where you'll check out one of Africa's largest collections of rock engravings. The carvings show rhinos, elephants, ostriches, giraffes, and animal footprints from centuries past.

days.title: Twyfelfontein to Swakopmund
days.description: The drive takes you to Swakopmund on the Atlantic coast, and along the way you'll spot Brandberg, which contains Namibia's highest peak. Once you arrive at this colonial town, you can feel that cooler ocean breeze and explore the area. There's a historic lighthouse, the Mole sea wall, and several museums to check out if you want. If your lodge offers it, you could also get a massage or other spa treatment to unwind.

days.title: Swakopmund to Sossusvlei
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Light Lunch during the boat trip), Dinner
days.description: You'll leave early and head to Walvis Bay for a boat cruise on the Atlantic searching for dolphins and sea lions. The catamaran holds about 25 people and you might also see pelicans, cormorants, or even the rare Mola-Mola fish. There's a light lunch served during the cruise. After that, you drive south through Naukluft Park, crossing the Kuiseb Pass and the Tropic of Capricorn, with a quick stop in Solitaire for refreshments.

days.title: Sossusvlei
days.description: You'll spend the day exploring the massive red and orange dunes of Sossusvlei and the white clay pan of Deadvlei. These are among the world's highest dunes, and the contrast between the colors and shapes is really something. Dune 45 and Sesriem Canyon are both on the itinerary. Bring your camera because you'll want to capture the dramatic landscapes throughout the day.

days.title: Sossusvlei to Windhoek
days.description: The drive back to Windhoek takes you through some varied terrain, and you'll arrive in the late morning or early afternoon. If there's time before your transfer to the airport, you might explore the city or do some shopping around town. After that, you get transferred to either the international airport or your accommodation depending on your flight schedule.

intro: Explore Egypt's long history and fascinating culture on this thrilling guided tour. You'll see Cairo's famous landmarks, including the Step Pyramid, Red Pyramid, and Bent, The pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx, and many more. Then visit Luxor, home to opulent temples and tombs. Next, take a Nile River cruise between Luxor and Aswan in your very own private cabin, seeing ancient artifacts as you go. Visit the ancient port city of Alexandria, where you'll ramp up the adventure with a full-day tour of extraordinary ruins and relics from Greco-Roman times and much more!

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo, Egypt (Cairo International Airport)
days.description: Your journey starts when you land at Cairo International Airport. From there, you'll be driven to your 4-star hotel in the city center, giving you a chance to settle in and get oriented to Egypt's historic capital. It's a good time to rest up before the real exploring begins tomorrow.

days.title: Cairo
included: Visit Red Pyramid at Dahshur Necropolis
days.meals: Lunch (Local Restaurant with famous local Egyptian food)
days.description: This morning you head out to Saqqara Necropolis to see the Step Pyramid of Djoser and the Pyramid of Teti. Around midday you'll grab lunch at a local restaurant, then continue southwest to Dahshur Necropolis where the Bent Pyramid and Red Pyramid wait for you. You'll head back to your hotel after that.

days.title: Cairo
days.description: Today you're spending time at Giza, walking through the Great Pyramid of Khufu, Pyramid of Chefren, and Pyramid of Mykerinus. The Sphinx and Valley Temple are there too. Later in the afternoon, you'll check out the Grand Egyptian Museum, which has 5,000 years of artifacts and royal treasures from Ancient Egypt.

days.title: Cairo to Luxor
included: Visit Karnak Temple Complex - Great Hypostyle Hall
Visit courtyard and granite statues of Ramses II at Karnak
View Obelisks of Queen Hatshepsut and Tuthmosis III
optional: Luxor city tour by horse carriage
days.description: An early flight takes you to Luxor this morning, and then you board a 5-star Nile cruise for the next 5 days. You'll spend the day walking through Karnak's Great Hypostyle Hall with its intricate columns, seeing the granite statues of Ramses II and ancient obelisks. Later you head to Luxor Temple, checking out its columns and colossal statues.

days.title: Luxor
optional: Sunrise hot air balloon excursion over ancient lands of Luxor
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Leisurely dinner on board)
days.description: The West Bank of the Nile is your focus today. You'll explore the Valley of the Kings where 63 tombs and chambers sit carved into the hillside, then see the Colossi of Memnon and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. By evening you're sailing toward Edfu with dinner served on board, and you'll sleep on the ship.

days.title: Edfu to Kom Ombo
included: Visit Temple of Horus at Edfu
days.description: After breakfast, you go ashore for a guided tour of Edfu's Temple of Horus, one of Egypt's best-preserved temples. Back on the cruise you'll have lunch, then later the ship sails to Kom Ombo Temple, which has an unusual setup with two deities honored there - Horus and the Crocodile God Sobek. Tonight there's an Egyptian Night Party with traditional music and Galabeya gowns.

days.title: Aswan
optional: Late afternoon tour to Nubian Village
days.description: You wake up at Aswan where the cruise docks. The morning is spent at Philae Temple on Agilkia Island, which was moved here in the 1960s to save it from the dam flooding. You'll also see the Aswan High Dam, built between 1960 and 1970 for hydroelectric power. If you're interested, there's an optional late afternoon trip to a Nubian Village.

days.title: Aswan to Cairo
optional: Early morning tour to Great Temples of Abu Simbel
days.description: You disembark from the cruise today. There's an optional early morning tour available to Abu Simbel's Great Temples, where Ramses II and Nefertari's sanctuaries were relocated in 1968 to escape submersion by Lake Nasser. After that you transfer to Aswan International Airport for your internal flight back to Cairo, then check into your hotel.

days.title: Alexandria
included: Visit Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
days.description: This morning you travel to Alexandria, the ancient port city founded by Alexander the Great in 331 BC. You'll walk through the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa to see the rock-cut tombs with their blend of Egyptian, Greek, and Roman styles. Then you visit Pompey's Pillar and the modern Alexandrina Bibliotheca with its granite facade covered in 120+ scripts. By evening you head back to Cairo.

days.title: Cairo Departure
days.description: Breakfast at your Cairo hotel ends your trip. After checking out, you're driven to Cairo International Airport where you catch your departure flight home.

days.description: This morning you'll head out to the Great Pyramids of Giza to see the pyramids of Cheops, Chefren, and Mykerinus, along with the Sphinx and Valley Temple. After lunch, the Grand Egyptian Museum is next on your list, where you can see 5,000 years of Ancient Egyptian treasures including the Statue of King Ramses II and various royal artifacts.

days.title: Cairo to Aswan
included: Domestic flight from Cairo to Aswan
optional: Nubian Village tour - explore a small town with its own culture, painted in bright colors, where camels move through the streets
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch on board cruise ship as it sets off), Dinner
days.description: You'll fly from Cairo to Aswan and check into your 5-star Nile cruise ship. From there, a tour takes you to Philae Temple, which was built to honor the goddess Isis. Back in Aswan, you'll board your cruise and have lunch while sailing begins. Late afternoon offers an optional visit to the colorful Nubian Village if you're interested.

days.title: Aswan to Kom Ombo
optional: Early morning optional tour to Great Temples of Abu Simbel
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Egyptian Night Party on board with traditional Galabeya gowns and Arabian music)
days.description: Early morning brings an optional tour to the Great Temples of Abu Simbel, those massive sanctuaries built for Ramses II and Nefertari that were relocated in 1968 to prevent flooding. Your ship then sails for about 5 hours to Kom Ombo, where you'll explore a unique dual-deity temple honoring Horus and the Crocodile God Sobek. By evening, an Egyptian Night Party happens on board with traditional Galabeya gowns, music, and dancing.

days.title: Kom Ombo to Luxor
included: Evening entertainment with belly dancing show and music on board
days.description: The morning tour covers the Temple of Edfu, a well-preserved structure built to honor the God Horus during the Greco-Roman period. Your cruise continues on the Nile, arriving in Luxor by afternoon where you'll visit the temples of Luxor and Karnak, checking out their towering structures and the newly opened avenue of sphinxes. An evening show featuring belly dancing and music wraps up your day.

days.title: Luxor
included: Valley of the Kings tour with royal tomb visit
Domestic flight from Luxor to Cairo
days.description: You'll drive early to the West Bank and cross the Nile to tour the Temple of Hatshepsut, built for one of ancient Egypt's most successful female Pharaohs. From there, the Valley of the Kings is next, where you'll see royal tombs and the Colossus of Memnon, plus ongoing archaeological work. Later, you transfer to Luxor International Airport for your domestic flight back to Cairo, staying overnight there.

days.title: Cairo
days.description: After breakfast at your Cairo hotel, you'll check out and have free time to do as you like. Then it's time to transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight home.

name: Heart of England

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Step into storybook England, where Oxford enchants with its ‘dreaming spires’ and Bath inspires with its Roman and Georgian architecture. Trace Shakespeare’s footsteps in Stratford-upon-Avon as you visit his half-timbered childhood home. Indulge in the sweet and savoury delights of afternoon tea in the charming Cotswolds. And pause in Lacock Abbey, where hushed cloisters whisper of movie magic and centuries past. Delve into the heart of England and discover deeper with us.

days.title: London
days.description: You'll arrive in London and meet your tour leader along with the other travelers for dinner together. It's a good chance to get to know everyone before things really get going.

days.title: London to Oxford
included: Walking tour of Oxford with Tour Leader (including entrance to a college)
days.description: Head to Oxford for the day and join a walking tour that takes you through a medieval college and the Bodleian Library, one of Europe's oldest. After that, the afternoon is yours to spend browsing the Covered Market, visiting the castle, or checking out the Ashmolean Museum. You'll stay overnight at a converted Victorian prison hotel, which is quite a unique place.

days.title: Oxford - Cotswolds - Stratford-upon-Avon
included: Stroll the high street of Chipping Campden
days.description: Travel through the Cotswolds countryside by minicoach, stopping in Chipping Campden to walk around the high street and see the historic 17th-century Market Hall. Then it's on to Stratford-upon-Avon, the half-timbered town associated with Shakespeare, where you'll have dinner together as a group.

days.title: Stratford-upon-Avon
days.description: This morning focuses on Shakespeare's heritage in Stratford. You'll visit his childhood home, his final resting place, and Anne Hathaway's Cottage with its gardens. The afternoon is free to relax at a pub, look around the shops, or take a walk along the River Avon on your own.

days.title: Stratford-upon-Avon to Bath
days.description: Spend the morning at the Roman Baths, where you can see the natural hot springs and use the audio guide. Then visit the Jane Austen Centre to learn about Regency England. The afternoon is free to relax at Thermae Bath Spa with its rooftop pool overlooking the city, or hunt for a famous Sally Lunn Bun. You'll have a farewell dinner with the group this evening.

days.title: Bath
included: Entrance to the Roman Baths (including audio guide)
Entrance to the Jane Austen Centre
optional: Visit Thermae Bath Spa with rooftop pool
Sample a Sally Lunn Bun at the city's oldest eating house
days.description: Start at Longleat House, an Elizabethan stately home with gilded halls and interesting interiors, where a local guide walks you through centuries of family history. Next, head to Avebury to see the stone circles, a 5,000-year-old prehistoric monument you can touch and walk around. Then it's back to London to say goodbye to your fellow travelers.

days.title: Bath - Longleat House - Avebury - London
included: Visit Longleat House with local guide
Free time to explore Avebury's stone circles
days.description: Start with afternoon tea at a local family's home in a Cotswolds village, enjoying finger sandwiches, cakes, and scones with jam and clotted cream. Continue to the village of Lacock and explore its 13th-century abbey, which appeared in the Harry Potter films. By evening you'll arrive in Bath and check in for two nights.

intro:
Visit: Osaka-Nara-Kyoto-Nagoya-Naraijuku-Nagano/Yamanashi-Mt.Fuji-Tokyo

Comfortable hotels (3 star).  

8 nights in Japan (Osaka 3 nights, Nagoya 1 night, Nagano 1 night, Tokyo 3 night)

Included: daily breakfasts, English-speaking tour guide, upscale motor coach, City-to-city transportations

days.title: Arrival in Osaka
days.start_point: 関西国際空港 (Kansai International Airport) (KIX), 泉州空港北1, 泉南郡, Osaka 549-0011, Japan (Kansai International Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at Kansai International Airport and take the train to your hotel, which is conveniently just one station away. Check-in happens after 3 pm, so you'll have time to settle in and rest from your flight before dinner.

days.title: Osaka - Nara - Osaka
included: Explore Todaiji Temple (UNESCO World Heritage site)
Feed free-roaming deer with deer senbei crackers
optional: Purchase deer senbei crackers (150 yen per pack)
days.description: You'll drive out to Nara for a half-day trip and spend your morning in Nara Park checking out Todaiji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site that's been around for over 1200 years. The main draw here is the massive Buddha statue inside, standing at about 15m tall. While you're in the park, you can feed the deer roaming freely around the grounds if you pick up some deer senbei crackers (150 yen per pack). From there, you'll head to Kasuga Taisha, which is Nara's most celebrated shrine. After grabbing lunch, you'll drive back to Osaka, check into your hotel, and have the rest of the afternoon and evening free to relax and settle in.

days.title: Osaka
optional: Hiroshima on Shinkansen Optional Tour - includes door-to-door transfer from hotel, Shinkansen bullet train to Hiroshima Station, visit to Itsukushima Shrine and Miyajima Island, Atomic Dome and Ground Zero, Peace Memorial Park, and return journey by bullet train
days.description: Today is yours to do as you like in Osaka, or you can opt into an organized tour to Hiroshima. If you go with the tour option, you'll leave your hotel at 8:30am and take Japan's famous Shinkansen bullet train, arriving in Hiroshima by 10:30am. From there you'll visit Itsukushima Shrine and Miyajima Island between 11:30am and 1:30pm, then tour the Atomic Dome and Ground Zero from 3:30pm to 4:30pm. After that, you'll spend time in the Peace Memorial Park until 6pm, and then head back to Osaka by bullet train. If you skip the tour, you can wander around Osaka at your own pace and check out whatever interests you.

days.title: Osaka to Kyoto to Nagoya
days.description: You'll leave Osaka for Kyoto this morning and start with Fushimi Inari Shrine, known for thousands of vermilion torii gates. The half-day guided tour continues to Kinkaku-ji, a stunning gold leaf-covered Zen temple, then moves to Arashiyama Bamboo Forest and Togetsu Bashi Bridge. After that, you'll head back to Kyoto station and then travel to your hotel in the Nagoya area.

days.title: Nagoya
included: Visit Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
landmarks: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
days.description: Your morning starts at the Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology, where you'll learn about how the Toyota family built their global business from a small village. In the afternoon, you'll explore Naraijuku, an old town that feels like 17th century Japan, and visit Tsumagoi Village. Later you'll drive to your hotel in the Nagano or Yamanashi area and have time to relax.

days.title: Mount Fuji
included: Scenic boat ride around Lake Yamanaka
days.description: You'll drive through countryside and mountains to Lake Yamanaka, the largest of the Fuji Five Lakes with excellent Mt. Fuji views. In Yamanakako village, you'll take a scenic boat ride around the lake and see the many swans that give it the nickname 'Swan Lake'. Weather permitting, you'll drive up to Mt. Fuji 5th Station at 2,300m elevation for commanding views of the Five Lakes and Fujiyoshida City. You'll also visit Komitake Shrine behind the shops before checking into your hotel.

days.title: Tokyo
optional: Free time in Shinjuku Kabukicho area for nightlife exploration
days.description: You'll start the Tokyo One Day City Tour at Meiji Shrine from 9:00-10:00am. From 10:30am-1:00pm, you'll browse fashionable Omote Sando and Takeshita Dori. At 2:00-3:30pm, you'll visit a secret Japanese traditional rock garden. Tokyo Tower comes next from 4:00-5:00pm with admission included. Free time from 5:30-6:30pm lets you explore Shinjuku Kabukicho's colorful nightlife. Note that the schedule may change due to weather or traffic.

days.title: Tokyo
days.description: You have a free day in Tokyo to explore at your own pace and do whatever interests you most.

days.title: Departure from Tokyo
days.description: After breakfast, your tour guide will help you figure out the best route to Haneda or Narita Airport. You'll depart in plenty of time to catch your flight and head back home.

Peter
