reviews.body: This tour was somewhat of a disappointment. To start with we had booked the deluxe tour with the luxury hotels, but a...
reviews.reply:
Dear Sandra,

Thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback with us. We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the magnificent shrines, the fascinating history of the 17th-century village, and the great shopping along the way.
We would also like to apologize for the areas where your experience fell short of expectations, and we appreciate the opportunity to clarify what occurred:
The Tour Downgrade: It is always a difficult challenge for us to operate our 4-star (deluxe) tours because fewer people sign up for them, making it hard to meet the minimum group size required to run them. When we realized we couldn't run the deluxe departure, we transitioned you to our standard tour and promptly refunded you the price difference, which was $800 USD lower per person.
Hotel Accommodations: Because of the transition to the standard tour, the hotels booked were our standard-tier properties. Hotel rooms in major cities like Tokyo can be significantly smaller than Western standards, but we apologize that they felt cramped during your stay.
The Tour Guide: We are sorry to hear that your guide's style didn't quite match what you were looking for. While some travelers prefer more independent time at the sites, we understand you wanted a deeper, more informative guiding experience. We will share this feedback directly with our team to ensure our guides find the right balance of historical context and free time.
We appreciate your patronage and your valuable feedback, as it helps us continually refine our itineraries and services. We hope that the beautiful sights and memories of your journey stay with you for years to reach.
Warm regards,

Peter

Scott

name: Historic Horizons – Egypt 8 Days (5-Star)

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Explore the Must-see attractions of Egypt within 8 Days , and witness the marvelous landmarks and monuments of our ancestors throughout the different eras.

Discover the Great Civilization of ancient Egypt in Cairo, aswan,luxor starting in Cairo with one of the world's seven wonders (The Great Pyramid) at Giza Plateau with the extraordinary human-headed lion (The Sphinx), then Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) which contains enormous number of ancient Egyptian beautiful artifacts. Sail to amazing monuments and temples scattered along the banks of the Nile on  Nile Cruiser for 3 nights

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo International Airport (CAI), Airport Rd, Al Shorouk, Cairo 11, Egypt (we offer pickup throughout the whole day , 00:00 - 23:00)
days.description: Your tour representative meets you at Cairo airport and handles all the entry formalities for you. They'll arrange your transfer to the hotel, so you don't need to worry about transportation regardless of when your flight lands.

days.title: Cairo
included: Guided tour of Giza Pyramids complex including Great Pyramid, Great Sphinx, and Valley Temple
Guided tour of Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) with Egyptologist
days.description: Breakfast starts at 7am, and you'll be ready to leave your hotel by 8am. A private Egyptologist guide takes you through the Giza Pyramids complex, where you'll see the Great Pyramid, the Great Sphinx, and the Valley Temple. After lunch, you head to the Grand Egyptian Museum to explore over 100,000 artifacts, including the full Tutankhamun collection.

days.title: Cairo to Aswan
included: Guided tour of Temple of Philae
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch on board cruise), Dinner (Dinner on board cruise)
days.description: You'll fly to Aswan in the morning and start with a visit to the Temple of Philae. From there, you transfer to your 5-star Nile cruise where lunch and dinner are served on board. You'll spend the night on the cruise.

days.title: Nile Cruise - Kom Ombo to Edfu
optional: Early morning trip to Abu Simbel by road
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Dinner on board cruise)
days.description: Breakfast happens on board, and you'll have some free time before lunch. The cruise then sails down the Nile to Kom-Ombo Temples for a visit. Later, you continue sailing toward Edfu, where dinner is served on board. You'll overnight on the cruise again.

days.title: Nile Cruise - Edfu to Luxor
included: Visit Edfu Temple by horse carriage
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast on board), Lunch (Lunch on board), Dinner
days.description: After breakfast on board, you take a horse carriage to visit the Edfu Temple before returning to the cruise. The boat continues sailing to Luxor with lunch served on board. After crossing the Esna lock, you arrive in Luxor and tour the East Bank, seeing both Karnak and Luxor Temple. Another night on the cruise.

days.title: Luxor
included: Guided tour of Valley of the Kings
optional: Early morning hot air balloon tour over the West Bank
days.description: You disembark after breakfast and explore the West Bank of Luxor. The day starts at the Colossi of Memnon, the remaining pieces of Amenophis III's temple. Next comes the Valley of the Kings, then a stop at an alabaster factory. You finish at the Temple of Hatshepsut before checking into your Luxor hotel.

days.title: Luxor
optional: Guided tour of Dendera Temple complex including Hathor Temple
days.description: You can choose to take an optional morning tour of the Dendera Temple complex, a well-preserved temple dating back to around 330 BC, or simply explore Luxor on your own. If you do the temple tour, your guide brings you back to the hotel. You stay another night in Luxor.

name: 8-Day Pyramids, Grand Egyptian Museum, Nile Cruise, Aswan, Abu Simbel, Luxor & Hurghada

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Our Egypt Itinerary 8 Days contain inside the best match of exciting excursions, comfortable accomodation and luxury transportation. Let yourself to experience a week full of joy and happiness! Visit authentic Cairo, see the Great Pyramids of Giza, explore ancient Luxor with its countless tombs and treasures, discover Nubian culture in Aswan and Abu Simbel and spend a great time on the Red Sea coast.

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo International Airport (CAI), Airport Rd, Al Shorouk, Cairo 11, Egypt (Main Entrance)
days.description: You'll land at Cairo airport and connect with your tour representative who arranges your private transfer to the hotel. The air-conditioned car gets you there whenever you arrive, so timing works around your flight.

days.title: Cairo - Giza Pyramids & Sphinx, Grand Egyptian Museum - Aswan
included: Guided tour of Giza Pyramids complex
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch at Pyramids/Nile view restaurant), Dinner
days.description: Start with breakfast at 7am and be ready by 8am to head out with your Egyptologist guide. Spend the morning at Giza Pyramids checking out the Great Pyramid, Great Sphinx, and Valley Temple. Lunch includes views of either the Pyramids or the Nile, then you'll visit the Grand Egyptian Museum where around 100,000 artifacts are on display, including Tutankhamun's treasures. By evening you're transferred to Giza station to board the sleeper train heading to Aswan.

days.title: Aswan
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast on the sleeper train), Lunch, Dinner
days.description: Have breakfast on the train as you arrive at Aswan station later in the morning. After transferring to your 5-star Nile cruise and freshening up, you'll visit Philae Temple which was dedicated to the goddess Isis. This temple was taken apart and moved to Agilkia Island during UNESCO's Nubia Campaign project to preserve it. You'll spend the night onboard the cruise ship.

days.title: Aswan - Kom Ombo
included: Guided tour of Kom Ombo Temple
days.description: There's an optional early morning trip to Abu Simbel if you're interested. During the afternoon, the cruise sails toward Kom Ombo, departing around 5pm. You'll tour Kom Ombo Temple which sits above the Nile and has an interesting layout with two temples, two entrances, two hypostyle halls, and two sanctuaries. The night is spent onboard again.

days.title: Edfu - Luxor
days.description: After breakfast, your guide leads a tour of Edfu Temple, which was built to honor the god Horus and remains one of Egypt's most well-preserved Greco-Roman temples with walls showing plays depicting Horus defeating Seth. The cruise continues sailing and reaches Luxor around 4pm. Later in the afternoon you'll check out Karnak Temple on the East Bank, a massive complex covering 247 acres with three main temples, and then visit Luxor Temple also on the East bank of the Nile. Overnight onboard the cruise.

days.title: Luxor - Hurghada
included: Guided tour of Valley of the Kings
Guided tour of Temple of Hatshepsut
Guided tour of Colossi of Memnon
optional: Hot air balloon ride over West bank of Luxor
days.description: An optional hot air balloon ride over Luxor's West Bank is available early in the morning if you want. After breakfast you'll check out from the cruise and head to Valley of the Kings where rock-cut tombs from pharaohs and nobles of the New Kingdom between the 16th and 11th centuries BC are carved into the rock. Then you'll see the Temple of Hatshepsut with its three massive terraces rising from the desert, plus the Colossi of Memnon, two large stone statues of Pharaoh Amenhotep III. An air-conditioned bus takes you to Hurghada city after that. You'll stay overnight in a Hurghada hotel.

days.title: Hurghada
optional: Paradise island trip by yacht with lunch and 2 snorkeling stops
days.description: This day is yours to do what you want at your beachfront hotel in Hurghada. You can try snorkeling or diving, relax on the white sand at the all-inclusive resort, or book an optional yacht trip to Paradise Island which includes lunch and two snorkeling stops. You'll stay another night at the resort.

days.title: Hurghada - Cairo
days.description: After breakfast you'll check out and get transferred by air-conditioned bus back to Cairo. When you arrive, your tour representative takes you either to Cairo International Airport or your Cairo accommodation depending on your plans. Tour services wrap up around 5pm.

name: 5 Days Magical Easter Island

attributes.name: Ancient Wonders
attributes.tip: Walk among ruins, temples, and timeless landmarks

intro:
Get ready for a unique experience visiting Easter Island!

The island is located more than 3700 km off the coast of Chile, in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, Rapa Nui or Easter Island, also known as "The Belly Button of the World" is the most insular island in the world.

The island is considered the largest archaeological museum site of the world, and it is definetely a place full of fascinating mystery! We invite you to come and explore the entire Rapa Nui culture, its moai, meadows, and its people. 

From Abril 1st to 12th, 2 big events will take place on the island, so rooms availability is limited.  

­

days.title: Easter Island Arrival
included: Airport transfer with flower necklace greeting
optional: Visit Tahai to watch sunset over moai statues
days.start_point: Isla de Pascua Rapa Nui, Isla de Pascua, Easter Island, Valparaíso 2770000, Chile (Pick uo at Mataveri Airport, Easter Island)
days.description: You'll arrive at Easter Island Airport and receive a traditional flower necklace before heading to your hotel. The rest of the day is open, so wander downtown Hanga Roa if you're feeling up for it and grab lunch at one of the local spots. If jet lag isn't hitting too hard, it's worth the 25-minute drive to Tahai to watch the sunset over the moai statues. It's where both locals and visitors go, and you'll get your first real look at what makes this island so distinctive.

days.title: Easter Island - Ahu Tongariki, Rano Raraku, Anakena Beach
included: Explore Rano Raraku volcano and moai quarry
Visit Ahu Tongariki platform with restored moai
Visit Te Pito Kura and see the Paro moai
Visit Ahu Nau-Nau at Anakena Beach
optional: Optional activities available for additional cost (specific activities to be confirmed with tour operator)
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch in a Rapa Nui family house with opportunity to learn about local trees, flowers and typical vegetation of the island)
days.description: You'll start at Ahu Akahanga to see some of Easter Island's most recognizable archaeological sites, then head to Rano Raraku volcano where nearly 400 moai statues were carved into the rock. The restored platforms at Ahu Tongariki come next, and you'll break for lunch at a local family house to get a sense of how people actually live here. After lunch, make your way to Te Pito Kura to stand in front of the largest moai that was ever successfully moved, then finish the day at Ahu Nau-Nau near Anakena Beach. You'll have time for a swim before wrapping up, so bring your swimsuit if you'd like to take a dip.

days.title: The Legend of the Bird Man & Mirando Las Estrellas Tours
included: Visit Ahu Akivi platform with 7 moai
Panoramic views of Hanga Roa village
Entrance fee to Rapa Nui National Park
days.description: Two separate guided tours hit different archaeological zones today. The morning session runs from 09:00 to 12:30 and covers Oronio, Rano Kau crater (the deepest and widest on the island), and Vinapu with its carved rocks and moai remains. Your afternoon tour starts at 14:30 until 17:30, taking you to Ahu Akivi and its 7 moai, then Ana Te Pahu which is an ancient lava tube cave people used for shelter, and finally Puna Pau where they quarried the pukao. Throughout both tours you'll catch panoramic views of Hanga Roa village below.

days.title: Easter Island Free Day with Optional Activities
optional: Rapa Nui Traditional Polynesian Show + Dinner (approximately 4 hours with round-trip hotel transportation)
Navigation to the Motus (Motu Kao Kao, Motu Iti and Motu Nui)
Snorkeling (all equipment included: fins, diving goggles, diving suit, floats and ladders)
Half Day Horseback riding (3 hours, minimum 2 / maximum 5 people)
days.description: Breakfast at your hotel starts the day, then it's yours to do as you like. Several optional activities are available if you want them (extra cost applies). You could catch sunrise at Ahu Tongariki or sunset at Ahu Tahai, take in a traditional Polynesian show with dinner, boat out to nearby islets, go snorkeling with gear provided, ride horses through spots the roads don't reach, or try surfing if you're into the waves. name: Circle Indochine 16 Days - Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Partially Guided
attributes.tip: Independent travel, featuring selected guided excursions

intro: It is a truly great round of Laos Thailand Vietnam Cambodia tour. Your journey starts in the magnificent capital, Bangkok, with splendid temples, unique floating markets, and must-visit historical sites. Then, go to the Capital of Khmer Civilization in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Soak in the magical beauty of Angkor Wat, experience unique things like riding a tuk-tuk around the city, or join a blessing ceremony.  After experiencing local life here, travel along the rich land, Vietnam. Savor amazing Vietnam travel bit by bit from the mighty Mekong and complex Cu Chi Tunnels to the majestic Ha Long and the poetic land of Ninh Binh. The fourth country will be Laos with the mysterious Luang Prabang. Have a laid-back day to religious Pak Ou and the multi-tiered Khouangsi Waterfall. Lastly, back to Thailand once more to perfect your Indochina tour in 16 days.

days.title: Bangkok
days.start_point: Suvarnabhumi Airport Cargo Clearance Customs Bureau, Suvarnabhumi Airport, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand (Bangkok International Airport ( BKK), 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive in Bangkok and meet your driver at the airport for the transfer to your hotel. After checking in, you can rest and adjust to the local time.

days.title: Bangkok
included: Visit Railway Track Market (Rom Hoop Market / Siang Tai Market) near Mae Klong railway station
Long tail boat ride through canals to Damnen Saduak Floating Market (approximately 30-45 minutes)
landmarks: Railway Track Market (Rom Hoop Market / Siang Tai Market)
days.description: Breakfast comes first at your hotel, then you'll meet your English guide at 7:30 AM. The morning takes you to the Railway Track Market near Mae Klong railway station, followed by a long tail boat ride through the canals to Damnen Saduak Floating Market (about 30-45 minutes). You'll browse local Thai products and grab some food before heading back to Bangkok for lunch. Later in the afternoon, three temples are on the itinerary: Wat Traimit featuring a 5.5-ton solid gold Buddha, Wat Pho with its 45-meter Reclining Buddha and traditional massage center, and Wat Benjamabophit with marble architecture.

days.title: Bangkok to Siem Reap
optional: Explore Bangkok at your own pace
days.description: After breakfast, you have the morning and early afternoon to explore Bangkok on your own. Your driver will then transfer you to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon landing, you'll be taken to your hotel for check-in.

days.title: Siem Reap
included: Visit South Gate of Angkor Thom
Visit Terrace of the Leper King
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll spend the day visiting temples at Angkor Thom, including the South Gate, Bayon Temple with its 54 towers built in the late 12th to early 13th century, the Royal Enclosure, Phimeanakas, Elephants Terrace, and Terrace of the Leper King. Afterward you'll see Ta Prohm surrounded by jungle, and Angkor Wat, the world's largest temple covering 200 hectares with surrounding moat and walls measuring 1300m by 1500m.

days.title: Siem Reap
included: Boat ride on Tonle Sap Lake to floating villages by traditional wooden boat
Visit silk farm with silk creation process demonstration
days.description: After breakfast, a traditional wooden boat takes you out on Tonle Sap Lake to explore floating villages with stilted houses and fish traps, giving insight into life tied to the lake's cycles. In the afternoon, you'll drive about 15 km west to Pouk district to visit a silk farm where you can watch the entire process from worm breeding through dyeing and looming. You'll browse retail silk and souvenirs, then visit the Western Baray (8 km by 2.3 km) on the return route.

days.title: Siem Reap to Ho Chi Minh City
optional: Explore Siem Reap at your own pace
days.description: Breakfast at your hotel precedes free time to explore Siem Reap at your own pace. Your driver will transfer you to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. After arriving at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, you'll be escorted to your hotel for check-in.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Mekong Delta
included: Visit coconut island in Ben Tre
Visit local family home with tropical fruit tasting
Honey tea and honey wine tasting
Coconut candy shop visit and candy-making lesson
optional: Short bike ride in the village
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Special Vietnamese food at local restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, a bus takes you to My Tho in the Mekong Delta with your English-speaking guide (approximately 1.5 hours). You'll see green rice paddies along the way. Vinh Trang Pagoda, the largest in the Mekong Delta, is your first stop. In My Tho, a boat trip along the Mekong River shows you fish cages and floating houses, then you'll explore a small canal and visit a coconut island in Ben Tre. A local family home gives you the chance to sample tropical fruit, honey tea, honey wine, and traditional Vietnamese music. The coconut candy shop teaches you about candy-making, and you'll explore handicrafts before lunch at a local restaurant. Leisure time in the village follows, then return to Ho Chi Minh City by around 5:00 PM.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
optional: Fire AK47, MK16, or machine guns at nearby shooting range
days.description: Your English-speaking guide picks you up for a trip to Cu Chi Tunnels in the countryside near Ho Chi Minh City (approximately 1 hour 30 minutes away). You'll explore the extensive underground tunnel network that once stretched to Cambodia and included meeting rooms, kitchens, and triage areas. Learning about the harsh living conditions and Vietnamese resilience during the war provides historical context. You can try manioc, the main food of guerilla warriors. Visitors have the option to fire AK47, MK16, or machine guns at a nearby shooting range. Later you'll return to your accommodation.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi
optional: Explore Ho Chi Minh City at your own pace
days.description: Breakfast at your hotel gives way to free time exploring Ho Chi Minh City on your own. Your driver will transfer you to the airport for your flight to Hanoi. After arriving at Noi Bai International Airport, you'll be taken to your hotel for check-in.

days.title: Hanoi to Tam Coc
included: Visit Hoa Lu historic temples (Le and Dinh Dynasties)
Boat trip through Tam Coc with karst formations and limestone caves
Cycling in Tam Coc-Bich Dong villages (approximately 1 hour, around 5 km)
days.description: Your guide and driver pick you up at your Hanoi Old Quarter hotel and travel by coach to Hoa Lu (2.5 hours). You'll visit the historic ancient capital of Vietnam and temples of the Le and Dinh Dynasties. Then transfer to Tam Coc for lunch around 12:30 PM. In the afternoon, a boat trip through Tam Coc shows you karst formations and rows into caves carved through limestone. Cycling for about an hour on quiet roads through villages, rice fields, rivers, and rocky outcrops in the Tam Coc-Bich Dong area (around 5 km) follows. You'll return to Hanoi and arrive at your hotel around 6:30 PM.

days.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay
included: Transfer to Halong Bay across Red River Delta
Traditional junk boat cruise on Halong Bay
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and transfer to Halong Bay by scenic route across the Red River Delta with emerald green rice paddies. Upon arrival, you'll board a traditional junk for a full day and night cruise among 3,000 limestone islets. Kayaking on gentle waters lets you admire the crystal clear water, islands, and diverse flora and fauna. As the sun sets over the lagoon, a seafood meal and shore excursions from the boat complete the evening. You'll spend the night on the luxury boat.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
included: Cave exploration with stalagmites and stalactites
days.description: Morning starts early with a laid-back atmosphere on the cruise. Tai Chi lessons happen on the sundeck before breakfast. You'll explore a cave full of stalagmites and stalactites, then return by boat to the harbor for the trip back to Hanoi, arriving around 4:30 PM. Your driver will drop you off at your hotel.

days.title: Hanoi to Luang Prabang
optional: Explore Hanoi at your own pace
days.description: Breakfast at your hotel comes before free time exploring Hanoi at your own pace. Your driver will transfer you to the airport for your flight to Luang Prabang. After arriving at Luang Prabang International Airport, you'll be escorted to your hotel for check-in.

days.title: Luang Prabang
included: Participate in morning alms-giving ritual with Buddhist monks (optional early start)
Guided tour of Wat Sene temple
Swimming and forest trail walking at Khouangsi Waterfall
Visit Ban Xangkhong village for silk handweaving and Saa paper making
days.description: Start early to catch the morning alms-giving ritual with Buddhist monks, then walk through Luang Prabang's oldest temples like Wat Sene and Wat Xiengthong. In the afternoon, head out to local Lao ethnic minority villages before making your way to Khouangsi Waterfall where you can swim in the turquoise pools or hike the forest trails. On the way back, stop at Ban Xangkhong village to see traditional silk weaving and Saa paper making, then catch the sunset at Wat Siphouthabath.

days.title: Luang Prabang to Bangkok
days.description: After breakfast, you'll take a flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, your driver will escort you to your hotel for check-in.

days.title: Departure
days.description: Your driver will pick you up at your hotel and take you to the airport to catch your flight back home. The tour ends here.

reviews.author: Eugenia
reviews.body: Overall communication with Tour Radar was good and With Dat at Prestigo once we started our trip. He was very...
reviews.reply:
Dear Eugenia,
Thank you very much for your patience.
Following your feedback, I would like to clarify each of your points—not only regarding Phuket, but across the entire trip—so you can better understand our approach and services.
1. TourRadar platform
Regarding the TourRadar platform, it does not allow additional participants to join the conversation, and the system is fixed. As a tour operator, we do not have control over this feature. However, we will certainly pass your feedback on to the TourRadar team.
2. Cruise & accommodation standards
Concerning Orchid Cruise, it is a luxury cruise in Ha Long Bay, but with a different concept and style compared to Calista. Orchid Cruise follows a more traditional “junk boat” design, which many travelers appreciate, while Calista offers a more modern concept. Both are considered luxury, but with different experiences.
We understand that expectations regarding “luxury” can vary. For example, your hotel in Hanoi was a 5-star boutique hotel rather than an international luxury brand.
At the beginning, we did not clearly understand your preference for high-end luxury accommodations. If we had known your expectations more specifically, we would have recommended more exclusive options. This is why the Phuket, Katathani is a 5-star beachfront resort was added.

Additionally, we initially proposed balanced options to avoid significantly increasing the overall cost, as luxury upgrades can raise the price considerably—and we noticed your concern when the quotation increased based on your hotel preferences.
If you could share a clearer idea of your preferred level of luxury in the future, we would be able to tailor our recommendations more precisely.
3. Guide in Ninh Binh
We sincerely apologize for the issue with the guide in Ninh Binh. This was due to a misunderstanding, and we addressed it immediately once we were informed. The guide has been penalized, and we trust he still took proper care of your group during the trip.
4. Accommodation in Dong Hoi
Dong Hoi is not a major tourist destination; most travelers stay there mainly to visit Phong Nha Cave. Due to logistical reasons, at least two nights are required to explore the area properly.
, Dong Hoi is not particularly known for its beaches, and during the low season, beach conditions are not as favorable compared to other destinations.
5. Mekong Delta experience
The Mekong Delta is one of the most popular destinations for travelers visiting Ho Chi Minh City. As your trip took place during peak season, it was naturally more crowded. Most day tours in the Mekong Delta follow similar itineraries and activities. We apologize if the experience did not feel as authentic as expected.
6. Phuket – Phi Phi tour
Regarding the Phi Phi tour, we received your feedback about the scuba diving activity, which unfortunately could not be completed due to issues from the boat operator. We have already agreed to refund this portion.
Other parts of the tour were completed as planned with a private speedboat. Please note that Phi Phi Islands are among the busiest tourist destinations in Phuket, and most key highlights were covered during your trip.
The additional fee you paid for the speedboat was for a private service rather than a shared group tour only.
Regarding your feedback about the guide and crew, we were only informed after the trip. At this stage, it is more difficult to verify with the boat operator. If this had been raised during the tour, we could have addressed it immediately and provided a timely solution.

Thank you again for your valuable feedback—it is truly helpful for us to improve our services.
This was a customized itinerary, different from our standard package such as Circle Indochine 16 Days, and your insights are extremely important for us to refine future experiences.
We sincerely hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with an even better experience.
Wishing you a wonderful day.
Best regards,

intro:
Discover the best of Portugal on this unforgettable 10-day journey from historic Lisbon through picturesque towns, stunning coastal landscapes, and the serene Douro Valley. Beginning in Lisbon, enjoy free time to soak up the city’s vibrant culture and sample local flavors before heading north to the legendary pilgrimage site of Fátima and the fairytale palaces of Sintra. Travel onward to Porto, where you’ll explore the charming riverside district, taste world-famous Port wines and glide along the Douro River on a scenic cruise. Then relax in the sun-soaked Algarve region, with all-inclusive meals and beach days at your leisure. With sightseeing, river cruises, wine tastings, comfortable accommodations and seamless transfers, this tour blends culture, history, gastronomy and relaxation into a perfectly balanced Portuguese escape.


TOUR HIGHLIHTS


✔ Explore Lisbon’s historic quarters, enjoy Porto’s riverside charm, and relax on the sunny Algarve coast.

✔ Comfortable 4-star hotels throughout.

✔ Travel by comfortable train between Lisbon, Porto and Albufeira.

✔ Savor local wines, dine overlooking terraced vineyards, and cruise along the picturesque Douro River.

✔ Unwind with free days at an all-inclusive Algarve beach resort, with meals and drinks included for a stress-free stay.

days.description: After breakfast, you'll head north from Lisbon to Fátima. From there, check out several locations around town connected to these apparitions, including the angel apparition site and the 1917 apparition location.

Later in the day, end at Monserrate Palace, another former summer residence used by the Portuguese court.

days.title: Lisbon to Porto
days.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to the train station to board your train to Porto. When you arrive in Porto, transfer to your hotel and get settled in for the next part of your trip.

days.title: Porto
included: Hop-on hop-off bus tour of Porto

days.description: You'll start with breakfast and then use a hop-on hop-off bus ticket to explore Porto's historic setting. Head to Ribeira, the oldest district, and have traditional Portuguese lunch at a café near the medieval walls. Later, visit the Cales Câlem cellars to sample different port wines including white, dry, and ruby. Wrap up the day with a scenic cruise on the Douro River, passing under 6 of the city's bridges.

days.title: Porto to Douro Valley
included: Lunch overlooking the vineyards on a family wine estate
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch overlooking the vineyards on a family wine estate)

Later, relax with a 1-hour Douro River cruise in Pinho.

Head down Drosselgasse alley where half-timbered buildings and rustic wine taverns line the street. Then at 4 PM you'll depart for Mainz, arriving around 7 PM. Once there, take a walk along the riverbank or visit Saint Martin's Cathedral if you want to see its richly decorated interior before settling in for the evening.

days.description: You'll land in Frankfurt at 6:00 AM and have the morning to get oriented in this city along the Main River. The downtown area has plenty of banks and high-rises, but there's more to it than that. Head to Goethe's birthplace to see where the famous writer grew up, and you'll get a sense of the city's cultural side too. Between the business districts and these historical spots, you can piece together how Frankfurt has developed over time. Grab breakfast at a local café and spend your time walking through the different neighborhoods.

By 10:00 AM, you'll reach the Loreley Valley, which gives you time to see the northern Rhine landscape and walk around a bit. The scenery here is different from what you saw in Frankfurt, and it's worth checking out. Then you'll continue downriver and pull into Koblenz by 3:00 PM. This city has Roman history mixed with modern elements, so you can explore both. The Kaisarin-Augusta-Anlagen park runs along the Rhine waterfront and is a good place to stretch your legs after being on the boat.

intro:
Enjoy an exciting journey to Switzerland on the 7-day trip to the charming cities, natural beauty, and spectacular views. 

We start our small group tour every Sunday in Zurich and explore the main region's historical and cultural diversity. 

Stay in 4-star accommodation and relax next to picturesque Swiss lakes and mountain scenery.

days.title: Zurich
days.start_point: Vorfahrt Abflug 2 2, 8302 Kloten, Switzerland (Zurich Airport Arrival Zone 2, 08:00 - 23:30)
days.description: You'll arrive at Zurich Airport and meet your representative at Arrivals Zone 2, who'll take you to your hotel via complimentary private transfer. After settling in, the evening is yours to spend however you'd like, so consider taking a walk around the neighborhood near your accommodation or grabbing dinner at a nearby restaurant to get a feel for the area.

days.title: Zurich - Rhine Falls - Lucerne - Interlaken
included: Zurich panoramic walking tour of historical quarters
days.description: After breakfast, you'll take a walking tour through Zurich's historical quarters with panoramic views. From there, you'll head out to see the Rhine Falls, which is Europe's most powerful waterfall and definitely worth the visit. Then it's on to Lucerne where you can walk through the historic areas and check out the architecture. By evening, you'll transfer to the Interlaken region.

days.title: Interlaken - Bernese Oberland
optional: Day trip to Jungfraujoch - Guided train and Eiger Express journey to Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 meters with stop at Eismeer station

Discover Lauterbrunnen Waterfalls Valley (November-March: includes Giessbach waterfall, Iseltwald village, Sigriswill Bridge; April-October: includes Reichenbach Falls, Aareschlucht glacial gorge, Trummelbach waterfall)
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll spend the day exploring the Bernese Oberland region. What you see depends on when you're traveling (November through March has different scenery than April through October), but you'll encounter waterfalls, scenic valleys, and mountain villages. There's also an optional day trip available to Jungfraujoch if you want to go to Europe's highest railway station.

intro: Cornwall; a region where enchantment awaits you at every turn. Situated on the southwestern tip of the UK, Cornwall is a land steeped in history and myth, boasting beautiful beaches with pristine towns, ancient castles and fine modern art. Looking back, the legendary King Arthur fought passionately for this rugged far-flung land and it certainly is not difficult to see why. From smugglers to surfers, cream teas to the delicious Cornish pasty; Cornwall casts a spell on every visitor, with its unique charm, unspoiled beauty and the sense of mystery often leaving those that visit feeling as though they have gone back in time. With Dacey’s you can tour cornwall in a unique and relaxed way.

days.title: London
optional: Explore South Bank of the Thames
days.description: You'll arrive in London and have the day to explore at your own pace. Walk along the South Bank of the Thames, pop into St Paul's Cathedral, check out the museums, or catch a West End show if that interests you. You're staying overnight in London, so take your time getting oriented and finding a good spot for dinner.

days.title: London to Tintagel
days.description: Leave London at 8:00am and drive to Cornwall, reaching the historic town of Tintagel by afternoon. This is where King Arthur's legend took root, and you'll explore the castle ruins and walk the newly built rope bridge. The coastal views here are pretty dramatic. You'll stay overnight in North Cornwall.

days.title: Tintagel
included: Informative walk through Truro historic city centre with guide
days.description: Your guide walks you through Truro's historic city centre, pointing out the architecture and local stories as you go. From there, you'll drive to Charlestown, a charming coastal town worth a quick look around. In the afternoon, head to the Eden Project, Cornwall's most-visited attraction with two enormous biomes set into what used to be a china clay mine from the 1800s. If you want something with more excitement, there's a zipline experience available to book. Later in the day, you'll drive back to your hotel in North Cornwall, the same place where you stayed the night before.

days.title: Port Isaac - St Michaels Mount - St Ives
optional: Visit the old schoolhouse in Port Isaac
Visit the surgery set from Doc Martin
Walk through St Michael's Mount subtropical gardens
Explore St Ives boutique shops and galleries
days.description: Travel 20 minutes down the coast to Port Isaac, famous from the Doc Martin television series. Walk through the streets, visit the old schoolhouse bar, and see the surgery set from the show. After lunch, head to St Michael's Mount to see its castle and gardens. Later in the afternoon, drive to St Ives where you can walk the beaches, browse galleries and shops, or visit the Tate. You're staying overnight in St Ives.

days.title: Lands End - Porthgwwara - Minack Theatre - Merry Maidens
optional: Visit Minack Theatre (shows subject to availability)
days.description: Spend the day exploring Land's End with its dramatic cliffs and wild coastal scenery. If Poldark interests you, the cliffs at Porthgwwara are where they filmed those scenes. Check out the Minack Theatre, a unique outdoor venue built into the cliffs, and visit Merry Maidens, a local stone circle similar to Stonehenge. Return to St Ives by late afternoon for more time wandering the beaches and town. You're staying another night in St Ives.

days.title: Lanhydrock - Exeter
optional: Enjoy English afternoon tea in Exeter
days.description: Walk through the narrow medieval streets of Fowey, then drive to Lanhydrock, a National Trust property with beautiful gardens and a 17th-century house to explore. Continue north to Exeter, where you'll take a 90-minute guided walking tour covering the old and new parts of this historic Roman settlement. Spend the afternoon strolling the quieter streets and trying afternoon tea if you like. You'll stay overnight in Exeter.

days.title: Exeter to London
days.description: Leave Exeter at 8:30am for the drive back to London, arriving around 2:30pm where your tour ends. You'll have time to settle in before heading home or making other plans.

intro:
First Discovery is the ideal excursion route around the country for those who go to Switzerland for the first time and would like to see as much as possible within 6 days. 

The tour is dynamic, and the excursion program is complete, but you always have enough time for leisure.  

Explore lakes and alpine landscapes from Geneva to Gruyeres region, the Waterfalls Valley, Interlaken, Bern, Montreux, and Lausanne with accommodation in 4-star hotels and entry tickets.

days.title: Geneva
days.start_point: Aéroport de Genève Cointrin (GVA), Route de l'Aéroport, Genève, Geneva 1215, Switzerland (Arrival Zone, 07:00 - 23:00)
days.description: You'll touch down at Geneva Airport and head to your hotel to get settled. The rest of the evening is yours to do as you like, whether that's resting after your journey or taking a walk around the neighborhood to get your bearings.

days.title: Geneva to Interlaken
included: Lauterbrunnen Waterfalls Valley tour (seasonal: May-October includes Reichenbach Falls, Aareschlucht glacial gorge, and Trummelbach Falls; November-April includes Staubbach Waterfall and Giessbach waterfall)
Visit Iseltwald village on Lake Brienz shores
optional: Day trip to Jungfraujoch - Guided train and Eiger Express journey to Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 meters above sea level with stop at Eismeer station
days.description: Start early at 7:30 am when you leave the hotel and travel toward Interlaken. What you see depends on when you're visiting. From May through October, you'll check out the Lauterbrunnen Waterfalls Valley, see Reichenbach Falls and Trummelbach Falls, and walk through the Aareschlucht glacial gorge. If you're going November through April, you'll visit Staubbach Waterfall, Giessbach waterfall, the small village of Iseltwald on Lake Brienz, and cross the Sigriswill Bridge. Once you arrive in Interlaken, you have free time to wander around town in the evening.

days.title: Interlaken to Montreux
included: Explore Bern City with fountains, sandstone facades, arcades, and historic towers
Gruyères cheese factory (La Maison du Gruyère) visit
days.description: After breakfast, you travel to Bern to walk through the medieval old town, seeing the fountains, historic towers, and impressive sandstone buildings with their characteristic arcades. From there, head to Gruyères where you can tour the cheese factory, La Maison du Gruyères, and visit the Cailler chocolate factory. By evening, you'll reach the Montreux region and settle in for the night.

days.title: Montreux
optional: Visit Queen: The Studio Experience museum
Scenic steamboat cruise on Lake Geneva from Vevey
days.description: This day is yours to plan however you like in the Swiss Riviera area. You could walk along Montreux's promenade lined with flowers, stop by the Queen: The Studio Experience museum, or visit Chaplin's World dedicated to Charlie Chaplin. Alternatively, take a scenic steamboat cruise on Lake Geneva from Vevey and enjoy views of the Swiss and French Alps from the water.

days.title: Montreux to Geneva
days.description: After breakfast, visit Chillon Castle, which is the most visited historical monument in the country. Spend time exploring the embankments in both Montreux and Vevey, then continue to Lausanne to see the Olympic Park. Later, you'll head back to Geneva for a walking tour of the city and stay overnight there.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka
days.start_point: 関西国際空港 (Kansai International Airport) (KIX), 泉州空港北1, 泉南郡, Osaka 549-0011, Japan (Kansai International Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at Kansai International Airport and head into Osaka by train, which is just one station away from your hotel. After checking in, you can settle in for the evening and get some rest from your flight.

days.title: Osaka - Nara - Osaka
included: Explore Todaiji Temple (UNESCO World Heritage site)
Feed free-roaming deer in Nara Park with deer senbei
optional: Purchase deer senbei crackers (150 yen per pack) to feed deer
days.description: You'll drive out to Nara for the afternoon and start at Nara Park, where you can see the massive Todaiji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site that's been around for over 1200 years. The park has hundreds of deer roaming freely, and you'll be able to feed them with crackers they provide. From there, head to Kasuga Taisha, one of Nara's most important shrines. You'll have time to grab lunch on your own somewhere in the area. After that, it's back to Osaka for check-in at your hotel, and the rest of your evening is free to do whatever you like.

days.title: Osaka
optional: Hiroshima Optional Tour with Shinkansen Bullet Train (Door to Door service with hotel pickup at 8:30 and return after Peace Memorial Park visit)
Visit Itsukushima Shrine and Miyajima Island (11:30-13:30)
Visit Atomics Dome and Ground Zero (15:30-16:30)
Shinkansen bullet train journey to and from Hiroshima
days.description: This day is completely open for you to wander around Osaka at your own pace and see what interests you. If you'd prefer a structured outing, there's an optional door-to-door tour to Hiroshima you can book. That tour uses Japan's famous Shinkansen bullet train and takes the full day. You'd visit Itsukushima Shrine and Miyajima Island, see the Atomics Dome at Ground Zero, and walk through the Peace Memorial Park. The tour includes hotel pickup and drop-off, so all the transportation is handled for you.

days.title: Osaka to Kyoto
days.description: Head to Kyoto and start at Fushimi Inari Shrine with its thousands of vermilion torii gates. A half-day guided tour then takes you through Kinkaku-ji (the Golden Pavilion), Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, and Togetsu Bashi Bridge before returning to Kyoto station.

days.title: Kyoto to Nagano/Yamanashi
included: Visit Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
landmarks: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
days.description: Visit the Toyota Commemorative Museum to learn how the Toyota family grew from a village into a global company. After lunch, explore Naraijuku, an old town that feels like 17th century Japan, and pass through Tsumagoi Village before arriving at your hotel in the Nagano or Yamanashi area.

days.title: Lake Yamanaka and Mt. Fuji
included: Scenic boat ride around Lake Yamanaka
days.description: Drive through countryside and mountains to reach Lake Yamanaka, the largest of the Fuji Five Lakes, known for swans and views of Mt. Fuji. You'll take a scenic boat ride around the lake, then drive up to Mt. Fuji 5th Station at 2300m for panoramic views before checking into your hotel.

days.title: Tokyo One Day Tour
included: Explore Omote Sando and Takeshita Street
Visit Tokyo Tower with admission included
Free time in Shinjuku Kabukicho area
days.description: Join a guided one-day Tokyo tour that starts at Meiji Shrine, then moves to shopping at Omote Sando and Takeshita Street. You'll see a private Japanese traditional rock garden and visit Tokyo Tower with admission included. The evening is free to spend time in Shinjuku Kabukicho exploring the nightlife.

days.title: Departure
days.description: After breakfast, your guide will help you figure out the best route to either Haneda or Narita Airport. You'll depart at the right time to catch your flight back home.

reviews.reply:
Dear Lucia,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback following your recent tour with us. We sincerely appreciate your comments as they help us continually evaluate and refine our travel experiences.

We would like to take a moment to address the points you raised:

Airport Transfers & Distances: We regret if there was any confusion regarding Tokyo's airport geography prior to your journey. To clarify, our pre-trip documentation and communications advise guests that Tokyo is served by two main international airports: Haneda Airport (HND) and Narita International Airport (NRT). We explicitly note that Haneda is significantly closer to downtown Tokyo and our central hotel locations, whereas Narita is located further out in neighboring Chiba Prefecture, which naturally requires additional travel time to reach the city center.

Tour Pace & Itinerary: Our multi-city Japan itineraries are designed to cover a broad array of iconic highlights within a limited timeframe. While this allowed the group to experience many key sights, we understand that a fast-paced schedule can feel hurried, and we appreciate your input on balancing sightseeing time with a more relaxed flow.

Hotels & Transportation: Hotel room sizes in Japanese metropolitan centers are notoriously compact compared to Western standards, though cleanliness and convenience are always our priority. Regarding transportation, our chartered coaches strictly adhere to local safety regulations, though we recognize that comfort during longer drives is essential for an enjoyable journey.

We truly regret that these aspects impacted your overall impression of the trip. Your feedback has been shared with our operations team to help us improve communication and tour arrangements for future guests.

Sincerely,

Guest Relations Team

Stunning Tours

Lavanya

intro:
Embark on a journey of luxury and intrigue. Travel across Egypt as you follow in the footsteps of the legendary author, Agatha Christie. This ultra-luxury journey will take you on a fascinating adventure through the land of Pharaohs, pyramids, and ancient mysteries. Journey along the  bustling streets of Cairo,to the tranquil banks of the Nile, and experience the very best that Egypt has to offer. You will enjoy staying in some of the most luxurious accommodations in the country. With expert guides,and exclusive access to some of Egypt's most iconic sites, this journey is sure to be an unforgettable experience for any traveler seeking adventure, luxury, and a touch of mystery.

*Complimentary Abu simbel tour by car 

* Domestic flights from cairo to Luxor/ Aswan to cairo are included.

days.title: Cairo
included: Sunset dinner by the pyramids and Sphinx
days.meals: Dinner (Sunset dinner by the pyramids and Sphinx)
days.start_point: Cairo International Airport (CAI), Airport Rd, Al Shorouk, Cairo 11, Egypt (Cairo international airport, 00:05 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll arrive in Cairo and meet your representative who handles your transfer to a historic hotel located near the Great Pyramid of Giza. After settling in, you'll have dinner by the pyramids and Sphinx with your group as the sun sets over the plateau.

days.title: Cairo to Luxor
included: Tour of Giza Plateau pyramids of Mycerinus, Chephren, and Great Pyramid
Interior access to one of the pyramids
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll spend the morning on the Giza Plateau touring the Great Pyramid, Pyramid of Chephren, and Pyramid of Mycerinus. The Great Sphinx comes next, then you'll head to the Grand Egyptian Museum. Later in the afternoon you'll fly to Luxor and check into your 5-star resort on the Nile's banks.

days.title: Luxor
included: Temple of Karnak tour including Great Hypostyle Hall
Temple of Luxor tour including statues of Ramses II and Colonnade of Amenhotep III
days.description: This day focuses on Luxor's two major temples. You'll start at the Temple of Karnak to walk through the Great Hypostyle Hall with its 80-foot columns, then move to the Temple of Luxor to see the three large statues of Ramses II and the 50-foot columns of Amenhotep III's Colonnade.

days.title: Luxor - West Bank
included: Lunch on board luxury Dahabya Nile cruise boat
optional: Sunrise hot air balloon over West Bank of Luxor
Entry into tomb of Seti I
Luxor city tour by horse carriage
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast on board cruise boat), Lunch (Lunch on board luxury Dahabya Nile cruise boat), Dinner
days.description: An optional sunrise hot air balloon ride over the West Bank is available if you want it. After breakfast, you'll head to the West Bank to see the Colossi of Memnon and the Temple of Hatshepsut, then explore the Valley of the Kings including Tutankhamun's tomb and Seti I's decorated tomb (optional). You'll board your luxury Dahabya Nile cruise boat for lunch, with an optional evening horse carriage tour of Luxor.

days.title: West Bank - Nile Cruise
included: Tombs of the Nobles tour (Ramose, Userhet, Khaemhat, and Menna)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll explore tombs of nobles like Ramose, Userhet, Khaemhat, and Menna to see their intricate wall paintings and hieroglyphics. The Medinat Habu temple complex comes next with its main temple, shrines, courtyards, and pharaoh statues. You'll also stop at Howard Carter's house before returning to your cruise boat by noon for lunch and afternoon Nile sailing.

days.title: Nile Cruise - Kom Ombo
days.description: You'll begin by viewing the Temple of Horus, the falcon-headed deity temple built in 230 BC. Your boat then cruises to Kom Ombo where you'll enjoy a scenic drink as you travel. There you'll visit the Greco-Roman temple dedicated to Haroeris and Sobek, and see mummified crocodile remains from ancient times.

days.title: Aswan - Philae
days.description: Starting after breakfast, you'll visit Philae temple dedicated to the goddess Isis with its well-preserved ruins, main sanctuary, smaller chapels, and carved reliefs from ancient Egyptian mythology. You'll return to your cruise boat for lunch and relaxation, then take a felucca ride on the Nile River in the afternoon, enjoying desert landscape views and chances to spot birds and wildlife.

days.title: Aswan to Cairo
included: Abu Simbel temples of Ramses II and Nefertari tour
days.description: You'll disembark from your cruise boat and drive to Abu Simbel to see the twin temples of Ramses II and Queen Nefertari with their four 70-foot-tall statues of the pharaoh. Your guide will explain how the entire site was disassembled and relocated to escape the Aswan High Dam floodwaters. Later you'll fly back to Cairo and check into your hotel.

days.title: Cairo - Old City
days.description: A guided tour takes you through Old Cairo's history and culture. You'll visit Islamic Coptic sites including Sultan Hassan and Al Rafay mosques, plus the Hanging Church. Then you'll head to Khan El Khalili Bazaar, one of the Middle East's oldest markets, where you can wander through traditional workshops, check out handicrafts, spices, perfumes, jewelry, and textiles.

days.title: Cairo - Departure
days.description: You'll have breakfast and check out from your Cairo hotel. Your transfer takes you to Cairo Airport for your departure.

intro:
This safari features all of the popular Northern Circuit game parks. This safari departs with special discounted offers during the April and May departures. With the Best of Tanzania Safari travel in custom designed 4×4 safari vehicles with open roofs for game viewing. This is a small group seat-in vehicle safari with a maximum of 6 travelers per vehicle, all with window seats. Traveling for 8- days, the Safari is inclusive of Meals, Accommodation, Park entry Fees and all Government Taxes, The Destinations are Lake Manyara National Park, Serengeti National Park & Ngorongoro Conservation Area Authority (The great Ngororongo Crater).

- Not only National Parks but Tanzania has a Tribe cultural attractions, which our visitors enjoy more, example

Chagga Culture as well as Maasai Culture, but on our 9- Days Endless Experience you will visit materuni waterfall

and coffee plantation which is Found in Materuni Hamlet, wich is in the URU area and it is home to the Chagga

people where you will be able to have variety of activities

­ 

WHY BOOK THIS TRAVEL PLAN?

(1) View an Extraordinary variety of Wildlife, includind Wildlife.

-Africa's five most recognizable and sought-after game animals—the African lion, African elephant, African leopard, Cape buffalo, and black rhinoceros—are collectively referred to as the "Big 5." These animals have been the focus of several stories, folklore, and traditional beliefs, and they hold great cultural value in Africa. An opportunity to engage with this rich cultural legacy is to go on a big five safari in Tanzania. Tarangire National Park, Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara, and the Serengeti are all places in Tanzania where you may cross off the Big Five on your bucket list. Because every park has a different assortment of species, you will be able to witness a wide variety of wildlife in a comparatively short space. Welcome to Book with us.

­ 

(2) This is our best-selling travel plan.

-And this is Becouse, The accommodation is comfortable, charming, and great value for money.

­ 

(3) The main parks are all on this travel plan.

-The most well-known national parks in Tanzania are Tarangire, Serengeti, Ngorongoro, and Lake Manyara. Since we strongly want our visitors to have a great time, we have bundled all of these parks into one package at the lowest possible cost. 

­ 

(4) Proffesional Safari Guide.

-Safari Guide who speak English know the ins and outs of the parks and education in conservation and the animals. This will give your safari experience depth.

­ 

(5) Explore in open-rooftop vehicles, offering spectacular views of the natural surroundings and its inhabitants

­ 

Tanzania Wildlife Adventures, We have good guides with sufficient knowledge and have the ability to work for a long time, our hotels are beautiful with an attractive environment and great tranquility, some of our hotels are located inside  park and others outside of the the park. 

We’re convinced that our safari in Tanzania will be an experience you’ll never forget!

days.title: Arrival in Moshi
days.start_point: Moshi, Kilimanjaro, Tanzania (Springlands Hotel )
days.description: You'll land at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport where a driver meets you with a nameplate. From there, it's a transfer to Springlands Hotel in Moshi for check-in and a welcome meal. After you settle in, experienced safari coordinators will walk you through what to expect on the upcoming expedition. The hotel has a swimming pool, garden, bar, and restaurant if you want to relax before dinner.

days.title: Tarangire National Park
included: Game drive in Tarangire National Park
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive out to Tarangire National Park for game drives across this wildlife sanctuary. The landscape shifts between riverine forests, acacia woodlands, and rolling hills dotted with ancient baobab trees. Keep your eyes open for elephants, giraffes, and buffalo moving through the terrain, and if you're lucky, you might spot rare antelope species or African wild hunting dogs. By evening, you'll head back to your lodge.

days.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park
included: Game drive en route to Serengeti
optional: Maasai village visit (at an additional fee)
Olduvai Gorge visit (at an additional fee) - known as the Cradle of Humanity with museum
days.description: Starting after breakfast, you'll travel to Serengeti National Park, whose name means 'endless plain' in the Maasai language. On the way, there's an option to visit a Maasai village or Olduvai Gorge if you want to learn about local culture and early human history (both require additional payment). During the drive to your lodge, you'll also have game drives to spot wildlife along the route.

days.title: Serengeti National Park
included: Full day game drive in Serengeti National Park
days.description: This day is yours to explore Serengeti National Park fully. The park's famous for the Great Wildebeest Migration, and you'll see massive herds of wildebeest, zebra, and antelope spread across the landscape. Predators like lions and cheetahs hunt among the scattered rock formations called kopjes. The terrain changes from open grasslands to woodlands and black clay plains as you move through the park.

days.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive to Ngorongoro Crater and spend the day doing a game drive inside this massive crater. It's one of Tanzania's best places to see black rhinos and lion prides with their distinctive black-maned males. You'll also encounter colorful flamingoes, water birds, leopards, cheetahs, hyenas, various antelope, and smaller mammals throughout the day.

days.title: Ngorongoro to Lake Manyara
days.description: Following breakfast, you'll travel to Lake Manyara near the rift valley, which has acacia forests, grassy plains, a swampy delta, and the lake itself. The variety of habitats here means diverse mammals and birds, and the lake is known for its rare tree-climbing lions. You'll see buffalo, impalas, giraffes, warthogs, hippos, and plenty of elephants roaming the lakeside, plus several areas where monkeys gather.

days.title: Materuni Falls and Coffee Tour
included: Visit to coffee farm with coffee roasting and preparation experience
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive toward Mount Kilimanjaro's slopes and the village of Materuni. At a coffee farm, you'll learn how coffee gets grown, harvested, and processed, then try roasting and brewing it the Chaga way. Next comes a 45-minute hike through hills and valleys to Materuni Falls, passing through banana and coffee plantations. Your guide will point out local plants used for food and traditional medicine along the way. The 200-foot waterfall drops into a pristine valley with a pool where you can swim and cool off.

days.title: Departure
days.description: You'll have the morning free to relax at your accommodation before transferring to Kilimanjaro airport for your flight home. The exact timing depends on when your flight is scheduled, so coordinate with your guide accordingly.

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo International Airport (CAI), Airport Rd, Al Shorouk, Cairo 11, Egypt (pickup from anywhere at Cairo c, 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll touch down at Cairo Airport and meet your representative who takes care of all the airport procedures and gets you to your hotel. Once you check in, you can settle into your room and rest up for what's ahead.

days.title: Cairo
included: Visit the Pyramids of Giza (Great Pyramid of Khufu, Pyramid of Khafre, Pyramid of Menkaure)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch at a special restaurant)
days.description: After breakfast, your guide takes you to see Cairo's major sites starting with the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx. You'll have lunch at a restaurant in the area, then head to the Grand Egyptian Museum before returning to your hotel in the evening.

days.title: Dahshur - Memphis - Saqqara
included: Visit Dahshur pyramids with access to interior chambers
Visit Saqqara and Step Pyramid of Djoser
days.description: This day covers three significant archaeological sites. Start at Dahshur where you'll squeeze through narrow tunnels to see ancient burial chambers, then visit Memphis for its open-air museum. Next is Saqqara to see Djoser's Step Pyramid and the stone building complex there. You're back in Cairo by evening.

days.title: Alexandria
included: Visit Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
days.description: Travel north to Alexandria, the ancient port city Alexander the Great founded. You'll tour the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa with its detailed columns and burial halls, Pompey's Pillar from Roman times, and the Alexandrina Bibliotheca with its carved stone facade. The evening drive returns you to Cairo for the night.

days.title: White Desert
days.meals: Lunch (Typical lunch of the Bahariya region at a cozy restaurant), Dinner (Barbecue dinner under the stars)
days.description: Depart around 6:30 AM heading southwest into the desert for four hours. After lunch at a local spot in Bahariya, you switch to 4x4 jeeps to explore hot springs, the Black Desert, Crystal Mountain, and White Desert National Park with photo stops and dune sliding. Watch the sunset, then camp under stars with barbecue, Bedouin music, and stargazing where you can see planets and the Milky Way.

days.title: Cairo to Aswan
days.description: Fly to Aswan in the morning and a representative picks you up, taking you to your 5-star cruise ship to check in. Later your guide explains the itinerary, then you explore Aswan's highlights including the Temple of Philae on Agilika Island, the Unfinished Obelisk in the quarries, and the High Dam.

days.title: Aswan to Edfu
optional: Optional morning tour to Abu Simbel Temple
days.description: An optional early tour goes to Abu Simbel to see the giant statues of King Ramesses II and Queen Nefertari with the sun's dramatic perpendicular effect. Back on the cruise, you visit Kom Ombo's temple dedicated to Sobek and Horus, plus see mummified crocodiles. The ship sails toward Edfu for the night.

days.title: Edfu to Luxor
included: Visit Edfu Temple by horse carriage
days.description: After breakfast, ride a horse carriage to Edfu Temple, Egypt's second-largest ancient temple honoring Horus. The cruise sails to Luxor, arriving around 4 PM. On the East Bank you'll see the Karnak Temple Complex with its many temples and chapels, and the Luxor Temple in the modern city center.

days.title: Luxor
optional: Optional sunrise hot air balloon ride over West Bank of Luxor
days.description: You can opt for an early hot air balloon ride over the West Bank or start after breakfast around 8 AM instead. Either way, visit the Valley of the Kings where 63 pharaohs were buried over centuries, see Hatshepsut's mortuary temple at the cliff edge, and view the Colossi of Memnon statues. Check into your 4-star Luxor hotel.

days.title: Luxor to Hurghada
optional: Optional morning tour to Dendera Temple complex
days.description: Optionally visit the Dendera Temple complex on the way to Hurghada to see the Hathor Temple with its sun dial and zodiac ceiling, or skip this and travel straight there. Either way, you arrive at your 5-star beachfront all-inclusive hotel on the Red Sea to start relaxing.

days.title: Hurghada
days.description: Spend your day at the 5-star beachfront all-inclusive resort on the Red Sea. Use the sandy beach, or check with a guide about excursion options like safari trips and water activities. Relax and enjoy at your own pace.

days.title: Hurghada to Cairo
optional: Optional snorkeling trip in the morning
days.description: After breakfast, head to Hurghada airport for your flight back to Cairo. Upon arrival a representative meets you and drives you to your Cairo hotel for your last night.

days.title: Cairo
days.description: Your trip ends after breakfast when you transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight home.

intro:
­Discover the best of Egypt on this 10-day all-inclusive adventure that takes you from the bustling streets of Cairo to the tranquil waters of the Nile. Stand in awe before the Pyramids of Giza, explore the rich history of Alexandria, sail through ancient wonders on a luxury Nile cruise, and soak in the natural beauty of Fayoum.


With expert guides, comfortable accommodations, and carefully planned experiences, this tour is designed to give you a stress-free and unforgettable journey through Egypt’s most iconic sights. Whether you're a history lover, an adventurer, or just looking to experience something new, this trip offers the perfect mix of culture, relaxation, and exploration.

days.title: Cairo
days.start_point: Cairo, Cairo, Egypt (Cairo Airport, 00:00 - 23:55)
days.description: You'll land at Cairo airport where your tour representative meets you to help with check-in and any paperwork. From there, it's a transfer to your 5-star hotel for the evening. This gives you time to settle in and recover from travel before your trip really gets going.

days.title: Giza
included: Guided tour of the Great Pyramid of Khufu
Guided tour of the Pyramid of Khafre
Guided tour of the Pyramid of Menkaure
Visit to the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM)
days.description: You'll start your morning heading out to the Giza Plateau to see the three great pyramids up close. Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure each have their own story and distinct architectural details worth taking time to understand. From there, you'll make your way to the Grand Egyptian Museum, where you can spend several hours looking through over 100,000 artifacts. King Tutankhamun's treasures are on display here and they're worth the attention. By evening you'll be back at your 5-star hotel in Cairo to rest up.

days.title: Memphis - Saqqara
included: Pyramids of Dahshur tour with inner chamber exploration
Saqqara necropolis visit including Step Pyramid of Djoser
Nile Dinner Cruise with folklore show and belly dancing
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Dinner with folklore show and belly dancing aboard a floating restaurant cruise ship on the Nile)
days.description: Starting early, you'll go to Dahshur and descend into narrow tunnels to see ancient chambers inside the pyramids. After that, you visit Memphis, Egypt's first capital, touring the open-air museum. Then it's on to Saqqara necropolis to see the Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later in the evening, you'll have dinner on a Nile cruise with a folklore show and belly dancing.

days.title: Cairo to Aswan
included: Temple of Philae (Temple of Isis) visit
days.description: You take an internal flight from Cairo to Aswan and check into your 5-star Nile cruise ship. After settling in, your tour guide briefs you on the itinerary. The afternoon brings visits to the Temple of Philae on Agilika Island, the Unfinished Obelisk in the quarries, the Aswan High Dam, and a traditional Nubian Village on the west bank.

days.title: Kom Ombo
included: Abu Simbel Temples tour including Temple of Ramses II and Temple of Nefertari
days.description: Early on, you'll head to Abu Simbel Temples carved into a mountainside by Pharaoh Ramses II. You'll see the massive statues at the entrance and explore halls with carvings of pharaonic victories. Then you check out the Temple of Nefertari dedicated to the queen and goddess Hathor. In the afternoon, you sail toward Kom Ombo and tour the temple dedicated to gods Sobek and Horus.

days.title: Luxor
included: Karnak Temple Sound and Light Show
days.description: Early morning takes you to Edfu city to tour the Edfu Temple, Egypt's second-largest temple after Karnak. You continue sailing toward Luxor, arriving around 4 pm. That afternoon, you explore the East Bank visiting Karnak Temple Complex, Luxor Temple in the heart of modern Luxor, and then watch the Karnak Temple Sound and Light Show as darkness falls.

days.title: Luxor
included: Hot air balloon ride over West Bank of Luxor
days.description: You start before dawn with a hot air balloon ride over Luxor's West Bank. After breakfast, you check out from the cruise and explore Valley of the Kings with 63 royal tombs carved into rock faces. Then you see the mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut at the foot of cliffs and the Colossi of Memnon. An evening flight takes you back to Cairo.

days.title: Alexandria
included: Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa tour
days.description: You head to Alexandria, the ancient Mediterranean port city founded by Alexander the Great. Start at the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, a complex of rock-cut tombs mixing Egyptian, Greek, and Roman styles. You'll see Pompey's Pillar and the Biblioteca Alexandrina with its granite facade. Later, you return to Cairo for the night.

days.title: Al Fayoum Oasis
included: Wadi El Rayan visit with waterfall viewing
days.description: This day trip takes you to Al Fayoum Oasis in the desert. You start at Lake Qarun for views and birdwatching, then head to Wadi El Rayan to see Egypt's only waterfalls surrounded by sand dunes. After a desert safari and optional sandboarding, you visit Magic Lake known for color-changing waters. You can also explore the Forest of Fossils where ancient whale remains turn up. Watch for crocodiles and lizards along the way. You return to Cairo hotel by evening.

days.title: Cairo
days.description: After breakfast at your hotel, you check out and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight home.

name: Japan Essentials 9 Day - One Life Adventures

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided

intro:
Dive into Japan’s vibrant culture with a group that feels like family – from sunrise temple visits to late-night ramen adventures. Our expert guides share hidden spots and cultural insights you won’t find in guidebooks, while giving you the freedom to shape your own journey.


Speed between cities on the epic bullet train, swap stories in unique hostels and discover the real Japan through its markets, street food, and local hangouts. Some nights you’ll be mastering chopstick skills at tiny izakayas, others you’ll be exploring Tokyo’s neon-lit streets with your crew.


This is Japan without the overwhelm – all the bucket-list experiences plus those off-the-beaten-path gems, designed to keep your wallet happy. Because the best adventures happen when you’ve got the essentials sorted and the freedom to explore.

days.title: Tokyo
days.start_point: サクラホステル浅草, 浅草2-24-2, 東京都, Tokyo Prefecture 111-0032, Japan (Sakura Hostel Asakusa )
days.description: You'll arrive in Tokyo and get settled at your hostel in the historic Asakusa district. After meeting your guide and travel group, there's a welcome dinner with Japanese cuisine. Once evening rolls around, you'll head to Senso-ji Temple to see the iconic red lanterns and ancient architecture all lit up against the night sky.

days.title: Tokyo
days.description: The day starts with a Japan Orientation Briefing covering local customs and useful phrases. From there, you'll check out Harajuku, which is basically the center of Japanese teen pop culture, then move on to Yoyogi Park and Meiji Shrine. Later in the afternoon, you'll head to Akihabara where you can play arcade games, check out maid cafes, or just wander through the neon-lit shops.

days.title: Tokyo
days.description: This morning you have the freedom to explore Tokyo on your own pace with your guide available if you need help planning. You could take an optional sushi-making class or visit the Imperial Palace if those interest you. In the evening, you'll travel to Shinjuku for views of Tokyo's skyline, walk through the famous Omoide Yokocho Alley, grab dinner, and catch the iconic Shibuya Pedestrian Crossing.

days.title: Tokyo to Hakone
included: Train journey on the Romance Car
days.description: You'll take the scenic Romance Car train to Hakone, a mountain town, and check into your guesthouse. After settling in, you'll explore the surrounding area by train, heading deeper into the mountains. The day offers views of Mt. Fuji depending on weather, and you can try some of the town's local food. By evening, you'll head back to your guesthouse for a family-style dinner.

days.title: Hakone to Kyoto
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Yakitori (grilled chicken sticks) at one of the best yakitori places in town)
days.description: Today you're leaving Hakone and taking the bullet train to Kyoto, Japan's ancient capital. Once you check into your accommodation near the traditional area, you'll have time to wander the neighborhood at your own pace. Your guide leads a walking tour through Gion district in the evening, the historic area known for geisha, and then dinner follows at a yakitori restaurant.

days.title: Kyoto
optional: Tea ceremony with or without kimono rental
days.description: You'll wake up early and take the subway to Fushimi-Inari Shrine to walk through the famous red torii gate corridors before crowds show up. Then you'll continue to Kiyomizu-dera temple, one of Japan's most iconic temples with its wooden structure perched high on the mountainside. The afternoon is free, and you can choose optional traditional experiences if you want them.

days.title: Kyoto
days.description: A train takes you to Arashiyama, a mountain town with a river running through it. You'll explore the Arashiyama Bamboo Forest and climb Monkey Mountain for scenic views. The afternoon opens up for wandering the town at your own pace. There's also the option of a traditional Japanese boat ride through the valleys or visiting the Samurai and Ninja Museum to see rare artifacts.

days.title: Kyoto to Osaka
days.meals: Dinner (Street food experience in Osaka Dotonbori area)
days.description: You'll visit the Golden Pavilion, a gold-covered building with a lake and traditional Japanese garden surrounding it. Next, you'll walk through Daitoku-ji, a peaceful temple complex with ancient buildings. Later, you're heading to the famous Dotonbori area in Osaka to try street food and see the vibrant lights and colors of the 'kitchen of Japan'. The evening wraps up with karaoke and drinks.

days.title: Osaka
days.description: It's time to say goodbye to your group and all the people you've met during the tour. You'll have time to reflect on everything you've seen and done throughout your Japan experience.

Would you be interested in adding any of the optional extra activities? The Essentials has been designed for younger travellers, dormitory stays throughout, less activities with instead more free time, and no unique acommodation/stays - allowing for the price to be more affordable to a younger market. The Classic tour is designed to give you a much more thorough Japan experience, unique Temple and Guest house stays as you visit the ancient Takayama and Hakone to get a sighting of Mt Fuji. Plus, more included activities which really allow you to feel and taste Japan. There is still free time throughout the tour to pick up your own personal interests too.

qa.question: May I please have the airport code for plane ticket booking? What time do you recommend arrival time? I am not sure if I can get a taxi or Uber to get to the meetup point to see the rest of the group. I have credit cards, is that enough? Or do I need to exchange some cash? If so, how much? Flights / Transfers Payments
qa.answer: You can land at either Narita (NRT) or Haneda Airport (HND) and I would recommend arriving no later than 3-4pm. That will give you enough time to get from the airport to the hotel, and then ready to meet the group at 6pm for the Welcome Dinner. We will provide instructions on how to get from either airport to your hotel via the public transport system (trains). You can take an Uber but taxis in Japan can be expensive. Cash is still commonly used. Withdrawing cash from an ATM in Japan is probably the easiest choice, ATMs can be found in the airport and in all convenience stores such as at 7-Eleven, Family Mart & Lawson. You have many opportunities throughout the tour to withdraw. Most ATM's have a maximum withdrawal limit of ¥50,000 ($452 USD). It will most likely be cheaper to exchange money into Yen in your own country. Currency exchange is less common outside of the airport so if you...
