name: 7 Day - Iceland Ring Road & Snæfellsnes Peninsula Small-Group Tour

attributes.name: Nature & Wildlife
attributes.tip: Explore untamed landscapes teeming with wildlife

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Come embark on an enchanting 7-day expedition through Iceland, where you'll traverse the stunning terrain along the renowned Ring Road, Golden Circle & Snæfellsnes Peninsula. This comprehensive journey will take you through Iceland's most prominent attractions, featuring glaciers, geothermal hot springs, volcanic craters, black sand beaches, glacier lagoons, cascading waterfalls, and charming coastal villages. Additionally, you'll have the chance to partake in a thrilling whale-watching excursion in North Iceland and explore an ice cave in the southern region, capping it all off with a rejuvenating soak at the Vök Baths.

days.title: Golden Circle to South Coast
included: Visit Þingvellir National Park UNESCO World Heritage site including the historic Althing parliament location
View Strokkur geyser at Geysir geothermal area
Explore Reynisfjara black sand beach and basalt formations
days.description: Starting your day with a pickup in Reykjavik, you'll head to Thingvellir National Park to see the dramatic rift valley where tectonic plates meet. From there, you'll drive to the Geysir geothermal area where Strokkur erupts roughly every 10-15 minutes, so you might catch several displays. After that, you'll walk right up to Gullfoss waterfall and feel the power of the water and mist. Grab lunch somewhere along the way, then continue south to Seljalandsfoss where the trail lets you walk behind the curtain of water. It's quite a different experience from viewing it from in front. Next comes Skógafoss, another powerful waterfall on the South Coast, and then you'll finish at Reynisfjara beach with its black sand and basalt columns before heading to your hotel.

days.title: South Coast - Vík to Höfn
included: Visit Vík coastal village with black sand beaches and Reynisdrangar sea stacks
optional: Katla Ice Cave tour beneath Mýrdalsjökull glacier (May until September, costs extra)
Crystal Ice Cave near Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon (October until April, costs extra)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive east toward the coastal village of Vik to see Reynisdrangar sea stacks rising from the black sand. Here you can choose to pay extra for either the Katla Ice Cave (available May through September) or the Crystal Ice Cave near Jökulsárlón if visiting October through April, or just explore Vik on your own for free. Lunch happens in Vik, then you'll continue driving toward Fjadrargljufur canyon, which has those tall colorful cliffs rising from a river gorge. From there, head to Jökulsárlón glacial lagoon where chunks of ice break off the glacier and float in the water. Just five minutes away is Diamond Beach where those same ice fragments wash up on black sand. You'll reach your hotel in the Höfn area by evening.

days.title: East Iceland
included: Visit Djúpivogur fishing village and 'Eggs in Gleðivik' art installation
Visit Borgarfjörður Eystri and puffin colonies
optional: Vök Baths geothermal natural hot springs (costs extra)
Free time exploring Egilstaðir on your own (free)
days.description: This morning you'll head along the coast to Djupivogur, a small fishing village where you can see the 'Eggs in Gleðivik' art installation with 34 types of local birds' eggs. Continuing on, you'll drive to Egilstaðir using either the Öxi highland route if it's summer, which has cascading waterfalls along the way, or the coastal route through fishing villages in winter. Stop in Egilstaðir for lunch and a break. After that, you'll go to Borgarfjörður Eystri to watch puffin colonies if you're visiting between late April and late August. You can also choose to add an extra cost visit to Vök Baths for a soak in natural hot springs on Lake Urridavatn, or spend free time exploring Egilstaðir instead. Finally, you'll head back to Egilstaðir and check into your hotel.

days.title: North Iceland - Studlagil to Akureyri
included: Explore Studlagil Canyon with basalt columns and blue glacial river
days.description: After breakfast and checking out, you'll explore the western side of Studlagil Canyon with its striking basalt columns and blue glacial river. Then you'll drive to Dettifoss, which is Europe's most powerful waterfall, and you'll really feel the force and hear the roar from the ground. Moving on, you'll enter the Lake Mývatn area starting at Námaskarð geothermal area where you'll see bubbling mud pots, steam vents, and colorful mineral deposits scattered across otherworldly terrain. Walking through Dimmuborgir lava field comes next, where strange rock formations and lava pillars create an eerie landscape. You'll also visit the pseudocraters at Skútustaðagígar for views across the area. Then comes Goðafoss waterfall, which has historical connections to ancient Icelandic sagas. You'll finish the day by checking into your hotel in the Akureyri area.

days.title: Northwest Iceland - Akureyri to Laugarbakki
optional: Whale Watching Tour in Akureyri (costs extra)
Free time exploring Akureyri on your own (free)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll explore Akureyri, known as the Capital of the North. You have the option to pay extra for a whale watching tour down at the harbor, or spend free time walking the main street, climbing up to the church, and checking out the botanical gardens. Lunch is in Akureyri, then you'll drive to Víðimórkirkja, a historic turf church that shows what rural Icelandic homes looked like with their traditional sod construction. Next is Hítsertur, a rock formation rising from the sea with interesting shapes and local stories attached to it. You'll also visit Koluglúfur, a canyon with waterfalls and quiet areas named after a giantess from local folklore. The day ends when you arrive at your hotel in Laugarbakki.

days.title: Borgarfjörður - Silver Circle to Reykjavik
included: Visit Hraunfossar waterfalls in lava fields
Visit Sturlureykir traditional Icelandic horse farm
days.description: Starting after breakfast, you'll head to Grábrok, a volcanic crater where a short walk takes you to the rim with wide-open views across the landscape. Then you're off to Hraunfossar, a series of waterfalls that flow right through old lava fields, creating striking contrasts between blue water and dark volcanic rock. You'll visit Sturlureykir, a traditional Icelandic horse farm where you can learn about the unique horses and their importance to Icelandic culture. Deildartunguhver comes next, Europe's most powerful hot spring, where boiling water comes straight from the earth. Finally, you'll drive back to Reykjavik, check into your hotel, and have the evening to yourself to walk around town and get dinner.

days.title: Snæfellsnes Peninsula to Reykjavik
included: Visit Mt. Kirkjufell and Kirkjufellsfoss waterfall
Visit Snæfellsjökull National Park and glacier-capped Snæfellsjökull volcano
days.description: On your last day, you'll have breakfast at the hotel before checking out, then drive to the Snæfellsnes Peninsula to see diverse landscapes and learn about local culture. First is the Berserkjahraun Lava Field, which has interesting stories tied to it from local folklore. Then you'll see Mt. Kirkjufell with Kirkjufellsfoss waterfall, a spot that photographers love. You'll explore Snæfellsjökull National Park with its glacier-topped volcano and varied scenery. Next comes Djúpalónssandur Beach with black sand and remnants of a shipwreck. Lóndrangar Basalt Cliffs offer dramatic photo opportunities and have their own local tales. You'll wander through Arnarstapi village, a small coastal settlement with history and a working harbor. The Búðir Black Church is an iconic building set against the landscape. Before heading back to Reykjavik, you'll stop at Ytri-Tunga Seal Beach for a chance to see seals in their natural setting. Your driver will drop you off in Reykjavik where you'll say goodbye to the group.

name: East Philippines Classic 10 Day - One Life Adventures

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro:
Want to live your best life while giving back? Join us on our Philippines East group tour and experience four islands packed with wild views, epic activities, and unforgettable moments. From sunrise treks to mountaintops, to swimming under waterfalls and paddleboarding down the iconic Loboc River, this journey is packed with unforgettable moments. Along the way, we work with local suppliers, making sure the community benefits from your adventure too.


You’ll snorkel in pristine reef areas, sip cocktails on a private sandbar while dinner is prepared right in front of you, and sail into sunset views over Boracay’s famous White Beach. All of this is shared with a squad of like-minded travellers on a Philippines East group tour that’s all about meaningful experiences and living life to the fullest. Are you in?

days.title: Cebu
days.meals: Dinner (Welcome meal at a local favourite spot)
days.description: You'll be met at the airport in Cebu and have time to settle into your accommodation and explore at your own pace. This evening, you'll join the group for a welcome dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Cebu to Moalboal
included: Snorkel amongst thousands of sardines at the Sardine Run
days.description: Drive through Cebu's countryside and stop at Simala Shrine to see the Filipino architecture and culture. After checking into your beachfront place in Moalboal and grabbing lunch, you'll head out for snorkelling with thousands of sardines during the famous Sardine Run. Keep an eye out for sea turtles.

days.title: Moalboal
included: Hike to Osmena Peak for sunrise
Filipino breakfast at a local community-supporting restaurant
Swim at a tropical swimming hole
days.meals: Breakfast (Filipino breakfast provided by a local restaurant supporting the local community)
days.description: Start early to catch sunrise at Osmena Peak, where the jagged hills create a unique landscape. After coming down, you'll have a Filipino breakfast at a local restaurant. The afternoon is for swimming and relaxing at a tropical pool before heading back to Moalboal, leaving the rest of the day free.

days.title: Moalboal to Bohol
days.description: Following breakfast, drive back to Cebu City on a scenic route then board a ferry to Bohol. The crossing gives you time to relax and take in the sea views. By afternoon you'll reach your accommodation and can either unwind at the pool or head to Alona Beach for drinks and sunset.

days.title: Bohol
included: Stand-up paddle boarding or kayaking down the Loboc River
Dessert-making workshop for traditional Filipino desserts
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch at an open-air restaurant overlooking the Loboc River)
days.description: Explore Bohol's countryside starting with views of the iconic Chocolate Hills. Walk through the Mahogany Cultivated Forest with its towering trees, then visit the Tarsier Sanctuary to see the tiny primates up close. You'll have lunch overlooking the Loboc River and then kayak or paddle board down the river through thick green vegetation. The day ends with a workshop where you'll learn to make traditional Filipino desserts.

days.title: Bohol
included: Visit Badjao Community daycare to interact with local children
Sunset tour with snorkelling amongst coral reefs and marine life
days.meals: Dinner (Traditional Filipino 'boodle fight' communal meal with various Filipino dishes served on banana leaves)
days.description: Spend the morning at a local daycare in the Badjao Community, interacting with kids and learning about their daily lives. In the afternoon, take a sunset boat tour around tropical waters while snorkelling among coral reefs and marine life. You'll arrive at Gak-Ang Island, a white sandbar, for sunset. Dinner is a traditional boodle fight, a communal Filipino meal shared family-style, along with cocktails.

days.title: Bohol to Boracay
optional: Explore hidden gems and beaches in Boracay
days.description: Fly to Caticlan Airport and take a short trike ride to the ferry terminal. A brief 10-minute public ferry gets you to Boracay, where you'll be picked up and transferred to your accommodation for three nights. After freshening up, you'll head out for a sunset sailing trip with great views.

days.title: Boracay
included: Visit Motag Living Museum cultural experience
optional: Kayak and explore the clear waters
days.description: Take a short ferry to Malay on the mainland to visit the Motag Living Museum, an exclusive cultural experience showing how locals live in Caticlan. You'll interact with residents and get a real look at rural Filipino life. Return to Boracay in the afternoon and spend the rest of the day on White Beach, or choose an optional massage and kayaking.

days.title: Boracay
included: Hop On and Hop Off bus pass to explore lesser-known beaches
days.description: You have a leisurely morning to move at your own pace. In the afternoon, use your Hop On Hop Off bus pass to explore lesser-known beaches with secluded coves and hidden bays. Wander quiet beaches, find small islands, walk through local villages, and take in the tropical scenery. End the day with a free massage.

days.title: Boracay
optional: Join other tour operator options to explore more of the Philippines
days.description: After breakfast, the day is entirely yours. You can stay in Boracay and relax, or explore more of the Philippines by joining one of the tour operator's other available options.

name: Splendours of Sri Lanka

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: "Splendours of Sri Lanka" promises an enchanting journey through the diverse landscapes and cultural treasures of this beautiful island nation.

days.title: Colombo to Negombo
included: Sightseeing tour of Negombo including visits to Angurukaramulla Temple (Bodhirajaramaya), Negombo Dutch Fort, Negombo Beach Park, and St. Mary's Church
days.start_point: Colombo, Sri Lanka (Colombo)
days.description: You'll land at Colombo airport where someone will be waiting to pick you up and drive you to Negombo, which is about 35 km away and takes roughly an hour. Once you check in and get settled at your hotel, you'll head out on a sightseeing tour that includes Angurukalamulla Temple, the old Dutch Fort, Negombo Beach Park, and St. Mary's Church. After that, the rest of the day is open for you to relax or wander around on your own.

days.title: Negombo - Pinnawala - Sigiriya
included: Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage including witnessing baby elephants being fed and bathing
days.description: After eating breakfast at the hotel, you'll check out and start driving toward Sigiriya, which is 180 km away and about 4 hours by car. On the way, you'll stop at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to watch young elephants being fed and take a bath, then walk through the Royal Botanical Garden. Once you reach Sigiriya, you'll check in and have the rest of the day free to do as you please.

days.title: Sigiriya - Anuradhapura - Sigiriya
included: Day excursion to Anuradhapura with visits to Sri Maha Bodhi, Brazen Palace, Dagobas, Ruwanwelisaya, Abeygiri and Jetawana Monasteries, rock-cut statues of Lord Buddha, palace ruins, and Isurumuniya Rock Temple
days.description: You'll have breakfast at the hotel, then take a day trip to Anuradhapura, which is about 75 km away and takes roughly 1.5 hours to get there. The ancient city has a lot to see, including the Sri Maha Bodhi, which is the world's oldest historically documented tree, plus the Brazen Palace, various Dagobas, Ruwanwelisaya, Abeygiri and Jetawana Monasteries, rock-cut Buddha statues, old palace ruins, and the Isurumuniya Rock Temple. You'll head back to Sigiriya for the night.

days.title: Sigiriya - Minneriya National Park - Polonnaruwa - Sigiriya
included: Wildlife safari in Minneriya National Park with opportunity to spot wild Asian Elephants
Visit to Polonnaruwa UNESCO World Heritage Site including Royal Palace, Gal Vihare complex, and giant statue of the king
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and drive to Minneriya National Park, which is 60 km away and about 1.5 hours from your hotel, where you can go on a wildlife safari and see wild Asian elephants in their natural habitat. From there, you'll continue to Polonnaruwa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with lots of medieval architecture, and check out the Royal Palace, the Gal Vihare complex with four Buddha images carved from one piece of granite, and a giant statue of the city's greatest king. You'll return to Sigiriya for the night and have free time to unwind.

days.title: Sigiriya - Dambulla - Matale - Kandy
included: Visit to Dambulla Royal Cave Temple with golden Buddha statue
optional: Visit to Aluviharaya Rock Cave Temple
days.description: You'll eat breakfast, check out, and drive toward Kandy, which is 90 km away and takes about 2.5 hours. Along the route, you'll visit the Dambulla Royal Cave Temple with its gold Buddha statue and the Ibbankatuwa Megalithic Tombs, plus you can see the Aluviharaya Rock Cave Temple, Fort Macdowall, and a spice garden in Matale if you'd like. When you arrive in Kandy, you'll check into your hotel and have the rest of the day to yourself.

days.title: Kandy - Peradeniya - Kandy
included: Sightseeing tour of Peradeniya including Royal Botanic Gardens and Gatabe Rajopanaramaya Buddhist Temple
Visit to Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy
Visit to Old Royal Palace in Kandy
Visit to Sri Natha Devalaya Temple Square in Kandy
landmarks: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
days.description: Start with breakfast at your hotel, then go on a sightseeing tour of Peradeniya and Kandy. You'll visit the Royal Botanic Gardens and Gatabe Rajopanaramaya Buddhist Temple in Peradeniya, then move on to see Kandy's Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Old Royal Palace, and Sri Natha Devalaya Temple Square. There's a view of the artificial Kandy Lake to take in, and later in the day you'll watch a traditional Sri Lankan Cultural Performance. The rest of your time is yours to relax.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
included: Scenic train journey from Kandy to Nawalapitiya
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to Gampola Railway Station and board a scenic train to Nawalapitiya, where you can see tea plantations, mist-covered mountains, and waterfalls from the windows. From Nawalapitiya, you'll continue by road to Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka's highest hill station known as 'Little England,' and check into your hotel in this charming place with colonial architecture and gardens at the foot of Pidurutalagala Mountain. You'll have the rest of the day free.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya - Bandarawela - Kataragama
included: Sightseeing tour of Kataragama including visits to Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Dewalaya, Kebiliththa Dewalaya, and Sella Kataragama Ganesh Temple
optional: Stop in Bandarawela to view tea plantations
days.description: You'll have breakfast, check out, and drive to Kataragama, which is 160 km away and takes about 4 hours. On the way, you'll stop in Bandarawela to see the beautiful tea plantations that have been around since British colonial times and are part of the famous Ceylon Tea region. Once you get to Kataragama, you'll check in, freshen up, and then tour Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Dewalaya, Kebiliththa Dewalaya, and Sella Kataragama Ganesh Temple. The rest of the day is yours to relax.

days.title: Kataragama - Galle - Bentota
included: Visit to Mahamodara Sea Turtle Hatchery Centre
Exploration of Galle Dutch Fort, Sri Sudharmalaya Buddhist Temple, Mahamevnawa Buddhist Monastery, and Yatagala Raja Maha Viharaya
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and drive to Bentota, which is 220 km away and about 4 hours by car. During the drive, you'll stop at the Mahamodara Sea Turtle Hatchery Centre to see the work being done there. You'll also visit Galle and check out the Galle Dutch Fort, Sri Sudharmalaya Buddhist Temple, Mahamevnawa Buddhist Monastery, and Yatagala Raja Maha Viharaya before arriving at your hotel in Bentota. Once you're settled, the rest of the day is free.

days.title: Bentota to Colombo
included: Sightseeing tour of Colombo including visits to Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Colombo National Museum, and Seema Malakaya, and exploration of Beira Lake
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out and drive to Colombo, which is 90 km away and takes about 2 hours. You'll check into your hotel, refresh yourself, then head out on a sightseeing tour that includes Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Colombo National Museum, and Seema Malakaya, plus a look at the scenic Beira Lake. After the tour, you can either go shopping or head back to your hotel for the evening.

intro: Dive into Sri Lanka's captivating heart in 8 days! Witness ancient marvels carved in stone at Dambulla and Polonnaruwa, then ascend Sigiriya's mythical rock and embrace Kandy's spiritual pulse. Trade cityscapes for Nuwara Eliya's tea-drenched hills before embarking on a thrilling wildlife safari at Udawalawe National Park. This journey promises history, serenity, and a touch of the wild, leaving you mesmerized by Sri Lanka's timeless magic. Are you ready for your island adventure?

days.title: Colombo

days.description: Your representative meets you at Colombo airport and drives you to your hotel. From there, the day is open for you to relax, unpack, and get settled into your room.

days.title: Colombo - Dambulla - Polonnaruwa
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive toward Polonnaruwa, which takes about 5 hours covering 230 km. Along the way, you'll stop at Dambulla Royal Cave Temple to see the Golden Buddha statue, then visit Ibbankatuwa Megalithic Tombs. When you reach Polonnaruwa, check into your hotel and spend the afternoon exploring the ancient ruins, walking through the Royal Palace and seeing Gal Vihara.

days.title: Polonnaruwa - Sigiriya - Kandy
days.description: After breakfast, the drive to Kandy takes about 3 hours for 150 km, with several stops along the route. You'll see Sigiriya Rock Fortress, visit Aluviharaya Rock Cave Temple and Fort Macdowall, then spend time at a spice garden in Matale. Once you arrive in Kandy and check into your hotel, the rest of your day is free to do as you please.

days.title: Kandy
included: Visit Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Visit Sri Natha Devalaya Temple Square
Watch typical Sri Lankan Cultural Performance
landmarks: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
days.description: After breakfast, a guide takes you around Kandy to visit the Royal Botanical Garden, the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Old Royal Palace, and Sri Natha Devalaya Temple Square. You'll also walk around the artificial Kandy Lake. In the evening, there's a typical Sri Lankan Cultural Performance to see, and after that, time to shop or head back to your hotel.

days.title: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
included: Scenic train journey from Kandy to Nawalapitiya
Drive from Nawalapitiya to Nuwara Eliya
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head to Gampola Railway Station and board a scenic train to Nawalapitiya, where you'll see tea plantations, misty mountains, and waterfalls from your window. From there, you continue by road to Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka's highest hill station. Once you check in at your hotel, spend the rest of the day exploring this colonial-era town at your own pace.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya - Udawalawe National Park
included: Afternoon jungle safari at Udawalawe National Park
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive to Udawalawe National Park, which is 150 km away and takes about 4 hours. The route includes stops at Ravana's Cave and Rawana Falls near Ella. After checking in and freshening up at your hotel, you head out in the afternoon for a jungle safari. The park has roughly 400 Sri Lankan elephants, plus leopards, sloth bears, and various deer. You'll return to your hotel by evening.

days.title: Udawalawe National Park - Colombo
days.description: After breakfast, the drive back to Colombo is 250 km and takes about 4.5 hours. Once you check in at your hotel and freshen up, a guide takes you around the city. You'll see Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, the Colombo National Museum, Seema Malakaya, and Beira Lake. The evening gives you time to shop or return to your hotel.

days.title: Colombo
days.description: After breakfast, you'll check out of your hotel and transfer to Colombo airport for your flight home or onward to your next destination.

intro:
Experience the very best of Vietnam, a journey that combines breathtaking landscapes, rich history, vibrant culture, and authentic local experiences. Explore the charming capital of Hanoi, cruise through the spectacular limestone scenery of Halong Bay, wander the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, and discover the dynamic atmosphere of Ho Chi Minh City.

Along the way, enjoy hands-on cultural activities, from visiting a traditional tea plantation and joining a local cooking class to cycling through peaceful villages and cruising the waterways of the Mekong Delta. Complete your adventure with a visit to the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, offering fascinating insights into Vietnam's past.

Perfectly balanced between sightseeing, cultural immersion, and leisure, Astonishing Vietnam In 11 Days is an unforgettable journey through the heart and soul of Vietnam.

optional: Explore Hanoi Old Quarter at your own pace
days.start_point: Hanoi, Vietnam (Noi Bai International airport)
days.description: Your private driver meets you at Hanoi airport and takes you to your hotel in the Old Quarter area. After settling in, you can either take a walk around the neighborhood or rest from your flight, whatever suits you best.

days.title: Hanoi - Ba Vi

Cooking class with local host preparing Vietnamese dishes
Cycling through rice fields and villages
Traditional herbal foot soak following Muong ethnic minority recipes
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Vietnamese dishes prepared during cooking class)
days.description: Wake up to the sunrise over Halong Bay and eat breakfast on the vessel as it heads back toward port. You'll have an early lunch before disembarking, then your driver transfers you back to your Hanoi hotel.

days.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay

Swimming and kayaking activities (depending on boat itinerary)
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Served while cruising through the islets), Dinner
days.description: Early morning departure takes you 1.5 hours to Ba Vi countryside. You'll start at a local tea plantation harvesting on 30-year-old plants, then head to a cooking class where you prepare Vietnamese dishes for lunch. The afternoon includes visits to local workshops, cycling through rice fields, and finishing with a traditional herbal foot soak before returning to Hanoi.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
days.description: Your guide meets you around 3:00 pm for a city tour covering Hoi An Market, the colorful Phuc Kien Chinese Assembly Hall, old preserved houses, and the Museum of Folk Culture. You'll watch traditional performing arts, cross the historic Japanese Bridge, then take a boat ride and release a flower lantern. Dinner features local specialties before heading back to your hotel.

days.title: Hanoi to Hoi An
days.description: The day is yours to spend as you like in Hoi An. If you prefer something structured, there's an optional group tour to Ba Na Hills with cable cars, the Golden Bridge, and Fantasy Park.

Ancient house visits (Phung Hung and Tan Ky houses)

Boat ride on Hoi An River
landmarks: Museum of Folk Culture, Hoi An

days.description: Spend your final morning in Hanoi before your driver takes you to the airport. Flight to Danang connects with another driver who brings you to Hoi An. The rest of the day is open for you to check in and get familiar with the town.

days.title: Hoi An
optional: Day trip to Ba Na Hills via cable car - includes Golden Bridge visit, Dream Stream Cable Car Station, Le Jardin D'amour gardens, Linh Ung Pagoda, French Village, Lava Train, Fantasy Park attractions - USD 75 per person
Buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills restaurant (as part of optional tour)
days.description: Travel to My Tho in the Mekong Delta and visit Vinh Trang Pagoda first. Then board a sampan cruising past the four islands (Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, Tortoise) and stop at Unicorn Island to walk village lanes and visit orchards for tropical fruits. You'll hear traditional folk music, explore a family honeybee farm, and see coconut candy being made. After lunch, cycle through Tan Thach Village meeting locals. Hammocks are available if you'd rather relax. Return to Ho Chi Minh City by evening.

days.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City
days.description: Check out of your Hanoi hotel and travel to Halong Bay, arriving around midday. After boarding your cruise ship and having lunch while sailing past the limestone islets, you'll have the afternoon for swimming, kayaking, or visiting caves. Later you'll watch the sunset and have dinner, staying overnight on the water.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City - Mekong Delta
included: Sampan cruise past Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Tortoise Islands
Orchard visit with tropical fruit tasting
Hand-rowed sampan through Thoi Son Canal
Family-run honeybee farm visit with honey tea
Local villager interaction and daily life experience
optional: Relax in hammocks during afternoon (alternative to cycling)
days.description: Your driver takes you to Da Nang airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Another driver picks you up and brings you to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for exploring on your own.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City

days.description: Spend the day relaxing and exploring Ho Chi Minh City at your own pace. An optional half-day group tour to Cu Chi Tunnels is available, which includes a video about tunnel construction, exploration of the remaining systems with living areas and military facilities, and shooting range access if interested.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City
days.description: Enjoy a healthy breakfast and check out of your hotel. Before heading to the airport, you'll have time to visit local markets for souvenirs. Your private driver then takes you to the airport for your flight home.

intro:
­Although the Amazon rainforest is the most famous eco vacation destination in Brazil, you won't see most of the animal species there. Your best chance to discover Brazil's wildlife is on one of the many Pantanal tours that are offered across the country.


Pantanal is a unique ecosystem, in one of the most fascinating regions in the world: 230,000 square kilometers that form a biological oasis of wildlife and the largest water-covered plain in the world. Around 650 species of birds, 230 species of fish, 80 species of mammals, 50 species of reptiles and countless species of insects are waiting to be discovered by you.


For wildlife-spotting, the dry season (June-October) is undoubtedly the best time to visit the Pantanal. The water has receded and the animals come out from the deeper and more inaccessible parts of the wetlands and cluster around the waterholes.


The peak of the rainy summer season (November to March) is still a great time to visit as it's quintessentially Pantaneiro in its lush landscape. This is when the rivers overflow and flood the lowlands, making most of Pantanal only accessible by aeroplane or boat.

days.title: Arrival in Pantanal
included: Drive along Transpantaneira route with wildlife viewing
optional: Night hike in search of nocturnal animals
days.meals: Lunch (Lunch depending on arrival time), Dinner
days.start_point: Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil (Hotel or CGB Airport)
days.description: You'll arrive at the airport and head to Poconé, where the Transpantaneira route begins. This unpaved road cuts through wildlife habitat, and you'll start spotting kaimans, capybaras, and tuiuiú right away. After checking in at your fazenda lodge, lunch comes first, then you'll have time to rest. Later in the afternoon, take a guided walk on the lodge trails to see what else is around. Dinner happens back at the pousada, and if you're interested, there's an optional night hike with flashlights to look for nocturnal animals.

days.title: Pantanal
included: Sunrise walk in the Pantanal (5:00 AM start)
Paddled boat tour on Rio Novo or Rio Claro
optional: Join in saddling and unsaddling animals during horseback ride
days.description: You'll start early at 5:00 AM with a sunrise walk to catch the Pantanal coming to life, then head back for breakfast. After eating, you'll get on a mule or horse for a ride through the landscape. This is how locals traditionally move around the area, and the setup works well for beginners since helmets are provided. Later in the afternoon, you'll take a paddled boat out on Rio Novo or Rio Claro. This is your chance to look for giant otters, birds, tapirs, and whatever else might be around.

days.title: Porto Jofre
included: 5-hour guided boat trip along Cuiabá, São Lourenço, Três Irmãos, and Piquiri rivers
days.meals: Breakfast (Picnic breakfast), Lunch (Lunch on one of the beaches on the banks of the river in the form of a snack), Dinner
days.description: Coffee at 5:00 a.m. and then a 107 km drive toward Porto Jofre at the end of the Transpantaneira route. Alligators, capybaras, and birds show up throughout the drive. You'll stop for a picnic breakfast along the way. At Porto Jofre, you'll spend 5 hours on boats exploring the Cuiabá, São Lourenço, Três Irmãos, and Piquiri rivers through untouched forest. This is jaguar country, so there's a real chance you'll see one. A riverside snack lunch happens on one of the beaches, then back to the lodge for dinner.

days.title: Pantanal
included: Walking tour exploring wilderness with observation platforms
optional: Scatter corn and salt along forest trail
Pool, lounge chair, or hammock relaxation
days.description: After breakfast, you'll walk out into the surrounding wilderness with time at observation platforms to watch for wildlife. You can scatter corn and salt along the forest trails if you want. Following lunch, the afternoon is yours to relax by the pool, in a hammock, or on a lounge chair. Later as the day cools down, you'll drive along the Transpantaneira looking for birds, caimans, tapirs, and giant anteaters before heading back for dinner.

days.title: Departure from Pantanal
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch depending on departure time)
days.description: Breakfast at the pousada, then transfer to the airport for your departure. If your flight leaves later in the afternoon, an optional morning excursion is possible, with airport transfer after lunch instead. Your time in Brazil's Pantanal ends today.

reviews.author: Toni
reviews.body: The lodge seemed to be in a state of confusion. Tours were cancelled or rearranged. We rode a mule not a horse....
reviews.reply:
Dear Toni,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. I am sorry to hear that your overall impression of the lodge was disappointing.

I did try to contact you after receiving your review to better understand some of the points you raised, particularly as several of the situations described were not clear enough for us to investigate properly. Unfortunately, I never received a response.

For example, the lodge has confirmed that breakfast is normally served from 7:00 to 9:30 a.m., so I would have liked to understand what happened in your particular case. Similarly, while wildlife sightings can never be guaranteed in such a natural environment, I would have appreciated more details about the walking tours in order to investigate your experience with the lodge.

I was also particularly concerned by your comment that “our friends were not on lists for tours and missed the best one of all... the jaguar tour”. According to our records, you and your travel companion were correctly registered and took part in the jaguar excursion as planned, without experiencing any issue with the booking or access to the tour.

This makes it particularly important for me to understand who you were referring to as “our friends”. If you were referring to other guests travelling with you, I would need more information about their booking and what happened to them before I could reasonably hold the lodge responsible for the situation.

I completely respect your right to share your opinion, and I do not wish to dismiss your concerns. However, without further details or clarification, I am unfortunately unable to verify several of the incidents described or establish whether they concerned your own booking or other guests.

As a travel operator, I take feedback seriously and always investigate issues with our local partners when something goes wrong. In order to do so fairly and responsibly, however, I also need sufficient information to identify what actually happened.

I am therefore sorry that you did not enjoy your experience, but I believe it is important to clarify that, based on the information available to us, you and your travel companion participated normally in the jaguar excursion and were not affected by the issue described in your review. We cannot, however, take responsibility for situations involving other guests or circumstances that we have not been able to verify.

Best regards,
Daria

name: Southern Africa Safari

attributes.name: Safari
attributes.tip: Track iconic wildlife on unforgettable game drives

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro: Looking for the ultimate safari adventure through Africa?  This one doesn't just explore the gorgeous city of Cape Town and thundering might of Victoria Falls - it also takes a wild safari through iconic Kruger, before exploring the breathtaking landscapes of Botswana and Namibia, with heaps of included game drives, luxe lodges with swimming pools, opportunities for helicopter wildlife spotting and interactions with indigenous communities. This is the ultimate African adventure, unfiltered, and once you've made memories like these under African skies, your life will never be the same.

days.title: Cape Town
days.description: You'll arrive in Cape Town and get settled at your hotel near the V&A Waterfront. After meeting your Trip Manager and getting oriented to the city, the evening starts with a walkabout dinner that kicks off your safari adventure.

days.title: Cape Town
included: Cable car ride up Table Mountain
Cape Town city tour covering Bo-Kaap, City Centre, and V&A Waterfront
optional: Township Tour & Amy Foundation Lunch with locally guided insight into Apartheid
MasterChef-style cooking class with food, drinks and music
days.description: Start the day with a cable car ride up Table Mountain for 360-degree views of the city and coast. A guided city tour follows, covering historical attractions around Cape Town. The afternoon is yours to explore, with the V&A Waterfront being a popular choice. You can optionally do a Township Tour with lunch or take a cooking class with food and entertainment in the evening.

days.title: Cape Town - Chapman's Peak - Cape Point - Boulders Beach
optional: Kayaking with African penguins at Boulders Beach
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive along Chapman's Peak Drive with its dramatic cliff views, heading down to Cape Point at Africa's southwestern tip. The afternoon brings a visit to Boulders Beach to see African penguin colonies up close, with kayaking available if you'd like. The day wraps up with optional wine tasting while taking in the views.

days.title: Cape Town to Kruger National Park via Johannesburg
included: Sunset game drive into Kruger National Park
Transfer from Johannesburg to Kruger National Park
days.description: An early morning flight takes you to Johannesburg, then a coach journey heads into Kruger National Park. You'll arrive at the park gates in the afternoon and set out on a sunset game drive to your exclusive Contiki Safari Camp on the Sabie River. Tonight you'll sleep in canvas dome tents surrounded by the African bush.

days.title: Kruger National Park
optional: Traditional South African braai (BBQ) with local sides and desserts
days.description: Rise early if you want to join an optional sunrise safari to catch predators finishing their night hunts. The midday hours are relaxed at camp with access to the shop, pool, and riverside restaurant overlooking the Sabie River. An optional sunset game drive happens in the afternoon, and the evening features an optional traditional South African braai around the campfire.

days.title: Kruger National Park to Johannesburg
included: Game drive through Kruger National Park
days.description: You can join the sunrise game drive for more wildlife spotting or sleep in for a late breakfast. One final game drive takes you through the park looking for any remaining wildlife before you head out. The afternoon drive to Johannesburg gives you time to rest at your hotel before tomorrow's flight.

days.title: Johannesburg to Victoria Falls
optional: Jump, zipline, or swing off the bridge over the Zambezi River
days.description: You'll fly from Johannesburg to Victoria Falls this morning. A hike along the falls lets you see one of the Seven Natural Wonders and the world's largest waterfall. Bring a raincoat because the spray can soak you completely, which is why locals call it 'The Smoke That Thunders'. The afternoon offers optional activities like jumping, ziplining, or swinging off the bridge that connects Zimbabwe and Zambia over the Zambezi River.

days.title: Victoria Falls
optional: White water rafting along the Zambezi River
days.description: Choose between white water rafting on the Zambezi River or a locally guided village tour to see how people live in the area. The evening ends with an optional sunset cruise on the river with drinks, which is highly recommended for an unforgettable African sunset experience.

days.title: Victoria Falls to Chobe
optional: Guided walking safari along Zambezi National Park
days.description: Start with an optional walking safari through Zambezi National Park to track wildlife on foot and learn about smaller animals and plants. A helicopter ride upgrade is available for aerial views of the falls. Later, you'll cross into Botswana and head to Chobe National Park, known for its large elephant population. You'll camp under the stars at a private Contiki site with your own guides, cooks, and bonfire.

days.title: Chobe
optional: Wildlife cruise on the Chobe River at sunset
days.description: Wake early to watch the sunrise over the African bush with light breakfast, then head out on a morning game drive to spot wildlife you may have heard during the night. After checking into the lodge late morning, relax by the pool and swap stories with other travelers. An optional wildlife cruise on the Chobe River at sunset puts you near hippos and crocodiles, followed by a buffet dinner.

days.title: Chobe to Makgadikgadi Salt Pans
optional: Cruise the salt pans in open safari vehicles searching for meerkat colonies
Optional dinner and drinks at the bar
days.description: You'll head south from Kasane to Gweta Lodge at the edge of the Makgadikgadi Salt Pans. An optional cruise through the salt pans in open safari vehicles searches for meerkat colonies while you capture funky perspective photos in one of the world's largest salt flats. The day ends with sundowner drinks under a Botswana icon, then dinner and drinks at the lodge bar are optional.

days.title: Makgadikgadi Salt Pans to Okavango Delta
days.description: Leaving the salt pans behind, you'll head to the Okavango Delta, a unique wildlife haven and natural landscape. An awe-inspiring game drive happens before you settle into your exclusive Contiki Safari Camp with pre-erected two-person dome tents. You'll share a campfire meal under the stars while swapping tales with fellow travelers.

days.title: Okavango Delta
optional: Mokoro boat trip along the waterways
Night drive with spotlights seeking nocturnal animals
days.description: After breakfast, join an early morning game drive spotting elephants, hippos, and hopefully predators in Africa's iconic wildlife paradise. Back at camp for lunch, you can relax in the chill tent. The afternoon gives you a choice between staying at camp or taking an optional Mokoro boat trip along the waterways. Another afternoon game drive follows, then an optional night drive with spotlights searches for nocturnal animals, and a traditional campfire dinner wraps up the evening.

days.title: Okavango Delta to Maun
optional: Okavango Delta Brewery tour, tasting, and dinner
days.description: Enjoy one last morning at the Delta with coffee and breakfast at sunrise, followed by a final morning game drive with eyes out for elephants as you leave this wildlife area. After checking into the lodge, relax by the pool. An optional helicopter flight hovering above the waterways or flying high offers stunning views of the unique inland delta. This evening, celebrate your last night in Botswana at the Okavango Delta Brewery with a tour, tasting, and dinner.

days.title: Maun to Windhoek
days.description: You'll leave Botswana and head into Namibia, crossing two countries on this journey. Say goodbye to your first Trip Manager in Maun, cross the border, and arrive in Windhoek later that evening. Your new local Namibian Trip Manager will meet you and lead the rest of your adventure. Keep cameras ready for the savannah scenery along the way. The evening is relaxed with dinner near the hotel and time for last-minute shopping.

days.title: Windhoek to Etosha National Park
included: Guided city tour of Windhoek including Christuskirche, Independence Memorial Museum, Parliament Building and gardens
Game drive at Okapuka Safari Lodge
Visit to cultural hotspots en route to Etosha
days.description: Begin in Windhoek with a guided city tour, walking through the Christuskirche and checking out the Independence Memorial Museum to get a feel for the local history. After that, head out toward Etosha National Park and stop at Okapuka Safari Lodge for a game drive and lunch. Once you reach your lodge in Etosha, you'll have some free time to relax by the pool before dinner in Outjo.

days.title: Etosha
included: Game drive in Etosha National Park
days.description: Wake early for your first big game drive in Namibia, a wildlife experience unlike anywhere else. Keep your eyes open for desert-adapted antelope and other incredible animals. You'll return to the lodge for lunch, then have free time for sunbathing and relaxing. A sunset walk in the late afternoon leads to a buffet dinner back at the lodge.

days.title: Etosha to Swakopmund via Spitzkoppe
included: Visit San Bushmen of Omandumba with language lesson and survival education
days.description: Heading west toward the coastal town of Swakopmund, you'll stop in the Erongo Mountains to visit San Bushmen of Omandumba who teach you their local language and share survival skills in the harsh desert. Browse handmade arts and crafts for souvenirs. Next comes Spitzkoppe, the 'Matterhorn of Namibia', for lunch and to see its towering granite peaks. After checking into your hotel, a Swakopmund Township Tour follows with traditional dinner, and the rest of the evening is free to explore.

days.title: Swakopmund and Walvis Bay
optional: Kayaking trip at Pelican Point with seal viewing
Combo tour exploring coastal sand dunes to Sandwich Harbour
days.description: Head to Walvis Bay for a kayaking trip at Pelican Point with serious wow factor, keeping eyes open for seals, dolphins, and maybe whales. You can optionally combine this with a full-day adventure exploring coastal sand dunes on the way to famous Sandwich Harbour. If you prefer a more relaxed pace, spend the afternoon freely exploring Swakopmund, checking out local bars and restaurants, hitting the dunes, or experiencing both.

days.title: Swakopmund to Sossusvlei
days.description: A long but beautiful drive takes you into the Namibian desert. You'll stop for lunch at Solitaire, a one-horse town known for its apple pie. Arriving at your lodge near the Sossusvlei salt and clay pans in the evening, you'll be framed by some of the world's highest sand dunes. After checking in, enjoy a swim, then head out for a sunset desert drive followed by buffet dinner.

days.title: Sossusvlei to Windhoek
included: Walk along Big Daddy sand dune and Deadvlei
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner (Farewell dinner at Joe's Beerhouse)
days.description: Wake early to visit Namib-Naukluft National Park with eyes open for Oryx and other desert wildlife. Once in the sand dunes, you'll leave the jeep and walk along Big Daddy sand dune down into nearby Deadvlei for unrivalled 360-degree views. After lunch, the drive back to Windhoek offers a final scenic journey. You'll check in, freshen up, and head out for a farewell dinner at the famous Joe's Beerhouse.

name: Costa Rica Classic 12 Day - One Life Adventures

attributes.name: Nature & Wildlife
attributes.tip: Explore untamed landscapes teeming with wildlife

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

attributes.name: Medium Intensity
attributes.tip: Travelers should be comfortable with somewhat-demanding activities

intro:
Discover Costa Rica on our first-ever Americas tour. This 12-day Costa Rica group tour unveils volcanic vistas, pristine beaches, and diverse wildlife including sloths. From adrenaline-pumping activities to serene moments, experience the perfect blend of nature and culture. Enjoy Costa Rica's stunning landscapes and vibrant communities on this transformative Central American journey.


Get ready for an unforgettable journey that begins and ends in the trendy suburb of Escazu within the province of San José. Over the next 12 days on our Costa Rica tour, you'll explore Poás Volcano, experience the world-famous Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve, and unwind on sun-drenched beaches. You'll explore the diverse destinations of San José, Sarapiquí, Monteverde, Santa Teresa and Manuel Antonio. 


Each day offers a mix of adventure, cultural immersion, and relaxation. This journey takes you from a Sloth & wildlife sanctuary tour to freedom days spent hiking, relaxing on the beach, or ziplining through the forest. Designed for nature lovers, adventurers, and eco-conscious travellers, our Costa Rica group tour promises an experience you will remember forever.

days.title: San José to Escazú
included: Welcome dinner at a charming local restaurant with traditional Costa Rican cuisine
optional: Explore San José (not included in tour itinerary)
days.start_point: Aeropuerto Internacional Juan Santamaría (SJO), Ruta Nacional 1, Alajuela, Alajuela 20109, Costa Rica (Arrival Area)
days.description: You'll arrive at San José airport and get transferred to Escazú, a lively suburb with great views over the Central Valley. Once you're settled into your accommodation, there's a welcome dinner where you'll meet the group and try traditional Costa Rican dishes like gallo pinto and patacones.

days.title: Poás Volcano & Rainforest Lodge
included: Walk to the crater of Poás Volcano
optional: Trek to the lagoon rim at Poás Volcano
Red-eyed tree frog spotting in the evening
days.description: You'll leave San José and head up to Poás Volcano's crater rim, which is one of Costa Rica's most active volcanoes. Weather permitting, you might catch gas emissions from the center, and there's an optional hike out to the lagoon rim where the water's this vibrant blue color. On the drive back, the route passes by the 4th and 5th falls of La Paz Waterfalls, so you'll get those views from the road. After checking into your sustainable rainforest lodge, there's a hands-on cooking class waiting at a family farm where you'll learn traditional Costa Rican recipes. If you're interested, the evening brings an optional chance to spot red-eyed tree frogs with other travelers.

days.title: La Fortuna - Wildlife & Chocolate
optional: Ziplining adventure through the forest canopy
Swimming at El Salto swimming hole with rope swing
days.description: Your morning starts at Proyecto Asis Wildlife Rescue Centre meeting sloths and learning about them in their natural setting. From there, you'll visit a small family-run coffee and cacao plantation where the owners share their story. After a late lunch in La Fortuna town, the afternoon opens up with choices. You can zipline through the forest canopy, visit La Fortuna Waterfall, swim at El Salto with a rope swing, or relax in natural hot springs.

days.title: La Fortuna - Free Time & Hot Springs
optional: Hiking through national parks with wildlife viewing
National park exploration with drop-off service
days.description: The morning is completely yours to fill however you'd like. National parks are nearby for hiking where you might spot toucans, coatis, and sloths. Or try ziplining through the canopy, cooling off under a waterfall, or doing something else entirely. Drop-off service can get you to whatever activity you choose. As the afternoon settles in, you'll head to a local spot with natural thermal springs to soak and relax before the next day.

days.title: Journey to Monteverde Cloud Forest
included: Cloud Forest Night Safari Walk with ranger
days.description: You'll travel by road and boat into the Monteverde Cloud Forest for a full day. Check into a rainforest conservation lodge right within the national park. When night falls, a ranger leads you on a night walk through the forest where you might spot tarantulas, snakes, sloths, birds, and toucanets. The evening ends with a cup of local hot chocolate.

days.title: Monteverde Cloud Forest - Volunteering & Wildlife
included: Cloud Forest Trail Management with a Ranger
days.description: Work gloves on, and you'll help park rangers maintain trails throughout Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve while earning eco-points. There are ecology talks before and after your trail work that cover sustainability efforts in the reserve. In the afternoon, you can switch gears and either spot wildlife like quetzals and monkeys, hang out at the nearby Hummingbird Café, or go for adrenaline activities. The hanging bridge walks, ziplines, rope swings, and bungee jumps are all available depending on what calls to you.

days.title: Monteverde to Santa Teresa Beach
included: Guided Ocean Kayaking with Trash Collection in Paquera
days.description: You'll descend the mountain roads toward the Pacific Ocean. Along the way, stop in Paquera bay for a guided ocean kayaking activity that includes helping clean up ocean plastic. Continue driving to Santa Teresa, a lively coastal town, and check into beachfront accommodation just a 5-minute walk from the sand. Spend the rest of the day by the pool watching the sunset.

days.title: Santa Teresa Beach Free Day
optional: Sunset yoga session near the beach
days.description: Most of the day is free for beach time. You can take a surf lesson to try out the legendary breaks, or just relax on the beach and get some sun. There's an optional sunset yoga session near the beach for a peaceful end to the day. If you want more adventure, you can join an optional bioluminescent night kayaking tour or a full moon tour depending on the timing.

days.title: Gulf Ferry to Manuel Antonio
optional: Explore small trails from the hotel for wildlife spotting
days.description: A gulf-crossing ferry takes you toward Manuel Antonio National Park, and you'll watch for marine life during the crossing. There are a couple of stops before you reach your eco-village accommodation. Once settled, you can relax by the pool while watching for monkeys in the nearby trees. A local bus stops right outside the hotel if you want to get to the beach, restaurants, or sunset spots. Small trails behind the hotel offer chances to see birds, frogs, and other wildlife without going far.

days.title: Manuel Antonio - National Park Exploration
days.description: You'll spend the day experiencing Manuel Antonio National Park, one of Costa Rica's well-known nature reserves. The jungle has swimming spots, evergreen forests thick with relaxed sloths and monkeys, beaches to walk along, and trails throughout. Birds and monkeys show up regularly as you move around. The afternoon is free, so you can relax at your jungle hotel or keep exploring. Bus service makes it easy to get back whenever you're ready.

days.title: Manuel Antonio to Escazú Farewell
days.description: You'll wake up in Manuel Antonio with a free morning to do what you want. Choose to walk through rainforest trails, paddle through mangrove waterways, spend time on pristine beaches, or join an optional yoga session. In the afternoon, you'll drive back through scenic mountain roads to Escazú. The tour ends with a farewell dinner where you'll celebrate with the group and toast to the connections and memories you've made.

days.title: Departure from Costa Rica
optional: Explore San José (not included in tour itinerary)
days.description: After one last hearty breakfast, you'll say goodbye to Costa Rica. Transfer to the airport (at your own cost) with plenty of memories from your group tour.

days.title: Rome
optional: Explore restaurants and dining options on Via Cavour
days.start_point: Rome, Italy (Rome)
days.description: You'll arrive in Rome and get transferred to your hotel where your guide will meet you. Later in the evening, head over to Via Cavour and check out the restaurants there. You've got plenty of options whether you want Italian, Indian, Chinese, or something else entirely.

days.title: Rome
included: Three-hour guided tour of Imperial Rome combining walking tour and panoramic bus ride
Visit Arch of Constantine, exterior of Colosseum, Imperial Forums, Circus Maximus, Baths of Caracalla, Basilica of Saint Mary Major, Pyramid of Cestius, and Castel Sant'Angelo
optional: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel guided tour (70 EUR, 3 hours) - high demand, advance booking recommended
The Baroque Rome tour featuring beautiful squares and fountains including Plaza de España, Fontana de Trevi, Pantheon, and Piazza Navona (40 EUR, 2 hours 30 minutes) - 15 people minimum required
days.description: Start your morning with a three-hour guided tour that combines walking through Imperial Rome and a bus ride taking in major sights. You'll pass by the Arch of Constantine, the Colosseum exterior, Imperial Forums, Circus Maximus, and the Baths of Caracalla before wrapping up at Vatican City around 11:00 a.m. By evening, head to Trastevere for dinner and you'll be back at the hotel around 8:30 p.m.

days.title: Rome - Florence
included: Guided walking tour of Florence visiting Ponte Vecchio, Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria
optional: Explore Florence's historic center and surrounding attractions during free time
days.description: After leaving Rome, you'll head north through nice countryside and arrive in Florence. Start at Piazzale Michelangelo for views of the city, then walk toward the historic center and grab lunch. From there, a local guide takes you through Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria. You'll have free time in the evening to wander around and find somewhere to eat.

days.title: Florence - Venice
included: Boat transfer across Giudecca Canal to Island of Venice
Visit St. Mark's Square with local guide
optional: Gondola ride in Venice (40 EUR, 20 minutes) - includes guide accompaniment and shared gondola for up to 5 persons, 15 people minimum required
days.description: You'll cross the Apennines heading toward Venice with some beautiful mountain views along the way. Once there, take a boat across the Giudecca Canal to reach the Island of Venice. A local guide shows you St. Mark's Square, then you'll visit the Murano Glass Factory to see how they make glass using traditional techniques. Free time after that to explore on your own. Your hotel is in the Mestre district.

days.title: Venice - Innsbruck - Zurich
days.description: Leaving Venice, you'll head toward Austria with a stop in Innsbruck where you can walk through the historic town center and have lunch. After that, you'll travel through the Tyrolean region with nice landscapes as you cross into Switzerland, getting to Zurich by evening.

days.title: Zurich - Lucerne - Zurich
included: Cable car ride to Grindelwald First
Walking tour to suspended bridge with glacier views
optional: Full-day Mount Titlis excursion (185 EUR) - take rotating cable car to summit at 3,028 m, visit Glacier Cave, cross Cliff Walk suspension bridge, ride Ice Flyer chair lift, snowtubing at Glacier Park, includes meals and professional guide, operated by third party, minimum 15 people required, must be booked in advance, replaces the regular Day 6 itinerary
days.description: Spend the day in the Interlaken region with great mountain and lake views. You'll stop in Grindelwald for coffee, then take a cable car up the mountain and walk along a winding path to a suspended bridge with glacier views. Lunch is included while you're up there. Later, head to Lucerne for some time to walk around before returning to Zurich.

days.title: Zurich - Strasbourg - Paris
days.description: Head out from Zurich toward Alsace in France. You'll visit Strasbourg, the regional capital, where French and German influences mix together nicely. Walk around and see the city before continuing on to Paris, where you'll arrive in the evening.

days.title: Paris
included: Visit Palace of Versailles grounds and gardens
Panoramic city tour of Paris with local guide
optional: Paris by Night panoramic tour (40 EUR, 3 hours) - guided tour of illuminated landmarks including Arc de Triomphe, Alexander III Bridge, Opera House, Eiffel Tower, Champs-Élysées, depends on arrival time and sunset schedule, must be purchased from tour leader, minimum 20 people required

Moulin Rouge show 21:00 (190 EUR, 2 hours) - oldest famous cabaret with over 80 artists, champagne included, reserved seating, gratuities included, minimum 15 people required, advance booking recommended, no children under 6 allowed, no child discount

Moulin Rouge show 23:00 (160 EUR, 2 hours) - oldest famous cabaret with over 80 artists, champagne included, reserved seating, gratuities included, minimum 20 people required, advance booking recommended, no children under 6 allowed, no child discount
days.description: This morning, go to the Palace of Versailles and check out the beautiful gardens there. Then head to Montmartre, a neighborhood known for artists and the cabaret scene. Later, take a panoramic city tour with a local guide who'll show you Paris's wide avenues and famous monuments before heading back to the hotel.

days.title: Paris - Rouen
included: Visit Eiffel Tower up to second floor (tickets included)
days.description: Start at the Eiffel Tower and go up to the second floor with your included ticket. After that, take a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine. You'll have a free afternoon to explore Paris however you like. Around 4:00 p.m., head out toward Normandy and arrive in Rouen where you can walk around and see the medieval buildings and the Gothic cathedral.

days.title: Rouen - English Channel - Canterbury - London
days.description: Start with a walk through central Rouen before heading north to the English Channel. Cross by ferry to Canterbury, England's religious center with a nice historic area. Continue on to London where you'll have free time in the Tower Bridge area before checking into your hotel.

days.title: London
included: Panoramic city tour of London with local guide
View Parliament, River Thames, and Buckingham Palace
Evening stroll through Piccadilly, Leicester Square, Chinatown, and Soho
optional: Thames Valley and Windsor Town excursion (35 EUR, 6 hours) - visit Windsor Castle (outside view), explore historic town with Tudor, Georgian and Victorian architecture, see Eton College founded in 1440, includes bus transport through Thames Valley with guide assistance, minimum 15 people required
days.description: Take a panoramic tour of London with a local guide to see the city's culture and history. You'll see Parliament, the River Thames, Buckingham Palace, and possibly catch the Changing of the Guard depending on the dates. By evening, meet up to stroll through Piccadilly, Leicester Square, Chinatown, and Soho which have lots of theaters and entertainment. Have dinner before returning to the hotel.

days.title: London
optional: Browse Camden Market during free time
days.description: After breakfast, visit the British Museum, one of the world's oldest museums with artifacts from many different cultures. At lunchtime, transfer to Camden where the market is known for its variety of items from different cultures. You'll have a free afternoon to look around at your own pace. The tour ends today.

days.title: Berlin
days.start_point: Berlin, Germany (Berlin)
days.description: You'll arrive in Berlin and get transferred to your hotel. After checking in, the afternoon is yours to settle down and rest from travel. Around that time, stop by the hotel reception to pick up information about what's coming up on the tour.

days.title: Berlin
included: Guided panoramic tour of Berlin historic center
optional: Potsdam excursion with Sanssouci Palace gardens and Cecilienhof Palace (50 EUR, 5 hours, minimum 20 people, May-September only)
Sachsenhausen Concentration Camp excursion (45 EUR, 5 hours, minimum 15 people)
days.description: Today you're taking a guided tour through Berlin's main sights. The route covers the historic center, Museum Island, and the Reichstag and Brandenburg Gate. You'll also walk through some of the city's shopping streets and parks. The Holocaust Memorial and Berlin Wall Memorial Museum are on the schedule. If you're interested, there's an optional trip out to Potsdam to see the palaces there.

days.title: Berlin - Dresden - Bamberg - Nuremberg
optional: Visit site of Hitler's Coliseum in Nuremberg
days.description: You're heading south from Berlin toward Bavaria. First stop is Dresden, where you'll see the palace sitting along the Elbe River. From there, the route takes you through Bamberg, a charming town with a section called Little Venice that's worth walking around. Later you'll reach Nuremberg, Bavaria's second-largest city. There's time to see the historic site of the former Nazi rally grounds if you want.

days.title: Nuremberg - Kloster Weltenburg - Dachau - Munich
included: Danube cruise from Kelheim through Danube Gorge
optional: Visit Landshut (winter alternative if Danube cruise unavailable)
days.description: Early in the day, you'll board a boat at Kelheim for a cruise down the Danube Gorge, which includes a stop at Kloster Weltenburg monastery. After that, you head to Dachau to tour the concentration camp museum, a significant but difficult part of the itinerary. Then it's on to Munich for the afternoon and evening. You'll see BMW Welt, the Olympiastadion, and the historic center with Marienplatz, Viktualienmarkt, and the Englischer Garten. Traditional beer houses are scattered throughout the city if you want to grab dinner.

days.title: Munich - Füssen - Rothenburg - Frankfurt
included: Walk to Mary's Bridge at Neuschwanstein Castle
optional: Horse carriage ride from Mary's Bridge in Füssen
days.description: The route takes you through the Alps to Füssen and Neuschwanstein Castle. After exploring the castle, you can walk out to Mary's Bridge to see the gorge from above. Horse carriage rides are available if you prefer not to walk. Continuing along the Romantic Road, you'll reach Rothenburg, a walled town with a medieval feel, and visit the Christmas Museum there. By evening, you'll arrive in Frankfurt, Germany's financial hub.

days.title: Frankfurt - Rhine Cruise - Cologne - Dortmund
included: Rhine cruise between Rüdesheim and Sankt Goar
optional: Walk along Rhine River in Cologne
days.description: You're taking a scenic cruise through the Rhine and Moselle valleys. The stretch between Rüdesheim and Sankt Goar is the highlight, so the boat cruise covers that route. At Cochem, you'll stop to see the ancient riverside castle and have lunch. From there, it's to Cologne to visit the Gothic cathedral, walk along the Rhine riverbank, and check out the lively downtown area. Later you'll head to Dortmund where you're staying for the night.

days.title: Dortmund - Fairy Tale Route - Hanover
included: Visit Trendelburg castle and Rapunzel Tower
optional: Visit Hamelin and Pied Piper landmarks
Explore Hanover old town hall area
days.description: Today follows the Fairy Tale Route inspired by the Brothers Grimm, visiting old medieval towns along the way. You'll start at Trendelburg with its Rapunzel Tower, then move to Höxter and Corvey Abbey, a UNESCO site. Next is Polle to see the ruins of Cinderella's Castle. Hamelin is on the route as well, known for the Pied Piper legend. The day ends in Hanover, where you'll have time to explore near the old town hall.

days.title: Hanover - Goslar - Quedlinburg - Berlin
days.description: After breakfast, you're heading to Goslar, which has some of the best medieval wooden architecture in Germany and old walls around the town. Then you continue to Quedlinburg, another UNESCO site with over 2,100 half-timbered houses, the town hall, and Collegiate Castle. You'll have free time during lunch to walk around and explore on your own. By evening, you're driving back to Berlin.

days.title: Paris to Loire Valley - Blois, Tours, Villandry, Amboise
included: Visit Château de Villandry gardens (tickets included)
days.description: Head south into the Loire Valley, starting in Blois where you'll check out the castle there. From there, move on to Tours, which sits along the Loire River and is nice for a walk and lunch break. After lunch, you'll see the Château de Villandry with its gardens that are the real draw here. The day wraps up in Amboise, a medieval city right on the river, and dinner's included.

days.title: Amboise to Loire Valley - Chenonceaux, Chambord, Limoges
days.description: This morning takes you through Amboise to visit the Château du Clos Lucé, where Leonardo da Vinci lived out his final years. From there, you'll head to the Château de Chenonceau, which is built right over the river like a bridge. Next comes Chambord, the largest castle in the valley, then travel to Limoges, which is known for porcelain production. If time allows, you can see the historic center and Saint-Etienne Cathedral before the day ends.

days.title: Limoges to Dordogne - Lascaux, Sarlat, Beynac-et-Cazenac, Rocamadour
included: Visit Lascaux museum and cave replica (tickets included)
Explore Sarlat UNESCO World Heritage town
Explore Rocamadour medieval village and sanctuary
optional: Walk the Via Crucis in Rocamadour
days.description: Travel from Limoges into the Dordogne region and visit Lascaux, where you'll see the museum and a replica of the prehistoric caves with their paintings inside. After that, you'll head to Sarlat, a UNESCO World Heritage site with a nice Renaissance center where you can walk around and grab lunch. In Beynac, there's a medieval castle overlooking the river to explore. The day finishes in Rocamadour, a medieval village built into a cliff with a sanctuary, where you'll walk the Via Crucis and take a lift back up. Dinner is included.

days.title: Rocamadour to Bordeaux - Padirac, Collonges-la-Rouge, Saint-Émilion
days.description: Start the day at Padirac Chasm, where you'll take a boat ride 75 meters down underground on the river. Then head to Collonges-la-Rouge, a village made from red stone and connected to the Way of St. James. After lunch, you'll travel to Saint-Émilion in the Bordeaux wine region and have time to walk around. You'll arrive in Bordeaux by evening.

days.title: Bordeaux to Paris
included: Explore Bordeaux UNESCO World Heritage center
optional: Visit Cité du Vin interactive museum
days.description: Walk through Bordeaux's UNESCO World Heritage center, including the Water Mirror and the old town with its pedestrian streets and 11th-century cathedral. You have free time to stroll along the Garonne River banks, where there are restaurants and cafes, or you can check out the Cité du Vin wine museum if you're interested. After lunch, hop on a modern high-speed train that covers 500 km to Paris in just over two hours. Once you arrive, you'll transfer from the station to your hotel.

days.title: Paris
days.description: After breakfast, your tour comes to an end. You'll head out with good memories from everything you've seen and done over these days.
