days.title: Madrid
optional: Dinner at a restaurant in Plaza Mayor or La Latina (Spanish, Indian, Chinese, or Middle Eastern cuisines available)
days.description: You'll land at Madrid airport and head to your hotel to get settled. The rest of the afternoon is yours to relax and do what you like. When evening comes around, you'll meet with your guide for a welcome briefing. From there, you'll get a transfer over to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, where the neighborhood has plenty of tapas spots and restaurants to grab dinner.

days.title: Madrid
included: Comprehensive tour of central Madrid (Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, Plaza Mayor)
Visit to Retiro Park with lake and Palacio de Cristal
days.description: This morning starts with a guided tour through central Madrid hitting Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. After that, you'll head to Retiro Park to walk around the lake and see the Palacio de Cristal. The tour also includes entry to Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, where Real Madrid plays. You've got the afternoon free to spend however you want, then it's back to the hotel by evening.

days.title: Madrid - Zaragoza - Poblet - Barcelona
included: Visit to Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar in Zaragoza
landmarks: Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar
days.description: You're heading out from Madrid through Castile toward Zaragoza to check out the Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar. Next on the route is Poblet Abbey, a medieval monastery that's one of the best preserved in Europe (admission's covered). From there, you'll continue on to Barcelona, pulling in as the sun sets.

days.title: Barcelona
included: Panoramic tour of Barcelona including Gaudí modernist architecture, Ramblas, and World Exposition and Olympic Games sites
optional: Guided visit to Basilica La Sagrada Familia by Antoni Gaudí (1 hour 50 minutes, 65 EUR)
days.description: The morning has a panoramic tour of Barcelona showing you Gaudí's modernist buildings, the busy Ramblas, and historical spots from past World Expositions and the Olympic Games. The tour wraps up at Maremagnum, which is a leisure and dining area right by the water near Columbus Square. You've got the afternoon to explore on your own pace, then head back to the hotel.

days.title: Barcelona - Peniscola - Valencia
included: Stop in Peniscola for a stroll through the medieval walled city
Guided tour of Valencia with local guide covering historic monuments and City of Arts and Sciences
days.description: You're traveling south down the Mediterranean coast and stopping in Peniscola, a medieval walled town with nice beaches. The drive continues to Valencia, and you'll get there around lunchtime. In the afternoon, a local guide takes you through this historic port city on the coast, showing you old monuments mixed with the modern City of Arts and Sciences. Later you'll have free time to wander around, then dinner back at the hotel is included.

days.title: Valencia - Alicante - Guadix - Granada
included: Free time in Alicante to stroll through the city and see the Castle of Santa Bárbara
Stop in Guadix to explore the historic quarter with its unique inhabited cave houses, Renaissance cathedral, and views of Sierra Nevada
days.description: Heading through the Valencian Community to Alicante, a Mediterranean city with golden beaches, an old quarter, and the Castle of Santa Bárbara sitting on a hill. You'll have time to walk around before moving on through the Murcia region with a lunch break included. Once in Andalusia, you'll stop in Guadix to see the cave houses people actually live in, along with the Renaissance cathedral and views toward the Sierra Nevada. You'll roll into Granada late afternoon, and dinner at your hotel is covered.

days.title: Granada
included: Alhambra Palace and Generalife Gardens (if tickets are included in your tour)
optional: Visit Granada Cathedral with tombs of the Catholic Monarchs
Zambra Gitana Show Los Tarantos - flamenco performance with stroll through Albaicín-Sacromonte UNESCO neighborhood and San Nicolás viewpoint (3 hours, 40 EUR)
days.description: Today is completely yours in Granada. If your tour includes tickets, you can explore the Alhambra Palace and the Generalife Gardens, both from the Arab period. In the afternoon, you're free to discover the city at your own pace, and the cathedral is worth seeing since it holds the tombs of the Catholic Monarchs.

days.title: Granada - Nerja - Malaga - Ronda - Seville
included: Stop in Nerja for a stroll through the charming seaside town
Stop in Málaga for lunch and time to explore the historic center
Stop in Ronda to see the stunning white town and dramatic gorge
Dinner at the hotel in Seville
days.description: Leaving Granada, the drive takes you through mountain scenery as you head away from the Sierra Nevada. You'll follow the Mediterranean coast, an area called the Tropical Coast where they grow guavas, mangoes, and avocados. Nerja is a stop along the way, a charming seaside town with impressive cliffs. Then on to Málaga, the capital of Costa del Sol, for lunch and a walk through the historic center. Later you'll head into the Andalusian mountains to reach Ronda, a white town famous for its dramatic gorge. You'll reach Seville in the late afternoon, and dinner is included at your hotel.

days.title: Seville
included: City tour of Seville including the Cathedral with Giralda, Guadalquivir River banks, and neighborhoods of Santa Cruz and Triana
Boat ride on the Guadalquivir River with panoramic views
optional: Flamenco Night with Dinner at a traditional grill restaurant (2 hours, 70 EUR) - includes delicious dinner with 2 courses and dessert, wine/water/sangria, flamenco show with tables close to the stage, and bus transfers
Artistic Guided Visit to Seville Cathedral (1 hour, 35 EUR) - includes entrance, reservation, and option to climb La Giralda tower (104 meters) for city views
Flamenco Show in Patio Sevillano (1 hour 30 minutes, 40 EUR) - includes glass of Spanish wine or sangria, flamenco show with dancers, singers, and musicians, and bus transfers
days.description: A city tour of Seville starts the day, covering the cathedral with its famous Giralda tower, the Guadalquivir River banks, and the neighborhoods of Santa Cruz and Triana. After the tour ends, you'll take a relaxing boat ride on the Guadalquivir River for views from the water (this is included). If you're interested, there's a flamenco tablao option in the evening.

days.title: Seville - Córdoba - Consuegra - Madrid
included: Visit to Mosque-Cathedral in Córdoba (admission included)
Guided tour of the Jewish Quarter in Córdoba with local guide
Stop in Consuegra to see the 12 windmills and castle
Visit to the Rucio Mill in Consuegra
days.description: You're leaving Seville and heading into the Guadalquivir Valley toward Córdoba, which was the capital during the Caliphate era in Islamic times. A local guide shows you the Mosque-Cathedral (admission included) and the Jewish Quarter, known for its narrow lanes and flower-filled patios. After lunch, you'll move into Castilian territory with a stop in Consuegra where you can see 12 windmills next to a castle overlooking the La Mancha plain. You'll visit the Rucio Mill before heading back to Madrid to finish out the day.

name: Sri Lanka Highlights - 11 Days Private / Small Group Comfort Tour

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided
attributes.tip: An experienced guide will be with you for the entire tour

intro:
Discover the diverse beauty of Sri Lanka on this captivating 11-day journey - a perfect blend of history, nature, and seaside relaxation. Begin with the coastal charm of Negombo, then travel to Sigiriya to witness its majestic rock fortress and the nearby Dambulla Caves. Immerse yourself in Kandy’s sacred heritage, wander through the emerald tea fields of Nuwara Eliya, and unwind amid Ella’s breathtaking mountain scenery.


Highlights You’ll Experience

  • Wildlife encounters at Udawalawe National Park — home to herds of elephants
  • Golden beaches & whale watching in Mirissa
  • Cultural explorations in Kandy & Sigiriya
  • Vibrant Colombo - where modern life meets colonial charm


Travel with Comfort & Confidence

  • Accommodation, daily breakfasts & listed transport included
  • No hidden costs, commission stops, or forced shopping detours
  • Optional activities clearly marked — enjoy full flexibility
  • Dedicated travel consultant available via WhatsApp & email before and during your trip
  • Licensed English-speaking chauffeur-guide throughout (other languages on request)
  • Backup vehicle always on standby to ensure uninterrupted travel


A Note on Cuisine


Sri Lankan cuisine is rich, flavorful, and spiced to perfection — but it may differ from what you’re used to. We recommend exploring new dishes gradually while savoring the island’s delicious variety.


A perfectly balanced 11-day adventure that captures Sri Lanka’s best — culture, wildlife, and beachside tranquility in one unforgettable journey.

days.title: Negombo
included: Airport pick-up and transfer to hotel in Negombo
optional: Negombo city tour - Dutch Canal stroll
days.start_point: Katunayaka, Gampaha, Sri Lanka (Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport)
days.description: You'll land at Colombo airport and head to Negombo, which is just 30 minutes away on the coast. If you have time before settling in, walk through the historic Dutch Canal, check out the Fish Market where local vendors sell fresh catches, and browse the spice shops. By evening, settle into your hotel with dinner overlooking the tropical coastline.

days.title: Negombo to Sigiriya
included: Sigiriya Village Tour - bullock cart ride through paddy fields
Traditional catamaran ride across scenic lake
Authentic Sri Lankan cooking session with ancient methods
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel in Negombo), Lunch (Traditional Sri Lankan lunch served on banana leaf during Sigiriya Village Tour)
days.description: After breakfast, you're heading inland through Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle to reach the Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO site with centuries-old Buddha statues and murals covering the walls. From there, you'll experience village life through a bullock cart ride across paddy fields, followed by a tuk-tuk ride and catamaran crossing. A traditional cooking demonstration gives you hands-on learning before climbing Sigiriya Rock Fortress at sunset for views across the jungle and surrounding villages.

days.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
included: Spice Garden in Matale - guided tour
Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic visit
optional: Herbal product purchases at Spice Garden
landmarks: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
days.description: Breakfast comes first, then you'll head to a Spice Garden in Matale to learn how cinnamon, nutmeg, and other spices connect to Ayurvedic practices. Moving on to Kandy, you'll take in views from the Kandy View Point and walk around Kandy Lake at a relaxed pace. The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of Buddhism's most important shrines, is next on your list. If there's a traditional cultural dance performance available, you can catch it during the evening.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
days.description: You'll drive through winding mountain roads with views of rolling tea plantations stretching across the landscape. Stop at a Tea Plantation and Factory to learn about Ceylon Tea production, watch workers hand-picking leaves, and taste different varieties. Later, continue to Nuwara Eliya and spend the afternoon at Bomburu Ella Waterfall, one of Sri Lanka's widest cascades with impressive water flow.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella
included: Scenic train ride from Nanuoya to Ella
optional: Cooking demonstration at Ella Spice Garden
days.meals: Breakfast (Breakfast at hotel in Nuwara Eliya)
days.description: Start with breakfast and a leisurely walk around Gregory Lake, surrounded by pine trees and misty mountains creating a peaceful setting. Then board the scenic train from Nanuoya to Ella, a journey considered one of the world's most scenic rail routes as it winds through tea plantations and valleys. Visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, a colonial engineering masterpiece, and explore Ella's evening scene with cozy cafes and bars.

days.title: Ella
optional: Flying Ravana Zipline at Ravana Pool Club
Infinity pool with mountain views at Ravana Pool Club
days.description: You'll wake in the cool mountain air and have breakfast before starting your full adventure day. A morning hike to Little Adam's Peak gives you panoramic views across valleys and tea plantations. Later, head to Ravana Pool Club where you can try the Flying Ravana Zipline or relax at the infinity pool. Stop by the Nine Arch Bridge again for photography, then spend the evening strolling through Ella town's laid-back atmosphere.

days.title: Ella to Udawalawe
optional: 3-hour jeep safari at Udawalawe National Park
days.description: After breakfast, you're driving south toward Udawalawe National Park, one of the best places to see wild elephants in Sri Lanka. A 3-hour jeep safari takes you through grasslands, scrub jungles, and shimmering lakes where you'll spot elephant herds, crocodiles, spotted deer, water buffalo, and various bird species. Back at the hotel, you'll have a BBQ dinner to wrap up the day.

days.title: Udawalawe to Mirissa
optional: Coconut Tree Hill visit at sunset
days.description: After breakfast, you'll drive south toward Mirissa's golden beaches, a coastal town where lush forests transition to swaying palms and ocean views. Check in and relax by the pool or beach at your own pace. In the late afternoon, explore Coconut Tree Hill with its towering palms overlooking the water and Parrot Rock Island just offshore, both especially nice at sunset. You can end with optional beachside seafood dining if you'd like.

days.title: Mirissa
optional: Local cafés and seafood restaurants exploration
days.description: You'll wake to waves and have breakfast before heading out for optional whale-watching in the Indian Ocean (seasonal November to April). The waters here are home to blue whales, sperm whales, dolphins, and sea turtles. After returning, spend the rest of the day relaxing on Mirissa Beach with swimming, sunbathing, and beach games. Explore local cafes and seafood restaurants on your own schedule.

days.title: Mirissa to Colombo
included: Galle Fort visit - Clock Tower, Maritime Museum, Dutch Reformed Church, ramparts
optional: Colombo city tour - Lotus Tower, Galle Face Green, local markets
days.description: Following breakfast and checkout from Mirissa, you're traveling along the beautiful southern coastline toward Colombo. Stop at the UNESCO World Heritage Galle Fort, a historic Dutch fort town featuring cobblestone streets, the Clock Tower, Maritime Museum, and Dutch Reformed Church. Walk the ramparts for ocean views or take an optional cycling tour. Then continue to Colombo, check in, and you can optionally explore the city's highlights like Lotus Tower and Galle Face Green.

days.title: Colombo
days.meals: Breakfast (Final breakfast at hotel in Colombo)
days.description: Have your final breakfast at the hotel in Colombo, then head to Bandaranaike International Airport for departure. You'll have time to reflect on everything you've experienced, from climbing Sigiriya Rock to visiting the Temple of the Sacred Tooth, exploring tea hill plantations, riding the scenic train, spotting wildlife on safari, and watching beach sunsets.

days.title: Frankfurt
days.description: You'll arrive in Frankfurt and get transferred to your hotel. After checking in, you have free time to settle down and get comfortable. Tour information will be available at the hotel reception in the afternoon if you want to stop by and pick it up.

days.title: Frankfurt - Cologne - Dortmund
included: Rhine River cruise between Rüdesheim and Sankt Goar
optional: Walk along the Rhine River in Cologne
days.description: This morning you'll cruise the Rhine between Rüdesheim and Sankt Goar, taking in the river scenery. From there, head to the Moselle River where lunch happens in Cochem village next to its old castle. Later you'll reach Cologne to see the Gothic cathedral and walk through the city center, then continue on to Dortmund for the night.

days.title: Dortmund - Hanover
included: Visit Trendelburg medieval castle and Rapunzel Tower
Visit Corvey Abbey (9th-century monastery and World Heritage Site)
Visit Cinderella's Castle ruins in Polle
optional: Stroll near Hanover old town hall
days.description: Travel through the Fairy Tale Route inspired by the Brothers Grimm stories. Check out Trendelburg castle and its famous Rapunzel Tower, then stop for lunch in Höxter where you can see Corvey Abbey. After that, visit the ruins of Cinderella's Castle in Polle and pass through Hamelin before arriving in Hanover for a walk near the old town hall.

days.title: Hanover - Goslar - Göttingen - Bad Sooden-Allendorf - Eisenach
included: Explore Goslar medieval old town (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
Visit Church of St. Peter in Goslar
optional: Stroll through Göttingen historic old town
days.description: Start the day in Goslar exploring its medieval old town, which is a UNESCO World Heritage site. You'll also visit the Rammelsberg silver mines museum to see the historic mining operation. Head to Göttingen for lunch and time to wander through the old town where the Brothers Grimm lived. Before arriving in Eisenach, stop in the scenic spa town of Bad Sooden.

days.title: Eisenach - Gotha - Erfurt - Leipzig
included: Visit Wartburg Castle (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
optional: Walk across house-lined bridge in Erfurt
days.description: Begin with a visit to Wartburg Castle, a UNESCO site where Martin Luther translated the New Testament. Return to Eisenach and you'll have free time to see the Bach House or the Automobile Museum on your own. Later you'll go to Gotha to see its Baroque palace and historic center, then to Erfurt to check out the cathedral and the famous bridge lined with houses. You'll arrive in Leipzig by late afternoon.

days.title: Leipzig - Dresden - Meissen - Moritzburg - Berlin
included: Visit Monument to the Battle of the Nations
optional: Explore Dresden Baroque and Renaissance architecture
Walk along the Elbe River in Dresden
landmarks: Monument to the Battle of the Nations
days.description: See the Monument to the Battle of the Nations in Leipzig, then travel to Dresden to walk through its Baroque and Renaissance neighborhoods and along the scenic Elbe riverwalks. Stop in Meissen to browse the famous porcelain and have lunch in the old town with its castle and cathedral. Visit Moritzburg's castle on an island with beautiful gardens, then head toward Berlin, arriving around 7:00 p.m.

days.title: Berlin
included: Guided tour of Berlin with local guide
optional: Explore Berlin at own pace in the afternoon
days.description: You'll take a guided tour of Berlin with a local guide covering Museum Island, the Television Tower, shopping areas, Brandenburg Gate, Reichstag, and parks from the coach. The group stops at the Holocaust Memorial and Berlin Wall Memorial Museum. In the afternoon you have free time to explore the city at your own pace, then head to the Kantstrasse area in the early evening for dinner or drinks.

intro:
This exciting 6-day budget adventure safari begins in Nairobi and takes you through some of Kenya’s most iconic destinations. Your journey starts at Amboseli National Park, renowned for its large herds of African elephants affectionately known as the "Jumbos" and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro, often called the "White Roof of Africa."

Next, you’ll visit Lake Nakuru, a bird lover’s paradise famous for its vibrant flocks of flamingos lining the shores.

The safari concludes in the world-famous Masai Mara, where you'll have the chance to encounter the Big Five, big cats, and a wealth of other incredible wildlife in their natural habitat.

days.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara National Reserve
included: Afternoon game drive in Masai Mara National Reserve
Wildlife viewing including big 5, cheetahs, hyenas, hippos, crocodiles, and bird species
days.start_point: Nairobi, Kenya (Nairobi Kenys, 07:30 - 08:00)
days.description: You'll leave Nairobi early in the morning and drive through the Great African Rift Valley heading toward Masai Mara. The landscape changes as you move east, and you should arrive by lunchtime. After eating at your lodge, you'll head out on an afternoon game drive where lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinos are all possible sightings, along with cheetahs, hyenas, hippos, crocodiles, and numerous bird species. Back at the lodge by evening for dinner.

days.title: Masai Mara National Reserve
included: Full-day game drive in Masai Mara Game Reserve
Wildlife viewing including gazelle, impala, antelope, giraffe, elephant, buffalo, warthog, leopard, cheetah, and lion
days.meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Lunch served in the park at the Mara River), Dinner
days.description: This day is dedicated to a full game drive through Masai Mara. You'll start early and spend the morning exploring the park's wildlife. Around midday, lunch happens out in the field at the Mara River, which marks the Kenya Tanzania border and is where wildebeest and zebra migrations often occur. After eating, you'll continue searching different sections of the park before heading back to camp as the light fades. Dinner follows at the lodge.

days.title: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru
days.description: After breakfast, you'll have the option to visit a Masai village to learn about the Maasai people, their culture, and how they live. Then head toward Nakuru with lunch along the way. You'll arrive with time to settle in before dinner and spend the evening relaxing.

days.title: Lake Nakuru to Amboseli National Park
included: Game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park
days.description: Check out and do a game drive through Lake Nakuru National Park, which is known for large flocks of flamingos that color the lake pink, plus endangered rhinos and Rothschild giraffes. Later, drive to Amboseli with lunch en route and stop at the Great Rift Valley viewpoint. You'll get there late evening, head to camp, and catch a sundowner.

days.title: Amboseli National Park
included: Full-day game drives in Amboseli National Park
Observation hill visit with Mt. Kilimanjaro views
days.description: After breakfast, do a full-day game drive through Amboseli National Park where you'll see plenty of elephants and hippos in the central swamp. Stop at the observation hill to get views of Mt. Kilimanjaro's snow-capped peak. Return to camp for lunch and have the afternoon free to rest.

days.title: Amboseli National Park to Nairobi
included: Early morning game viewing in Amboseli National Park
days.description: Head out early to photograph Mt. Kilimanjaro when light conditions are best, then continue exploring the park to find wildlife and spot some of the 500 bird species in the area. After that, you'll drive back to Nairobi.

name: New Zealand North to South Island Adventure

attributes.name: City & Culture
attributes.tip: Immerse yourself in rich history and local traditions

attributes.name: Group Tour
attributes.tip: Join a group and forge lifelong friendships

attributes.name: Fully Guided

intro:
From heart-racing moments to awe-inspiring scenery, this road trip through New Zealand is one to remember. Join a local leader for an 11-day adventure through epic landscapes, wildlife and living culture. Take it easy at Coromandel’s Hot Water Beach, check out simmering mud pools and geysers in Rotorua, learn the haka and tuck into a traditional hangi in a Maori village, and make the most of all that scenic Taupo has to offer. Then, travel to the South Island to continue your adventure, sailing on the ferry through the spectacular Marlborough Sounds. End it all in Christchurch, the perfect spot to extend your journey into the south!

There are walking opportunities throughout this trip. We recommend you bring good quality walking shoes if you're keen to enjoy a hike or two., Multiple activities on this trip are subject to weather and water conditions and on occasion, may be cancelled for safety or operational reasons. In the case of cancellation, we will endeavour to find a suitable replacement activity., There are some long travelling days on this trip, but it’s all part of the adventure and a great way to get to know your fellow travellers.

days.title: Auckland
days.description: You'll arrive in Auckland, a multicultural city with plenty of food, music, and arts on offer. The welcome meeting happens at 6 pm with your local leader and travel group, so if you get in early, walk around the harbour or check out some of the local pubs and shops. After the meeting, you can relax by the water or head out for dinner with the group.

days.title: Auckland to Coromandel Peninsula
days.description: The drive to Coromandel Peninsula takes you along scenic coastal roads with water views and white sand beaches. You'll reach Hot Water Beach where warm waters run under the sand, and you can dig your own natural hot tub if the tide cooperates. Spend the rest of the day on the beach or wandering the local town.

days.title: Coromandel Peninsula to Rotorua
optional: Cathedral Cove guided kayaking tour with dolphin spotting - NZD175
days.description: Start with a clifftop walk down to Cathedral Cove, known for its rock arches and pristine beaches within the Te Whanganui-o-Hei Marine Reserve. After exploring the cove, you'll travel to Rotorua, which sits in a geothermal area and is home to significant Maori culture.

days.title: Rotorua
optional: Forest Ziplining Canopy Tour - from NZD189 (3.5hrs)
Whitewater Rafting on Kaituna River - NZD139
Guided Glowworm Kayak, Hot Pools & BBQ Dinner - NZD300
days.description: You have the full day to explore Rotorua at your own pace. Walk through Kuirau Park to see the bubbling mud pools, or ask your local leader for tips on adventure activities and other things to do around town.

days.title: Rotorua to Murupara
included: Village tour with local Maori community
days.description: Start at Te Puia Maori Village to learn about Maori culture and see Pohutu, the country's largest geyser. Visit the kiwi conservation centre, then head to Kohutapu Lodge in Murupara where you'll meet local Maori community members, tour tribal lands, learn the haka war dance, and weave a flax plate. The day finishes with a traditional hangi dinner cooked underground.

days.title: Murupara to Taupo
days.description: Drive toward Taupo with stops at simmering mud pools, Huka Falls, and Aratiatia Dam with its rapids. You'll arrive at Taupo on the shores of New Zealand's largest lake with calm waters and mountain views. The afternoon is free, so you can choose bungy jumping or skydiving if you want action, or take a sunset lake cruise to relax.

days.title: Taupo
included: Tongariro National Park scenic drive access
optional: Tongariro Crossing Return Shuttle to/from Trail Head (Nov-Apr only) - NZD130
days.description: The full day is yours in Taupo. Stay lakeside for views, explore hiking trails, or tackle the Tongariro Crossing in nearby Tongariro National Park, which is one of the world's best one-day walks but it's demanding. You can also take a boat trip to see 14-metre-tall Maori cliff carvings around the lake, or soak at the natural hot pools at Otumuheke Stream.

days.title: Taupo to Wellington
days.description: The drive from Taupo to Wellington is long but scenic, passing through the Rangipo Desert and Tongariro National Park. You'll see volcanic peaks like Mt Ruapehu, Mt Tongariro, and Mt Ngauruhoe (Mount Doom from the films). Once in Wellington, New Zealand's creative capital, grab dinner and drinks with your group to celebrate.

days.title: Wellington to Kaikoura
days.description: Board the ferry across the Cook Strait and cruise through the Marlborough Sounds into Picton Harbour. From there, travel down to Kaikoura, known for marine wildlife. If you head out for dinner tonight, try the local crayfish.

days.title: Kaikoura to Christchurch
days.description: This morning, head out on a wildlife tour in Kaikoura to see dolphins, humpbacks, orcas, and sperm whales in their natural habitat. Stop by a seal colony to watch fur seals, then drive down to Christchurch and arrive in time for dinner at one of the city's top restaurants.

days.title: Christchurch
days.description: Your tour wraps up this morning after breakfast. If you want to stay longer in Christchurch and explore more, contact your booking agent ahead of time to arrange extra accommodation.

intro:
Experience the highlights of China’s iconic Golden Triangle—Beijing, Xi’an and Shanghai. Walk along the legendary Great Wall, uncover the mystery of the Terracotta Warriors, and soak up the modern energy of Shanghai.

­ 

This 9-day tour blends ancient history, rich culture and breathtaking sights—perfect for first-time travellers keen to discover China’s most famous cities in one unforgettable journey.

days.title: Beijing
days.description: Your driver will meet you at Beijing Airport and take you to your hotel. Once you're checked in, the rest of the day is open. You can either relax and adjust to the time change, or if you're feeling energetic, wander around the nearby area to get a feel for the city.

days.title: Beijing
optional: Golden Mask Dynasty Show - acrobatic and dance performance with magnificent costumes
days.meals: Breakfast, Dinner (Welcome banquet featuring Peking Duck)
days.description: After breakfast, you'll head out with a guide to see Tiananmen Square and then spend time at the Forbidden City, where Ming and Qing dynasty emperors once lived. That evening, you'll attend a welcome banquet where you'll have the chance to try Peking Duck, one of Beijing's most famous dishes.

days.title: Beijing
included: Visit Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass
days.description: You'll go to Juyong Pass on the Great Wall, the most recognizable section built during the Ming dynasty. On the way, you'll stop at one of Asia's largest jade exhibitions. After that, you'll head to the Summer Palace, which spreads across 716 acres and features lakes, gardens, and the artificial Kunming Lake.

days.title: Beijing
included: Visit traditional Chinese medical clinic with foot massage
optional: Hutong Rickshaw with Homemade Lunch - ride a rickshaw through Beijing's classic Hutong lanes with insight into ancient Chinese living
days.description: Start by visiting the Temple of Heaven, an imperial complex where emperors performed religious ceremonies each year. From there, you'll go to a traditional Chinese medical clinic to learn about ancient healing practices and get a foot massage. In the afternoon, you can either take it easy at your hotel or walk along Wangfujing, Beijing's main shopping street.

days.title: Beijing to Xi'an
optional: Evening Tang Dynasty Music and Dance Show paired with dumpling banquet, celebrating the golden age of the Tang Dynasty
days.description: You'll board a high-speed train to Xi'an for about a 5-hour journey, and you'll pass through scenic countryside along the way. After arriving and settling in, you'll explore the Muslim Quarter, a lively neighborhood known for its street food and cultural blend.

days.title: Xi'an
optional: Evening tour of Datang Everbright City with dinner - a pedestrian mall at the foot of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda featuring light shows and Tang Dynasty-themed experiences
days.description: The day focuses on the Terracotta Warriors, a UNESCO World Heritage site with thousands of life-sized clay soldiers that were made to guard Emperor Qin Shi Huang's tomb. Later, you'll see a terracotta workshop and visit the Small Wild Goose Pagoda.

days.title: Xi'an to Shanghai
optional: Attend ERA: Intersection of Time acrobatic show - a world-class performance blending modern technology with traditional Chinese acrobatics
days.description: You'll head to the train station and take a high-speed train to Shanghai, which takes about 6 hours. Once you arrive at your hotel, you can either rest or take a short walk to check out the surrounding neighborhood.

days.title: Shanghai
optional: Guided tour of Shanghai Museum's bronze collection, highlighting ancient craftsmanship
Night cruise on Huangpu River, marveling at the city's illuminated skyline
days.description: You'll see several of Shanghai's most important sites today: the Bund, a historic waterfront with colonial-era buildings; Nanjing Road, a busy shopping district; and Xintiandi, where you'll find Shikumen stone-gate houses that show Shanghai's distinct architectural character.

days.title: Shanghai
days.description: Your last day in Shanghai gives you time to relax before your departure. Later, your driver will pick you up and take you to the airport for your flight home, ending your China trip.

days.title: Paris
optional: Paris By Night panoramic tour (3 hours) - 40 EUR
Moulin Rouge Show at 23:00 (2 hours) - 160 EUR
Moulin Rouge Show at 21:00 (2 hours) - 190 EUR
days.description: You'll be transferred to your hotel when you arrive in Paris. After checking in and settling down, you have the afternoon free to relax or wander around. Later, stop by the hotel reception to pick up information about your tour.

days.title: Paris
included: Panoramic city tour of Paris with local guide
days.description: Head out in the morning to see the Palace of Versailles and walk through its gardens (you'll need to arrange admission separately). Get back to Paris and then explore Montmartre, the neighborhood known for its artist community and cabaret culture. A local guide takes you on a panoramic tour showing off Paris's grand boulevards and major landmarks before heading back to the hotel.

days.title: Paris to Rouen
included: Eiffel Tower visit with access to second floor (tickets included)
days.description: Start with a visit to the Eiffel Tower and go up to the second floor. Later, take a relaxing boat cruise on the Seine. The afternoon is yours to spend however you like in Paris. Around 4:00 p.m., you'll depart for Normandy and arrive in Rouen with time to walk around the historic center and see its medieval architecture and Gothic cathedral.

days.title: Rouen to London
days.description: Walk through Rouen's center in the morning, then travel north toward the English Channel. Take the ferry across to Canterbury, England's religious heart with its charming old town. From there, continue to London and spend free time near Tower Bridge, one of the city's most recognizable landmarks, before going to your hotel.

days.title: London
included: Panoramic city tour of London with local guide
Evening stroll through Leicester Square, Chinatown, and Soho
optional: Thames Valley and Windsor Town (6 hours) - 35 EUR
days.description: A local guide takes you on a panoramic tour through London, showing you Parliament, the River Thames, and Buckingham Palace where you might catch the Changing of the Guard depending on the day. By evening, meet up in Piccadilly and walk through Leicester Square, Chinatown, and Soho, areas full of theaters and restaurants where you can grab dinner.

days.title: London to Durham
included: Tour of York cathedral, Roman walls, and shopping streets
days.description: Leave London heading north to Cambridge first, where you'll look at the colleges. After lunch, move on to York to see its cathedral, Roman walls, and busy shopping area with time to explore on your own. Then continue to Durham, a medieval town with a cathedral sitting in front of a castle.

days.title: Durham to Edinburgh
included: Stop in Alnwick with view of gardens and castle
Panoramic tour of Edinburgh with local guide
days.description: Travel to Scotland with a stop in Alnwick, known for its gardens and medieval castle where Harry Potter was filmed. Drive on to Edinburgh, arriving around midday. Scotland's capital and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Edinburgh has a castle overlooking steep streets and parks. A local guide will take you on a panoramic tour of the city.

days.title: Edinburgh to Glasgow
days.description: Head into the Scottish Highlands starting with coffee and a walk in Pitlochry. Pass through Inverness near Loch Ness and stop at Urquhart Castle. Take a boat ride on Loch Ness's water, then pass Fort Augustus and Fort William at the base of Ben Nevis, the UK's highest peak. Travel through high plateaus and along Loch Lomond before arriving in Glasgow.

days.title: Glasgow to Dublin
days.description: Leave Glasgow heading south to Cairnryan where you'll board a ferry. Cross to Northern Ireland and arrive in Belfast, the capital working through its historical past. Then travel into the Republic of Ireland, ending the day in Dublin by evening.

days.title: Dublin
included: Panoramic tour of Dublin with local guide
Stroll along River Liffey and parks
optional: Saint Patrick's Cathedral and Dublin on Foot (2 hours 30 minutes) - 35 EUR
days.description: Start with a panoramic tour of Dublin, Ireland's capital. Walk along the River Liffey, check out parks, the historic university, and downtown streets. You'll see Trinity College from the outside. The afternoon is free for exploring on your own.

days.title: Dublin to Liverpool
days.description: Take an early ferry for a three to three-and-a-half hour journey to Wales. Your first stop is Caernarfon, a seaside World Heritage Site dominated by its castle. You'll have time for lunch and a walk. Later, head to Liverpool, a World Heritage Site with the UK's second-largest port, and take a short bus tour.

days.title: Liverpool to London
days.description: Explore central England starting in Stratford-upon-Avon, Shakespeare's hometown, where you have free time for lunch and walking around. Then travel to Oxford, a town full of educational history that's shaped many leaders and thinkers. Continue to London, arriving in the evening.

intro: Embark on the Portugal Explorer tour for an intimate journey across the diverse heart of this captivating country. Your adventure begins with a storybook start in Sintra, exploring the whimsical Pena Palace, before easing into Portuguese life in the seaside charm of Cascais. From there, you'll travel north, stopping to taste ginjinha within the medieval walls of Óbidos and gliding by moliceiro boat through the canals of Aveiro. Settle in the vibrant city of Porto to discover its historic core and savor the region's famous fortified wine at a traditional Port cellar. The journey continues into the timeless beauty of the Douro Valley, where you'll cruise past terraced vineyards and enjoy peaceful wine tastings at a local estate. Heading south, you'll immerse yourself in academic tradition in Coimbra, witnessing a heartfelt fado performance, and delve into Templar history at the stunning Convent of Christ in Tomar. The tour culminates in the Alentejo region, exploring the Roman ruins and eerie Chapel of Bones in Évora, before enjoying a final sensory feast at an authentic olive oil estate and concluding your unforgettable week back in Lisbon.

days.title: Lisbon to Sintra to Cascais
included: Free time to explore Sintra's streets and shops
days.start_point: Lisboa, Lisbon, Portugal (Hotel Real Palacio, Rua Tomás Ribeiro 115, 1050-228 Lisboa, Portugal., 08:00)
days.description: You'll get picked up in Lisbon and head to Sintra, where Pena Palace sits high above the pine forests with its bright colors visible from quite a distance. There's free time to walk around Sintra's streets, check out local shops, or sit at a café for a bit. After grabbing lunch, you'll continue on to Cascais by the coast where you can take an evening walk along the water and see the town as it winds down for the day.

days.title: Óbidos - Aveiro - Porto
included: Traditional moliceiro boat ride in Aveiro canals
optional: Sample ovos moles (local pastry) in Aveiro
days.description: This morning you're leaving the coast to get to Óbidos, a medieval town where you'll walk through the old stone streets and try ginjinha, the local cherry liqueur that the town's known for. From there, you'll head to Aveiro, which people sometimes call the Venice of Portugal because of its canals. You'll take a traditional moliceiro boat through the waterways while having some local pastries, then arrive in Porto by evening where there's plenty going on in this lively city.

days.title: Porto
included: Guided walk across Dom Luís I Bridge
days.description: A guided walk takes you across the Dom Luís I Bridge and past the cathedral and São Bento Station with its beautiful tiles. From there, you'll walk through lively markets and grand squares, stopping for treats like pastel de nata, checking out Rua das Flores and the colorful Ribeira riverside area. The afternoon is yours to do as you like before heading to historic wine cellars in the evening.

days.title: Porto to Douro Valley
included: Wine tour and tasting at estate
days.description: You'll leave Porto and follow the river into the Douro Valley, where terraced vineyards cascade down the hillsides. After a gentle cruise along the water to see the valley, you'll visit a local estate for a wine tour and tasting. By evening, you'll settle into your accommodation as the light spreads across the valley.

days.title: Douro Valley to Coimbra to Tomar
included: Experience fado music performance in Coimbra
days.description: Heading south from the Douro Valley, you'll reach Coimbra, a city full of tradition. On a guided walk through the old town, you'll see the university, the baroque Joanina Library, and São Miguel chapel. After lunch, you'll experience fado music in its original home, then travel to Tomar for the evening.

days.title: Tomar to Évora
included: Visit Convent of Christ in Tomar
Visit Chapel of Bones in Évora
optional: Wander Évora's lantern-lit streets at leisure
days.description: You'll explore the Convent of Christ in Tomar, a historical and architectural masterpiece with quiet, grand cloisters. Then you'll travel to Évora, where a guided walk introduces you to Roman ruins, the old town streets, and the Chapel of Bones. Later, you'll have time to wander the warm, lantern-lit streets on your own.

days.title: Évora to Lisbon
included: Taste freshly pressed olive oils and regional delicacies
days.description: On your final day, you'll visit a local olive oil estate in the Alentejo to taste the regional flavors. You'll stroll through the silvery-green groves and try freshly pressed olive oils alongside regional foods. After that, you'll head back to Lisbon, reflecting on your week of travel through Portugal's culture and history.
